```py
            return Result(reason="callee has no single ordinary return")
        body, expanded = [], 1
        for node in instructions[:-1]:
            entry = self.statement(node)
            body.append(entry if isinstance(entry, Nested) else node)
            expanded += entry.summary.expanded_instructions + 1 if isinstance(entry, Nested) else 1
            if expanded > self.limits.instructions:
                return Result(reason="expanded callee instruction limit")
        end = instructions[-1]
        if end.attributes:
            return Result(reason="return has unmodeled attributes")
        stack_return = end.dest.operation == Op.LLIL_POP and end.dest.size == self.arch.address_size
        link_return = (self.arch.link_reg is not None and end.dest.operation == Op.LLIL_REG
                       and str(end.dest.src) == self.arch.link_reg
                       and check(self.expr(end.dest), Var(self.arch.link_reg, self.arch.address_size * 8),
                                 deadline=self.deadline, z3_timeout_ms=self.limits.proof_ms).verdict is Verdict.PROVEN)
        if not (stack_return or link_return):
            return Result(reason="unproved return target")
        stack = self.state.values[self.arch.stack_pointer]
        if check(stack, Var(self.arch.stack_pointer, self.arch.address_size * 8), deadline=self.deadline,
                 z3_timeout_ms=self.limits.proof_ms).verdict is not Verdict.PROVEN:
            return Result(reason="unbalanced frame")
        if any(name != self.arch.stack_pointer and any(v.name == self.arch.stack_pointer for v in variables(value))
               for name, value in self.state.outputs().items()):
            return Result(reason="callee returns a frame-derived address")
        return Result(Summary(self.func, il, self.state.outputs(), frozenset(self.state.live_in),
                              self.frame.outputs(), frozenset(self.frame.inputs), frozenset(self.flags), stack_return,
                              tuple(body), expanded))


class Factory:
    """Snapshots and summaries are retained only for one immutable caller analysis pass."""
    def __init__(self, limits, deadline):
        self.limits, self.deadline = limits, deadline
        self.cache, self.active = {}, set()

    def get(self, func, depth=0):
        if depth >= self.limits.depth:
            return Result(reason="callee summary depth limit")
        if func.start in self.active:
            return Result(reason="recursive callee")
        key = (func.start, depth)
        if key not in self.cache:
            self.active.add(func.start)
            try:
                self.cache[key] = Lifter(func, self.limits, self.deadline, self, depth).summary()
            except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
                self.cache[key] = Result(reason=str(exc))
            finally:
                self.active.remove(func.start)
        return self.cache[key]


def summarize(func, limits=Limits(), deadline=Deadline.never()):
    return Factory(limits, deadline).get(func)

```

`binja_d810/binja/callees/native.py`:

```py
"""Optional native inlining for universally register-only summaries, recorded for undo.

Caller-specific frame proofs keep direct substitution: a global callee flag would also affect
callers whose frame uses have not been proved. Existing user/analysis flags always win.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from binaryninja import InlineDuringAnalysis, InlineDuringAnalysisWithConfidence, Settings

from ...deadline import Deadline
from ...flow.record import Change
from .. import settings
from ..flow import apply
from .lift import summarize


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Site:
    function: int
    address: int
    callee: int
    limits: object
    kind: str = "callee_inline"

    @property
    def key(self):
        return self.kind, self.function, self.callee


def _flag(func):
    flag = func.inline_during_analysis
    return [int(flag.value), flag.confidence]


def observe(func, enabled):
    state = apply.state_of(func.view)
    changed = False
    with state.lock:
        for change in state.record.claimed_by(func.start):
            if change.kind != "callee_inline":
                continue
            valid = enabled and all(func.view.read(a, len(raw)) == bytes(raw)
                                    for a, raw in change.detail["code"])
            if not valid:
                change.claims.discard(func.start)
                state.decided.pop(func.start, None)
                changed = True
        state.recount()
    if changed:
        apply._arm(func.view, state)


def request(func, sites, limits):
    for site in sites.values():
        summary = site.summary
        if summary.frame_outputs or summary.frame_inputs:
            continue
        apply.enqueue(func.view, Site(func.start, site.summary.function.start, summary.function.start, limits))


def decide(work, site):
    func = work.view.get_function_at(site.callee)
    caller = work.view.get_function_at(site.function)
    prefs = Settings()
    if func is None or caller is None or not prefs.get_bool(settings.CALLEES, caller) \
            or not prefs.get_bool(settings.CALLEE_NATIVE, caller):
        return
    existing = work.record.get("callee_inline", func.start)
    if existing is not None:
        work.add(Change("callee_inline", func.start, claims={site.function}))
        return
    result = summarize(func, site.limits, Deadline.after(site.limits.proof_ms / 1000))
    if result.summary is None or result.summary.frame_outputs or result.summary.frame_inputs:
        work.note(site.function, f"callee {func.start:#x}: native inline left unchanged; summary no longer register-only")
        return
    previous = _flag(func)
    if previous != [0, 0]:
        work.note(site.function, f"callee {func.start:#x}: native inline flag belongs to the user or other analysis")
        return
    code = []
    for node in result.summary.lifted.instructions:
        raw = work.view.read(node.address, func.arch.max_instr_length)
        info = func.arch.get_instruction_info(raw, node.address)
        if info is None or info.length <= 0:
            return
        pair = [node.address, list(raw[:info.length])]
        if pair not in code:
            code.append(pair)
    callers = sorted({f.start for f in func.callers} | {site.function})
    wanted = InlineDuringAnalysisWithConfidence(InlineDuringAnalysis.InlinePreservingTargetInstructionAddresses)
    undo = work.view.begin_undo_actions()
    try:
        func.set_user_inline_during_analysis(wanted)
    finally:
        work.view.commit_undo_actions(undo)
    work.add(Change("callee_inline", func.start,
                    {"callers": callers, "code": code, "previous_flag": previous,
                     "applied_flag": [int(wanted.value), wanted.confidence]},
                    claims={site.function}))
    work.touched |= {func.start, *callers}
    work.note(site.function, f"callee {func.start:#x}: native inline enabled after body-derived summary")

```

`binja_d810/binja/callees/rewrite.py`:

```py
"""Call-site substitution using exact IL copies, retaining flag and call-frame effects.

The scalar summary certifies the body; copying its operations preserves implicit flag writes
as well as every declared and undeclared register result. No calling convention is consulted.
The architecture's call/return mechanics are a separate, deliberately small boundary.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from binaryninja import (
    ILInstructionAttribute as Attr, ILSourceLocation, LowLevelILFunction, LowLevelILInstruction,
    LowLevelILOperation as Op,
)

from ...deadline import Deadline
from ...summaries.verify import identical
from .lift import Factory, Limits, Nested
from . import frame
from .calls import CALL_MODELS, return_address, target


# These are call-link semantics, not instruction patterns. Other architectures remain unchanged
# until their link-address rules have an independent fixture (e.g. mode bits and delay slots).
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Site:
    index: int
    summary: object
    return_address: int


def plan(il, func, limits: Limits, deadline):
    sites, notes = {}, []
    if len(il) > limits.caller_instructions:
        return sites, ["caller instruction limit"]
    factory = Factory(limits, deadline)
    considered = 0
    mode = CALL_MODELS.get(func.arch.name)
    if mode is None:
        return sites, ["unsupported call-link semantics"]
    for instruction in il.instructions:
        if deadline.expired():
            notes.append("time budget exhausted")
            break
        if instruction.operation != Op.LLIL_CALL:
            continue
        considered += 1
        if considered > limits.sites:
            notes.append("callee call-site limit")
            break
        try:
            callee = target(func, instruction)
            ret = return_address(func, instruction)
        except ValueError as exc:
            notes.append(f"{instruction.address:#x}: {exc}")
            continue
        result = factory.get(callee)
        if result.summary is None:
            notes.append(f"{instruction.address:#x}: {result.reason}")
            continue
        summary = result.summary
        if summary.stack_return != (mode == "stack"):
            notes.append(f"{instruction.address:#x}: return does not match call-link semantics")
            continue
        sites[instruction.instr_index] = Site(instruction.instr_index, summary, ret)
    needing = {i for i, site in sites.items() if site.summary.frame_outputs}
    if needing:
        accepted, why = frame.prove(il, func, {i: s.summary for i, s in sites.items()},
                                    {i: s.return_address for i, s in sites.items()}, limits, deadline)
        for i in needing - accepted:
            notes.append(f"{il[i].address:#x}: {why}")
            del sites[i]
    return sites, notes


def _copy(node, new):
    # The SDK's copy_to does not copy optional attributes, including volatile/atomic metadata.
    out = node.copy_to(new, lambda child: _copy(child, new))
    new.set_expr_attributes(out, node.attributes)
    return out


def rewrite(il, sites, limits=Limits(), deadline=Deadline.never()):
    """Only ordinary returns are removed; their pop/read effects remain, as in native inlining."""
    if len(il) > limits.caller_instructions:
        raise ValueError("caller instruction limit")
    new = LowLevelILFunction(il.arch, source_func=il.source_function)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(il)
    for block in il.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for instr in block:
            if deadline.expired():
                raise ValueError("time budget exhausted before substitution completed")
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            site = sites.get(instr.instr_index)
            if site is None:
                new.append(_copy(instr, new))
                continue
            _emit_call(new, instr, site.summary, site.return_address, limits, deadline)
    new.finalize()
    return new


def _emit_call(new, instr, summary, ret, limits, deadline):
    loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
    address = new.const_pointer(new.arch.address_size, ret, loc)
    if summary.stack_return:
        link = new.push(new.arch.address_size, address, loc=loc)
    else:
        link = new.set_reg(new.arch.address_size, new.arch.link_reg, address, loc=loc)
    # Matches native inlining: a used return-address value stays; only a dead link may go.
    new.set_expr_attributes(link, {Attr.ILAllowDeadStoreElimination})
    new.append(link)
    for inner in summary.body:
        if isinstance(inner, Nested):
            _emit_call(new, inner.node, inner.summary, inner.return_address, limits, deadline)
            continue
        copied = _copy(inner, new)
        if not identical(inner, LowLevelILInstruction.create(new, copied), limits.nodes, deadline):
            raise ValueError("callee copy failed exact structural proof")
        new.append(copied)
    operand = list(summary.lifted.instructions)[-1].dest
    copied = _copy(operand, new)
    if not identical(operand, LowLevelILInstruction.create(new, copied), limits.nodes, deadline):
        raise ValueError("return copy failed exact structural proof")
    new.append(copied)

```

`binja_d810/binja/commands.py`:

```py
"""The Plugins > D810 menu. Analysis stays asynchronous so the UI remains usable."""

import threading

from binaryninja import BackgroundTaskThread, PluginCommand, Settings

from . import completion, log, settings, workflow

_REGISTERED = False
_LOCK = threading.Lock()
_TASKS = {}


def function_enabled(view, func, enabled):
    with completion.batch(view):
        prefs = Settings()
        if enabled:
            prefs.set_bool(settings.ENABLED, True, func)
        prefs.set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, enabled, func)
        log.logger.log_info(f"D810: {'enabling' if enabled else 'disabling'} {func.name}.")
        func.reanalyze()
        view.update_analysis()


class BinaryAction(BackgroundTaskThread):
    def __init__(self, view, enabled):
        super().__init__(f"D810: {'enabling' if enabled else 'disabling'} analysis")
        self.view, self.enabled = view, enabled

    def run(self):
        try:
            with completion.batch(self.view):
                prefs = Settings()
                if self.enabled:
                    prefs.set_bool(settings.ENABLED, True, self.view)
                prefs.set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, self.enabled, self.view)
                for func in self.view.functions:
                    if self.enabled:
                        prefs.set_bool(settings.ENABLED, True, func)
                    prefs.set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, self.enabled, func)
                    func.reanalyze()
                self.view.update_analysis()
        except Exception as exc:
            log.logger.log_error(f"D810 menu action failed: {exc!r}")
        finally:
            with _LOCK:
                _TASKS.pop(self.view.file.session_id, None)


def binary_enabled(view, enabled):
    with _LOCK:
        key = view.file.session_id
        if key in _TASKS:
            return
        task = BinaryAction(view, enabled)
        _TASKS[key] = task
    task.start()
    return task


def show_report(view, func):
    text = workflow.debug_report_text(func) or "No D810 report yet. Enable D810 for this function to run analysis."
    view.show_plain_text_report(f"D810: {func.name}", text)


def _available(view, func=None):
    with _LOCK:
        return view.file.session_id not in _TASKS


def register():
    global _REGISTERED
    if _REGISTERED:
        return
    _REGISTERED = True
    for enabled, word in ((True, "Enable"), (False, "Disable")):
        PluginCommand.register_for_function(
            f"D810\\{word} for Current Function", f"{word} D810 and reanalyze the current function.",
            lambda view, func, enabled=enabled: function_enabled(view, func, enabled), _available)
        PluginCommand.register(
            f"D810\\{word} for This Binary", f"{word} D810 and reanalyze this binary's functions.",
            lambda view, enabled=enabled: binary_enabled(view, enabled), _available)
    PluginCommand.register_for_function("D810\\Show Function Report", "Show the latest D810 analysis report.", show_report)

```

`binja_d810/binja/completion.py`:

```py
"""One console completion message after native analysis and D810's queued work settle."""

import os
import threading
from contextlib import contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass

from binaryninja import AnalysisState

from . import log


@dataclass
class Pending:
    generation: int = 0
    held: int = 0
    armed: bool = False
    event: object = None
    failed: bool = False


_LOCK = threading.RLock()
_PENDING = {}


def _key(view):
    return getattr(getattr(view, "file", None), "session_id", None)


def touch(view):
    key = _key(view)
    if key is None:
        return
    with _LOCK:
        state = _PENDING.setdefault(key, Pending())
        state.generation += 1
    _arm(view, state)


@contextmanager
def batch(view):
    """A menu action can schedule several functions before announcing completion."""
    key = _key(view)
    with _LOCK:
        state = _PENDING.setdefault(key, Pending())
        state.held += 1
        state.generation += 1
    try:
        yield
    except Exception:
        failed(view)
        raise
    finally:
        with _LOCK:
            state.held -= 1
        _arm(view, state)


def failed(view):
    key = _key(view)
    if key is not None:
        with _LOCK:
            state = _PENDING.setdefault(key, Pending())
            state.failed = True
            state.generation += 1


def _arm(view, state):
    with _LOCK:
        if _PENDING.get(_key(view)) is not state or state.held or state.armed:
            return
        state.armed = True
    try:
        event = view.add_analysis_completion_event(lambda: _native_done(view, state))
    except Exception:  # the view may have closed while its analysis was ending
        with _LOCK:
            _PENDING.pop(_key(view), None)
        return
    with _LOCK:
        if state.armed:  # an already-idle view may have called us synchronously
            state.event = event


def _native_done(view, state):
    with _LOCK:
        if _PENDING.get(_key(view)) is not state:
            return
        state.armed = False
        state.event = None
    done(view)


def done(view):
    """Also called by the flow worker after its final batch, including deferred undo."""
    from .flow import apply

    key = _key(view)
    with _LOCK:
        state = _PENDING.get(key)
        if state is None or state.held:
            return
        generation = state.generation
    if apply.busy(view):
        return  # the flow worker will call done after draining its queue
    try:
        idle = view.analysis_info.state == AnalysisState.IdleState
    except Exception:  # a closed view has no analysis left to announce
        with _LOCK:
            if _PENDING.get(key) is state:
                _PENDING.pop(key)
        return
    if not idle:
        _arm(view, state)
        return
    with _LOCK:
        if _PENDING.get(key) is not state or state.held or state.generation != generation:
            return
        _PENDING.pop(key)
        state.event = None
    name = os.path.basename(view.file.filename).replace("\n", " ") or "this binary"
    status = "analysis finished with errors" if state.failed else "analysis complete"
    log.logger.log_info(f"D810: {status} for {name}.")

```

`binja_d810/binja/constant_buffers.py`:

```py
"""Exact bounded evaluation of a local-buffer region, retaining its exit and live values."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import time

from binaryninja import (BuiltinType, Endianness, ILInstructionAttribute as Attr, ILSourceLocation,
                         MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, MediumLevelILOperation as M,
                         SSAVariable, VariableSourceType)

from ..consteval.program import Address
from ..consteval.state import Cell, State, binary, unary
from ..consteval.strings import recognize
from ..deadline import Deadline
from .memory import fixed_load_is_safe
from .mlil.lift import _BINARY, _COMPARE, _UNARY
from .scratch import operands, walk


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Limits:
    instructions: int = 4096
    nodes: int = 2000
    steps: int = 10000
    trips: int = 256
    frame_bytes: int = 4096
    work: int = 100000
    starts: int = 64
    exit_instructions: int = 4096
    scalar_bits: int = 128
    string_bytes: int = 256
    string_minimum: int = 4
    store_bytes: int = 8


@dataclass
class Report:
    regions: int = 0
    instructions: int = 0
    steps: int = 0
    strings: list = field(default_factory=list)
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    seconds: float = 0.0
    cpu_seconds: float = 0.0
    exhausted: bool = False
    evidence: tuple = ()


_PROTECTED = {Attr.ILPreventDeadStoreElimination, Attr.ILPreventAliasAnalysis}
_READS = {M.MLIL_VAR, M.MLIL_VAR_FIELD}
_WRITES = {M.MLIL_SET_VAR, M.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD}
_LOADS = {M.MLIL_LOAD, M.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT}
_STORES = {M.MLIL_STORE, M.MLIL_STORE_STRUCT}
_ADDRESSES = {M.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF, M.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD}
_CALLS = {M.MLIL_CALL, M.MLIL_TAILCALL}


class Scope:
    def __init__(self, il, limits, deadline):
        self.il, self.func, self.limits, self.deadline = il, il.source_function, limits, deadline
        self.left = limits.work
        self.vars, self.extents, self.addressed = {}, {}, set()
        self.parameters = {v.identifier for v in self.func.parameter_vars}
        self.aliased = {v.identifier for v in il.ssa_form.aliased_vars}
        self.little = il.arch.endianness == Endianness.LittleEndian
        self.copies = {}
        self.readonly = {}
        self.expression_left = limits.nodes
        self.observed = set()
        self.last_writes = {}
        self.constant_writes = {}
        self.sequence = 0
        for instr in il.instructions:
            for node in walk(instr):
                self.tick()
                if node.operation in _READS | _WRITES | _ADDRESSES:
                    var = node.dest if node.operation in _WRITES else node.src
                    self.vars[var.identifier] = var
                    if self.local(var):
                        size = max(var.type.width if var.type else 0,
                                   0 if node.operation in _ADDRESSES else node.size + getattr(node, "offset", 0))
                        self.extents[var.identifier] = max(size, self.extents.get(var.identifier, 0))
                        if node.operation in _ADDRESSES:
                            self.addressed.add(var.identifier)
                elif node.operation == M.MLIL_FORCE_VER:
                    self.vars[node.dest.identifier] = node.dest
                    self.vars[node.src.identifier] = node.src
            if instr.operation == M.MLIL_CALL and (data := self.builtin(instr)) is not None:
                destination = instr.params[0]
                if destination.operation in _ADDRESSES and self.local(destination.src):
                    key = destination.src.identifier
                    self.extents[key] = max(self.extents.get(key, 0), getattr(destination, "offset", 0) + len(data))
        if not self.addressed:
            raise ValueError("no local buffer addresses")
        if any(not width or self.vars[key].storage + width > 0 for key, width in self.extents.items()):
            raise ValueError("local frame extent is unproved")
        self.base = min(self.vars[key].storage for key in self.extents)
        self.end = max(self.vars[key].storage + width for key, width in self.extents.items())
        if self.end - self.base > limits.frame_bytes:
            raise ValueError("constant frame byte limit")
        self.anchor = next(self.vars[key] for key in self.extents if self.vars[key].storage == self.base)
        self.state = State(self.end - self.base, self.little)

    def tick(self):
        self.left -= 1
        if self.left < 0 or self.deadline.expired():
            raise ValueError("constant-region proof budget exhausted")

    def local(self, var):
        return var.source_type == VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType and var.storage < 0 \
            and var.identifier not in self.parameters

    def protected(self, node):
        if node.attributes & _PROTECTED:
            raise ValueError(f"protected constant-region operation: {node.operation.name} {node.attributes & _PROTECTED}")
        if node.operation in _READS | _WRITES | _ADDRESSES:
            var = node.dest if node.operation in _WRITES else node.src
            if var.type is not None and var.type.volatile:
                raise ValueError("volatile constant-region variable")

    def read_var(self, var, width, offset=0):
        if self.local(var):
            if not self.little and (offset or var.type and width != 8 * var.type.width):
                raise ValueError("partial native stack fields on this endianness are unmodeled")
            cell = self.state.cells.get(var.identifier)
            if cell is not None and isinstance(cell.value, Address):
                return self.state.read(var.identifier, width, offset)
            if width % 8 or offset % 8:
                raise ValueError("non-byte local read")
            physical = self.state.load(var.storage - self.base + offset // 8, width // 8)
            if var.identifier not in self.aliased and var.identifier in self.state.cells:
                logical = self.state.read(var.identifier, width, offset)
                if logical != physical:
                    raise ValueError("logical and physical local values differ")
            return physical
        return self.state.read(var.identifier, width, offset)

    def expression(self, node):
        self.tick()
        self.expression_left -= 1
        if self.expression_left < 0:
            raise ValueError("constant expression node limit")
        self.protected(node)
        op, width = node.operation, node.size * 8 or 1
        if width > self.limits.scalar_bits:
            raise ValueError("constant scalar width limit")
        if op == M.MLIL_CONST_PTR:
            if node.constant == 0: return 0, width
            return Address("image", node.constant, width), width
        if op == M.MLIL_CONST:
            return node.constant & ((1 << width) - 1), width
        if op == M.MLIL_FLOAT_CONST:
            return int(node.raw_operands[0]), width  # raw lane bits; no floating arithmetic is evaluated
        if op in _READS:
            return self.read_var(node.src, width, 8 * getattr(node, "offset", 0)), width
        if op in _ADDRESSES:
            if not self.local(node.src):
                raise ValueError("address is not local storage")
            return Address("frame", node.src.storage - self.base + getattr(node, "offset", 0), self.il.arch.address_size * 8), self.il.arch.address_size * 8
        if op in _BINARY or op in _COMPARE:
            a, aw = self.expression(node.left); b, bw = self.expression(node.right)
            compare = op in _COMPARE
            operand_width = node.size * 8 or max(aw, bw)
            if aw != operand_width or (op not in (M.MLIL_LSL, M.MLIL_LSR, M.MLIL_ASR, M.MLIL_ROL, M.MLIL_ROR) and bw != operand_width):
                # A 1-bit comparison used as an integer has explicit 0/1 semantics in BNIL.
                if aw == 1 and not isinstance(a, Address): aw = operand_width
                if bw == 1 and not isinstance(b, Address): bw = operand_width
                if aw != operand_width or (op not in (M.MLIL_LSL, M.MLIL_LSR, M.MLIL_ASR, M.MLIL_ROL, M.MLIL_ROR) and bw != operand_width):
                    raise ValueError("constant arithmetic operand widths differ")
            return binary(_COMPARE[op] if compare else _BINARY[op], a, b, aw, bw, 1 if compare else width), 1 if compare else width
        if op in _UNARY or op == M.MLIL_BOOL_TO_INT:
            value, inner = self.expression(node.src)
            return unary("zx" if op == M.MLIL_BOOL_TO_INT else _UNARY[op], value, inner, width), width
        if op in _LOADS:
            if node.expr_type is not None and node.expr_type.volatile:
                raise ValueError("volatile constant-region load")
            address, _ = self.expression(node.src)
            offset = getattr(node, "offset", 0)
            if isinstance(address, Address) and address.buffer == "frame":
                return self.state.load(address.offset + offset, node.size), width
            if isinstance(address, Address): address = address.offset
            address += offset
            key = address, node.size
            if key not in self.readonly:
                view = self.func.view
                segment = view.get_segment_at(address)
                if not fixed_load_is_safe(view, address, node.size) or segment.writable \
                        or view.range_contains_relocation(address, node.size):
                    raise ValueError("load is not immutable image data")
                raw = view.read(address, node.size)
                if len(raw) != node.size:
                    raise ValueError("readonly bytes unavailable")
                self.readonly[key] = int.from_bytes(raw, self.state.order)
            return self.readonly[key], width
        raise ValueError(f"unsupported constant expression: {op.name}")

    def builtin(self, instr):
        if instr.expr_index in self.copies:
            return self.copies[instr.expr_index]
        found = None
        if instr.operation == M.MLIL_CALL and not instr.output and len(instr.params) in (2, 3) \
                and instr.params[1].operation == M.MLIL_CONST_DATA:
            data = instr.params[1].constant_data
            if data.size > self.limits.frame_bytes:
                raise ValueError("native constant-data byte limit")
            raw, kind = data.data_and_builtin
            raw = bytes(raw)
            if kind in (BuiltinType.BuiltinMemcpy, BuiltinType.BuiltinStrncpy) and len(instr.params) == 3 \
                    and instr.params[2].operation == M.MLIL_CONST:
                count = instr.params[2].constant
                if 0 < count <= len(raw): found = raw[:count]
            elif kind == BuiltinType.BuiltinStrcpy and len(instr.params) == 2 and b"\0" in raw:
                found = raw[:raw.index(0) + 1]
            if found is not None:
                sources = instr.llils
                if not any(n.operation.name == "LLIL_STORE_SSA" for n in sources) \
                        or any(any(word in n.operation.name for word in ("CALL", "INTRINSIC", "UNIMPL", "TRAP"))
                               or n.attributes & _PROTECTED for n in sources):
                    found = None  # Never interpret a real call, even if its argument is constant data.
        self.copies[instr.expr_index] = found
        return found

    def step(self, instr):
        self.tick(); self.protected(instr)
        self.expression_left = self.limits.nodes
        op = instr.operation
        if op in _WRITES:
            value, width = self.expression(instr.src)
            actual = instr.size * 8 or 1
            if width == 1 and actual > 1 and not isinstance(value, Address): width = actual
            if width != actual:
                raise ValueError("constant assignment width differs")
            var, offset = instr.dest, getattr(instr, "offset", 0)
            if var.source_type == VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType and not self.local(var):
                raise ValueError("write to incoming frame storage")
            if self.local(var):
                if not self.little and (offset or var.type and var.type.width != instr.size):
                    raise ValueError("partial native stack fields on this endianness are unmodeled")
                self.state.span(var.storage - self.base + offset, instr.size)
                if isinstance(value, Address): raise ValueError("pointer bytes are unknown")
            if op == M.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD:
                whole = max((var.type.width if var.type else 0) * 8, offset * 8 + actual)
                self.state.field(var.identifier, value, offset * 8, actual, whole)
            else:
                self.state.assign(var.identifier, value, actual)
            if self.local(var): self.state.store(var.storage - self.base + offset, value, instr.size)
            self.sequence += 1; self.last_writes[var.identifier] = self.sequence
            if not self.local(var):
                self.constant_writes[var.identifier, op, instr.size, offset] = (self.sequence, var, op, instr.size, offset, value)
        elif op in _STORES:
            address, _ = self.expression(instr.dest)
            value, width = self.expression(instr.src)
            if not isinstance(address, Address) or address.buffer != "frame" or width != instr.size * 8:
                raise ValueError("store is not exact local bytes")
            self.state.store(address.offset + getattr(instr, "offset", 0), value, instr.size)
        elif op == M.MLIL_FORCE_VER:
            self.state.cells[instr.dest.identifier] = self.state.cells.get(instr.src.identifier, Cell(0, (instr.dest.type.width if instr.dest.type else 0) * 8, 0))
        elif op == M.MLIL_IF:
            value, width = self.expression(instr.condition)
            if width != 1 or isinstance(value, Address): raise ValueError("unknown branch condition")
            return instr.true if value else instr.false
        elif op == M.MLIL_GOTO:
            return instr.dest
        elif op == M.MLIL_NOP:
            pass
        elif op == M.MLIL_CALL and (data := self.builtin(instr)) is not None:
            address, _ = self.expression(instr.params[0])
            if not isinstance(address, Address) or address.buffer != "frame": raise ValueError("constant copy does not target local storage")
            self.state.span(address.offset, len(data))
            for offset, value in enumerate(data): self.state.store(address.offset + offset, value, 1)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"region boundary: {op.name}")
        return instr.instr_index + 1


def successors(il):
    result = {}
    for block in il.basic_blocks:
        for i in block:
            result[i.instr_index] = (i.instr_index + 1,) if i.instr_index + 1 < block.end else tuple(e.target.start for e in block.outgoing_edges if e.target is not None)
    return result


def reachable(edges, start, tick):
    pending, seen = [start], set()
    while pending:
        tick(); node = pending.pop()
        if node in seen: continue
        seen.add(node); pending.extend(edges.get(node, ()))
    return seen


@dataclass
class Plan:
    scope: object
    start: int
    exit: int
    visited: set
    outputs: list
    steps: int
    writes: list


def attempt(scope, start):
    il, limits = scope.il, scope.limits
    visited, visits, pc, steps = set(), {}, start, 0
    scope.state.written.clear()
    scope.last_writes.clear(); scope.constant_writes.clear(); scope.sequence = 0
    reason = ""
    while pc in range(len(il)):
        if steps >= limits.steps or scope.deadline.expired(): raise ValueError("constant evaluation step budget")
        visits[pc] = visits.get(pc, 0) + 1
        if visits[pc] > limits.trips: raise ValueError("constant evaluation trip limit")
        # A failed statement cannot partly change the candidate's memory state.
        try:
            following = scope.step(il[pc])
        except ValueError as exc:
            reason = str(exc)
            break
        visited.add(pc); steps += 1; pc = following
    if not visited or not scope.state.written or pc not in range(len(il)):
        raise ValueError(reason or "no bounded local region")
    if scope.deadline.expired() or "budget" in reason or "limit" in reason:
        raise ValueError(reason or "constant evaluation deadline")
    edges = successors(il)
    after = reachable(edges, pc, scope.tick)
    if after & visited:
        raise ValueError("retained control flow can reenter the evaluated region")
    # Only SSA values actually defined in the region and used after its exit need registers.
    outputs, seen, storage = [], set(), set()
    for index in sorted(after):
        scope.tick()
        for value in il[index].ssa_form.vars_read:
            if not isinstance(value, SSAVariable) or value in seen: continue
            seen.add(value)
            definition = il.ssa_form.get_ssa_var_definition(value)
            if definition is None or definition.non_ssa_form.instr_index not in visited: continue
            var = value.var
            if var.identifier not in scope.aliased and il[pc].get_ssa_var_version(var) != value.version:
                raise ValueError("region live-out is an older SSA version")
            cell = scope.state.cells.get(var.identifier)
            if cell is None or cell.known != (1 << cell.width) - 1:
                raise ValueError("region live-out has unknown bits")
            identity = var.source_type, var.storage
            if identity in storage:
                raise ValueError("region live-outs overlap storage")
            storage.add(identity)
            if scope.local(var):
                if isinstance(cell.value, Address) or scope.state.load(var.storage - scope.base, cell.width // 8) != cell.value:
                    raise ValueError("live logical stack value differs from physical bytes")
            outputs.append((var, cell.value, cell.width))
    # Retain the last write of each identical register/flag write shape, in execution order.
    # Keeping the original SET_VAR/FIELD widths preserves unknown high bits and private call
    # inputs; FORCE_VER is an analysis rename, not another physical register write.
    writes = sorted(scope.constant_writes.values(), key=lambda row: row[0])
    recorded = {row[1].identifier for row in writes}
    outputs = [row for row in outputs if row[0].identifier not in recorded]
    outputs.sort(key=lambda row: scope.last_writes.get(row[0].identifier, 0))
    return Plan(scope, start, pc, visited, outputs, steps, writes)


def rewrite(plan):
    scope = plan.scope; il = scope.il
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(il.arch, low_level_il=il.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(il)
    resume = MediumLevelILLabel()
    loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(il[plan.start])
    def literal(value, width):
        if width <= 64: return new.const(width // 8, value, loc)
        size = width // 8
        result = new.zero_extend(size, new.const(8, value & ((1 << 64) - 1), loc), loc)
        for shift in range(64, width, 64):
            chunk = new.zero_extend(size, new.const(8, (value >> shift) & ((1 << 64) - 1), loc), loc)
            result = new.or_expr(size, result, new.shift_left(size, chunk, new.const(8, shift, loc), loc), loc)
        return result
    def pointer(value):
        if value.buffer == "image": return new.const_pointer(il.arch.address_size, value.offset, loc)
        anchors = [scope.vars[key] for key in scope.addressed if scope.vars[key].storage - scope.base <= value.offset]
        anchor = max(anchors, key=lambda v: v.storage) if anchors else scope.anchor
        offset = value.offset - (anchor.storage - scope.base)
        base = new.address_of(anchor, loc)
        return base if offset == 0 else new.add(il.arch.address_size, base, new.const(il.arch.address_size, offset, loc), loc)
    for block in il.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for instr in block:
            scope.tick(); new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            if instr.instr_index == plan.exit: new.mark_label(resume)
            if instr.instr_index == plan.start:
                for _, var, op, size, offset, value in plan.writes:
                    expression = pointer(value) if isinstance(value, Address) else literal(value, size * 8 or 1)
                    emitted = new.set_var_field(size, var, offset, expression, loc) if op == M.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD else new.set_var(size, var, expression, loc)
                    new.append(emitted, loc)
                for var, value, width in plan.outputs:
                    expression = pointer(value) if isinstance(value, Address) else literal(value, width)
                    new.append(new.set_var(width // 8, var, expression, loc), loc)
                offsets = sorted(scope.state.written); position = 0
                while position < len(offsets):
                    scope.tick(); begin = offsets[position]; end = position + 1
                    boundaries = {scope.vars[key].storage - scope.base for key in scope.addressed}
                    while end < len(offsets) and offsets[end] == offsets[end - 1] + 1 and offsets[end] not in boundaries and end - position < min(8, scope.limits.store_bytes): end += 1
                    size = end - position
                    value = scope.state.load(begin, size)
                    new.append(new.store(size, pointer(Address("frame", begin, il.arch.address_size * 8)), new.const(size, value, loc), loc), loc)
                    position = end
                new.append(new.goto(resume, loc), loc)
            if instr.instr_index not in plan.visited:
                new.append(instr.copy_to(new), ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr))
    new.finalize(); new.generate_ssa_form()
    return new


def strings(plan):
    scope, found = plan.scope, []
    # This read-only continuation may interpret literal synthetic copies, retaining all
    # protected original instructions. Real calls remain boundaries.
    index, visits = plan.exit, {}
    for _ in range(scope.limits.exit_instructions):
        scope.tick()
        if index not in range(len(scope.il)): break
        visits[index] = visits.get(index, 0) + 1
        if visits[index] > scope.limits.trips: break
        scope.expression_left = scope.limits.nodes
        instr = scope.il[index]
        if instr.operation == M.MLIL_CALL and (raw := scope.builtin(instr)) is not None:
            dest = instr.params[0]
            if dest.operation not in _ADDRESSES or not scope.local(dest.src) or dest.src.type and dest.src.type.volatile: break
            at = dest.src.storage - scope.base + getattr(dest, "offset", 0)
            scope.state.span(at, len(raw))
            for offset, byte in enumerate(raw): scope.state.store(at + offset, byte, 1)
            index += 1
            continue
        if instr.operation in _CALLS:
            for position, parameter in enumerate(instr.params):
                try: address, _ = scope.expression(parameter)
                except ValueError: continue
                if not isinstance(address, Address) or address.buffer != "frame": continue
                options = dict(maximum=scope.limits.string_bytes, minimum=scope.limits.string_minimum)
                text = recognize(scope.state.memory, address.offset, **options)
                if text is None and position + 1 < len(instr.params):
                    # An adjacent integer may be a length. This is a display heuristic only:
                    # no assumption about the callee or this relationship enters the proof.
                    try: length, _ = scope.expression(instr.params[position + 1])
                    except ValueError: length = None
                    if type(length) is int:
                        text = recognize(scope.state.memory, address.offset, length=length, **options)
                if text is not None: found.append((instr.address, text))
            break
        if instr.operation in _WRITES:
            try:
                value, width = scope.expression(instr.src)
                if scope.local(instr.dest) and isinstance(value, Address):
                    at = instr.dest.storage - scope.base + getattr(instr, "offset", 0)
                    scope.state.span(at, instr.size)
                    scope.state.memory[at:at + instr.size] = [None] * instr.size
                    scope.state.assign(instr.dest.identifier, value, width)
                    index += 1
                else: index = scope.step(instr)
            except ValueError: break
        else:
            try: index = scope.step(instr)
            except ValueError: break
    return found


def run(il, limits=Limits(), deadline=Deadline.never()):
    started, cpu = time.monotonic(), time.thread_time(); report = Report()
    try:
        if len(il) > limits.instructions: raise ValueError("constant instruction limit")
        first = next(iter(il.basic_blocks), None)
        if first is None or first.start != 0: return il, report
        scope = Scope(il, limits, deadline)
        prefix = State(len(scope.state.memory), scope.little)
        for start in range(min(first.end, limits.starts)):
            scope.tick()
            scope.state = State(len(prefix.memory), scope.little)
            scope.state.memory = list(prefix.memory); scope.state.cells = dict(prefix.cells)
            try:
                plan = attempt(scope, start)
                new = rewrite(plan)
                try: report.strings = strings(plan)
                except ValueError as exc: report.notes.append(f"annotation unavailable: {exc}")
                if report.strings:
                    code = [(block.start, block.end - block.start) for block in il.source_function.basic_blocks]
                    if sum(size for _, size in code) <= limits.instructions * il.arch.max_instr_length:
                        footprint = []
                        for address, size in code:
                            scope.tick()
                            raw = il.source_function.view.read(address, size)
                            if len(raw) != size: raise ValueError("comment code bytes unavailable")
                            footprint.append((address, tuple(raw)))
                        footprint += [(address, tuple(value.to_bytes(size, scope.state.order))) for (address, size), value in scope.readonly.items()]
                        report.evidence = tuple(footprint)
                    else:
                        report.notes.append("comment code-footprint limit")
                        report.strings = []
                report.regions = 1; report.instructions = len(plan.visited); report.steps = plan.steps
                report.notes.append(f"{il[start].address:#x}: evaluated {plan.steps} steps; replaced {len(plan.visited)} instructions with exact final local bytes")
                return new, report
            except (ValueError, NotImplementedError, RecursionError) as exc:
                report.strings = []; report.evidence = ()
                reason = str(exc) or "constant expression depth unsupported"
                if reason not in report.notes: report.notes.append(reason)
            # Retain an unknown pure prologue assignment; its result stays unknown.
            scope.state = prefix
            try: scope.step(il[start])
            except ValueError:
                instr = il[start]
                if instr.operation == M.MLIL_CALL and (data := scope.builtin(instr)) is not None:
                    dest = instr.params[0]
                    if dest.operation in _ADDRESSES and scope.local(dest.src) and not (dest.src.type and dest.src.type.volatile):
                        at = dest.src.storage - scope.base + getattr(dest, "offset", 0)
                        prefix.span(at, len(data))
                        for offset, byte in enumerate(data): prefix.store(at + offset, byte, 1)
                        continue  # Analyze the literal effect, while retaining the protected original.
                if instr.operation not in _WRITES: break
                prefix.cells.pop(instr.dest.identifier, None)
                if scope.local(instr.dest):
                    at = instr.dest.storage - scope.base + getattr(instr, "offset", 0)
                    prefix.span(at, instr.size); prefix.memory[at:at + instr.size] = [None] * instr.size
        return il, report
    except (ValueError, NotImplementedError, RecursionError) as exc:
        report.notes.append(str(exc) or "constant expression depth unsupported")
        return il, report
    finally:
        report.seconds, report.cpu_seconds = time.monotonic() - started, time.thread_time() - cpu
        report.exhausted = deadline.expired()

```

`binja_d810/binja/deadcode.py`:

```py
"""Liveness policy shared by both IL levels.

An adapter describes its function as pure definitions (key -> the keys its value reads) plus the
keys read by everything else (effects, returns, branches, impure definitions). A pure definition
is dead if no live use reaches it, even through other pure definitions. The engine removes only
the definitions its own rewrites made dead: dead_after - dead_before.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable, Hashable, Iterable, Mapping, Optional


def dead_definitions(pure: Mapping[Hashable, Iterable[Hashable]], roots: Iterable[Hashable]) -> set[Hashable]:
    live: set = set()
    work = list(roots)
    while work:
        key = work.pop()
        if key in live:
            continue
        live.add(key)
        work.extend(pure.get(key, ()))
    return {key for key in pure if key not in live}


def dead_with_checks(pure: Mapping[Hashable, Iterable[Hashable]], roots: Iterable[Hashable],
                     checks: Mapping[Hashable, Callable[[], bool]]) -> set[Hashable]:
    """dead_definitions where some definitions are pure only if a check passes (a division that cannot
    trap, v3.5). A check runs only for a definition that would be removed: a live one keeps what it reads
    alive whether or not it is pure. One that fails is not removable and keeps its reads alive."""
    pure, roots, pending = dict(pure), list(roots), dict(checks)
    while True:
        dead = dead_definitions(pure, roots)
        failed = [key for key in dead if key in pending and not pending.pop(key)()]
        if not failed:
            return dead
        for key in failed:
            roots.extend(pure.pop(key))


def dying_with_root(uses: Mapping[Hashable, Iterable[int]], defined_at: Mapping[Hashable, int],
                    root_statement: int) -> set[Hashable]:
    """The inlined definitions a rewrite of the root would leave dead: every use is in the root's
    statement or in another such definition. Used to measure the code a rewrite really replaces."""
    dying: set = set()
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        allowed = {root_statement} | {defined_at[d] for d in dying}
        for key, statements in uses.items():
            statements = list(statements)
            if key not in dying and statements and all(s in allowed for s in statements):
                dying.add(key)
                changed = True
    return dying


def shown_in(dying: Iterable[Hashable], uses: Mapping[Hashable, Iterable[int]], defined_at: Mapping[Hashable, int],
             root_statement: int) -> dict[Hashable, Optional[Hashable]]:
    """The statement HLIL shows each dying definition in: one used once is folded into the
    statement that uses it (repeatedly), one used several times is a statement of its own (named
    by itself); None is the root's statement. MLIL is three-address code, so its statements say
    little about what the user reads."""
    dying = set(dying)
    at = {defined_at[key]: key for key in dying}
    shown: dict = {}
    for key in dying:
        current, seen = key, set()
        while current not in seen and len(list(uses[current])) == 1:
            seen.add(current)
            user = list(uses[current])[0]
            if user == root_statement:
                current = None
                break
            if user not in at:
                break
            current = at[user]
        shown[key] = current
    return shown

```

`binja_d810/binja/effects.py`:

```py
"""Effect policy for candidate roots. No binaryninja import: tables use names.

An unsupported operation inside a candidate root may stay as an opaque leaf only if it is pure and
safe to evaluate again, or not at all: algebra can delete or duplicate a leaf (0 & [p] -> 0). A
supported expression containing anything else is not a candidate; its effect-free supported
sub-expressions are, so loads, calls and their order and count are never touched. A value that an
earlier instruction already materialized from a load or call is an ordinary SSA leaf.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable, Optional

# Pure functions of their operands, which never trap (division may: it is pure only once proven never
# to trap, which the lifter decides, spec v3.2). Anything
# not listed, including operations added to Binary Ninja later, is treated as an effect.
MLIL_PURE = frozenset({
    "MLIL_VAR_SSA", "MLIL_VAR_SSA_FIELD", "MLIL_VAR_SPLIT_SSA", "MLIL_VAR", "MLIL_VAR_FIELD", "MLIL_VAR_SPLIT",
    "MLIL_CONST", "MLIL_CONST_PTR", "MLIL_EXTERN_PTR", "MLIL_IMPORT", "MLIL_CONST_DATA", "MLIL_FLOAT_CONST",
    "MLIL_ADDRESS_OF", "MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD",
    "MLIL_ADD", "MLIL_SUB", "MLIL_MUL", "MLIL_AND", "MLIL_OR", "MLIL_XOR", "MLIL_LSL", "MLIL_LSR", "MLIL_ASR",
    "MLIL_NEG", "MLIL_NOT", "MLIL_SX", "MLIL_ZX", "MLIL_LOW_PART", "MLIL_ROL", "MLIL_ROR", "MLIL_RLC", "MLIL_RRC",
    "MLIL_ADC", "MLIL_SBB", "MLIL_MULU_DP", "MLIL_MULS_DP", "MLIL_ADD_OVERFLOW",
    "MLIL_CMP_E", "MLIL_CMP_NE", "MLIL_CMP_SLT", "MLIL_CMP_ULT", "MLIL_CMP_SLE", "MLIL_CMP_ULE",
    "MLIL_CMP_SGE", "MLIL_CMP_UGE", "MLIL_CMP_SGT", "MLIL_CMP_UGT", "MLIL_TEST_BIT", "MLIL_BOOL_TO_INT",
    "MLIL_BSWAP", "MLIL_POPCNT", "MLIL_CLZ", "MLIL_CTZ", "MLIL_RBIT", "MLIL_CLS",
    "MLIL_MINS", "MLIL_MAXS", "MLIL_MINU", "MLIL_MAXU", "MLIL_ABS",
})


def _nodes(tree):
    stack = [tree]
    while stack:
        item = stack.pop()
        if isinstance(item, list):
            stack.extend(item)
        elif hasattr(item, "operation") and hasattr(item, "operands"):
            yield item
            stack.extend(item.operands)


def mlil_effect(tree, pure: Optional[Callable] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """None if every operation in the (SSA-form) tree is pure, else "effect: <operation>". `pure(node)`
    may accept a node outside the table: a division proven never to trap."""
    for node in _nodes(tree):
        name = node.operation.name
        if name not in MLIL_PURE and (pure is None or not pure(node)):
            return f"effect: {name}"
    return None


# HLIL: a candidate's leaves are variables, constants and field reads of variables; supported
# operations combine them. Everything else bounds a candidate. These are the operations that may
# stay *inside* an HLIL expression the pass leaves alone without making it unsafe to rewrite the
# pure parts around them; any other operation found under a supported node splits it.
HLIL_LEAVES = frozenset({"HLIL_VAR", "HLIL_VAR_SSA", "HLIL_CONST", "HLIL_CONST_PTR", "HLIL_STRUCT_FIELD"})


def hlil_effect(tree, aliased: frozenset = frozenset(), allowed: frozenset = frozenset(),
                pure: Optional[Callable] = None) -> Optional[str]:
    """None if the tree only reads variables (not address-taken ones), fields of them and
    constants through supported operations (and the operation names in `allowed`); else the reason
    it is not a candidate. `pure(node)` may accept a division proven never to trap, with
    its double-width dividend (0:x)."""
    dividends: set = set()
    for node in _nodes(tree):
        name = node.operation.name
        if name in HLIL_DIVISIONS and pure is not None and pure(node):
            if name.endswith("_DP"):
                dividends.add(node.left.expr_index)
            continue
        if name == "HLIL_SPLIT" and node.expr_index in dividends:
            continue
        if name in ("HLIL_VAR", "HLIL_VAR_SSA"):
            var = getattr(node.var, "var", node.var)
            if var in aliased:
                return "effect: aliased read"
            continue
        if name == "HLIL_STRUCT_FIELD":
            if node.src.operation.name not in ("HLIL_VAR", "HLIL_VAR_SSA"):
                return "effect: HLIL_STRUCT_FIELD of a non-variable"
            continue
        if name in HLIL_LEAVES or name in _HLIL_SUPPORTED or name in allowed:
            continue
        return f"effect: {name}" if name not in _HLIL_PURE_UNSUPPORTED else f"unsupported: {name}"
    return None


HLIL_DIVISIONS = frozenset({"HLIL_DIVU", "HLIL_DIVS", "HLIL_MODU", "HLIL_MODS",
                            "HLIL_DIVU_DP", "HLIL_DIVS_DP", "HLIL_MODU_DP", "HLIL_MODS_DP"})
_HLIL_SUPPORTED = frozenset({
    "HLIL_ADD", "HLIL_SUB", "HLIL_MUL", "HLIL_AND", "HLIL_OR", "HLIL_XOR", "HLIL_LSL", "HLIL_LSR", "HLIL_ASR",
    "HLIL_NEG", "HLIL_NOT", "HLIL_ZX", "HLIL_SX", "HLIL_LOW_PART", "HLIL_ROL", "HLIL_ROR",
    "HLIL_CMP_E", "HLIL_CMP_NE", "HLIL_CMP_SLT", "HLIL_CMP_ULT", "HLIL_CMP_SLE", "HLIL_CMP_ULE", "HLIL_CMP_SGE",
    "HLIL_CMP_UGE", "HLIL_CMP_SGT", "HLIL_CMP_UGT", "HLIL_BOOL_TO_INT",
})
_HLIL_PURE_UNSUPPORTED = frozenset({
    "HLIL_TEST_BIT",
    "HLIL_RLC", "HLIL_RRC", "HLIL_ADC", "HLIL_SBB", "HLIL_BSWAP", "HLIL_POPCNT", "HLIL_CLZ", "HLIL_CTZ",
    "HLIL_RBIT", "HLIL_CLS", "HLIL_MINS", "HLIL_MAXS", "HLIL_MINU", "HLIL_MAXU", "HLIL_ABS", "HLIL_SPLIT",
    "HLIL_MULU_DP", "HLIL_MULS_DP", "HLIL_ADDRESS_OF", "HLIL_IMPORT", "HLIL_EXTERN_PTR", "HLIL_CONST_DATA",
})

```

`binja_d810/binja/engine.py`:

```py
"""IL-independent per-function fixpoint: plan, verify, apply, report, roll back.

The engine knows nothing about MLIL or HLIL; an ILAdapter (binja_d810.binja.adapter) supplies
candidates, lowering, dead-code analysis, the control-flow fingerprint and the transaction.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
import time
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import NamedTuple, Sequence

from ..deadline import Deadline
from ..ir.expr import ARITH_OPS, BITWISE_OPS, Const, brief, is_mba, ops, tree_size
from ..semantic import cobra_shim
from ..rules.base import Rewrite, Rule
from ..semantic.constancy import fold_shared
from ..semantic.backend import Tier2Backend
from ..semantic.verify import Verdict
from ..simplify import Limits, Outcome, simplify_expression
from .adapter import ILAdapter
from .storage import visible_size


# Passes planning at once, process-wide. Binary Ninja analyzes functions on parallel threads, and
# Python runs one at a time: with every function's pass planning together, each pass's wall time
# stretched far past its CPU time (27 s for 1 s of work on one large export) and past Binary Ninja's own
# per-function limit. Two slots let one pass plan while another waits on Z3 or CoBRA; waiting for a
# slot counts against the pass's deadline.
PASS_SLOTS = 2
_SLOTS = threading.BoundedSemaphore(PASS_SLOTS)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class EngineConfig:
    limits: Limits = Limits()
    max_iterations: int = 10
    tier2: bool = True
    disabled_rules: frozenset[str] = frozenset()
    # Shared by both passes of one analysis run. v3.3: 20 s, with Binary Ninja's own
    # per-function limit raised to twice that where D-810 is enabled (binja_d810.binja.limits). At 10 s,
    # an OLLVM-obfuscated export needed 85% of the budget and stopped short on a slower machine.
    function_seconds: float = 20.0


class RewriteRecord(NamedTuple):
    address: int
    source: str
    before: str
    after: str
    verdict: str  # "PROVEN" or "TESTED": the original -> replacement check
    method: str  # "signature", "z3", "low bits" or "sampling"
    reason: str  # why a TESTED rewrite has no proof
    level: str = "mlil"
    mechanism: str = "rules"  # what folded it, for the summary (mechanism())


class SkipRecord(NamedTuple):
    address: int
    reason: str
    level: str = "mlil"
    expression: str = ""  # what was left, in brief


class ErrorRecord(NamedTuple):
    source: str
    message: str
    level: str = "mlil"


@dataclass
class FunctionReport:
    rewrites: list[RewriteRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    skipped: list[SkipRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    errors: list[ErrorRecord] = field(default_factory=list)
    capped: bool = False
    still_firing: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    rolled_back: bool = False
    refuted: int = 0  # candidate results the checker refuted; never applied
    rolled_back_rewrites: int = 0  # attempted, then undone; never counted as applied
    subsumed: int = 0  # candidates skipped because a planned later candidate inlined them
    constant_uses: int = 0  # reads replaced by the constant their definition was proven to be (v3.1)
    flow: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # targets the flow fixes made constant in this MLIL (v4.0)
    unflatten: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)  # one line per unflattening round (v4.2)
    callees: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    callee_calls: int = 0
    scratch: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    scratch_stores: int = 0
    scratch_accesses: int = 0
    scratch_aliases: int = 0
    scratch_computations: int = 0
    scratch_seconds: float = 0.0
    flags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    flag_conditions: int = 0
    flag_seconds: float = 0.0
    allocations: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    allocation_loads: int = 0
    allocation_lifetimes: int = 0
    allocation_seconds: float = 0.0
    constant_buffers: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    constant_regions: int = 0
    constant_steps: int = 0
    constant_strings: list = field(default_factory=list)
    constant_seconds: float = 0.0
    # Time. Planning is the budgeted work; commit (replace, finalize, SSA, cleanup,
    # rollback) is native and measured separately. overrun: planning past the deadline.
    allowance_seconds: float = 0.0
    budget_exhausted: bool = False
    plan_seconds: float = 0.0
    plan_cpu_seconds: float = 0.0  # this thread's CPU time while planning; much less than plan_seconds: waiting
    commit_seconds: float = 0.0
    lock_wait_seconds: float = 0.0
    slot_wait_seconds: float = 0.0  # waiting for one of PASS_SLOTS
    enumerate_seconds: float = 0.0  # lifting candidates (inside planning)
    slowest: list = field(default_factory=list)  # [(address, seconds, nodes, outcome)], at most 5, slowest first
    overrun_seconds: float = 0.0
    total_seconds: float = 0.0
    reserved_seconds: float = 0.0  # MLIL allowance held for the later control-flow and HLIL passes
    dispatch_probe_seconds: float = 0.0  # included in planning/total: checking for a table dispatcher

    def assurance(self) -> Counter:
        return Counter(r.verdict for r in self.rewrites)

    def summary(self) -> dict:
        """What was folded, by mechanism, and what was left, by reason: zero counts left out."""
        folded = Counter(r.mechanism for r in self.rewrites)
        folded.update({"constant uses": self.constant_uses, "flow": len(self.flow), "unflatten": len(self.unflatten),
                       "callee calls": self.callee_calls, "scratch stores": self.scratch_stores,
                       "scratch accesses": self.scratch_accesses, "flag conditions": self.flag_conditions,
                       "allocation loads": self.allocation_loads, "allocation lifetimes": self.allocation_lifetimes,
                       "constant regions": self.constant_regions})
        left = Counter(r.reason.split(":")[0] for r in self.skipped)
        return {"folded": {k: n for k, n in folded.items() if n}, "left": dict(left)}


def mechanism(rewrite: Rewrite) -> str:
    """The mechanism a rewrite counts under in the summary."""
    source = rewrite.source
    if rewrite.original.width == 1 and isinstance(rewrite.replacement, Const):
        return "predicates"
    if "constancy" in source:
        return "constants"
    if "select" in source:
        return "conditions"
    if "tier2:bitwise" in source:
        return "bitwise"
    return "mba" if "tier2:" in source else "rules"


def _grows_visible_code(candidate, replacement) -> bool:
    """The size gate (simplify._worth_applying) compares with the lifted form, which inlines
    definitions. When those definitions stay alive, the rewrite only copies them into the root:
    `arg2 - arg1 + rdi_1` (rdi_1 = arg1 & ~0x7f, used elsewhere) became `arg2 - (0x7f & arg1)`. A
    rewrite must not grow what is visible, nor mix arithmetic and bitwise operations where the
    visible code did not."""
    if candidate.consumer_kinds is not None and _newly_mixes(candidate, replacement):
        return True
    if candidate.visible_nodes is None:
        return False
    if visible_size(replacement) > candidate.visible_nodes:
        return True
    return not candidate.visible_mixed and is_mba(replacement)


def _kinds(e) -> frozenset:
    found = ops(e)
    return frozenset({"arith"} if found & ARITH_OPS else set()) | frozenset({"bitwise"} if found & BITWISE_OPS else set())


def _newly_mixes(candidate, replacement) -> bool:
    """The statement HLIL shows the root in (its value's single-use consumers, v3.1) was arithmetic
    or bitwise only and would mix: n + d - 8 with d = -8 | p (glibc's pointer alignment)."""
    both = {"arith", "bitwise"}
    before = candidate.consumer_kinds | candidate.root_kinds
    return not both <= before and both <= (candidate.consumer_kinds | _kinds(replacement))


def simplify_function(adapter: ILAdapter, rules: Sequence[Rule], backends: Sequence[Tier2Backend],
                      config: EngineConfig, deadline: Deadline = Deadline.never()) -> FunctionReport:
    start = time.monotonic()
    cobra_shim.reset_lock_wait()
    report = FunctionReport()
    report.allowance_seconds = deadline.remaining() if deadline.at != float("inf") else config.function_seconds
    try:
        _run(adapter, rules, backends, config, deadline, report)
    finally:
        report.lock_wait_seconds = cobra_shim.lock_wait_seconds()
        report.total_seconds = time.monotonic() - start
    return report


def _passes(adapter, rules, backends, config, deadline, report, dead: set, skip) -> None:
    """Plan, apply and clean up until nothing changes, the iteration cap or the deadline.

    Each pass tries every candidate with the cheap backends (rules and the atom-abstracting linear
    backend) first, and only then the others on what is left: in a Tigress VM's one 248-candidate
    function, CoBRA's slow failures on the first candidates otherwise used up the budget before
    later candidates the linear backend answers in milliseconds were reached.
    """
    level = adapter.level
    cheap = [b for b in backends if getattr(b, "abstracts_atoms", False)]
    rounds = [cheap, list(backends)] if cheap and len(cheap) < len(backends) else [list(backends)]
    # Outcomes of the last round without a rewrite, by lifted expression: a pure function of it
    # (names are symbols), so an unchanged candidate is not planned again in later passes.
    # Outcomes cut short by the shared deadline are not kept.
    stuck: dict = {}
    tier1_cache: dict = {}  # both rounds and every pass ask about the same expressions
    constants: dict = {}  # constancy outcomes of constant-only lifts, by expression (v3.1)
    inconclusive: dict = {}  # proofs that ran out of time, by shape: not tried again in this run (v3.5)
    last_sources: list = []
    for _ in range(config.max_iterations):
        planning, planning_cpu = time.monotonic(), time.thread_time()
        planned = []
        consumed: set = set()
        # Last first (the adapter's order): a later candidate that inlines a single-use definition
        # makes rewriting that definition on its own wasted work (it is dead once the later one is
        # applied). Candidates are lifted lazily, so the deadline also bounds lifting.
        order: dict = {}  # candidate -> position in the adapter's (last first) order
        pending = _numbered(adapter.candidates(skip), order, report)
        by_path: list = []  # last-round candidates left for per-path constancy
        # Constant folds first (v3.3): the lifts only a proven constant may come from, by constancy alone,
        # before any backend runs. An opaque predicate folded now removes the junk code behind it in the
        # next pass (an OLLVM-obfuscated function: Tier 2 on hundreds of junk roots used the whole budget
        # before its predicates' 10-60 ms folds were reached). Constancy rejects ordinary roots after a
        # sample or two.
        rest = []
        for candidate in pending:
            if deadline.expired():
                report.budget_exhausted = True
                break
            rewrite = None
            if candidate.ir not in stuck and (candidate.unchecked is not None or candidate.shared_dag is not None):
                rewrite, _ = _constant_only(candidate, constants, deadline, inconclusive)
            if rewrite is None:
                rest.append(candidate)
                continue
            planned.append((candidate, rewrite))
            consumed |= candidate.consumes
        pending = rest
        # A pass that folded constants commits them before any backend runs: the folded predicates remove
        # the code behind them, so the backends work in the next pass on what remains.
        for number, round_backends in enumerate(rounds if not planned else []):
            final = number == len(rounds) - 1
            deferred = []
            for candidate in pending:
                if candidate.single_use and candidate.defines is not None and candidate.defines in consumed:
                    report.subsumed += 1
                    continue
                if deadline.expired():
                    # No new solver or proof work; candidates already verified are still applied.
                    report.budget_exhausted = True
                    break
                # A candidate stuck in an earlier pass skips the simplification, a function of its lift. Its
                # constant-only and per-path attempts depend on more (the merges around it, v3.3) and run
                # again in the last round, remembered by their own lifts.
                known = stuck.get(candidate.ir)
                if known is not None and not final:
                    deferred.append(candidate)
                    continue
                def attempt(target):
                    result = simplify_expression(target.ir, rules, round_backends, config.limits, frozenset(dead),
                                                 deadline=deadline, tier1_cache=tier1_cache)
                    report.refuted += result.refuted
                    for source, message in result.errors:
                        if source != "verify":
                            dead.add(source)
                        report.errors.append(ErrorRecord(source, message, level))
                    return result

                started = time.monotonic()
                outcome = (Outcome() if candidate.constant_only
                           else Outcome(skipped=known.skipped) if known is not None else attempt(candidate))
                chosen, rewrite, grows = candidate, outcome.rewrite, False
                if rewrite is not None and _grows_visible_code(candidate, rewrite.replacement):
                    rewrite, grows = None, True
                worth = outcome.rewrite is not None or (outcome.skipped or "").startswith("too complex")
                if (known is None and candidate.shared and worth and hasattr(adapter, "shallow")
                        and not deadline.expired()):
                    # The lift inlined definitions that stay alive (values used several times, as in
                    # a Tigress VM's handlers): a result over those shared values may be smaller, and
                    # never copies them. The smaller visible result wins. Only worth a second
                    # simplification when the first found a rewrite (which may copy them) or gave up
                    # on size; most roots of ordinary code simplify neither way.
                    local = adapter.shallow(candidate)
                    if local is not None and local.ir != candidate.ir:
                        found = attempt(local).rewrite
                        if (found is not None and not _grows_visible_code(local, found.replacement)
                                and (rewrite is None
                                     or visible_size(found.replacement) < visible_size(rewrite.replacement))):
                            chosen, rewrite, grows = local, found, False
                if (known is None and grows and candidate.consumes and hasattr(adapter, "shallow")
                        and not deadline.expired()):
                    # The inlined form was refused (larger, or mixing statements that were each
                    # arithmetic or bitwise only): the root alone, over its inputs as they are.
                    local = adapter.shallow(candidate, keep=candidate.consumes)
                    if local is not None and local.ir != candidate.ir:
                        found = attempt(local).rewrite
                        if found is not None and not _grows_visible_code(local, found.replacement):
                            chosen, rewrite, grows = local, found, False
                _note_slowest(report, candidate, time.monotonic() - started, rewrite, outcome)
                if rewrite is None and not grows and final and not deadline.expired():
                    # The constant-only lifts again (remembered from the first stage: no new work unless
                    # it was cut short).
                    rewrite, unproven = _constant_only(candidate, constants, deadline, inconclusive)
                    if unproven:
                        outcome.skipped = "constant on every sample, not proven"
                    if rewrite is None and (candidate.paths is not None or hasattr(adapter, "path_variants")):
                        by_path.append(candidate)  # per-path constancy comes last (below)
                if rewrite is None and not final:
                    deferred.append(candidate)
                    continue
                if outcome.skipped and rewrite is None:
                    skip(candidate.address, outcome.skipped, candidate.ir)
                if outcome.rewrite is None and outcome.skipped != "budget exhausted" and not deadline.expired():
                    stuck[candidate.ir] = outcome
                if grows:
                    skip(candidate.address, "would make the visible code larger or newly mixed", candidate.ir)
                elif rewrite is not None:
                    order[id(chosen)] = order[id(candidate)]
                    planned.append((chosen, rewrite))
                    consumed |= chosen.consumes
            pending = deferred
        # Per-path constancy last, with what remains of the budget (v3.3): the costliest
        # and rarest mechanism must not take the time of other candidates' folds (an OLLVM-obfuscated export).
        for candidate in by_path:
            if deadline.expired():
                report.budget_exhausted = True
                break
            rewrite = _fold_paths(adapter, candidate, constants, deadline, inconclusive)
            if rewrite is not None:
                planned.append((candidate, rewrite))
        now = time.monotonic()
        report.plan_seconds += now - planning
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += time.thread_time() - planning_cpu
        report.overrun_seconds = max(report.overrun_seconds, now - deadline.at)
        if deadline.expired():
            report.budget_exhausted = True
        if not planned:
            return
        committing = time.monotonic()
        dead_before = adapter.dead_assignments()
        planned.sort(key=lambda item: -order[id(item[0])])  # apply in instruction order, as before
        for candidate, rewrite in planned:
            adapter.replace(candidate, rewrite.replacement)
            report.rewrites.append(RewriteRecord(
                candidate.address, rewrite.source, brief(rewrite.original, 2000), brief(rewrite.replacement, 2000),
                rewrite.verdict.name if rewrite.verdict else "UNCHECKED", rewrite.method, rewrite.reason, level,
                mechanism(rewrite)))
        adapter.finish()
        if hasattr(adapter, "propagate_constants"):
            # Definitions made constant: their other reads become the constant (v3.1), so plain uses
            # (a + k * 3, a call's argument) show it and the definitions die.
            folded = [c for c, r in planned if isinstance(r.replacement, Const) and r.verdict is not None
                      and r.verdict.name == "PROVEN"]
            uses = adapter.propagate_constants(folded) if folded else 0
            if uses:
                report.constant_uses += uses
                adapter.finish()
        # Only what these rewrites made dead: ordinary dead stores (z_1 = z at -O0) stay.
        newly_dead = adapter.dead_assignments() - dead_before
        if newly_dead:
            adapter.remove(newly_dead)
            adapter.finish()
        report.commit_seconds += time.monotonic() - committing
        last_sources = sorted({rewrite.source for _, rewrite in planned})
        if report.budget_exhausted:
            return
    report.capped = True
    report.still_firing = last_sources


def _constant_only(candidate, constants: dict, deadline: Deadline, inconclusive: dict):
    """Lifts only a proven constant may come from (v3.1), by constancy alone: the root over inputs whose
    registers were reused before it (x86-64 -O2's x in rdi; arm64 -O2's per-path values), and the root
    too large as a tree but small as shared values (an OLLVM-obfuscated export). A constant reads no variable.
    (rewrite or None, whether a lift was constant on every sample but not proven). Outcomes are
    remembered in `constants` by lift (an outcome cut short by the deadline is not)."""
    unchecked = candidate.unchecked
    if unchecked is not None and not candidate.constant_only and unchecked == candidate.ir:
        unchecked = None
    unproven = False
    for lifted, source in ((unchecked, "constancy (unchecked versions)"),
                           (candidate.shared_dag, "constancy (shared values)")):
        if lifted is None or deadline.expired():
            continue
        if lifted in constants:
            folded = constants[lifted]
        else:
            folded = fold_shared(lifted, deadline, inconclusive=inconclusive)
            if not deadline.expired():
                constants[lifted] = folded
        if folded is not None and folded[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN:
            return Rewrite(original=lifted, replacement=Const(folded[0], lifted.width), source=source,
                           verdict=folded[1].verdict, method=folded[1].method, reason=folded[1].reason), False
        unproven = unproven or folded is not None
    return None, unproven


def _fold_paths(adapter, candidate, constants: dict, deadline: Deadline, inconclusive: dict):
    """Per-path constancy: the condition once per incoming path of the merged values
    it reads. The adapter gives alternatives, cheapest first (v3.3: invariant merges alone, then every
    merge split); one folds only if every variant in it is the same proven constant."""
    alternatives = candidate.paths if candidate.paths is not None else adapter.path_variants(candidate)
    for variants in alternatives or ():
        value = _same_constant(variants, constants, deadline, inconclusive)
        if value is not None:
            original = candidate.unchecked if candidate.unchecked is not None else candidate.ir
            return Rewrite(original=original, replacement=Const(value, original.width), source="constancy (per path)",
                           verdict=Verdict.PROVEN, method="z3", reason="")
    return None


def _same_constant(variants, constants: dict, deadline: Deadline, inconclusive: dict):
    """The constant every variant is proven to be, or None."""
    value = None
    for variant in variants:
        if deadline.expired():
            return None
        if variant in constants:
            folded = constants[variant]
        else:
            folded = fold_shared(variant, deadline, inconclusive=inconclusive)
            if not deadline.expired():
                constants[variant] = folded
        if folded is None or folded[1].verdict is not Verdict.PROVEN or value not in (None, folded[0]):
            return None
        value = folded[0]
    return value


def _numbered(candidates, order: dict, report: FunctionReport):
    position = 0
    while True:
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            candidate = next(candidates)
        except StopIteration:
```
