`binja_d810/binja/scratch.py`:

```py
"""Proven local stack accesses and byte-range dead-store cleanup in MLIL."""

from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
import time

from binaryninja import (
    Endianness, ILInstructionAttribute as Attr, ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILOperation as Op,
    SSAVariable, Variable, VariableSourceType,
)

from ..deadline import Deadline
from ..ir.expr import to_signed
from ..scratch.liveness import Access, analyze
from ..scratch.values import Use, unobserved
from .effects import MLIL_PURE, mlil_effect
from .mlil.adapter import MLILAdapter


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Limits:
    instructions: int = 20000
    nodes: int = 40000
    frame_bytes: int = 4096
    visits: int = 100000
    rounds: int = 4
    address_depth: int = 64


@dataclass
class Report:
    stores: int = 0
    accesses: int = 0
    aliases: int = 0
    computations: int = 0
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    seconds: float = 0.0
    cpu_seconds: float = 0.0
    exhausted: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Address:
    var: object
    offset: int = 0


_READS = {Op.MLIL_VAR, Op.MLIL_VAR_FIELD, Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA_FIELD,
          Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD}
_WRITES = {Op.MLIL_SET_VAR, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA_FIELD,
           Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD}
_ADDRESS = {Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF, Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD}
_LOADS = {Op.MLIL_LOAD, Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT, Op.MLIL_LOAD_SSA, Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA}
_STORES = {Op.MLIL_STORE, Op.MLIL_STORE_STRUCT, Op.MLIL_STORE_SSA, Op.MLIL_STORE_STRUCT_SSA}
_OPAQUE = {Op.MLIL_CALL, Op.MLIL_CALL_UNTYPED, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL_UNTYPED,
           Op.MLIL_SYSCALL, Op.MLIL_SYSCALL_UNTYPED, Op.MLIL_INTRINSIC, Op.MLIL_UNIMPL,
           Op.MLIL_UNIMPL_MEM, Op.MLIL_UNDEF, Op.MLIL_JUMP}
_PROTECTED = {Attr.ILPreventDeadStoreElimination, Attr.ILPreventAliasAnalysis}
_CONTROL = {Op.MLIL_NOP, Op.MLIL_IF, Op.MLIL_GOTO, Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO, Op.MLIL_RET}


def operands(node):
    for name, value, _ in node.detailed_operands:
        for item in value if isinstance(value, list) else (value,):
            yield name, item
    # Native call operands expose output variables through detailed_operands, but copy_to
    # also visits their expression wrappers (and STORE_OUTPUT addresses). Include those
    # expressions in the postorder and the effect/escape scans.
    for item in getattr(node, "output_exprs", ()):
        yield "output", item


def walk(root):
    pending = [root]
    while pending:
        node = pending.pop()
        yield node
        pending.extend(value for _, value in operands(node) if hasattr(value, "operation"))


def var_of(value):
    return value.var if isinstance(value, SSAVariable) else value


class Scope:
    def __init__(self, il, limits, deadline):
        self.il, self.ssa, self.limits, self.deadline = il, il.ssa_form, limits, deadline
        self.nodes, self.parents, self.readers = {}, defaultdict(list), defaultdict(list)
        self.vars, self.widths, self.bytes = {}, {}, {}
        self.escaped = set()
        self.external = False
        self.barrier = False
        self.left = limits.nodes
        self.addresses, self.active = {}, set()
        self.protected = set()
        self.parameters = {v.identifier for v in il.source_function.parameter_vars}
        self.definitions = {}
        self._data_reads = None
        if len(il) > limits.instructions:
            raise ValueError("scratch instruction limit")
        for instr in il.instructions:
            for node in walk(instr):
                self.tick()
                if node.operation in _READS | _WRITES | _ADDRESS:
                    var = var_of(node.dest if node.operation in _WRITES else node.src)
                    if self.local(var):
                        self.vars[var.identifier] = var
                        size = var.type.width if var.type is not None else 0
                        accessed = 0 if node.operation in _ADDRESS else node.size + getattr(node, "offset", 0)
                        self.widths[var.identifier] = max(self.widths.get(var.identifier, 0), size, accessed)
                        if (il.arch.endianness != Endianness.LittleEndian and node.operation not in _ADDRESS
                                and (getattr(node, "offset", 0) or size and node.size != size)):
                            raise ValueError("partial stack-field layout is not modeled for this endianness")
                        if node.attributes & _PROTECTED or var.type is not None and var.type.volatile:
                            self.protected.add(var.identifier)
        offsets = set()
        for key, var in self.vars.items():
            width = self.widths[key]
            if width < 0 or width > limits.frame_bytes or var.storage + width > 0:
                raise ValueError("scratch frame bounds unavailable")
            offsets.update(range(var.storage, var.storage + width))
            if len(offsets) > limits.frame_bytes:
                raise ValueError("scratch frame byte limit")
        self.bytes = {offset: bit for bit, offset in enumerate(sorted(offsets))}
        self.all = (1 << len(self.bytes)) - 1
        for statement in self.ssa.instructions:
            pending = [(statement, None)]
            while pending:
                node, parent = pending.pop()
                if parent is not None:
                    self.parents[node.expr_index].append(parent)
                if node.expr_index in self.nodes:
                    continue
                self.tick()
                self.nodes[node.expr_index] = node
                for name, value in operands(node):
                    if hasattr(value, "operation"):
                        pending.append((value, (node, name)))
                    elif isinstance(value, SSAVariable) and name != "dest":
                        self.readers[value].append(node)
        for node in list(self.nodes.values()):
            if node.operation in _ADDRESS and self.local(node.src):
                if not self.no_escape(node):
                    self.escaped.add(node.src.identifier)
                    if self.external:
                        break

    def tick(self):
        self.left -= 1
        if self.left < 0 or self.deadline.expired():
            raise ValueError("scratch proof budget exhausted")

    def local(self, var):
        return (isinstance(var, Variable) and var.source_type == VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType
                and var.storage < 0 and var.identifier not in self.parameters)

    def definition(self, var):
        if var not in self.definitions:
            self.definitions[var] = self.ssa.get_ssa_var_definition(var)
        return self.definitions[var]

    def mask(self, var, offset, size):
        if var.identifier not in self.widths or size <= 0 or offset < 0 \
                or offset + size > self.widths[var.identifier]:
            return None
        result = 0
        for at in range(var.storage + offset, var.storage + offset + size):
            if at not in self.bytes:
                return None
            result |= 1 << self.bytes[at]
        return result

    def address(self, node):
        self.tick()
        key = node.expr_index
        if key in self.addresses:
            return self.addresses[key]
        if key in self.active:
            return None
        if len(self.active) >= self.limits.address_depth:
            raise ValueError("scratch address depth limit")
        self.active.add(key)
        result = None
        try:
            pointer_size = self.il.arch.address_size
            if node.operation in _ADDRESS and self.local(node.src):
                result = Address(node.src, getattr(node, "offset", 0))
            elif node.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA and node.size == pointer_size:
                if node.src.var.type is not None and node.src.var.type.volatile:
                    self.addresses[key] = None
                    return None
                definition = self.definition(node.src)
                if definition is not None and definition.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA \
                        and definition.size == pointer_size:
                    result = self.address(definition.src)
                elif definition is not None and definition.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                    found = []
                    for value in definition.src:
                        d = self.definition(value)
                        found.append(self.address(d.src) if d is not None and d.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA
                                     and d.size == pointer_size else None)
                    if found and found[0] is not None and all(v == found[0] for v in found):
                        result = found[0]
            elif node.operation in (Op.MLIL_ADD, Op.MLIL_SUB) and node.size == pointer_size:
                base, constant = node.left, node.right
                if node.operation == Op.MLIL_ADD and base.operation == Op.MLIL_CONST:
                    base, constant = constant, base
                if constant.operation == Op.MLIL_CONST:
                    previous = self.address(base)
                    if previous is not None:
                        delta = constant.constant if node.operation == Op.MLIL_ADD else -constant.constant
                        result = Address(previous.var, to_signed(previous.offset + delta, pointer_size * 8))
            self.addresses[key] = result
            return result
        finally:
            self.active.remove(key)

    def no_escape(self, root):
        pending, seen = [root], set()
        safe = True
        while pending:
            self.tick()
            node = pending.pop()
            if node.expr_index in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(node.expr_index)
            for parent, role in self.parents[node.expr_index]:
                op = parent.operation
                if op in _LOADS and role == "src" or op in _STORES and role == "dest":
                    address = self.address(node)
                    if address is None or self.mask(address.var, address.offset + getattr(parent, "offset", 0), parent.size) is None:
                        self.external = True
                        return False
                elif op == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA and role == "src" and parent.size == self.il.arch.address_size:
                    pending.extend(self.readers[parent.dest])
                elif op in (Op.MLIL_ADD, Op.MLIL_SUB) and self.address(parent) is not None:
                    pending.append(parent)
                elif op in (Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD) and role == "src":
                    # A pointer spill that is never read can itself be eliminated first. If
                    # its data is read, the address may escape through memory and stays opaque.
                    var = parent.dest.var
                    mask = self.mask(var, getattr(parent, "offset", 0), parent.size)
                    self.external |= mask is None or bool(self.data_reads() & mask)
                    safe = False
                elif op in _STORES and role == "src":
                    address = self.address(parent.dest)
                    mask = None if address is None else self.mask(address.var,
                            address.offset + getattr(parent, "offset", 0), parent.size)
                    self.external |= mask is None or bool(self.data_reads() & mask)
                    safe = False
                else:
                    self.external = True
                    return False
            if node.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                pending.extend(self.readers[node.dest])
        return safe

    def data_reads(self):
        if self._data_reads is None:
            result = 0
            for node in self.nodes.values():
                self.tick()
                mask = 0
                if node.operation in _READS and self.local(var_of(node.src)):
                    mask = self.mask(var_of(node.src), getattr(node, "offset", 0), node.size)
                elif node.operation in _LOADS:
                    address = self.address(node.src)
                    mask = None if address is None else self.mask(address.var,
                            address.offset + getattr(node, "offset", 0), node.size)
                result |= self.all if mask is None else mask
            self._data_reads = result
        return self._data_reads

    def pure(self, node):
        for part in walk(node):
            if part.attributes & _PROTECTED:
                return False
            if part.operation in _READS:
                var = var_of(part.src)
                if var.identifier in self.protected or var.type is not None and var.type.volatile:
                    return False
            if part.operation in (Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD):
                var = part.src.var
                if var.identifier in self.escaped | self.protected or not self.local(var):
                    return False
        return mlil_effect(node, pure=lambda n: n.operation in (Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD)) is None

    def access(self, instr):
        reads = writes = 0
        unknown = False
        for node in walk(instr):
            self.tick()
            op = node.operation
            if node.attributes & _PROTECTED or op in _OPAQUE:
                unknown = True
            if op.name not in MLIL_PURE and op not in _CONTROL | _READS | _WRITES | _ADDRESS | _LOADS | _STORES:
                unknown = True
            if op in _READS | _WRITES:
                var = var_of(node.dest if op in _WRITES else node.src)
                if not self.local(var):
                    continue
                mask = self.mask(var, getattr(node, "offset", 0), node.size)
                if mask is None:
                    unknown = True
                elif op in _READS:
                    reads |= mask
                else:
                    writes |= mask
            elif op in _LOADS | _STORES:
                pointer = node.dest if op in _STORES else node.src
                address = self.address(pointer.ssa_form)
                mask = None if address is None else self.mask(address.var,
                        address.offset + getattr(node, "offset", 0), node.size)
                if mask is None:
                    unknown = True
                elif op in _LOADS:
                    reads |= mask
                else:
                    writes |= mask
            else:
                for _, value in operands(node):
                    if self.local(var_of(value)) and op not in _ADDRESS:
                        unknown = True  # split/unsupported stack operands cannot silently disappear
        if unknown:
            reads |= self.all
            self.barrier = True
        removable = False
        if instr.operation in _WRITES and self.local(var_of(instr.dest)):
            var = var_of(instr.dest)
            removable = var.identifier not in self.escaped | self.protected and self.pure(instr.src)
        elif instr.operation in _STORES:
            address = self.address(instr.dest.ssa_form)
            removable = (address is not None and address.var.identifier not in self.escaped | self.protected
                         and self.pure(instr.src))
        return Access(reads, writes, removable and not unknown)

    def producers(self, dead):
        """Pure SSA definitions feeding the removed stores, never loads/calls materialized earlier."""
        pending = [self.il[i].ssa_form.src for i in dead]
        pending += [self.il[i].ssa_form.dest for i in dead if self.il[i].operation in _STORES]
        seen, result = set(), set()
        while pending:
            root = pending.pop()
            for node in walk(root):
                self.tick()
                if node.operation not in (Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA_FIELD) or node.src in seen:
                    continue
                seen.add(node.src)
                definition = self.definition(node.src)
                if definition is not None and definition.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA \
                        and self.pure(definition.src) and not definition.attributes & _PROTECTED:
                    result.add(definition.non_ssa_form.instr_index)
                    pending.append(definition.src)
        return result

    def dead_reads(self, dead_definitions):
        if self.barrier or self.external:
            return set()
        result = set()
        for index in dead_definitions:
            instr = self.il[index]
            if instr.operation != Op.MLIL_SET_VAR or self.local(instr.dest) or not self.pure(instr.src):
                continue
            for node in walk(instr.src):
                if node.operation in _READS | _ADDRESS:
                    var = var_of(node.src)
                    if self.local(var) and var.identifier not in self.escaped | self.protected:
                        result.add(index)
                        break
        return result

    def variable_value_is_dead(self, index, dead_definitions):
        """Physical overlap alone cannot kill an older *logical* SSA value. Different native
        variables can share a storage location after propagation or a control-flow rewrite.
        Aliased writes are checked by memory liveness; plain assignments also need SSA deadness.
        """
        instruction = self.il[index].ssa_form
        if instruction.operation not in (Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA_FIELD):
            return True
        mask = self.mask(instruction.dest.var, getattr(instruction, "offset", 0), instruction.size)
        if mask is None:
            return False
        def users(value):
            for reader in self.readers[value]:
                if reader.operation in _READS:
                    read = self.mask(var_of(reader.src), getattr(reader, "offset", 0), reader.size)
                    yield Use(unknown=True) if read is None else Use(reads=read)
                elif reader.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA_FIELD and reader.prev == value:
                    written = self.mask(reader.dest.var, reader.offset, reader.size)
                    if written is None or reader.dest.var.identifier != value.var.identifier:
                        yield Use(unknown=True)
                    else:
                        yield Use(follows=reader.dest, overwritten=written)
                elif reader.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI and reader.dest.var.identifier == value.var.identifier:
                    yield Use(follows=reader.dest)
                else:
                    yield Use(unknown=True)
        return unobserved(instruction.dest, mask, users, self.tick)

    def alias_candidates(self):
        if self.external or self.barrier:
            return {}
        # A native variable can overlap another logical value occupying the same physical
        # location. Keep those alias identities; only independent whole slots are promoted.
        overlaps, component, end = set(), [], None
        intervals = sorted((v.storage, v.storage + self.widths[k] if self.widths[k] else 0, k)
                           for k, v in self.vars.items())
        for start, stop, key in intervals:
            if end is None or start >= end:
                if len(component) > 1:
                    overlaps.update(component)
                component, end = [key], stop
            else:
                component.append(key)
                end = max(end, stop)
        if len(component) > 1:
            overlaps.update(component)
        return {key: var for key, var in self.vars.items()
                if key not in overlaps | self.escaped | self.protected and var.type is not None
                and var.type.width > 0 and var.type.width == self.widths[key]}

    def promotions(self, eligible):
        result, blocked = {}, set()
        for instr in self.il.instructions:
            for node in walk(instr):
                self.tick()
                if node.operation not in _LOADS | _STORES:
                    continue
                address = self.address((node.dest if node.operation in _STORES else node.src).ssa_form)
                if address is not None and address.var.identifier in eligible:
                    offset = address.offset + getattr(node, "offset", 0)
                    if self.mask(address.var, offset, node.size) is not None:
                        if self.il.arch.endianness != Endianness.LittleEndian and (offset or node.size != address.var.type.width):
                            blocked.add(address.var.identifier)
                            continue
                        result[node.expr_index] = Address(address.var, offset)
        for key in blocked:
            eligible.pop(key, None)
        return {index: address for index, address in result.items() if address.var.identifier in eligible}


def control_flow(il, tick):
    result = {}
    for block in il.basic_blocks:
        targets = []
        for edge in block.outgoing_edges:
            tick()
            if edge.target is None:
                raise ValueError("scratch control flow is incomplete")
            targets.append(edge.target.start)
        for index in range(block.start, block.end):
            tick()
            result[index] = (index + 1,) if index + 1 < block.end else tuple(targets)
    return result


def _copy(root, new, promotions, deadline):
    pending, copied = [(root, False)], {}
    while pending:
        if deadline.expired():
            raise ValueError("scratch commit budget exhausted")
        node, ready = pending.pop()
        if node.expr_index in copied:
            continue
        address = promotions.get(node.expr_index)
        children = [value for _, value in operands(node) if hasattr(value, "operation")]
        if address is not None:
            children = [node.src] if node.operation in _STORES else []
        if not ready:
            pending.append((node, True))
            pending.extend((child, False) for child in children)
            continue
        loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(node)
        if address is None:
            result = node.copy_to(new, lambda child: copied[child.expr_index])
        else:
            whole = not address.offset and node.size == address.var.type.width
            if node.operation in _LOADS:
                result = new.var(node.size, address.var, loc) if whole else new.var_field(node.size, address.var, address.offset, loc)
            else:
                value = copied[node.src.expr_index]
                result = new.set_var(node.size, address.var, value, loc) if whole \
                    else new.set_var_field(node.size, address.var, address.offset, value, loc)
        new.set_expr_attributes(result, node.attributes)
        copied[node.expr_index] = result
    return copied[root.expr_index]


def remove_stores(il, dead, deadline, promotions=None, unaliased=()):
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(il.arch, low_level_il=il.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(il)
    for block in il.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for instr in block:
            if deadline.expired():
                raise ValueError("scratch commit budget exhausted")
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            new.append(new.nop(loc) if instr.instr_index in dead else _copy(instr, new, promotions or {}, deadline), loc)
    new.finalize()
    new.generate_ssa_form(known_not_aliases=list(unaliased))
    return new


def run(il, limits=Limits(), deadline=Deadline.never()):
    started, cpu = time.monotonic(), time.thread_time()
    current, report = il, Report()
    known = {}
    try:
        for _ in range(limits.rounds):
            scope = Scope(current, limits, deadline)
            if scope.external:
                report.notes.append("frame address escapes or has unproved uses")
                break
            if not scope.bytes:
                break
            if scope.protected and "volatile or protected stack slots left unchanged" not in report.notes:
                report.notes.append("volatile or protected stack slots left unchanged")
            accesses = {i.instr_index: scope.access(i) for i in current.instructions}
            if scope.barrier and "unknown call or memory effect limits scratch cleanup" not in report.notes:
                report.notes.append("unknown call or memory effect limits scratch cleanup")
            dead_definitions = MLILAdapter(current, deadline=deadline).dead_assignments()
            dead_reads = scope.dead_reads(dead_definitions)
            if dead_reads:
                current = remove_stores(current, dead_reads, deadline, unaliased=known.values())
                report.computations += len(dead_reads)
                continue
            eligible = scope.alias_candidates()
            promotions = scope.promotions(eligible)
            known.update(eligible)
            aliased = {v.identifier for v in current.ssa_form.aliased_vars}
            dealiased = [var for key, var in eligible.items() if key in aliased]
            if promotions or dealiased:
                current = remove_stores(current, set(), deadline, promotions, known.values())
                report.aliases += len(dealiased)
                report.accesses += len(promotions)
                # Regeneration exposes the promoted values to the ordinary SSA lifter.
                # The next round recomputes every liveness fact from this new form.
                continue
            proof = analyze(accesses, control_flow(current, scope.tick), max_visits=limits.visits, deadline=deadline)
            if proof.reason:
                report.notes.append(proof.reason)
                break
            dead = {i for i in proof.dead if scope.variable_value_is_dead(i, dead_definitions)}
            if len(dead) < len(proof.dead) and "live or unmodeled SSA uses keep some stores" not in report.notes:
                report.notes.append("live or unmodeled SSA uses keep some stores")
            if not dead:
                break
            producers = scope.producers(dead)
            current = remove_stores(current, dead, deadline, unaliased=known.values())
            report.stores += len(dead)
            # These computations fed only the proven-dead stores. Keep every producer with
            # another live use and all effectful producers, even if the native adapter would
            # otherwise consider a fixed-address load disposable.
            dead_producers = MLILAdapter(current, deadline=deadline).dead_assignments() & producers
            if dead_producers:
                current = remove_stores(current, dead_producers, deadline, unaliased=known.values())
                report.computations += len(dead_producers)
        else:
            report.notes.append("scratch cleanup round limit reached")
    except (ValueError, NotImplementedError) as exc:
        report.notes.append(str(exc))
    finally:
        report.seconds, report.cpu_seconds = time.monotonic() - started, time.thread_time() - cpu
        report.exhausted = deadline.expired()
    return current, report

```

```py
def register() -> None:
    s = Settings()
    s.register_group(PREFIX, "D-810")
    for key, spec in _SPECS.items():
        s.register_setting(key, json.dumps(spec))


def engine_config(ctx) -> EngineConfig:
    # The analysis context caches "number" settings with integer defaults as uint64;
    # get_setting_double fails with "SettingsCache failed to get a cached setting". Set them
    # with Settings().set_integer: a value stored with set_double is ignored by integer reads.
    return EngineConfig(
        limits=Limits(max_vars=ctx.get_setting_uint64(MAX_VARS), max_nodes=ctx.get_setting_uint64(MAX_NODES)),
        max_iterations=ctx.get_setting_uint64(MAX_ITERATIONS),
        tier2=ctx.get_setting_bool(TIER2),
        disabled_rules=frozenset(ctx.get_setting_string_list(DISABLED_RULES)),
        function_seconds=float(ctx.get_setting_uint64(FUNCTION_SECONDS)),
    )
```

`binja_d810/binja/ssa.py`:

```py
"""SSA definitions by variable, else by storage and version (v3.3). No binaryninja import.

Binary Ninja numbers SSA versions per storage location (binja_d810.binja.mlil.lift). After rewrites
and SSA regeneration, a read can name another variable of the same storage than its definition does:
a function can read edx_98#97, which edx_103#97 = phi(edx_98#90, edx_98#96) defines, and asking
for edx_98#97's definition finds nothing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

_BY_STORAGE = ("ssa definitions", "by storage")  # cache key, apart from the (identifier, version) keys


def definition_of(ssa_func, ssa_var, cache: dict, by_storage: bool = True):
    """The instruction defining `ssa_var`, or None (an input, or nothing of its storage at that version).
    `cache` is shared by the lifts of one SSA form. The storage index covers every definition of the
    function: `by_storage` only with a cache that lives through many lookups (a lift's own short-lived
    cache rebuilding it made a large function's analysis run past Binary Ninja's limit)."""
    key = (ssa_var.var.identifier, ssa_var.version)
    if key in cache:
        return cache[key]
    found = ssa_func.get_ssa_var_definition(ssa_var)
    if found is None and ssa_var.version > 0 and by_storage:
        index = cache.get(_BY_STORAGE)
        if index is None:
            # One scan of the SSA form, by what each instruction writes (v3.5): 0.14 s on a
            # large function, where every SSA version of every variable (ssa_vars, one call per variable) took 12 s.
            index = cache[_BY_STORAGE] = {}
            for instr in ssa_func.instructions:
                for written in instr.vars_written:
                    if hasattr(written, "version"):
                        index.setdefault(_storage(written), instr)
        found = index.get(_storage(ssa_var))
    cache[key] = found
    return found


def reaching(ssa_func, ssa_block, var, depth: int = 8):
    """The version of `var` leaving `ssa_block` (SSA form): written by its last instruction, or current there.
    A block of one instruction that does not write it, with one predecessor (a loop's back edge through a
    lone goto, at -O2, where the non-SSA form answers version 0), passes on what leaves its predecessor.
    None when there is no non-SSA instruction to ask."""
    from binaryninja import SSAVariable  # at call time: this module imports no binaryninja

    last = ssa_func[ssa_block.end - 1]
    for written in last.vars_written:
        if isinstance(written, SSAVariable) and written.var == var:
            return written
    edges = ssa_block.incoming_edges
    if depth and ssa_block.length == 1 and len(edges) == 1:
        return reaching(ssa_func, edges[0].source, var, depth - 1)
    try:
        return SSAVariable(var, last.non_ssa_form.get_ssa_var_version(var))
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no non-SSA instruction for it
        return None


def _storage(ssa_var) -> tuple:
    return int(ssa_var.var.source_type), ssa_var.var.storage, ssa_var.version

```

`binja_d810/binja/storage.py`:

```py
"""Backing-storage model for field reads and partial writes. No binaryninja import.

Each SSA version of a storage location (a register, or a stack variable) has one backing value of
the storage's full width, whose bits are all unknown. A read of `size` bytes at byte `offset` is
`trunc(backing >> 8*offset)`; a variable read at its declared width is the read at offset 0. Reads
of the same storage version are therefore related exactly (x == trunc8(x.w0)), and no read ever
assumes anything about the bits it does not cover: zero or sign extension appears only when the IL
says so.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from ..ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, UnOp, Var, mask


def contained(offset: int, size: int, storage_size: int) -> bool:
    """A read of `size` bytes at byte `offset` lies within `storage_size` bytes."""
    return size > 0 and offset >= 0 and offset + size <= storage_size


def field_read(backing: Expr, offset_bits: int, width: int) -> Expr:
    if not (0 <= offset_bits and offset_bits + width <= backing.width):
        raise ValueError(f"{width}-bit read at bit {offset_bits} exceeds {backing.width} bits")
    e = backing
    if offset_bits:
        e = BinOp("lshr", e, Const(offset_bits, backing.width), backing.width)
    if width < backing.width:
        e = UnOp("trunc", e, width)
    return e


def merge_partial_write(old: Expr, value: Expr, offset_bits: int) -> Expr:
    """The storage after writing `value` at bit `offset_bits`, keeping the other bits of `old`.

    For an IL write that preserves the rest of the storage (SET_VAR_FIELD). A zero-extending write
    is an ordinary assignment of a zx in the IL and never comes here.
    """
    big, small = old.width, value.width
    if offset_bits < 0 or offset_bits + small > big:
        raise ValueError(f"{small}-bit write at bit {offset_bits} exceeds {big} bits")
    if small == big:
        return value
    field_mask = mask(small) << offset_bits
    widened = UnOp("zx", value, big)
    if offset_bits:
        widened = BinOp("shl", widened, Const(offset_bits, big), big)
    kept = BinOp("and", old, Const(~field_mask & mask(big), big), big)
    return BinOp("or", kept, BinOp("and", widened, Const(field_mask, big), big), big)


def as_field(e: Expr) -> Optional[tuple[Var, int, int]]:
    """(variable, offset in bits, width) if `e` is a read of part of one variable, else None."""
    if isinstance(e, Var):
        return e, 0, e.width
    if isinstance(e, UnOp) and e.op == "trunc":
        inner, offset = e.operand, 0
        if isinstance(inner, BinOp) and inner.op == "lshr" and isinstance(inner.right, Const):
            inner, offset = inner.left, inner.right.value
        if isinstance(inner, Var) and offset % 8 == 0 and offset + e.width <= inner.width:
            return inner, offset, e.width
    return None


def read_over_write(read_offset: int, read_size: int, write_offset: int, write_size: int) -> str:
    """How a read of bytes relates to the last partial write before it: "inside" (the written value
    alone determines it), "disjoint" (the previous version alone does) or "partial" (both)."""
    if write_offset <= read_offset and read_offset + read_size <= write_offset + write_size:
        return "inside"
    if read_offset + read_size <= write_offset or read_offset >= write_offset + write_size:
        return "disjoint"
    return "partial"


def fit(e: Expr, width: int) -> Optional[Expr]:
    """An operand of a `width`-bit +, -, *, &, | or ^ whose IL size differs from the operation's.

    Wider: its low bits, exactly (those operations never look at higher bits). Narrower: None,
    since the extension is not stated by the IL and is never guessed."""
    if e.width == width:
        return e
    if e.width < width:
        return None
    if isinstance(e, Const):
        return Const(e.value, width)
    return UnOp("trunc", e, width)


def as_integer(e: Expr, width: int) -> Expr:
    """A 1-bit value (a comparison or a flag) read as a `width`-bit integer. Binary Ninja gives a
    comparison the value 0 or 1, whatever reads it, so this is its zero extension: (y s< 10).b
    (MSVC's setl r8b), sx.q(x < y) (1, never -1)."""
    return UnOp("zx", e, width) if e.width == 1 and width > 1 else e


def unary(op: str, operand: Expr, width: int) -> Optional[Expr]:
    """An IL unary operation of `width` bits on a lifted operand; None if the widths do not fit."""
    if operand.width == 1 and width > 1:
        operand = as_integer(operand, width)
        if op in ("zx", "sx", "trunc"):
            return operand
    try:
        return UnOp(op, operand, width)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def exact(e: Optional[Expr], width: int) -> Optional[Expr]:
    """`e` as a division operand of `width` bits: its own width, or a wider constant whose
    value fits. Never `fit`: a division reads every bit, so a wider operand's low bits are not its value."""
    if e is None or e.width == width:
        return e
    if isinstance(e, Const) and e.width > width and e.value >> width == 0:
        return Const(e.value, width)
    return None  # a narrower constant is never widened: its extension is not stated


def visible_size(e: Expr) -> int:
    """Nodes as they will appear in the IL: a read of part of a variable (trunc(b >> 8), lowered as
    one field read) counts once."""
    if as_field(e) is not None:
        return 1
    if isinstance(e, BinOp):
        return 1 + visible_size(e.left) + visible_size(e.right)
    if isinstance(e, UnOp):
        return 1 + visible_size(e.operand)
    return 1

```

`binja_d810/binja/test_runner.py`:

```py
"""Runs pytest inside the Binary Ninja GUI process (Personal edition has no headless API).

scripts/binja_pytest.sh launches Binary Ninja with BINJA_D810_PYTEST_ARGS (JSON list of pytest
arguments), BINJA_D810_PYTEST_OUT (a directory) and BINJA_D810_PYTEST_CWD (where pytest runs). This module runs pytest on a background
thread, writes pytest.log and result.json into that directory, then quits the application. On macOS the
test process prevents idle system sleep for its lifetime, so timed tests survive a detached launcher.
"""

import contextlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
from pathlib import Path

ENV_ARGS = "BINJA_D810_PYTEST_ARGS"
ENV_OUT = "BINJA_D810_PYTEST_OUT"
ENV_CWD = "BINJA_D810_PYTEST_CWD"  # the directory pytest runs in (an app launched hidden starts in /)
ENV_TIMEOUT = "BINJA_D810_PYTEST_TIMEOUT"  # bounds the idle-sleep assertion even if the launcher disappears


def maybe_run_from_env() -> bool:
    raw = os.environ.get(ENV_ARGS)
    if not raw:
        return False
    out_dir = Path(os.environ[ENV_OUT])
    threading.Thread(
        target=_run, args=(json.loads(raw), out_dir), daemon=True, name="binja-d810-pytest"
    ).start()
    return True


def _run(args: list[str], out_dir: Path) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    exit_code = 99
    awake = None
    try:
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            awake = subprocess.Popen(["/usr/bin/caffeinate", "-i", "-t", os.environ.get(ENV_TIMEOUT, "3600"),
                                      "-w", str(os.getpid())],
                                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, start_new_session=True)
        import pytest

        if os.environ.get(ENV_CWD):
            os.chdir(os.environ[ENV_CWD])
        with open(out_dir / "pytest.log", "w") as log, contextlib.redirect_stdout(log), contextlib.redirect_stderr(log):
            exit_code = int(pytest.main(args))
    finally:
        (out_dir / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps({"exit_code": exit_code}))
        if awake is not None:
            awake.terminate()
            try:
                awake.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                awake.kill()
                awake.wait()
        _quit()


def _quit() -> None:
    try:
        from binaryninja.mainthread import execute_on_main_thread
        from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication

        execute_on_main_thread(QApplication.instance().quit)
    except Exception:
        os._exit(0)

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/__init__.py`:

```py
"""Control-flow unflattening over MLIL (v4.2): the graph model built from MLIL and SSA, and its rewrite."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Sequence

from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op

from ...deadline import Deadline
from ...unflatten.thread import MIN_STATES, _terminator_keys, plan
from ...unflatten.values import Values
from . import junk, rewrite, selfcall, splice
from .graph import MLILGraph

MAX_ROUNDS = 4
GROWTH = 4  # a round is not applied when the function would grow past max(GROWTH x original, original + slack)
GROWTH_SLACK = 2048


def has_table_dispatcher(mlil, view, *, deadline: Deadline, ranges=()) -> bool:
    """A bounded preflight for reserving time after MBA: a jump table on a cycle reads constant-only state.
    This does not change the IL or accept a rewrite; the ordinary planner must still prove its threads.
    """
    blocks = []
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        if deadline.expired():
            return False
        last = mlil[block.end - 1]
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO and len(last.targets) >= MIN_STATES:
            blocks.append(block.index)
    if not blocks:
        return False
    graph = MLILGraph(mlil, view=view, ranges=ranges)
    values = Values(graph, deadline)
    for block in blocks:
        if deadline.expired():
            return False
        if not any(values.only_constants(k) for k in _terminator_keys(graph.terminator(block))):
            continue
        work, seen = [e.source for e in graph.preds(block)], set()
        while work and not deadline.expired():
            pred = work.pop()
            if pred == block:
                return True
            if pred not in seen:
                seen.add(pred)
                work.extend(e.source for e in graph.preds(pred))
    return False


def _looped(mlil, view, ranges, deadline: Deadline):
    """Prefer a plan combining self calls and outlined handlers. Keep a proven self-call-only plan
    when expansion fails, runs out of time or would exceed the growth bound."""
    found = _loop(mlil, view, ranges, deadline)
    if deadline.expired():
        return found
    spliced = splice.handlers(mlil, view)
    if spliced is None:
        return found
    expanded = _loop(spliced[0], view, ranges, deadline)
    if expanded is None:
        return found
    # Keep an already proven self-call recovery when adding handlers would exceed the growth bound.
    cap = max(GROWTH * len(mlil), len(mlil) + GROWTH_SLACK)
    if found is not None and rewrite.size_bound(expanded[0], expanded[1]) > cap:
        return found
    return expanded[0], expanded[1], [f"{spliced[1]} handlers spliced in", *expanded[2]]


def _loop(mlil, view, ranges, deadline: Deadline):
    found = selfcall.loop(mlil, view)
    if found is None:
        return None
    looped, head, count = found
    graph = MLILGraph(looped, view=view, ranges=ranges, passed=frozenset(mlil.source_function.parameter_vars))
    planned = plan(graph, deadline=deadline)
    paths = [o.path for t in planned.threads for o in ((t.outcome,) if t.split is None else t.split.outcomes.values())]
    if not any(head in path for path in paths):
        return None
    return graph, planned, [f"{count} self calls in tail position read as a loop"]


def run(ctx, *, deadline: Deadline, ranges: Sequence[tuple[int, int]]) -> list[str]:
    """Rounds of planning and rewriting ctx.mlil, each committed to ctx.mlil. One report line per round."""
    lines: list[str] = []
    mlil = ctx.mlil
    original = len(mlil)
    cap = max(GROWTH * original, original + GROWTH_SLACK)
    evidenced: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
    removed = junk.loops(mlil, ctx.function.view)
    if removed is not None:
        ctx.mlil = mlil = removed[0]
        lines.append(f"{removed[1]} junk loops removed")
    first = _looped(mlil, ctx.function.view, ranges, deadline)
    if first is not None:
        mlil = first[0].mlil
    for n in range(1, MAX_ROUNDS + 1):
        if n == 1 and first is not None:
            graph, found, report = first
            lines.extend(report)
        else:
            graph = MLILGraph(mlil, view=ctx.function.view, ranges=ranges)
            found = plan(graph, evidenced=evidenced, deadline=deadline)
        if not found.threads:
            break
        evidenced |= found.states
        new = rewrite.rewrite(graph, found)
        if len(new) > cap:
            lines.append(f"round {n}: not applied, {len(new)} instructions over the cap of {cap}")
            break
        ctx.mlil = mlil = new
        names = ", ".join(sorted(graph.name(v) for v in found.states))
        lines.append(f"round {n}: {len(found.threads)} edges threaded through {len(found.dispatcher)} dispatcher "
                     f"blocks, state {names}")
    return lines

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/entry.py`:

```py
"""Entry values carried outside a function's declared parameters."""

from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op, RegisterValueType, SSAVariable, VariableSourceType

_TRANSFERS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_CALL, Op.MLIL_CALL_UNTYPED, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL,
                         Op.MLIL_TAILCALL_UNTYPED, Op.MLIL_JUMP, Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO, Op.MLIL_RET})


def variables(mlil, params):
    """Live non-parameter entry variables, following phis but ignoring dead phi-only webs."""
    own = {p.identifier for p in params}
    ssa = mlil.ssa_form
    for var in mlil.vars:
        if var.identifier in own:
            continue
        if next(uses(ssa, var), None) is not None:
            yield var


def uses(ssa, var):
    """Concrete uses of an entry value, including uses reached through phis."""
    work, seen, emitted = [SSAVariable(var, 0)], set(), set()
    while work:
        version = work.pop()
        if version in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(version)
        for use in ssa.get_ssa_var_uses(version):
            if use.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                work.append(use.dest)
            elif use.instr_index not in emitted:
                emitted.add(use.instr_index)
                yield use


class Preserved:
    """A caller's hidden registers stay unchanged across each copied handler transition.

    Require full callee-saved registers, native entry-value evidence at transfers, and no
    overlapping handler variables. Stack slots, register aliases and missing evidence reject.
    """

    def __init__(self, mlil, params):
        self.arch = mlil.arch
        self.registers = {}
        self.supported = True
        func = mlil.source_function
        saved = set(func.calling_convention.callee_saved_regs) if func.calling_convention else set()
        for var in variables(mlil, params):
            if var.source_type != VariableSourceType.RegisterVariableSourceType:
                self.supported = False
                break
            name = self.arch.get_reg_name(var.storage)
            info = self.arch.regs.get(name)
            if info is None or name != info.full_width_reg or name not in saved:
                self.supported = False
                break
            self.registers[name] = var.storage

    def at(self, func, address: int) -> bool:
        """Native values at this transfer are the same registers that entered the function."""
        if not self.supported or func.arch != self.arch:
            return False
        for name, storage in self.registers.items():
            value = func.get_reg_value_at(address, name)
            if value.type != RegisterValueType.EntryValue or value.value != storage or value.offset != 0:
                return False
        return True

    def by(self, mlil) -> bool:
        if not self.registers:
            return self.supported
        func = mlil.source_function
        cc = func.calling_convention
        if not self.supported or func.arch != self.arch or cc is None \
                or not self.registers.keys() <= set(cc.callee_saved_regs):
            return False
        # Variables keep their identifiers when copied. Even a saved/restored local use
        # could overwrite the caller's IL variable, so reject all overlapping register storage.
        for var in (*mlil.vars, *func.parameter_vars):
            if var.source_type == VariableSourceType.RegisterVariableSourceType:
                info = self.arch.regs.get(self.arch.get_reg_name(var.storage))
                if info is None or info.full_width_reg in self.registers:
                    return False
        return all(self.at(func, i.address) for i in mlil.instructions if i.operation in _TRANSFERS)

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/frame.py`:

```py
"""Bounded provenance checks for arguments that may name the current invocation's frame."""

from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op, SSAVariable

from ..ssa import definition_of

_ADDRESSES = frozenset({Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF, Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD})
_READS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA_FIELD})
_ALIASED = frozenset({Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED, Op.MLIL_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD})
_CALLS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_CALL_SSA, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL_SSA,
                   Op.MLIL_CALL_UNTYPED_SSA, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL_UNTYPED_SSA})
_CONSTANTS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR})
_LOADS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_LOAD_SSA, Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA})


class Arguments:
    """Follow each argument's reaching SSA definitions. Proven independent values are reusable;
    incomplete or ambiguous proofs stay conservative. The bound counts definitions that need expansion.
    """

    def __init__(self, mlil, limit: int):
        self.ssa, self.limit = mlil.ssa_form, limit
        self.definitions, self.safe = {}, set()
        self._takes_address = None

    def _frame_address_exists(self) -> bool:
        """Without a memory-alias proof, an exposed frame pointer may have been stored and reloaded,
        or recovered by a helper. Cache this scan for the whole function, not once per argument."""
        if self._takes_address is None:
            self._takes_address = any(
                any(i.traverse(lambda n: True if n.operation in _ADDRESSES else None))
                for i in self.ssa.instructions)
        return self._takes_address

    def may_name_frame(self, root) -> bool:
        work, seen, expressions = [root], set(), set()
        expanded = 0
        while work:
            node = work.pop()
            if isinstance(node, SSAVariable):
                if node in seen or node in self.safe:
                    continue
                seen.add(node)
                definition = definition_of(self.ssa, node, self.definitions)
                if definition is None:
                    if node.version != 0:
                        return True
                    continue  # an incoming value was not constructed from this invocation's frame
                op = definition.operation
                if op == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA and definition.src.operation in _CONSTANTS:
                    continue
                expanded += 1
                if expanded > self.limit:
                    return True
                if op == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                    work.extend(definition.src)
                elif op == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA:
                    work.append(definition.src)
                elif op == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA_FIELD:
                    work.extend((definition.prev, definition.src))
                elif op in _CALLS:
                    if self._frame_address_exists():
                        return True
                    # A helper may return an alias of one of its arguments.
                    work.extend(definition.params)
                else:
                    return True
                continue
            if node.expr_index in expressions:
                continue
            expressions.add(node.expr_index)
            op = node.operation
            if op in _ADDRESSES or op in _ALIASED or op.name.startswith(("MLIL_UNDEF", "MLIL_UNIMPL")):
                return True
            if op in _LOADS and self._frame_address_exists():
                return True
            if op in _READS:
                work.append(node.src)
                continue
            for operand in node.operands:
                for child in operand if isinstance(operand, list) else (operand,):
                    if isinstance(child, SSAVariable) or hasattr(child, "operation"):
                        work.append(child)
        self.safe.update(seen)
        return False

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/graph.py`:

```py
"""The unflattening graph model (binja_d810.unflatten.graph) over one MLIL function and its SSA form (v4.2).

Blocks are the non-SSA basic blocks, by index. Values are SSA versions: lifted expressions have their
SSAVariable leaves relinked to Key(identifier, version), and every other leaf (a backing storage read, an
opaque or loaded value) stays unknown. Everything is built lazily and cached: planning reads only the blocks
and values its paths reach.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional, Sequence

from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op, SSAVariable, VariableSourceType

from ...ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, Var, substitute, variables
from ...unflatten.graph import (Assign, Branch, Definition, Edge, Goto, Jump, Key, Load, Phi, Step, Stop, Undefined,
                                Unknown)
from ..effects import mlil_effect
from ..memory import fixed_load_is_safe
from ..mlil.lift import Backing, lift, lift_live, lift_value
from ..ssa import definition_of, reaching

_PHIS = (Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI, Op.MLIL_MEM_PHI)
_ASSIGNS = (Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA_FIELD)
_LOADS = (Op.MLIL_LOAD_SSA, Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA)
MAX_COPIES = 8  # copies of a value searched for one live at a split


class MLILGraph:
    def __init__(self, mlil, *, view, ranges: Sequence[tuple[int, int]], max_nodes: int = 200,
                 passed: frozenset = frozenset()):
        """`passed`: parameters a loop's back edges assign (selfcall), whose entry value is the caller's."""
        self.mlil = mlil
        self.passed = passed
        self.ssa = mlil.ssa_form
        self.view = view
        self.ranges = list(ranges)
        self.max_nodes = max_nodes
        self._blocks = {b.index: b for b in mlil.basic_blocks}
        self._at = {b.start: b.index for b in mlil.basic_blocks}
        self.entry = mlil.get_basic_block_at(0).index
        self._defs: dict = {}  # the lifter's definition cache, shared by every lift of this SSA form
        self._vars: dict[Key, SSAVariable] = {}
        self._names: dict[int, str] = {}
        self._ssa_blocks: dict[int, object] = {}
        self._from_ssa: Optional[dict[int, int]] = None
        self._phis: dict[int, dict[Key, object]] = {}
        self._sources: dict[tuple[int, int, Key], Optional[Key]] = {}
        self._steps: dict[int, tuple[Step, ...]] = {}
        self._terms: dict[int, object] = {}
        self._definitions: dict[Key, Definition] = {}
        self._widths: dict[int, int] = {}
        self._value_widths: dict[SSAVariable, int] = {}
        self._preds: dict[int, list[Edge]] = {b: [] for b in self._blocks}
        for b, block in self._blocks.items():
            for target, slot in self._edges(block):
                self._preds[target].append(Edge(b, slot))

    # --- Graph protocol ---

    def blocks(self) -> list[int]:
        return sorted(self._blocks)

    def preds(self, block: int) -> list[Edge]:
        return self._preds[block]

    def phis(self, block: int) -> list[Key]:
        return list(self._phi_instrs(block))

    def phi_source(self, block: int, pred: int, dest: Key) -> Optional[Key]:
        cache = (block, pred, dest)
        if cache not in self._sources:
            phi = self._phi_instrs(block).get(dest)
            found = None if phi is None else reaching(self.ssa, self._ssa_block(pred), phi.dest.var)
            key = None if found is None else self._key(found)
            self._sources[cache] = key if phi is not None and key in {self._key(s) for s in phi.src} else None
        return self._sources[cache]

    def steps(self, block: int) -> tuple[Step, ...]:
        if block not in self._steps:
            b = self._blocks[block]
            self._steps[block] = tuple(self._step(self.mlil[i].ssa_form) for i in range(b.start, b.end - 1))
        return self._steps[block]

    def terminator(self, block: int):
        if block not in self._terms:
            self._terms[block] = self._terminator(self._blocks[block])
        return self._terms[block]

    def definition(self, key: Key) -> Definition:
        if key not in self._definitions:
            self._definitions[key] = self._definition(key)
        return self._definitions[key]

    def def_block(self, key: Key) -> Optional[int]:
        d = definition_of(self.ssa, self._vars[key], self._defs)
        return None if d is None else self.block_of(d)

    def block_of(self, ssa_instr) -> Optional[int]:
        """The block holding an instruction of the SSA form."""
        if self._from_ssa is None:
            self._from_ssa = {self._ssa_block(b).start: b for b in self._blocks}
        return self._from_ssa.get(ssa_instr.il_basic_block.start)

    def width(self, key: Key) -> int:
        return self._value_bits(self._vars[key])

    def read(self, address: int, width: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Constant memory: a load fixed_load_is_safe allows, in a segment that is not writable or inside one
        of the configured read-only ranges."""
        size = width // 8
        if width % 8 or not fixed_load_is_safe(self.view, address, size):
            return None
        segment = self.view.get_segment_at(address)
        constant = segment is not None and not segment.writable and address + size <= segment.end
        if not constant and not any(start <= address and address + size <= end for start, end in self.ranges):
            return None
        try:
            return self.view.read_int(address, size, False)
        except ValueError:
            return None

    def live_expression(self, pred: int, key: Key) -> Optional[Expr]:
        """The value of `key` in values live at the end of `pred`: rebuilt from them, or (v4.3) a full-width copy
        of it that is still live there (a value saved across a call: the register it was made in is clobbered)."""
        b = self._blocks[pred]
        root = self.ssa[self.mlil.get_ssa_instruction_index(b.end - 1)]
        found = lift_live(self.ssa, self._vars[key], self.width(key), root_instr=root, max_nodes=self.max_nodes,
                          definitions=self._defs)
        if found is not None:
            return self._relink(found)
        copy = self._live_copy(self._vars[key], root)
        return None if copy is None else Var(f"{copy.var.name}#{copy.version}", self.width(key), ref=self._key(copy))

    def _live_copy(self, ssa_var: SSAVariable, root) -> Optional[SSAVariable]:
        width, work, seen = self._bits(ssa_var.var), [ssa_var], {ssa_var}
        while work and len(seen) <= MAX_COPIES:
            for use in self.ssa.get_ssa_var_uses(work.pop(0)):
                if use.operation != Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA or use.src.operation != Op.MLIL_VAR_SSA:
                    continue
                dest = use.dest
                if dest in seen or self._bits(dest.var) != width:
                    continue
                if root.get_ssa_var_version(dest.var) == dest.version:
                    return dest
                seen.add(dest)
                work.append(dest)
        return None

    # --- for the rewrite ---

    def il_block(self, block: int):
        return self._blocks[block]

    def ssa_var(self, key: Key) -> SSAVariable:
        return self._vars[key]

    def name(self, var_id: int) -> str:
        return self._names[var_id]

    def with_refs(self, e: Expr) -> Expr:
        """`e` with Key refs back to SSA variables, for mlil.lower."""
        mapping = {leaf.name: Var(leaf.name, leaf.width, ref=self._vars[leaf.ref])
                   for leaf in variables(e) if isinstance(leaf.ref, Key)}
        return substitute(e, mapping) if mapping else e

    # --- building ---

    def _key(self, ssa_var: SSAVariable) -> Key:
        key = Key(ssa_var.var.identifier, ssa_var.version)
        self._vars.setdefault(key, ssa_var)
        self._names.setdefault(key.var, ssa_var.var.name)
        return key

    def _relink(self, e: Expr) -> Expr:
        mapping = {leaf.name: Var(leaf.name, leaf.width, ref=self._key(ref))
                   for leaf in variables(e) if (ref := self._whole(leaf)) is not None}
        return substitute(e, mapping) if mapping else e

    def _whole(self, leaf: Var) -> Optional[SSAVariable]:
        """The SSA variable a leaf reads in full: a variable, or the storage backing exactly one (a 64-bit state
        tested through its low half reads its register's backing value). Versions count per storage, so the
        backing's version is the variable's."""
        if isinstance(leaf.ref, SSAVariable):
            if not self._bits(leaf.ref.var) and leaf.width > self._value_bits(leaf.ref):
                return None  # an inferred narrow write says nothing about the additional bits of a wider read
            return leaf.ref
        if isinstance(leaf.ref, Backing) and 8 * leaf.ref.size == self._bits(leaf.ref.var):
            return SSAVariable(leaf.ref.var, leaf.ref.version)
        return None

    def _bits(self, var) -> int:
        """A variable's width: its type's, or for one the function's analysis has not typed (copied in from a
        spliced handler) the width its assignments write."""
        found = _bits(var)
        if found:
            return found
        if var.identifier not in self._widths:
            sizes = {d.size for d in self.mlil.get_var_definitions(var) if d.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR}
            self._widths[var.identifier] = 8 * sizes.pop() if len(sizes) == 1 else 0
        return self._widths[var.identifier]

    def _value_bits(self, ssa_var: SSAVariable) -> int:
        """An untyped variable may have unrelated writes at different widths after handler copying.
        Infer this version from full assignments and uniform phi sources, within the lift budget.
        Partial writes, missing definitions and mixed-width merges remain unknown.
        """
        fixed = self._bits(ssa_var.var)
        if fixed:
            return fixed
        if ssa_var in self._value_widths:
            return self._value_widths[ssa_var]
        work, seen, sizes = [ssa_var], set(), set()
        while work:
            current = work.pop()
            if current in seen:
                continue
            if len(seen) >= self.max_nodes:
                break
            seen.add(current)
            known = self._value_widths.get(current)
            if known is not None:
                sizes.add(known)
            else:
                d = definition_of(self.ssa, current, self._defs)
                if d is not None and d.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA:
                    sizes.add(8 * d.size)
                elif d is not None and d.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                    work.extend(d.src)
                else:
                    break
            if len(sizes) > 1 or 0 in sizes:
                break
        else:
            if len(sizes) == 1:
                width = sizes.pop()
                self._value_widths.update((var, width) for var in seen)
                return width
        self._value_widths[ssa_var] = 0
        return 0

    def _lift(self, e, root) -> Optional[Expr]:
        found = lift(e, root_instr=root, check_versions=False, max_nodes=self.max_nodes, definitions=self._defs,
                     dataflow=False)
        return None if found is None else self._relink(found)

    def _ssa_block(self, block: int):
        if block not in self._ssa_blocks:
            start = self.mlil.get_ssa_instruction_index(self._blocks[block].start)
            self._ssa_blocks[block] = self.ssa[start].il_basic_block
        return self._ssa_blocks[block]

    def _phi_instrs(self, block: int) -> dict[Key, object]:
        if block not in self._phis:
            sblock, found = self._ssa_block(block), {}
            for i in range(sblock.start, sblock.end):
                instr = self.ssa[i]
                if instr.operation not in _PHIS:
                    break
                if instr.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                    found[self._key(instr.dest)] = instr
            self._phis[block] = found
        return self._phis[block]

    def _edges(self, block) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:
        last = self.mlil[block.end - 1]
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_GOTO:
            return [(self._at[last.dest], "goto")]
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_IF:
            return [(self._at[last.true], "true"), (self._at[last.false], "false")]
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO:
            target = self._constant_jump(last)
            if target is not None:
                return [(target, "goto")]
            return [(b, "jump") for b in dict.fromkeys(self._at[i] for i in last.targets.values())]
        # Anything else that still has successors (a fall-through): an undecided jump, never rewritten.
        return [(b, "jump") for b in dict.fromkeys(e.target.index for e in block.outgoing_edges)]

    def _constant_jump(self, instr) -> Optional[int]:
        """A resolved jump with a literal destination matching its sole target is an ordinary goto.
        A target annotation alone does not establish the destination or make evaluating it effect-free."""
        if instr.dest.operation not in (Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR) or len(instr.targets) != 1:
            return None
        target = instr.targets.get(instr.dest.constant)
        return None if target is None else self._at.get(target)

    def _step(self, si) -> Step:
        if si.operation == Op.MLIL_NOP:
            return Step(None, None, (), False)
        if si.operation in _ASSIGNS and mlil_effect(si.src) is None:
            key = self._key(si.dest)
            return Step(key, self._value(si.dest), (key,), False)
        writes = tuple(self._key(v) for v in si.vars_written if isinstance(v, SSAVariable))
        return Step(None, None, writes, True)

    def _value(self, ssa_var: SSAVariable) -> Optional[Expr]:
        """What a pure definition computes, its own definitions inlined; None when nothing but the value
        itself comes out."""
        width = self._value_bits(ssa_var)
        d = definition_of(self.ssa, ssa_var, self._defs)
        if not width or d is None:
            return None
        found = lift_value(self.ssa, ssa_var, width, root_instr=d, max_nodes=self.max_nodes, definitions=self._defs)
        if isinstance(found, Var) and isinstance(found.ref, SSAVariable) and found.ref == ssa_var:
            return None
        return self._relink(found)

    def _local(self, ssa_var: SSAVariable) -> bool:
        """A stack slot below the frame that is not a parameter: its entry version is read before any store. Or a
        parameter in `passed`: its entry version is the first state, which the caller picks, as a flattened
        function's first store would; it does not count against a state the loop only assigns constants."""
        var = ssa_var.var
        if ssa_var.version == 0 and var in self.passed:
            return True
        if ssa_var.version != 0 or var.source_type != VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType or var.storage >= 0:
            return False
        return var not in self.mlil.source_function.parameter_vars

    def _definition(self, key: Key) -> Definition:
        ssa_var = self._vars[key]
        d = definition_of(self.ssa, ssa_var, self._defs)
        if d is None:
            return Undefined() if self._local(ssa_var) else Unknown()
        if d.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
            return Phi(tuple(self._key(s) for s in d.src)) if self._value_bits(ssa_var) else Unknown()
        if d.operation in _ASSIGNS and mlil_effect(d.src) is None:
            e = self._value(ssa_var)
            if e is not None:
                return Assign(e)
        return Unknown()

    def _terminator(self, block):
        last = self.mlil[block.end - 1]
        si = last.ssa_form
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_GOTO:
            return Goto(self._at[last.dest])
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_IF:
            return Branch(self._condition(si), self._at[last.true], self._at[last.false])
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO:
            target = self._constant_jump(last)
            if target is not None:
                return Goto(target)
            return self._jump(si, {address: self._at[i] for address, i in last.targets.items()})
        edges = self._edges(block)
        return Jump(None, {}, {i: b for i, (b, _) in enumerate(edges)}) if edges else Stop()

    def _condition(self, si) -> Optional[Expr]:
        if si.condition.operation in (Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR):
            return Const(1 if si.condition.constant else 0, 1)  # if (false): folded already, 0 bits wide
        return self._lift(si.condition, si)

    def _jump(self, si, targets: dict[int, int]) -> Jump:
        """The destination with each load a leaf (lift's load_leaves), and each load's address lifted on its own."""
        dest = lift(si.dest, root_instr=si, check_versions=False, max_nodes=self.max_nodes, definitions=self._defs,
                    load_leaves=True, dataflow=False)
        if dest is None:
            return Jump(None, {}, targets)
        loads = {}
        for leaf in variables(dest):
            if leaf.ref is None or getattr(leaf.ref, "operation", None) not in _LOADS:
                continue
            address = self._lift(leaf.ref.src, si)
            if address is None:
                return Jump(None, {}, targets)
            if leaf.ref.operation == Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA and leaf.ref.offset:
                address = BinOp("add", address, Const(leaf.ref.offset, address.width), address.width)
            loads[leaf.name] = Load(address, leaf.width)
        return Jump(self._relink(dest), loads, targets)


def _bits(var) -> int:
    try:
        return 8 * var.type.width if var.type is not None else 0
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - a variable without a usable type
        return 0

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/incoming.py`:

```py
"""Bindings for handler inputs omitted from its declared argument list."""

from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op, RegisterValueType as Value, VariableSourceType as Source

from ..effects import mlil_effect
from ..flow.collect import branch_instruction
from . import entry, selfcall


def _size(var):
    type_ = var.type
    return type_.width if type_ is not None else 0


def _register(arch, var):
    if var.source_type != Source.RegisterVariableSourceType:
        return None
    name = arch.get_reg_name(var.storage)
    info = arch.regs.get(name)
    return None if info is None else info.full_width_reg


def _entry_at(func, address, storage):
    value = func.get_reg_value_at(address, storage)
    return value.type == Value.EntryValue and value.value == storage and value.offset == 0


def _tail_frame(func, instr):
    """An actual tail branch with the same stack base as this function's entry."""
    if (instr.operation != Op.MLIL_TAILCALL or func.arch.stack_pointer is None
            or func.get_call_type_adjustment(instr.address) is not None):
        return False
    value = func.get_reg_value_at(instr.address, func.arch.stack_pointer)
    return (value.type == Value.StackFrameOffset and value.value == value.offset == 0
            and branch_instruction(func, instr.address) is not None)


class Inputs:
    def __init__(self, caller, mlil):
        self.caller, self.mlil = caller, mlil
        self.params = tuple(caller.parameter_vars)
        self.registers = tuple(entry.variables(mlil, mlil.source_function.parameter_vars))
        self.returns = {}
        self.supported = caller.arch == mlil.arch and self._registers() and self._returns()

    def _registers(self):
        if not self.registers:
            return True
        callee, arch = self.mlil.source_function, self.caller.arch
        if callee.arch != arch or self.caller.calling_convention is None or callee.calling_convention is None:
            return False
        saved = set(self.caller.calling_convention.callee_saved_regs) & set(callee.calling_convention.callee_saved_regs)
        own = {_register(arch, p) for p in callee.parameter_vars}
        for var in self.registers:
            name = _register(arch, var)
            if name not in saved or name in own or name in (arch.stack_pointer, arch.link_reg) or var.index != 0:
                return False
            info = arch.regs[name]
            matching = [p for p in self.params if _register(arch, p) == name]
            if (len(matching) != 1 or matching[0].identifier != var.identifier
                    or arch.get_reg_name(var.storage) != name
                    or _size(var) != info.size or _size(matching[0]) != info.size):
                return False
            if not all(_entry_at(callee, use.address, var.storage) for use in entry.uses(self.mlil.ssa_form, var)):
                return False
        return True

    def _returns(self):
        for instr in self.mlil.instructions:
            if instr.operation not in selfcall._CALLS | selfcall._TAILS or instr.dest.operation not in selfcall._CONSTANTS \
                    or instr.dest.constant != self.caller.start:
                continue
            args = list(getattr(instr, "params", []))
            if not args or len(args) == len(self.params):
                continue  # the existing explicit or untyped path already covers these
            n = len(args)
            if (n >= len(self.params) or not _tail_frame(self.mlil.source_function, instr)
                    or any(p.source_type != Source.RegisterVariableSourceType for p in self.params[:n])
                    or any(p.source_type != Source.StackVariableSourceType for p in self.params[n:])):
                return False
            self.returns[instr.instr_index] = self.params[n:]
        return not self.returns or (self._pure_body() and self._stack_slots())

    def _pure_body(self):
        """Only pure register/stack-variable code: no memory accesses, frame addresses or helper calls."""
        for instr in self.mlil.instructions:
            if instr.operation in (Op.MLIL_NOP, Op.MLIL_GOTO):
                continue
            if instr.operation in (Op.MLIL_SET_VAR, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD):
                exprs = (instr.src,)
            elif instr.operation == Op.MLIL_IF:
                exprs = (instr.condition,)
            elif instr.operation == Op.MLIL_TAILCALL and instr.dest.operation in selfcall._CONSTANTS \
                    and instr.dest.constant == self.caller.start:
                exprs = instr.params
            else:
                return False
            for expr in exprs:
                if mlil_effect(expr) is not None or any(expr.traverse(
                        lambda node: True if node.operation in selfcall._ADDRESSES else None)):
                    return False
        return True

    def _stack_slots(self):
        params = [p for p in self.params if p.source_type == Source.StackVariableSourceType]
        slots = []
        for p in params:
            size = _size(p)
            if p.storage < 0 or not size:
                return False
            slots.append((p.storage, p.storage + size, p.identifier))
        slots.sort()
        if any(left[1] > right[0] for left, right in zip(slots, slots[1:])):
            return False
        for var in self.mlil.vars:
            if var.source_type != Source.StackVariableSourceType:
                continue
            size = _size(var)
            if not size:
                return False
            for start, end, identifier in slots:
                if var.storage < end and start < var.storage + size:
                    if var.identifier != identifier or size != end - start:
                        return False
        return True

    def at(self, instr):
        """The caller supplies the same whole incoming registers; shared-stack returns also need a tail entry."""
        if not self.supported or (self.returns and not _tail_frame(self.caller, instr)):
            return False
        ssa = instr.ssa_form if self.registers else None
        for var in self.registers:
            held = instr.get_var_for_reg(var.storage)
            if held is None or held.identifier != var.identifier or ssa.get_ssa_var_version(held) != 0:
                return False
            if not _entry_at(self.caller, instr.address, var.storage):
                return False
        return True

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/junk.py`:

```py
"""Junk loops (v4.3, spec 3.7): a loop that does nothing but step its own counter until the counter meets a value.

Over the graph model (MLILGraph), a loop is junk when its body only computes values (no load, store or call),
exactly one value is carried round it (one phi at its header that the body reads), each iteration adds an odd
constant to that value, and its only exit is an equality test of the value plus a constant (or of its low bits)
against something the loop does not write. No loop lies inside it and the test's block dominates its back
edge, so each iteration ends having stepped and tested once. Adding an odd constant meets every value of the
counter's width within that many steps, so the loop ends; nothing it computes is read after it, and no variable
it writes has its address taken, so ending it at once changes nothing but time. In a copy of the MLIL, its header
becomes a goto to its exit. A loop is at most MAX_BLOCKS blocks of MAX_INSTRUCTIONS instructions.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from binaryninja import ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILOperation as Op

from ...ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, UnOp, Var
from ...unflatten.graph import Assign, Branch, Goto, key_of
from .graph import MLILGraph

MAX_BLOCKS = 4
MAX_INSTRUCTIONS = 32
_ADDRESSES = frozenset({Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF, Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD})


def loops(mlil, view) -> Optional[tuple[MediumLevelILFunction, int]]:
    """(the copy with each junk loop's header turned into a goto to its exit, how many), or None."""
    cycles = [(e.source.index, e.target.index, e.target in e.source.dominators) for block in mlil.basic_blocks
              for e in block.outgoing_edges if e.back_edge]
    back = [(latch, header) for latch, header, natural in cycles if natural]
    if not back:
        return None
    graph = MLILGraph(mlil, view=view, ranges=())
    exits: dict[int, int] = {}  # header block -> exit block
    for latch, header in back:
        if header in exits:
            continue
        body = _body(graph, header, latch)
        if body is not None and any(s in body and (s, t) != (latch, header) for s, t, _ in cycles):
            continue  # a loop inside it: an iteration need not end
        exit = None if body is None else _junk(graph, mlil, header, latch, body)
        if exit is not None:
            exits[header] = exit
    if not exits:
        return None
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(mlil.arch, low_level_il=mlil.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(mlil)
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        if block.index in exits:
            first = mlil[block.start]
            new.set_current_address(first.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(first)
            target = new.get_label_for_source_instruction(graph.il_block(exits[block.index]).start)
            new.append(new.goto(target, loc), loc)
            continue
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)
    new.finalize()
```
