```py
    new.generate_ssa_form()
    return new, len(exits)


def _body(graph: MLILGraph, header: int, latch: int) -> Optional[set[int]]:
    """The natural loop of the back edge latch -> header, or None past MAX_BLOCKS."""
    body, work = {header, latch}, [latch]
    while work:
        b = work.pop()
        if b == header:
            continue
        for e in graph.preds(b):
            if e.source not in body:
                body.add(e.source)
                work.append(e.source)
                if len(body) > MAX_BLOCKS:
                    return None
    return body


def _junk(graph: MLILGraph, mlil, header: int, latch: int, body: set[int]) -> Optional[int]:
    """The block the loop exits to, when it is junk."""
    if any(e.source not in body for b in body - {header} for e in graph.preds(b)):
        return None  # entered other than at its header
    if sum(len(graph.il_block(b)) for b in body) > MAX_INSTRUCTIONS:
        return None
    if any(step.impure for b in body for step in graph.steps(b)):
        return None
    exits, test = [], None
    for b in body:
        term = graph.terminator(b)
        if isinstance(term, Branch):
            outside = [t for t in (term.true, term.false) if t not in body]
            exits += outside
            if outside:
                test = (term, outside[0], b)
        elif not isinstance(term, Goto):
            return None
    if len(exits) != 1 or test is None:
        return None
    branch, exit, at = test
    if graph.il_block(at) not in graph.il_block(latch).dominators:
        return None  # an iteration may not test
    carried = [k for k in graph.phis(header) if _read_in(graph, k, body)]
    if len(carried) != 1:
        return None
    counter = carried[0]
    source = graph.phi_source(header, latch, counter)
    step = None if source is None else graph.definition(source)
    if not isinstance(step, Assign) or not _stepped(step.expr, counter, graph.width(counter)):
        return None
    if not _meets(branch, exit, counter, graph, body):
        return None
    written = _written(graph, header, body)
    if any(_read_after(graph, key, body) for key in written):
        return None
    if _address_taken(mlil, {key.var for key in written}):
        return None
    return exit


def _read_in(graph: MLILGraph, key, body: set[int]) -> bool:
    """`key` is read by a step or test of the loop."""
    ssa_var = graph.ssa_var(key)
    for use in graph.ssa.get_ssa_var_uses(ssa_var):
        if _block_of(graph, use) in body and use.operation != Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
            return True
    return False


def _stepped(e: Expr, counter, width: int) -> bool:
    """`e` is the counter plus or minus an odd constant, at the counter's width."""
    if not isinstance(e, BinOp) or e.op not in ("add", "sub") or e.width != width:
        return False
    for var, const in ((e.left, e.right), (e.right, e.left)):
        if isinstance(var, Var) and key_of(var) == counter and isinstance(const, Const) and const.value & 1:
            return e.op == "add" or var is e.left
    return False


def _meets(branch: Branch, exit: int, counter, graph: MLILGraph, body: set[int]) -> bool:
    """The loop leaves when (the low bits of) the counter plus a constant equal a value it does not write."""
    cond = branch.cond
    if not isinstance(cond, BinOp) or cond.op not in ("eq", "ne"):
        return False
    if (cond.op == "eq") != (branch.true == exit):
        return False
    for side, other in ((cond.left, cond.right), (cond.right, cond.left)):
        if _affine(side, counter, graph) and _invariant(other, graph, body):
            return True
    return False


def _affine(e: Expr, counter, graph: MLILGraph, depth: int = 2) -> bool:
    """`e` is the counter plus a constant, or the low bits of one; a variable through its definition."""
    while isinstance(e, UnOp) and e.op == "trunc":
        e = e.operand
    if isinstance(e, Var):
        key = key_of(e)
        if key == counter:
            return True
        d = None if key is None or not depth else graph.definition(key)
        return isinstance(d, Assign) and _affine(d.expr, counter, graph, depth - 1)
    if isinstance(e, BinOp) and e.op in ("add", "sub"):
        for var, const in ((e.left, e.right), (e.right, e.left)):
            if isinstance(var, Var) and key_of(var) == counter and isinstance(const, Const):
                return e.op == "add" or var is e.left
    return False


def _invariant(e: Expr, graph: MLILGraph, body: set[int]) -> bool:
    if isinstance(e, Const):
        return True
    return isinstance(e, Var) and key_of(e) is not None and graph.def_block(key_of(e)) not in body


def _written(graph: MLILGraph, header: int, body: set[int]) -> set:
    found = set(graph.phis(header))
    for b in body:
        for step in graph.steps(b):
            found.update(step.writes)
    return found


def _read_after(graph: MLILGraph, key, body: set[int]) -> bool:
    """A version the loop defines is read outside it, directly or through phis."""
    work, seen = [graph.ssa_var(key)], set()
    while work:
        ssa_var = work.pop()
        if ssa_var in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(ssa_var)
        for use in graph.ssa.get_ssa_var_uses(ssa_var):
            if use.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI:
                work.append(use.dest)
            elif _block_of(graph, use) not in body:
                return True
    return False


def _block_of(graph: MLILGraph, ssa_instr) -> Optional[int]:
    return graph.block_of(ssa_instr)


def _address_taken(mlil, var_ids: set[int]) -> bool:
    def taken(node):
        if node.operation in _ADDRESSES and node.src.identifier in var_ids:
            return True
        return None
    return any(True in instr.traverse(taken) for instr in mlil.instructions)

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/rewrite.py`:

```py
"""A plan's threads written into a new MLIL function (v4.2, spec §3.6).

Every original block is copied in order, each threaded edge retargeted to its trampoline, and the trampolines
appended: the non-terminator instructions of each path block, copied in order, then a goto. Blocks left
unreachable are Binary Ninja's to drop; what fed only the dispatcher is removed here (_clean). A trampoline
whose last edge is itself threaded ends in that edge's trampoline: its copy of the block is an execution of that
edge, so it may take what the edge takes, and a machine whose handlers merge before the dispatcher comes out as
one line in a single round.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from binaryninja import ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, MediumLevelILOperation as Op

from ...ir.evaluate import evaluate
from ...ir.expr import variables
from ...unflatten.graph import Branch, Goto
from ...unflatten.thread import Outcome, Plan, Thread
from ..mlil.adapter import MLILAdapter
from ..mlil.lift import lift
from ..mlil.lower import lower
from .graph import MLILGraph

_LOADS = (Op.MLIL_LOAD_SSA, Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA)


def size_bound(graph: MLILGraph, plan: Plan) -> int:
    """Instructions before cleanup: the original body plus each emitted trampoline."""
    size = len(graph.mlil)
    for thread in plan.threads:
        if not _emittable(graph, thread):
            continue
        outcomes = (thread.outcome,) if thread.split is None else tuple(thread.split.outcomes.values())
        if thread.split is not None:
            size += 1 if thread.split.condition is not None else len(outcomes)
        for outcome in outcomes:
            size += 1 + sum(graph.il_block(b).end - graph.il_block(b).start - 1 for b in outcome.path)
    return size


def rewrite(graph: MLILGraph, plan: Plan) -> MediumLevelILFunction:
    mlil = graph.mlil
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(mlil.arch, low_level_il=mlil.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(mlil)
    threads = [t for t in plan.threads if _emittable(graph, t)]
    labels = {(t.pred, t.slot): MediumLevelILLabel() for t in threads}
    origin: dict[int, int] = {}  # each copied instruction's index -> the index it was copied from
    for b in graph.blocks():
        block = graph.il_block(b)
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            last = i == block.end - 1
            if last and (b, "goto") in labels and isinstance(graph.terminator(b), Goto):
                new.append(new.goto(labels[(b, "goto")], loc), loc)
            elif last and instr.operation == Op.MLIL_IF and ((b, "true") in labels or (b, "false") in labels):
                true = labels.get((b, "true")) or new.get_label_for_source_instruction(instr.true)
                false = labels.get((b, "false")) or new.get_label_for_source_instruction(instr.false)
                new.append(new.if_expr(instr.condition.copy_to(new), true, false, loc), loc)
            else:
                origin[new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)] = i
    in_blocks = set(origin)
    for t in threads:
        new.mark_label(labels[(t.pred, t.slot)])
        if t.split is None:
            _path(new, graph, t.outcome, labels, origin)
        else:
            _split(new, graph, t, labels, origin)
    new.finalize()
    new.generate_ssa_form()
    _clean(new, graph, plan, origin, set(origin) - in_blocks)
    return new


def _clean(new, graph: MLILGraph, plan: Plan, origin: dict[int, int], trampolines: set[int]) -> None:
    """What fed only the dispatcher dies: the state's stores (at -O0, through a stack slot) and the reads of a
    jump's table. As after the MBA pass, an assignment the rewrite left unused is removed when it is pure, and
    one dead before stays, unless it stores a constant a state variable takes (at -O0 a spare slot keeps one).
    A trampoline's load is pure when its address is constant there, in the image."""
    before = MLILAdapter(graph.mlil).dead_assignments()
    states = _state_constants(graph.mlil, plan.states)
    adapter = MLILAdapter(new)
    dead = {i for i in adapter.dead_assignments(_constant_loads(new, trampolines, adapter.fixed_loads))
            if origin.get(i) not in before or _constant(new[i]) in states}
    if dead:
        adapter.remove(dead)
        adapter.finish()


def _state_constants(mlil, states: frozenset[int]) -> frozenset[int]:
    """The constants the state variables are assigned."""
    return frozenset(c for instr in mlil.instructions
                     if instr.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR and instr.dest.identifier in states
                     and (c := _constant(instr)) is not None)


def _constant(instr) -> Optional[int]:
    """The constant a SET_VAR stores, unsigned at its size."""
    if instr.operation != Op.MLIL_SET_VAR or instr.src.operation not in (Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR):
        return None
    return instr.src.constant & ((1 << 8 * instr.src.size) - 1)


def _constant_loads(new, trampolines: set[int], fixed) -> frozenset[int]:
    """Non-SSA expression indices of the loads in trampolines whose address evaluates to a constant that
    `fixed` (memory.FixedLoads) allows."""
    found, definitions = set(), {}
    for i in sorted(trampolines):
        si = new[i].ssa_form
        for node in si.traverse(lambda n: n if n.operation in _LOADS else None):
            address = lift(node.src, root_instr=si, check_versions=False, definitions=definitions)
            if address is None or variables(address):
                continue
            offset = node.offset if node.operation == Op.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA else 0
            if fixed(evaluate(address, {}) + offset, node.size):
                found.add(node.non_ssa_form.expr_index)
    return frozenset(found)


def _emittable(graph: MLILGraph, thread: Thread) -> bool:
    """A chain tests the variable at its own size, so it needs one."""
    return thread.split is None or thread.split.condition is not None or graph.width(thread.split.key) >= 8


def _split(new, graph: MLILGraph, thread: Thread, labels: dict, origin: dict) -> None:
    last = graph.mlil[graph.il_block(thread.pred).end - 1]
    loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(last)
    new.set_current_address(last.address, graph.il_block(thread.pred).arch)
    split = thread.split
    if split.condition is not None:
        one, zero = MediumLevelILLabel(), MediumLevelILLabel()
        new.append(new.if_expr(lower(new, graph.with_refs(split.condition), loc), one, zero, loc), loc)
        for label, value in ((one, split.if_one), (zero, split.if_zero)):
            new.mark_label(label)
            _path(new, graph, split.outcomes[value], labels, origin)
        return
    # The value set holds every value the variable can have here: the last one needs no test.
    size, var = graph.width(split.key) // 8, graph.ssa_var(split.key).var
    ordered = sorted(split.outcomes)
    targets = [MediumLevelILLabel() for _ in ordered]
    for value, here in zip(ordered[:-1], targets):
        rest = MediumLevelILLabel()
        test = new.compare_equal(size, new.var(size, var, loc), new.const(size, value, loc), loc)
        new.append(new.if_expr(test, here, rest, loc), loc)
        new.mark_label(rest)
    new.append(new.goto(targets[-1], loc), loc)
    for value, here in zip(ordered, targets):
        new.mark_label(here)
        _path(new, graph, split.outcomes[value], labels, origin)


def _path(new, graph: MLILGraph, outcome: Outcome, labels: dict, origin: dict) -> None:
    mlil = graph.mlil
    for b in outcome.path:
        block = graph.il_block(b)
        for i in range(block.start, block.end - 1):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            origin[new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)] = i
    end = outcome.path[-1]
    last = mlil[graph.il_block(end).end - 1]
    loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(last)
    new.set_current_address(last.address, graph.il_block(end).arch)
    target = labels.get((end, _slot(graph, end, outcome.dest)))
    if target is None:
        target = new.get_label_for_source_instruction(graph.il_block(outcome.dest).start)
    new.append(new.goto(target, loc), loc)


def _slot(graph: MLILGraph, block: int, dest: int) -> str:
    term = graph.terminator(block)
    if isinstance(term, Branch):
        return "true" if term.true == dest else "false"
    return "goto"

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/selfcall.py`:

```py
"""A call to the function itself in tail position is a back edge (v4.3, spec 3.3).

In a copy of the MLIL, a new entry jumps to the original first block, which becomes a loop head, and each self call
in tail position becomes its parameters' new values and a goto there. A self call is a call, tail call or jump to
the function's own start (a jump Binary Ninja resolved there too), or to a forwarder (a function whose MLIL only
copies its parameters and calls, tail-calls or jumps to it with them, returning the result unchanged; built
without tail calls, a stub keeps a frame): a dispatcher returning through code pointers that lead back to itself.
In tail position: a tail call or jump, or a
call whose result reaches a return through copies and width changes only (a width change the function applies to
its own result is idempotent, so applying it once instead of at every level returns the same value).

A typed call gives each parameter its argument; a call without arguments (an untyped call, a jump, a forwarder
that passes registers through) gives each parameter the variable holding its register or stack slot at the call.
The call stays when an argument is the frame's own address (spec 3.3: turning such recursion into a loop changes
which frame it names), when the counts differ, or when the new values cannot be assigned one at a time.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Callable, Optional

from binaryninja import (ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, MediumLevelILOperation as Op,
                         VariableSourceType)

from ...unflatten.copies import sequence
from ..flow.apply import read_by
from .frame import Arguments

_CALLS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_CALL, Op.MLIL_CALL_UNTYPED})
_TAILS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_TAILCALL, Op.MLIL_TAILCALL_UNTYPED, Op.MLIL_JUMP, Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO})
_CONSTANTS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR})
_WIDTHS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_ZX, Op.MLIL_SX, Op.MLIL_LOW_PART})
_READS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_VAR, Op.MLIL_VAR_FIELD})
_ADDRESSES = frozenset({Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF, Op.MLIL_ADDRESS_OF_FIELD})
_SKIP = frozenset({Op.MLIL_NOP})
MAX_TRACE = 32  # definition trace bound; each typed argument gets its own quota
MAX_STEPS = 16  # instructions followed from a call to its return
FORWARDER_BYTES = 64  # a forwarder is at most this long
MAX_COPIES = 8  # copies followed from a forwarder's argument back to its parameter

Move = tuple[object, frozenset, Callable]  # (parameter, variables the value reads, emit(new, loc) -> expression)


def loop(mlil, view) -> Optional[tuple[MediumLevelILFunction, int, int]]:
    """(the copy, the loop head's block index in it, the number of self calls turned into back edges), or None
    when the function has none it may turn."""
    func = mlil.source_function
    params = list(func.parameter_vars)
    sites: dict[int, list[Move]] = {}
    forwards: dict[int, bool] = {}
    frame = Arguments(mlil, MAX_TRACE)
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            found = _site(mlil, i, func, view, params, forwards, frame)
            if found is not None:
                sites[i] = found
                break  # the rest of the block only returns the call's result
    if not sites:
        return None
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(mlil.arch, low_level_il=mlil.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(mlil)
    head = MediumLevelILLabel()
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        if block.start == 0:  # the entry: appended before the first block is prepared, the copy has no blocks
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(mlil[0])
            new.set_current_address(mlil[0].address, block.arch)
            new.append(new.goto(head, loc), loc)
            new.mark_label(head)
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            if i in sites:
                for dest, _, emit in sites[i]:
                    new.append(new.set_var(_size(dest), dest, emit(new, loc), loc), loc)
                new.append(new.goto(head, loc), loc)
                break
            new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)
    new.finalize()
    new.generate_ssa_form()
    entry = new.basic_blocks[0]  # the goto to the head, alone in its block
    return new, entry.outgoing_edges[0].target.index, len(sites)


def _site(mlil, i: int, func, view, params, forwards: dict[int, bool], frame: Arguments) -> Optional[list[Move]]:
    """The ordered parameter moves replacing the self call at instruction `i`, or None."""
    instr = mlil[i]
    if instr.operation not in _CALLS | _TAILS or instr.dest.operation not in _CONSTANTS:
        return None
    target = instr.dest.constant
    if target not in forwards:
        forwards[target] = _reaches_self(view, target, func.start)
    if not forwards[target]:
        return None
    if instr.operation in _CALLS and not _returned(mlil, i):
        return None
    return moves(mlil, i, params, frame)


def moves(mlil, i: int, params, frame: Optional[Arguments] = None) -> Optional[list[Move]]:
    """The ordered moves giving `params` the arguments of the call at instruction `i`, or None: the counts
    differ, an argument is the frame's own address, or the values cannot be assigned one at a time."""
    instr = mlil[i]
    args = list(getattr(instr, "params", []))
    if len(args) == len(params) and args:
        found = [(p, frozenset(a.vars_read), _copier(a, _size(p))) for p, a in zip(params, args) if not _same(a, p)]
        frame = frame or Arguments(mlil, MAX_TRACE)
        # One expression can be shared by calls on different SSA versions. Get arguments from
        # this call's SSA instruction, rather than mapping each child without its use context.
        ssa_args = list(instr.ssa_form.params)
        if len(ssa_args) != len(args) or any(frame.may_name_frame(a) for a in ssa_args):
            return None
    elif not args:
        found, seen = [], set()
        for p in params:
            source = _held_at(instr, p)
            if source is None:
                return None
            if source.identifier == p.identifier:
                continue
            if _defined_from_frame(mlil, source, seen):
                return None
            found.append((p, frozenset({source}), _reader(source, _size(p))))
    else:
        return None
    # By identifier: a spliced handler's parameters are its own Variables, the same storage as the caller's.
    order = sequence([(dest.identifier, frozenset(v.identifier for v in reads)) for dest, reads, _ in found])
    return None if order is None else [found[k] for k in order]


def _reaches_self(view, target: int, start: int) -> bool:
    """`target` is the function's own start, or a forwarder to it."""
    if target == start:
        return True
    callee = view.get_function_at(target)
    if callee is None or callee.highest_address - callee.start > FORWARDER_BYTES:
        return False
    mlil = callee.mlil
    if mlil is None:
        return False
    body = [i for i in mlil.instructions if i.operation not in _SKIP]
    calls = [k for k, i in enumerate(body) if i.operation in _CALLS | _TAILS]
    if len(calls) != 1:
        return False
    call = body[calls[0]]
    if call.dest.operation not in _CONSTANTS:
        read_by(view, target, start)  # a flow fix may resolve it to the function
        return False
    if call.dest.constant != start:
        return False
    if call.operation in _CALLS and not _returned(mlil, call.instr_index, widths=False):
        return False
    if any(i.operation != Op.MLIL_SET_VAR or i.src.operation != Op.MLIL_VAR for i in body[:calls[0]]):
        return False
    forwarded = list(getattr(call, "params", []))
    own = list(callee.parameter_vars)
    return not forwarded or (len(forwarded) == len(own) and all(_copied(mlil, a, p) for a, p in zip(forwarded, own)))


def _copied(mlil, expr, param) -> bool:
    """`expr` reads `param` through copies only."""
    for _ in range(MAX_COPIES):
        if expr.operation != Op.MLIL_VAR:
            return False
        if expr.src.identifier == param.identifier:
            return True
        found = mlil.get_var_definitions(expr.src)
        if len(found) != 1 or found[0].operation != Op.MLIL_SET_VAR:
            return False
        expr = found[0].src
    return False


def _returned(mlil, i: int, widths: bool = True) -> bool:
    """The call's result reaches a return through copies and (with `widths`) width changes only, nothing else
    executed."""
    tracked = set(mlil[i].output)
    j = i + 1
    for _ in range(MAX_STEPS):
        if j >= len(mlil):
            return False
        instr = mlil[j]
        op = instr.operation
        if op in _SKIP:
            j += 1
        elif op == Op.MLIL_GOTO:
            j = instr.dest
        elif op == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR and _read_of(instr.src, widths) in tracked:
            tracked.add(instr.dest)
            j += 1
        elif op == Op.MLIL_RET:
            return all(_read_of(s, widths) in tracked for s in instr.src) and (bool(instr.src) or not mlil[i].output)
        else:
            return False
    return False


def _read_of(expr, widths: bool = True):
    """The variable `expr` reads, through width changes with `widths`, or None."""
    while widths and expr.operation in _WIDTHS:
        expr = expr.src
    if widths and expr.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_FIELD and expr.offset == 0:
        return expr.src
    return expr.src if expr.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR else None


def _same(expr, var) -> bool:
    return expr.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR and expr.src.identifier == var.identifier


def _held_at(instr, param):
    """The variable holding the parameter's register or stack slot at `instr`, or None."""
    storage = param.storage
    try:
        if param.source_type == VariableSourceType.RegisterVariableSourceType:
            return instr.get_var_for_reg(storage)
        if param.source_type == VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType:
            return instr.get_var_for_stack_location(storage)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - no variable for that storage here
        return None
    return None


def _frame_address(mlil, expr, seen: set) -> bool:
    """`expr` may be the address of something in the frame: it takes one, or reads a variable defined from one
    (every definition of it; past MAX_TRACE variables in `seen`, assumed to)."""
    stack = [expr]
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        if node.operation in _ADDRESSES:
            return True
        if node.operation in _READS and _defined_from_frame(mlil, node.src, seen):
            return True
        stack.extend(o for o in node.operands if hasattr(o, "operation"))
    return False


def _defined_from_frame(mlil, var, seen: set) -> bool:
    if var in seen:
        return False  # being checked, or checked already
    seen.add(var)
    if len(seen) > MAX_TRACE:
        return True
    for d in mlil.get_var_definitions(var):
        src = getattr(d, "src", None)
        if not hasattr(src, "operation"):
            if d.operation not in _CALLS | _TAILS:  # a call's result is the callee's; anything else is unknown
                return True
            continue
        if _frame_address(mlil, src, seen):
            return True
    return False


def _size(var) -> int:
    t = var.type
    return t.width if t is not None and t.width else 8


def _copier(expr, size: int) -> Callable:
    return lambda new, loc: _fit(new, expr.copy_to(new), expr.size, size, loc)


def _reader(var, size: int) -> Callable:
    return lambda new, loc: _fit(new, new.var(_size(var), var, loc), _size(var), size, loc)


def _fit(new, expr, width: int, size: int, loc):
    """`expr`, `width` bytes wide, as the parameter's `size` bytes: its low part, or zero-extended (a register
    written at half width is zero-extended on the 64-bit architectures)."""
    if width > size:
        return new.low_part(size, expr, loc)
    if width < size:
        return new.zero_extend(size, expr, loc)
    return expr

```

`binja_d810/binja/unflatten/splice.py`:

```py
"""Handlers spliced into their dispatcher (v4.3b, spec 3.3): outlined flattening moves each state's code into a
function of its own, which the dispatcher calls in tail position and which returns through a call back to the
dispatcher.

In a copy of the MLIL, each call to a handler in tail position (a tail call, or a call whose result reaches a
return through copies only) becomes the handler's parameters taking the call's arguments, then the handler's own
MLIL; its calls back to the dispatcher are then self calls in tail position (selfcall). A variable keeps its
identifier, so a handler's variables may share the dispatcher's: nothing of the dispatcher is live after such a
call. Hidden handler inputs must match unchanged caller parameters. A dispatcher's undeclared register inputs require native
preservation evidence and disjoint handler storage; unmodeled frame/stack state still rejects. A handler is
copied, not moved: other callers keep calling it.

A handler is a function called at a constant address with at most SPLICE_INSTRUCTIONS of MLIL and no jump table,
which ends only in returns and tail calls and calls the dispatcher (or a forwarder to it). A function with more
than MAX_HANDLERS has none spliced.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Optional

from binaryninja import ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, MediumLevelILOperation as Op

from ..flow.apply import read_by
from . import entry, incoming, selfcall

SPLICE_INSTRUCTIONS = 256  # MLIL instructions in a handler
MAX_HANDLERS = 64  # distinct handlers spliced into one function
_EXITS = frozenset({Op.MLIL_RET, Op.MLIL_NORET}) | selfcall._TAILS
_TARGETED = frozenset({Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO})  # instructions naming blocks other than goto and if


def handlers(mlil, view) -> Optional[tuple[MediumLevelILFunction, int]]:
    """(the copy, the number of distinct handlers spliced into it), or None when the function has none."""
    func = mlil.source_function
    context = None
    found: dict[int, object] = {}
    forwards: dict[int, bool] = {}
    sites: dict[int, tuple[object, list, incoming.Inputs]] = {}
    frame = None
    for instr in mlil.instructions:
        i = instr.instr_index
        if instr.operation not in selfcall._TAILS | selfcall._CALLS or instr.dest.operation not in selfcall._CONSTANTS:
            continue
        if instr.operation in selfcall._CALLS and not selfcall._returned(mlil, i, widths=False):
            continue
        target = instr.dest.constant
        if target == func.start:
            continue  # selfcall handles these; they are not separate handlers
        if context is None:
            context = entry.Preserved(mlil, func.parameter_vars)
            if not context.supported:
                return None
        if not context.at(func, instr.address):
            continue
        if target not in found:
            found[target] = _handler(view, target, func, forwards, context)
        handler = found[target]
        if handler is None:
            continue
        callee, inputs = handler
        if not inputs.at(instr):
            continue
        frame = frame or selfcall.Arguments(mlil, selfcall.MAX_TRACE)
        moves = selfcall.moves(mlil, i, list(callee.parameter_vars), frame)
        if moves is not None:
            sites[i] = (callee, moves, inputs)
    count = len({callee.start for callee, _, _ in sites.values()})
    if not sites or count > MAX_HANDLERS:
        return None
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(mlil.arch, low_level_il=mlil.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(mlil)
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            if i not in sites:
                new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)
                continue
            callee, moves, inputs = sites[i]
            for dest, _, emit in moves:
                new.append(new.set_var(selfcall._size(dest), dest, emit(new, loc), loc), loc)
            _append_body(new, inputs.mlil, loc, inputs.returns)
            break  # the rest of the block only returns the call's result
    new.finalize()
    new.generate_ssa_form()
    return new, count


def _handler(view, target: int, func, forwards: dict[int, bool], context=None):
    """The handler and its proven incoming bindings, or None."""
    if _back(view, target, func.start, forwards):
        return None  # the dispatcher itself or a forwarder to it: selfcall's
    callee = view.get_function_at(target)
    mlil = None if callee is None else callee.mlil
    if mlil is None or len(mlil) > SPLICE_INSTRUCTIONS:
        return None
    if any(not block.outgoing_edges and mlil[block.end - 1].operation not in _EXITS for block in mlil.basic_blocks):
        return None
    back = indirect = False
    for instr in mlil.instructions:
        if instr.operation in _TARGETED:
            return None
        if instr.operation in selfcall._CALLS | selfcall._TAILS:
            if instr.dest.operation not in selfcall._CONSTANTS:
                indirect = True
            else:
                returns = _back(view, instr.dest.constant, func.start, forwards)
                if returns and instr.dest.constant != func.start and context is not None and context.registers:
                    forwarder = view.get_function_at(instr.dest.constant)
                    if forwarder is None or forwarder.mlil is None or not context.by(forwarder.mlil):
                        return None
                back = back or returns
    if indirect:
        read_by(view, target, func.start)  # a flow fix may resolve it back to the dispatcher
    if not back:
        return None
    read_by(view, target, func.start)  # folding a handler's loads can make its inherited inputs provable
    inputs = incoming.Inputs(func, mlil)
    if not inputs.supported:
        return None
    if context is not None and not context.by(mlil):
        return None
    return callee, inputs


def _back(view, target: int, start: int, forwards: dict[int, bool]) -> bool:
    if target not in forwards:
        forwards[target] = selfcall._reaches_self(view, target, start)
    return forwards[target]


def _reads_entry(mlil, params) -> bool:
    """The function reads a variable other than its parameters before writing it: its entry version reaches a
    use other than a phi, through phis (Binary Ninja keeps phis of variables dead at the merge)."""
    return next(entry.variables(mlil, params), None) is not None


def _append_body(new, mlil, loc, returns) -> None:
    """Append the handler under its own labels. `returns` supplies proven shared stack arguments."""
    labels = {block.start: MediumLevelILLabel() for block in mlil.basic_blocks}
    new.append(new.goto(labels[0], loc), loc)
    for block in mlil.basic_blocks:
        new.mark_label(labels[block.start])
        for i in range(block.start, block.end):
            instr = mlil[i]
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            at = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            if i in returns:
                args = [a.copy_to(new) for a in instr.params]
                args.extend(new.var(selfcall._size(p), p, at) for p in returns[i])
                new.append(new.tailcall(instr.output, instr.dest.copy_to(new), args, at), at)
            elif instr.operation == Op.MLIL_GOTO:
                new.append(new.goto(labels[instr.dest], at), at)
            elif instr.operation == Op.MLIL_IF:
                new.append(new.if_expr(instr.condition.copy_to(new), labels[instr.true], labels[instr.false], at), at)
            else:
                new.append(instr.copy_to(new), at)

```

`binja_d810/binja/workflow.py`:

```py
"""Registers the D-810 activities on Binary Ninja's function workflows.

Two passes, one toggle: the MLIL activity runs after MLIL generation and is the one
users enable ("D-810: simplify MBA expressions"); the HLIL activity runs after HLIL generation for
every function and returns at once unless that same setting is on. It sees HLIL generated from the
already rewritten MLIL, so it only acts on what the MLIL pass could not express. Unflattening (v4.2)
follows the same toggle in an activity of its own, after Binary Ninja resolves indirect branches.
"""

import ctypes
import json
import time
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Optional

from binaryninja import Activity, AnalysisContext, Workflow, log_info
from binaryninja.interaction import show_plain_text_report

from ..deadline import Deadline
from ..flow.ranges import parse as parse_ranges
from ..rules.registry import load_rules
from ..semantic.backend import default_backends
from . import allocation_roundtrips, annotations, budget, constant_buffers, flag_conditions, log, scratch, settings, unflatten
from .engine import simplify_function
from .flow import apply as flow_apply, branches
from .callees import activity as callees
from .hlil.adapter import HLILAdapter
from .mlil.adapter import MLILAdapter

ACTIVITY_NAME = "extension.binja_d810.mba"
# Key of the enable setting Binary Ninja generates from eligibility.auto (per view / per function).
# Confirmed by tests/binja/test_environment.py::test_auto_setting_identifier.
ACTIVITY_SETTING = ACTIVITY_NAME
HLIL_ACTIVITY_NAME = "extension.binja_d810.mba_hlil"
BRANCHES_ACTIVITY_NAME = "extension.binja_d810.branches"
BRANCH_RESET = "core.function.resetIndirectBranchesOnFullUpdate"
UNFLATTEN_ACTIVITY_NAME = "extension.binja_d810.unflatten"
CALLEES_ACTIVITY_NAME = "extension.binja_d810.callees"
# That analysis reads ctx.mlil: a rewrite before it removes the jump it resolves, and the function's
# analysis then never settles (v4.2, measured). Without it, unflattening follows the MLIL pass.
UNFLATTEN_AFTER = "core.function.analyzeIndirectBranches"
BASE_WORKFLOWS = ("core.function.metaAnalysis", "core.function.objectiveC")
DISPATCH_RESERVE_SECONDS = 10.0

_ACTIVITIES: list[Activity] = []  # keep callbacks alive
_rules_override: Optional[list] = None
_levels_override: Optional[frozenset] = None
_backends_override: Optional[list] = None


def set_rules_override(rules: Optional[list]) -> None:
    """Testing hook: replace the Tier 1 rule list (None restores the registry)."""
    global _rules_override
    _rules_override = rules


def set_backends_override(backends: Optional[list]) -> None:
    """Testing hook: replace the Tier 2 backends (None restores the defaults)."""
    global _backends_override
    _backends_override = backends


def set_levels_override(levels: Optional[set]) -> None:
    """Testing hook: run only these passes ({"mlil"}, {"hlil"}); None runs both."""
    global _levels_override
    _levels_override = None if levels is None else frozenset(levels)


@lru_cache(maxsize=8)
def _rules(disabled: frozenset[str]) -> tuple:
    return tuple(load_rules(disabled))


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def _backends() -> tuple:
    return tuple(default_backends())


def _enabled(ctx) -> bool:
    func = ctx.function
    return (func is not None and ctx.get_setting_bool(ACTIVITY_SETTING) and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.ENABLED)
            and func.start not in settings.skipped_functions(ctx))


def _analysis_limit_ms(ctx) -> int:
    try:
        return ctx.get_setting_uint64("analysis.limits.maxFunctionAnalysisTime")
    except Exception:
        return 20_000


def _handle(il) -> int:
    return ctypes.addressof(il.handle.contents)


def _flow(ctx, adapter, func, report) -> bool:
    """The flow fixes (v4.0), after the MLIL pass. True when they changed the MLIL."""
    try:
        enabled = ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.FLOW_FIXES)
        flow_apply.observe_enabled(func, enabled, ctx.get_setting_string_list(settings.READ_ONLY_RANGES))
        if not enabled:
            flow_apply.release(func.view, func.start)
            return False
        return flow_apply.after_pass(func.view, func, adapter, report)
    except Exception as exc:  # never break analysis
        from . import completion
        completion.failed(func.view)
        log.logger.log_error(f"binja-d810 flow fixes failed at {func.start:#x}: {exc!r}")
        return False


def _begin(ctx, config, level: str, il) -> budget.Allowance:
    # One allowance per function and analysis run, shared by all passes: the generation is the
    # MLIL the MLIL pass produced, which the later activities see as ctx.mlil (binja/budget.py).
    func, mlil = ctx.function, ctx.mlil
    from . import limits  # it imports this module

    # The limit Binary Ninja really applies: the one the binary was opened with (v3.3, measured).
    limit_ms = limits.in_effect_ms(func, _analysis_limit_ms(ctx))
    return budget.LEDGER.begin((func.view.file.session_id, func.start), level,
                               generation=_handle(mlil) if mlil is not None else _handle(il),
                               keepalive=mlil if mlil is not None else il,
                               allowance=budget.plugin_allowance(config.function_seconds, limit_ms))


def _run(ctx, level: str) -> None:
    from . import completion
    if _levels_override is not None and level not in _levels_override:
        return
    func = ctx.function
    il = ctx.mlil if level == "mlil" else ctx.hlil
    if il is None:
        return
    completion.touch(func.view)
    config = settings.engine_config(ctx)
    rules = _rules_override if _rules_override is not None else _rules(config.disabled_rules)
    allowance = _begin(ctx, config, level, il)
    offered = allowance.remaining()
    early = callees.take(func) if level == "mlil" else None
    if early is not None:
        allowance.charge(early.seconds)
        allowance.deadline = allowance.deadline.earlier(Deadline.after(allowance.remaining()))
    reserved = probe_seconds = probe_cpu = 0.0
    if level == "mlil" and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.UNFLATTEN) and allowance.remaining() >= 2:
        started, cpu = time.monotonic(), time.thread_time()
        remaining = allowance.remaining()
        ranges, _ = parse_ranges(ctx.get_setting_string_list(settings.READ_ONLY_RANGES))
        probe_deadline = allowance.deadline.earlier(Deadline.after(min(1.0, remaining / 20)))
        if unflatten.has_table_dispatcher(il, func.view, deadline=probe_deadline, ranges=ranges):
            # Recovery and the resulting HLIL both need a turn. One slow backend call can overrun
            # the MLIL deadline, so a small tail allowance alone can still starve both later passes.
            reserved = min(DISPATCH_RESERVE_SECONDS, remaining / 2)
        probe_seconds, probe_cpu = time.monotonic() - started, time.thread_time() - cpu
    deadline = Deadline(allowance.deadline.at - reserved)
    allocations = None
    allocation_changed = False
    if level == "mlil" and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.ALLOCATIONS):
        original = il
        il, allocations = allocation_roundtrips.run(il, settings.allocation_limits(ctx), deadline)
        allocation_changed = il is not original
        if allocation_changed:
            allowance.adopt(_handle(il), il)
    scratch_report = None
    scratch_changed = False
    if level == "mlil" and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.SCRATCH):
        original = il
        il, scratch_report = scratch.run(il, settings.scratch_limits(ctx), deadline)
        scratch_changed = il is not original
        if scratch_changed:
            allowance.adopt(_handle(il), il)
    flags = flag_conditions.run(il, level, settings.flag_limits(ctx), deadline) \
        if ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.FLAGS) else None
    constants = None
    constant_changed = False
    if level == "mlil":
        if ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.CONSTANT_BUFFERS):
            original = il
            il, constants = constant_buffers.run(il, settings.constant_limits(ctx), deadline)
            constant_changed = il is not original
            if constant_changed: allowance.adopt(_handle(il), il)
        sites = []
        if constants is not None:
            texts = {}
            for address, text in constants.strings: texts.setdefault(address, []).append(text)
            sites = [annotations.Site(func.start, address, settings.CONSTANT_BUFFERS,
                     "D810 buffer text: " + ", ".join(json.dumps(text) for text in dict.fromkeys(values)), constants.evidence,
                     (settings.CONSTANT_COMMENTS,))
                     for address, values in texts.items()]
        annotations.reconcile(func, settings.CONSTANT_BUFFERS, sites,
                              ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.CONSTANT_COMMENTS) and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.FLOW_FIXES))
    make = MLILAdapter if level == "mlil" else HLILAdapter
    adapter = make(il, config.limits.max_nodes, deadline)
    backends = _backends_override if _backends_override is not None else _backends()
    report = simplify_function(adapter, rules, backends if config.tier2 else (), config, deadline)
    report.reserved_seconds = reserved
    report.dispatch_probe_seconds = probe_seconds
    report.allowance_seconds += probe_seconds
    report.total_seconds += probe_seconds
    report.plan_seconds += probe_seconds
    report.plan_cpu_seconds += probe_cpu
    if scratch_report is not None:
        _scratch_report(report, scratch_report, "before MBA")
        report.total_seconds += scratch_report.seconds
        report.plan_seconds += scratch_report.seconds
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += scratch_report.cpu_seconds
        report.allowance_seconds += scratch_report.seconds
    if flags is not None:
        report.flags, report.flag_conditions = flags.notes, flags.conditions
        report.flag_seconds = flags.seconds
        report.budget_exhausted |= flags.exhausted
        report.total_seconds += flags.seconds
        report.plan_seconds += flags.seconds
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += flags.cpu_seconds
        report.allowance_seconds += flags.seconds
    if allocations is not None:
        report.allocations = allocations.notes
        report.allocation_loads, report.allocation_lifetimes = allocations.loads, allocations.lifetimes
        report.allocation_seconds = allocations.seconds
        report.budget_exhausted |= allocations.exhausted
        report.total_seconds += allocations.seconds
        report.plan_seconds += allocations.seconds
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += allocations.cpu_seconds
        report.allowance_seconds += allocations.seconds
    if constants is not None:
        report.constant_buffers, report.constant_strings = constants.notes, constants.strings
        report.constant_regions, report.constant_steps = constants.regions, constants.steps
        report.constant_seconds = constants.seconds
        report.budget_exhausted |= constants.exhausted
        report.total_seconds += constants.seconds; report.plan_seconds += constants.seconds
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += constants.cpu_seconds; report.allowance_seconds += constants.seconds
    changed = _flow(ctx, adapter, func, report) if level == "mlil" else False
    allowance.charge(report.total_seconds)
    if early is not None:
        report.callees = early.notes
        report.callee_calls = early.calls
        report.budget_exhausted |= early.exhausted
        report.total_seconds += early.seconds
        report.plan_seconds += early.seconds
        report.plan_cpu_seconds += early.cpu_seconds
        report.allowance_seconds += early.seconds
    report.allowance_seconds = min(report.allowance_seconds, max(0.0, offered - reserved))
    report.overrun_seconds = max(report.overrun_seconds, report.total_seconds - report.allowance_seconds)
    log.record(func, report, level)
    if report.errors or report.rolled_back:
        completion.failed(func.view)
    if report.rewrites or changed or scratch_changed or allocation_changed or constant_changed or report.flag_conditions:
        if level == "mlil":
            ctx.mlil = il
        else:
            ctx.hlil = il


def _scratch_report(report, result, phase):
    report.scratch_stores += result.stores
    report.scratch_accesses += result.accesses
    report.scratch_aliases += result.aliases
    report.scratch_computations += result.computations
    report.scratch_seconds += result.seconds
    report.budget_exhausted |= result.exhausted
    report.scratch.extend(f"{phase}: {line}" for line in result.notes)


def _scratch_cleanup(ctx):
    if ctx.mlil is None or not ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.SCRATCH):
        return
    original = ctx.mlil
    allowance = _begin(ctx, settings.engine_config(ctx), "mlil", original)
    cleaned, result = scratch.run(original, settings.scratch_limits(ctx), allowance.deadline)
    allowance.charge(result.seconds)
    if cleaned is not original:
        ctx.mlil = cleaned
        allowance.adopt(_handle(cleaned), cleaned)
    report = log.latest_report(ctx.function, "mlil")
    if report is not None:
        _scratch_report(report, result, "after control flow")
    if result.stores or result.accesses or result.aliases or result.computations:
        log.logger.log_info(f"{ctx.function.start:#x} scratch after control flow: removed {result.stores} stores and "
                            f"{result.computations} unused computations; promoted {result.accesses} accesses")
    for line in result.notes:
        log.logger.log_debug(f"{ctx.function.start:#x} scratch after control flow: {line}")


def _unflatten(ctx) -> None:
    """Unflattening (v4.2): the MLIL pass's allowance and report, and each round committed to ctx.mlil."""
    func, mlil = ctx.function, ctx.mlil
    if mlil is None or not ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.UNFLATTEN):
        return
    from . import completion
    completion.touch(func.view)
    allowance = _begin(ctx, settings.engine_config(ctx), "mlil", mlil)
    ranges, _ = parse_ranges(ctx.get_setting_string_list(settings.READ_ONLY_RANGES))
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        lines = unflatten.run(ctx, deadline=allowance.deadline, ranges=ranges)
    finally:
        allowance.charge(time.monotonic() - started)
        if _handle(ctx.mlil) != _handle(mlil):
            allowance.adopt(_handle(ctx.mlil), ctx.mlil)  # the HLIL pass sees the unflattened MLIL
    report = log.latest_report(func, "mlil")
    if report is not None:
        report.unflatten = lines
    for line in lines:
        log.logger.log_info(f"{func.start:#x} unflatten: {line}")


def debug_report_text(func) -> str:
    """The D-810 debug report: each pass's report, then what the flow fixes did or skipped for the function."""
    reports = log.latest_reports(func)
    text = "\n\n".join(f"== {level.upper()} pass\n{log.render(r)}" for level, r in reports.items())
    notes = flow_apply.notes_for(func.view, func.start)
    if notes:
        text += "\n\n== flow\n" + "\n".join(notes)
    return text


def run_activity(ctx: AnalysisContext) -> None:
    try:
        if _enabled(ctx):
            _run(ctx, "mlil")
        elif ctx.function is not None:
            log.forget(ctx.function, "mlil")
            flow_apply.release(ctx.function.view, ctx.function.start)
    except Exception as exc:  # never break analysis
        from . import completion
        if ctx.function is not None:
            completion.failed(ctx.function.view)
        log.logger.log_error(f"binja-d810 MLIL activity failed: {exc!r}")


def run_hlil_activity(ctx: AnalysisContext) -> None:
    try:
        if not _enabled(ctx):
            if ctx.function is not None:
                log.forget(ctx.function, "hlil")
                flow_apply.observe_enabled(ctx.function, False, [])
                flow_apply.release(ctx.function.view, ctx.function.start)
            return
        _run(ctx, "hlil")
        func = ctx.function
        if func.check_for_debug_report("d810"):
            show_plain_text_report(f"D-810: {func.name}", debug_report_text(func))
    except Exception as exc:  # never break analysis
        from . import completion
        if ctx.function is not None:
            completion.failed(ctx.function.view)
        log.logger.log_error(f"binja-d810 HLIL activity failed: {exc!r}")


def run_unflatten_activity(ctx: AnalysisContext) -> None:
    func = ctx.function
    try:
        if _enabled(ctx) and (_levels_override is None or "mlil" in _levels_override):
            _unflatten(ctx)
            _scratch_cleanup(ctx)
    except Exception as exc:  # never break analysis: the last committed MLIL stays
        from . import completion
        if func is not None:
            completion.failed(func.view)
        log.logger.log_error(f"binja-d810 unflatten failed at {func.start:#x}: {exc!r}")


def run_branches_activity(ctx: AnalysisContext) -> None:
    try:
        enabled = _enabled(ctx) and ctx.get_setting_bool(settings.FLOW_FIXES)
        if ctx.function is not None:
            flow_apply.observe_enabled(ctx.function, enabled, ctx.get_setting_string_list(settings.READ_ONLY_RANGES))
            flow_apply.restore_inline(ctx.function)
        if enabled:
            branches.apply_branches(ctx.function)
        elif ctx.function is not None:
            # The MBA activity's eligibility skips its callback entirely when its toggle is off.
            flow_apply.release(ctx.function.view, ctx.function.start)
    except Exception as exc:  # never break analysis
        from . import completion
        if ctx.function is not None:
            completion.failed(ctx.function.view)
        log.logger.log_error(f"binja-d810 branches activity failed: {exc!r}")


def register(action=None, hlil_action=None, branches_action=None, unflatten_action=None) -> list[str]:
    action = action or run_activity
    hlil_action = hlil_action or run_hlil_activity
    branches_action = branches_action or run_branches_activity
    unflatten_action = unflatten_action or run_unflatten_activity
    config = json.dumps({
        "name": ACTIVITY_NAME,
        "title": "D-810: simplify MBA expressions",
        "description": "Rewrites mixed boolean-arithmetic obfuscation in MLIL, then HLIL (binja-d810).",
        "eligibility": {"auto": {"default": False}},
    })
    # No eligibility of its own: it follows ACTIVITY_SETTING (one toggle for both passes).
    hlil_config = json.dumps({
        "name": HLIL_ACTIVITY_NAME,
        "title": "D-810: simplify MBA expressions (HLIL pass)",
        "description": "Rewrites in HLIL what the MLIL pass could not; enabled by the D-810 setting.",
    })
    branches_config = json.dumps({
        "name": BRANCHES_ACTIVITY_NAME,
        "title": "D-810: computed jump targets",
        "description": "Restores recorded wrapper inline flags and computed jump targets (binja-d810).",
    })
    unflatten_config = json.dumps({
        "name": UNFLATTEN_ACTIVITY_NAME,
        "title": "D-810: unflatten control flow",
        "description": "Threads flattened control flow past its dispatcher in MLIL; enabled by the D-810 setting.",
    })
    callees_config = json.dumps({
        "name": CALLEES_ACTIVITY_NAME, "title": "D-810: pure-callee summaries",
        "description": "Substitute proven arithmetic helpers before calling-convention inference.",
    })
    registered = []
    for base in BASE_WORKFLOWS:
        if base not in Workflow:
            continue
        activity = Activity(configuration=config, action=action)
        hlil_activity = Activity(configuration=hlil_config, action=hlil_action)
        branches_activity = Activity(configuration=branches_config, action=branches_action)
        unflatten_activity = Activity(configuration=unflatten_config, action=unflatten_action)
        callees_activity = Activity(configuration=callees_config, action=callees.run)
        _ACTIVITIES.extend([activity, hlil_activity, branches_activity, unflatten_activity, callees_activity])
        wf = Workflow(base).clone(base)
        wf.register_activity(activity)
        wf.register_activity(hlil_activity)
        wf.register_activity(callees_activity)
        wf.insert_after("core.function.generateLiftedIL", [CALLEES_ACTIVITY_NAME])
        wf.insert_after("core.function.generateMediumLevelIL", [ACTIVITY_NAME])
        wf.insert_after("core.function.generateHighLevelIL", [HLIL_ACTIVITY_NAME])
        wf.register_activity(branches_activity)
        if wf.contains(BRANCH_RESET):
            wf.insert_after(BRANCH_RESET, [BRANCHES_ACTIVITY_NAME])
        wf.register_activity(unflatten_activity)
        wf.insert_after(UNFLATTEN_AFTER if wf.contains(UNFLATTEN_AFTER) else ACTIVITY_NAME, [UNFLATTEN_ACTIVITY_NAME])
        wf.register()
        registered.append(base)
    log_info(f"binja-d810: activities {ACTIVITY_NAME}, {HLIL_ACTIVITY_NAME}, {BRANCHES_ACTIVITY_NAME}, "
             f"{UNFLATTEN_ACTIVITY_NAME} registered on {registered}")
    return registered
```

`binja_d810/consteval/comments.py`:

```py
"""Remove only an unchanged owned line, preserving surrounding user text."""


def remove_line(current, owned):
    if current == owned:
        return ""
    if current.endswith("\n" + owned):
        return current[:-len(owned) - 1]
    lines = current.splitlines(keepends=True)
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if line.rstrip("\r\n") == owned:
            del lines[index]
            return "".join(lines)
    return current
```

`binja_d810/consteval/program.py`:

```py
"""An IL-independent interpreter. Unknown values/effects cancel the whole proposed region.

The native adapter must establish region entry, readonly inputs, local-buffer identity, live-outs
and a single exit before replacing any code. This core supplies exact bytes, not that CFG proof.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from ..deadline import Deadline
from ..ir.evaluate import evaluate
from ..ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, UnOp, Var, tree_size, variables


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Limits:
    instructions: int = 4096
    nodes: int = 2000
    steps: int = 10000
    trips: int = 256
    buffer_bytes: int = 4096
    buffers: int = 16
    work: int = 40000


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Address:
    buffer: str
    offset: int
    width: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AddressOf:
    destination: str
    buffer: str
    offset: Expr
    width: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class LoadIndirect:
    destination: str
    address: Expr
    size: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StoreIndirect:
    address: Expr
    value: Expr


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Assign:
    destination: str
    value: Expr


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Store:
    buffer: str
    offset: Expr
    value: Expr


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Load:
    destination: str
    buffer: str
    offset: Expr
    size: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Branch:
    condition: Expr
    yes: int
    no: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Jump:
    target: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Stop:
    pass


@dataclass
class Result:
    buffers: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    values: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
    visited: frozenset = frozenset()
    steps: int = 0
    reason: str = ""


def run(program, buffers, *, entry=0, limits=Limits(), little_endian=True, deadline=Deadline.never()):
    if type(entry) is not int or any(type(index) is not int or index < 0 for index in program):
        return Result(reason="constant region instruction identity is invalid")
    if len(program) > limits.instructions or len(buffers) > limits.buffers:
        return Result(reason="constant region size limit")
    if any(type(size) is not int or size <= 0 for size in buffers.values()) \
            or sum(buffers.values()) > limits.buffer_bytes:
        return Result(reason="constant region buffer limit")
    memory = {name: [None] * size for name, size in buffers.items()}
    values, widths, counts, visited = {}, {}, {}, set()
    pc, steps = entry, 0
    work = 0
    order = "little" if little_endian else "big"

    def calculate(expression):
        nonlocal work
        work += 1
        if work > limits.work or deadline.expired():
            raise ValueError("constant evaluation expression work limit")
        if isinstance(expression, Const):
            return expression.value
        if isinstance(expression, Var):
            return values[expression.name]
        if isinstance(expression, UnOp):
            value = calculate(expression.operand)
            if isinstance(value, Address):
                raise ValueError("local pointer bits are not known")
            return evaluate(UnOp(expression.op, Const(value, expression.operand.width), expression.width), {})
        a, b = calculate(expression.left), calculate(expression.right)
        if isinstance(a, Address) or isinstance(b, Address):
            if isinstance(a, Address) and isinstance(b, Address):
                if a.buffer != b.buffer or a.width != b.width:
                    raise ValueError("unproved relationship between local pointers")
                if expression.op in ("eq", "ne"):
                    return int((a.offset == b.offset) == (expression.op == "eq"))
                if expression.op == "sub" and expression.width == a.width:
                    return (a.offset - b.offset) & ((1 << a.width) - 1)
                raise ValueError("local pointer ordering or bits are not known")
            if expression.op == "add" and isinstance(b, Address):
                a, b = b, a
            if isinstance(a, Address) and expression.width == a.width and expression.op in ("add", "sub"):
                return Address(a.buffer, (a.offset + (b if expression.op == "add" else -b)) & ((1 << a.width) - 1), a.width)
            raise ValueError("local pointer bits are not known")
        return evaluate(BinOp(expression.op, Const(a, expression.left.width), Const(b, expression.right.width), expression.width), {})

    def expr(expression):
        if deadline.expired() or tree_size(expression) > limits.nodes:
            raise ValueError("constant expression budget exhausted")
        for variable in variables(expression):
            if variable.name not in values:
                raise ValueError("constant region has an unknown input")
            if widths[variable.name] != variable.width:
                raise ValueError("constant variable width is ambiguous")
        return calculate(expression)

    def integer(expression):
        value = expr(expression)
        if isinstance(value, Address):
            raise ValueError("local pointer is observed as data")
        return value

    def span(name, offset, size):
        if name not in memory or offset < 0 or size <= 0 or offset + size > len(memory[name]):
            raise ValueError("constant buffer access out of bounds")
        return memory[name]

    try:
        while True:
            if steps >= limits.steps or deadline.expired():
                raise ValueError("constant evaluation step budget exhausted")
            counts[pc] = counts.get(pc, 0) + 1
            if counts[pc] > limits.trips:
                raise ValueError("constant evaluation trip limit")
            if pc not in program:
                raise ValueError("constant region has an unknown exit")
            node = program[pc]
            steps += 1
            visited.add(pc)
            if isinstance(node, Stop):
                return Result({name: tuple(data) for name, data in memory.items()}, dict(values),
                              frozenset(visited), steps)
            if isinstance(node, Assign):
                values[node.destination] = expr(node.value)
                widths[node.destination] = node.value.width
            elif isinstance(node, AddressOf):
                if node.buffer not in memory or node.width < 1 or len(memory[node.buffer]) > 1 << node.width:
                    raise ValueError("local pointer extent is unproved")
                values[node.destination] = Address(node.buffer, integer(node.offset) & ((1 << node.width) - 1), node.width)
                widths[node.destination] = node.width
            elif isinstance(node, Store):
                if node.value.width % 8:
                    raise ValueError("constant store is not byte-sized")
                offset, size = integer(node.offset), node.value.width // 8
                data = span(node.buffer, offset, size)
                data[offset:offset + size] = integer(node.value).to_bytes(size, order)
            elif isinstance(node, Load):
                offset = integer(node.offset)
                data = span(node.buffer, offset, node.size)[offset:offset + node.size]
                if None in data:
                    raise ValueError("constant load has uninitialized bytes")
                values[node.destination] = int.from_bytes(data, order)
                widths[node.destination] = node.size * 8
            elif isinstance(node, (LoadIndirect, StoreIndirect)):
                address = expr(node.address)
                if not isinstance(address, Address):
                    raise ValueError("constant region accesses unknown memory")
                size = node.size if isinstance(node, LoadIndirect) else node.value.width // 8
                if isinstance(node, StoreIndirect) and node.value.width % 8:
                    raise ValueError("constant store is not byte-sized")
                data = span(address.buffer, address.offset, size)
                if isinstance(node, StoreIndirect):
                    data[address.offset:address.offset + size] = integer(node.value).to_bytes(size, order)
                else:
                    selected = data[address.offset:address.offset + size]
                    if None in selected:
                        raise ValueError("constant load has uninitialized bytes")
                    values[node.destination] = int.from_bytes(selected, order)
                    widths[node.destination] = size * 8
            elif isinstance(node, Branch):
                if node.condition.width != 1:
                    raise ValueError("constant branch is not boolean")
                pc = node.yes if integer(node.condition) else node.no
                continue
            elif isinstance(node, Jump):
                pc = node.target
                continue
            else:
                raise ValueError("constant region contains an unknown effect")
            pc += 1
    except KeyError:
        return Result(steps=steps, reason="constant region has an unknown input")
    except (ValueError, ArithmeticError, RecursionError) as exc:
        return Result(steps=steps, reason=str(exc) or "constant expression depth unsupported")

```

`binja_d810/consteval/state.py`:

```py
"""Concrete scalar/byte state with explicit unknown bits and symbolic local addresses."""

from dataclasses import dataclass

from ..ir.evaluate import evaluate
from ..ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp
from .program import Address


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cell:
    value: object
    width: int
    known: int


def binary(op, a, b, a_width, b_width, width):
    if isinstance(a, Address) or isinstance(b, Address):
        if isinstance(a, Address) and isinstance(b, Address):
            if a.buffer != b.buffer or a.width != b.width:
                raise ValueError("unproved relationship between local pointers")
            if op in ("eq", "ne"):
                return int((a.offset == b.offset) == (op == "eq"))
            if op == "sub" and width == a.width:
                return (a.offset - b.offset) & ((1 << width) - 1)
            raise ValueError("local pointer ordering or bits are unknown")
        if op == "add" and isinstance(b, Address):
            a, b = b, a
        if isinstance(a, Address) and width == a.width and op in ("add", "sub"):
            return Address(a.buffer, (a.offset + (b if op == "add" else -b)) & ((1 << width) - 1), width)
        raise ValueError("local pointer bits are unknown")
    return evaluate(BinOp(op, Const(a, a_width), Const(b, b_width), width), {})


def unary(op, value, inner_width, width):
    if isinstance(value, Address):
        if inner_width == width:
            return value
        raise ValueError("local pointer bits are unknown")
    if inner_width == width and op in ("zx", "sx", "trunc"):
        return value
    return evaluate(UnOp(op, Const(value, inner_width), width), {})


class State:
    def __init__(self, size, little_endian=True):
        self.memory = [None] * size
        self.cells = {}
        self.written = set()
        self.order = "little" if little_endian else "big"

    def assign(self, key, value, width):
        if width < 1:
            raise ValueError("unknown scalar width")
        if isinstance(value, Address) and value.width != width:
            raise ValueError("pointer width mismatch")
        self.cells[key] = Cell(value if isinstance(value, Address) else value & ((1 << width) - 1), width, (1 << width) - 1)

    def field(self, key, value, offset, width, whole_width):
        if offset < 0 or offset + width > whole_width or isinstance(value, Address):
            raise ValueError("unsupported partial scalar write")
        old = self.cells.get(key, Cell(0, whole_width, 0))
        if isinstance(old.value, Address):
            raise ValueError("partial pointer write")
        mask = ((1 << width) - 1) << offset
        self.cells[key] = Cell((old.value & ~mask) | ((value << offset) & mask),
                               max(old.width, whole_width), old.known | mask)

    def read(self, key, width, offset=0):
        cell = self.cells.get(key)
        mask = ((1 << width) - 1) << offset
        if cell is None or offset < 0 or offset + width > cell.width or cell.known & mask != mask:
            raise ValueError("unknown scalar bits")
        if isinstance(cell.value, Address):
            if offset or width != cell.width:
                raise ValueError("local pointer bits are unknown")
            return cell.value
        return (cell.value >> offset) & ((1 << width) - 1)

    def span(self, offset, size):
        if offset < 0 or size <= 0 or offset + size > len(self.memory):
            raise ValueError("local access outside the bounded frame")

    def store(self, offset, value, size):
        self.span(offset, size)
        if isinstance(value, Address):
            raise ValueError("pointer bytes are unknown")
        self.memory[offset:offset + size] = (value & ((1 << (8 * size)) - 1)).to_bytes(size, self.order)
        self.written.update(range(offset, offset + size))

    def load(self, offset, size):
        self.span(offset, size)
        data = self.memory[offset:offset + size]
        if None in data:
            raise ValueError("uninitialized local bytes")
        return int.from_bytes(data, self.order)

```

`binja_d810/consteval/strings.py`:

```py
"""Display heuristics over exact known bytes; never authorize an IL rewrite."""


def recognize(memory, offset, *, maximum, minimum, length=None):
    if offset < 0 or offset >= len(memory):
        return None
    if length is not None and (type(length) is not int or not minimum <= length <= maximum):
        return None
    end = min(len(memory), offset + (maximum if length is None else length))
    data = memory[offset:end]
    if length is not None:
        if len(data) != length or None in data:
            return None
    else:
        if 0 not in data:
            return None
        data = data[:data.index(0)]
    if len(data) < minimum or any(c is None or not (32 <= c < 127 or c in (9, 10, 13)) for c in data):
        return None
    return bytes(data).decode("ascii")

```

`binja_d810/deadline.py`:

```py
"""A monotonic deadline passed through planning, Tier 1, Tier 2, the verifier and the backends."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Deadline:
    at: float  # time.monotonic() value

    @classmethod
    def after(cls, seconds: float) -> "Deadline":
        return cls(time.monotonic() + max(0.0, seconds))

    @classmethod
    def never(cls) -> "Deadline":
        return cls(float("inf"))

    def remaining(self) -> float:
        return max(0.0, self.at - time.monotonic())

    def expired(self) -> bool:
        return time.monotonic() >= self.at

    def earlier(self, other: "Deadline") -> "Deadline":
        return self if self.at <= other.at else other

```

`binja_d810/flags/recombine.py`:

```py
"""Propose comparisons from the operands present in a flag expression; prove every result."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from ..deadline import Deadline
from ..ir.expr import BinOp, CMP_OPS, Const, UnOp, children, distinct_nodes, tree_size
from ..ir.normalize import normalize
from ..semantic.verify import Verdict, check
from .semantics import choose


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Limits:
    instructions: int = 20000
    nodes: int = 2000
    work: int = 80000
    candidates: int = 128
    conditions: int = 128
    merges: int = 8
    proof_ms: int = 200


@dataclass
class Result:
    expression: object
    changes: int = 0
    attempts: int = 0
    notes: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)


def recombine(expression, *, guards=(), limits=Limits(), deadline=Deadline.never(), tick=lambda: None):
    result = Result(expression)
    if deadline.expired() or tree_size(expression) > limits.nodes:
        result.notes.append("flag expression budget exhausted")
        return result
    # Operands are discovered semantically from subtraction and comparison expressions.
    # Their order and widths come from the IL; there is no catalogue of target constants.
    pairs, differences = [], []
    pending, seen = [expression], set()
    while pending:
        node = pending.pop()
        if node in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(node)
        pending.extend(children(node))
        if isinstance(node, BinOp) and (node.op == "sub" or node.op in CMP_OPS) \
                and node.left.width > 1 and node.left.width == node.right.width:
            pair = node.left, node.right
            if pair not in pairs:
                pairs.append(pair)
            if node.op == "sub" and pair not in differences:
                differences.append(pair)
        if len(pairs) * len(CMP_OPS) >= limits.candidates:
            break
    pairs = differences + [pair for pair in pairs if pair not in differences]
    candidates = [BinOp(op, a, b, 1) for a, b in pairs for op in sorted(CMP_OPS)]
    left = limits.work
    memo = {}

    def visit(node):
        nonlocal left
        tick()
        left -= 1
        if left < 0 or deadline.expired():
            raise ValueError("flag reconstruction budget exhausted")
        if node in memo:
            return memo[node]
        original = node
        if node.width == 1 and not isinstance(node, Const):
            old_cost = distinct_nodes(node)
            for candidate in candidates:
                tick()
                if distinct_nodes(candidate) >= old_cost:
                    continue
                if result.attempts >= limits.candidates or deadline.expired():
                    break
                result.attempts += 1
                proof = check(node, candidate, z3_timeout_ms=limits.proof_ms, deadline=deadline)
                if proof.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN:
                    node = candidate
                    result.changes += 1
                    break
        if node == original:
            if isinstance(node, BinOp):
                node = normalize(BinOp(node.op, visit(node.left), visit(node.right), node.width))
            elif isinstance(node, UnOp):
                node = normalize(UnOp(node.op, visit(node.operand), node.width))
        memo[original] = node
        return node

    try:
        # Split only on selectors proved by the adapter's CFG analysis. The final proof
        # checks the recombined expression too, so a selector is never an assumption.
        def selected(node, depth):
            nonlocal left
            tick()
            left -= 1
            if left < 0 or deadline.expired():
                raise ValueError("flag selector budget exhausted")
            if depth >= len(guards) or depth >= limits.merges:
                return visit(node)
            guard = guards[depth]
            from ..semantic.selects import replace
            yes = normalize(replace(node, guard, Const(1, 1)))
            no = normalize(replace(node, guard, Const(0, 1)))
            if yes == node and no == node:
                return selected(node, depth + 1)
            return choose(guard, selected(yes, depth + 1), selected(no, depth + 1))
        proposed = selected(expression, 0) if expression.width == 1 else visit(expression)
        proposed = normalize(proposed)
        if tree_size(proposed) > limits.nodes:
            raise ValueError("flag result expression limit")
        if proposed != expression and (result.changes or guards) and not deadline.expired():
            proof = check(expression, proposed, z3_timeout_ms=limits.proof_ms, deadline=deadline)
            if proof.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN:
                result.expression = proposed
            else:
                result.notes.append("flag recombination was not proven: " + (proof.reason or proof.verdict.value))
        if result.attempts >= limits.candidates:
            result.notes.append("flag candidate limit")
    except (ValueError, RecursionError) as exc:
        result.notes.append(str(exc) or "flag expression depth is unsupported")
    return result

```

`binja_d810/flags/semantics.py`:

```py
"""Integer subtraction flags. Carry polarity is the only architecture-specific rule here."""

from ..ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp
from ..ir.normalize import normalize

# IL architecture names, not instruction encodings or sample signatures.
CARRY_IS_NO_BORROW = {"aarch64": True, "x86_64": False, "x86": False}


def bit(op, a, b):
    return BinOp(op, a, b, 1)


def sign(value):
    return bit("slt", value, Const(0, value.width))


def add_overflow(a, b):
    result = BinOp("add", a, b, a.width)
    return bit("and", bit("eq", sign(a), sign(b)), bit("ne", sign(a), sign(result)))


def subtraction(a, b, architecture):
    difference = BinOp("sub", a, b, a.width)
    return {
        "n": sign(difference), "z": bit("eq", a, b),
        "v": bit("and", bit("ne", sign(a), sign(b)), bit("ne", sign(a), sign(difference))),
        "c": bit("uge" if CARRY_IS_NO_BORROW[architecture] else "ult", a, b),
    }


def condition(flags, comparison, architecture):
    n, z, v, c = (flags[k] for k in ("n", "z", "v", "c"))
    less = UnOp("not", c, 1) if CARRY_IS_NO_BORROW[architecture] else c
    signed = bit("ne", n, v)
    return {"eq": z, "ne": UnOp("not", z, 1),
            "slt": signed, "sle": bit("or", z, signed),
            "sge": UnOp("not", signed, 1), "sgt": UnOp("not", bit("or", z, signed), 1),
            "ult": less, "ule": bit("or", less, z),
            "uge": UnOp("not", less, 1), "ugt": UnOp("not", bit("or", less, z), 1)}[comparison]


def choose(guard, yes, no):
    """A boolean select, kept in the existing fixed-width IR."""
    if guard.width != 1 or yes.width != 1 or no.width != 1:
        raise ValueError("flag selection requires boolean values")
    if yes == no:
        return yes
    if no == Const(0, 1):
        return normalize(bit("and", guard, yes))
    if no == Const(1, 1):
        return normalize(bit("or", UnOp("not", guard, 1), yes))
    if yes == Const(1, 1):
        return normalize(bit("or", guard, no))
    if yes == Const(0, 1):
        return normalize(bit("and", UnOp("not", guard, 1), no))
    return normalize(bit("or", bit("and", guard, yes), bit("and", UnOp("not", guard, 1), no)))

```
