`tests/binja/test_pointer_uses.py`:

```py
"""Returned and locally stored pointer values need a proof of all later uses."""

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from helpers import data_pointers, function_named, open_sample, settle
from flowcases import text
from binja_d810.binja.flow import apply, evidence
from binja_d810.flow.record import Record

SAFE = ("return_read", "return_chain", "return_offset", "stored_local_read", "stored_local_return")
UNSAFE = ("return_write", "return_escape", "return_top_reader", "return_mixed", "return_indirect",
          "stored_local_write", "stored_local_escape", "stored_local_forward", "stored_partial", "stored_partial_write")


def key_of(bv, name):
    return next(a for a in data_pointers(bv, function_named(bv, name))
                if bv.read_int(a, 4, False) == 0x537ac921)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def builds(request):
    bv = open_sample(sample("pointer_uses", *request.param), d810=False)
    yield bv
    bv.file.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", SAFE + UNSAFE)
def test_proof_follows_returned_pointer_uses(builds, name):
    key = key_of(builds, name)
    work = apply.Round(builds, apply.State(Record()))
    first = evidence.object_start(builds, key, uses_of=work.uses_of)
    why = evidence.never_written(builds, key, key + 4, work.uses_of, first=first)
    assert (why is None) == (name in SAFE), (name, why)


def test_proof_graph_releases_its_native_snapshot_without_cyclic_gc(builds):
    import gc
    import weakref
    from binja_d810.binja.flow.access import Proof
    from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline

    work = apply.Round(builds, apply.State(Record()))
    graph = Proof(work.uses_of, Deadline.never()).graph(work.uses_of(function_named(builds, "stored_local_read")))
    ref = weakref.ref(graph)
    enabled = gc.isenabled()
    gc.disable()
    try:
        del graph
        assert ref() is None, "a proof must not retain native analysis snapshots in a reference cycle"
    finally:
        if enabled:
            gc.enable()


def test_summary_cache_distinguishes_a_pointer_from_its_slot_address(builds):
    from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op
    from binja_d810.binja.flow.access import Proof
    from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline

    func = function_named(builds, "local_return")
    call = next(i for i in func.mlil.ssa_form.instructions if i.operation == Op.MLIL_CALL_SSA)
    work = apply.Round(builds, apply.State(Record()))
    proof = Proof(work.uses_of, Deadline.never())
    direct = proof.argument(call, call.params[0].expr_index, 0)
    indirect = proof.argument(call, call.params[0].expr_index, 0, indirect=True)
    assert direct is not None and not direct.returned
    assert indirect is not None and indirect.returned


@pytest.mark.parametrize("caller, callee, accepted", (
    ("stored_local_read", "local_read", True), ("stored_local_return", "local_return", True),
    ("stored_local_write", "local_write", False), ("stored_local_escape", "local_escape", False),
    ("stored_local_forward", "local_forward", False), ("stored_partial", "local_partial", False),
    ("stored_partial_write", "local_partial_write", False),
))
def test_slot_summary_checks_the_consumer_without_neighboring_objects(builds, caller, callee, accepted):
    from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation as Op
    from binja_d810.binja.flow.access import Proof
    from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline

    target = function_named(builds, callee).start
    call = next(i for i in function_named(builds, caller).mlil.ssa_form.instructions
                if i.operation == Op.MLIL_CALL_SSA and i.dest.constant == target)
    work = apply.Round(builds, apply.State(Record()))
    summary = Proof(work.uses_of, Deadline.never()).argument(call, call.params[0].expr_index, 0)
    assert (summary is not None) == accepted


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", ("unknown", "wrong_entry", "displaced_entry", "frame"))
def test_propagated_returns_need_matching_native_values(case, monkeypatch):
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    from binaryninja import Function, RegisterValueType

    bv = open_sample("pointer_uses_O0.dylib", d810=False)
    try:
        helper = function_named(bv, "forward_pointer")
        native = Function.get_reg_value_after
        def value(func, address, reg):
            got = native(func, address, reg)
            if func != helper:
                return got
            assert got.type == RegisterValueType.EntryValue
            if case == "unknown":
                return SimpleNamespace(type=RegisterValueType.UndeterminedValue)
            if case == "frame":
                return SimpleNamespace(type=RegisterValueType.StackFrameOffset, value=0, offset=0)
            return SimpleNamespace(type=got.type, value=got.value + (case == "wrong_entry"),
                                   offset=8 if case == "displaced_entry" else 0)
        monkeypatch.setattr(Function, "get_reg_value_after", value)
        key = key_of(bv, "return_chain")
        work = apply.Round(bv, apply.State(Record()))
        assert evidence.never_written(bv, key, key + 4, work.uses_of,
                                       first=evidence.object_start(bv, key, uses_of=work.uses_of))
    finally:
        bv.file.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("build", MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def test_workflow_folds_safe_keys_and_undo_restores_them(build):
    from binaryninja import Settings
    from binja_d810.binja import workflow

    bv = open_sample(sample("pointer_uses", *build), d810=False)
    try:
        keys = {name: key_of(bv, name) for name in SAFE + UNSAFE}
        before = {name: text(function_named(bv, name)) for name in SAFE + UNSAFE}
        Settings().set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, True, bv)
        for f in bv.functions: f.reanalyze()
        settle(bv)
        for name, key in keys.items():
            change = apply.record_of(bv).get("table", key)
            assert (change is not None) == (name in SAFE), (name, apply.notes_for(bv, function_named(bv, name).start))
            if name in SAFE:
                assert "0x11111111" in text(function_named(bv, name))
        Settings().set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, False, bv)
        for f in bv.functions: f.reanalyze()
        settle(bv)
        for name in before:
            assert text(function_named(bv, name)) == before[name], name
    finally:
        bv.file.close()
```

`tests/binja/test_predicates.py`:

```py
"""Opaque predicates and branch conditions (v3): folded only when proven; ordinary ones stay."""

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from helpers import function_named, open_sample, set_types

LOOPS = ("loop_bitwise", "loop_masked", "loop_product")
TYPES = {name: f"uint32_t {name}(uint32_t x, uint32_t y)" for name in
         ("opaque_parity", "opaque_setnz", "opaque_mba", "plain_condition", "mirrored") + LOOPS}
TYPES["load_condition"] = "uint32_t load_condition(uint32_t* p, uint32_t y)"


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def fixtures(request):
    bv = open_sample(sample("predicates", *request.param), d810=True)
    set_types(bv, TYPES)
    yield bv
    bv.file.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["opaque_parity", "opaque_setnz", "opaque_mba", "mirrored"])
def test_opaque_conditions_are_folded_and_the_dead_branch_is_gone(fixtures, name):
    func = function_named(fixtures, name)
    text = "\n".join(map(str, func.hlil.instructions))
    assert "if (" not in text and "0x5a" not in text, text  # the dead branch returns x ^ 0x5a


def test_ordinary_conditions_stay(fixtures):
    func = function_named(fixtures, "plain_condition")
    assert "if (" in "\n".join(map(str, func.hlil.instructions))


def _conditions(func) -> list:
    """The conditions of every if, while, do-while and for in the final HLIL."""
    stack, found = [func.hlil.root], []
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        if hasattr(node, "condition") and node.operation.name in _CONDITIONAL:
            found.append(node.condition)
        stack.extend(o for o in node.operands if hasattr(o, "operation"))
        stack.extend(i for o in node.operands if isinstance(o, list) for i in o if hasattr(i, "operation"))
    return found


_CONDITIONAL = {"HLIL_IF", "HLIL_WHILE", "HLIL_DO_WHILE", "HLIL_FOR"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", LOOPS)
def test_loop_conditions_over_bitwise_operations_stay(fixtures, name):
    # HLIL's loop conditions have size 0: their operands' width must come from the operands.
    from binja_d810.binja import log

    func = function_named(fixtures, name)
    found = _conditions(func)
    assert found and all(c.operation.name != "HLIL_CONST" for c in found), [str(c) for c in found]
    for level, report in log.latest_reports(func).items():
        assert not report.rolled_back and not report.errors, (level, report.errors)


def _loads(func) -> int:
    return sum(1 for i in func.mlil.instructions for n in _walk(i) if n.operation.name == "MLIL_LOAD")


def _walk(e):
    stack = [e]
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        yield node
        stack.extend(o for o in node.operands if hasattr(o, "operation"))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("build,level", MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def test_loads_in_a_predicate_stay(build, level):
    counts = {}
    for d810 in (False, True):
        bv = open_sample(sample("predicates", build, level), d810=d810)
        try:
            set_types(bv, {"load_condition": TYPES["load_condition"]})
            counts[d810] = _loads(function_named(bv, "load_condition"))
        finally:
            bv.file.close()
    assert counts[True] == counts[False] > 0, counts


def test_folds_are_stable_and_disabling_the_plugin_restores_the_branch(fixtures):
    from binaryninja import Settings

    from binja_d810.binja import workflow

    func = function_named(fixtures, "opaque_parity")
    first = [str(i) for i in func.hlil.instructions]
    func.reanalyze()
    fixtures.update_analysis_and_wait()
    func = function_named(fixtures, "opaque_parity")
    assert [str(i) for i in func.hlil.instructions] == first
    Settings().set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, False, func)
    func.reanalyze()
    fixtures.update_analysis_and_wait()
    func = function_named(fixtures, "opaque_parity")
    try:
        assert "if (" in "\n".join(map(str, func.hlil.instructions))
    finally:
        Settings().set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, True, func)
        func.reanalyze()
        fixtures.update_analysis_and_wait()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("build,level", MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def test_the_hlil_pass_alone_folds_proven_conditions_and_leaves_others(build, level):
    # What the MLIL pass cannot express is left to the HLIL pass; a folded HLIL condition stays an
    # `if` on a constant until v3.1 removes dead branches in HLIL.
    from binaryninja import HighLevelILOperation as H

    from binja_d810.binja import workflow

    def conditions(func):
        stack, found = [func.hlil.root], []
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node.operation == H.HLIL_IF:
                found.append(node.condition)
            stack.extend(o for o in node.operands if hasattr(o, "operation"))
            stack.extend(i for o in node.operands if isinstance(o, list) for i in o if hasattr(i, "operation"))
        return found

    workflow.set_levels_override({"hlil"})
    bv = open_sample(sample("predicates", build, level), d810=True)
    try:
        set_types(bv, TYPES)
        folded = conditions(function_named(bv, "opaque_parity"))
        assert folded and all(c.operation == H.HLIL_CONST for c in folded), [str(c) for c in folded]
        plain = conditions(function_named(bv, "plain_condition"))
        assert plain and all(c.operation != H.HLIL_CONST for c in plain), [str(c) for c in plain]
    finally:
        workflow.set_levels_override(None)
        bv.file.close()
```

`tests/binja/test_safety.py`:

```py
import random

import pytest
from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation, Settings
import oracle
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, expect_miss, sample
from helpers import function_named, lift_return, manifest, open_sample, set_types, signature, strip_versions

from binja_d810.binja import log, workflow
from binja_d810.ir.evaluate import evaluate
from binja_d810.ir.expr import UnOp, Var, is_mba, substitute, variables
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent

TYPES = {
    "safety_reassign": "uint32_t safety_reassign(uint32_t x, uint32_t y)",
    "safety_u8": "uint8_t safety_u8(uint8_t x, uint8_t y)",
    "safety_load": "uint32_t safety_load(uint32_t* p, uint32_t y)",
}
_LOADS = (MediumLevelILOperation.MLIL_LOAD, MediumLevelILOperation.MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def safety(request):
    build, level = request.param
    bv = open_sample(sample("safety", build, level), d810=True)
    set_types(bv, TYPES)
    yield request.param, bv
    bv.file.close()


def _loads(func) -> int:
    count = 0
    for instr in func.mlil.instructions:
        stack = [instr]
        while stack:
            node = stack.pop()
            if node.operation in _LOADS:
                count += 1
            stack.extend(op for op in node.operands if hasattr(op, "operation"))
    return count


def _at_width(e, width):
    return e if e.width == width else UnOp("trunc", e, width) if e.width > width else UnOp("zx", e, width)


def test_safety_reassign_is_equivalent(safety):
    _, bv = safety
    lifted = _at_width(strip_versions(lift_return(function_named(bv, "safety_reassign"))), 32)
    reference = parse("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y) + (3 * x + 1)", 32)
    assert check_equivalent(lifted, reference, use_z3=False) is not Verdict.REFUTED


def test_safety_u8_is_simplified_without_assuming_upper_bits(safety, request):
    # x86 and ARM64 -O2 read the 8-bit parameters through wider registers or fields (y.w1 & x.w0,
    # var_8:5.b). The final HLIL must compute (x + y) & 0xff for every value of the registers'
    # upper bits: the oracle models them as unknown and checks all 2**16 low-byte pairs.
    (build, level), bv = safety
    expect_miss(request, "safety_u8", f"{build}-{level}")
    func = function_named(bv, "safety_u8")
    final = oracle.function_result(func)
    assert oracle.compare(final, oracle.reference("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)", 8), 8).kind in ("exhaustive", "proven")
    # The returned computation is simplified. Dead byte stores into a shared stack slot may remain at
    # -O0 (liveness is per variable version, not per byte): presentation only, listed in the report.
    (ret,) = [str(i) for i in func.hlil.instructions if i.operation.name == "HLIL_RET"]
    assert "^" not in ret and "&" not in ret, ret
    # The MLIL lift agrees, with random upper register bits.
    plain = strip_versions(lift_return(func))
    if {v.name for v in variables(plain)} <= {"x", "y"}:
        rng = random.Random(8)
        widths = {v.name: v.width for v in variables(plain)}
        for x in range(0, 256, 3):
            for y in range(256):
                env = {"x": x | (rng.getrandbits(widths.get("x", 8)) & ~0xFF),
                       "y": y | (rng.getrandbits(widths.get("y", 8)) & ~0xFF)}
                assert evaluate(plain, env) & 0xFF == ((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)) & 0xFF, (x, y)


def test_safety_load_keeps_single_load(safety):
    (build, level), bv = safety
    func = function_named(bv, "safety_load")
    plain = open_sample(sample("safety", build, level), d810=False)
    try:
        set_types(plain, TYPES)
        assert _loads(func) <= _loads(function_named(plain, "safety_load"))
    finally:
        plain.file.close()
    lifted = strip_versions(lift_return(func), params=("y",))
    (load_leaf,) = [v for v in variables(lifted) if v.name != "y"]
    candidate = substitute(lifted, {load_leaf.name: Var("m", 32)})
    assert check_equivalent(candidate, parse("(m ^ y) + 2 * (m & y)", 32), use_z3=False) is not Verdict.REFUTED


def test_reanalysis_is_idempotent_and_toggle_restores():
    entries = [e for e in manifest() if e["category"] == "d810"][:3]
    bv = open_sample("mba_O2.dylib", d810=True)
    try:
        set_types(bv, {e["name"]: signature(e) for e in entries})
        funcs = [function_named(bv, e["name"]) for e in entries]
        before = ["\n".join(map(str, f.mlil.instructions)) for f in funcs]
        for f in funcs:
            f.reanalyze()
        bv.update_analysis_and_wait()
        funcs = [function_named(bv, e["name"]) for e in entries]
        assert ["\n".join(map(str, f.mlil.instructions)) for f in funcs] == before
        Settings().set_bool(workflow.ACTIVITY_SETTING, False, bv)
        for f in funcs:
            f.reanalyze()
        bv.update_analysis_and_wait()
        for e in entries:
            assert is_mba(strip_versions(lift_return(function_named(bv, e["name"]))))
    finally:
        bv.file.close()
```

`tests/binja/test_samples.py`:

```py
import json
import os
import re
import time
from pathlib import Path

import oracle
import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from helpers import function_named, lift_return, manifest, open_sample, set_types, signature, strip_versions

from binja_d810.binja import log, settings
from binja_d810.ir.expr import UnOp, is_mba, node_count, to_str, variables
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic import cobra_shim
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent

OUT = Path(os.environ.get("BINJA_D810_PYTEST_OUT", ".binja-test"))
COVERAGE: dict = {"seconds": {}}
BITWISE = re.compile(r"\^(?!=)|(?<![&])&(?![&=])|(?<![|])\|(?![|=])|~|\bnot\.")

# Samples that stay obfuscated, per build, with the specific technical reason. Any other failure is
# a regression; a listed sample that starts passing fails the test until it is removed here.
_SPLIT64 = "64-bit values live in 32-bit register pairs joined by adc/sbb carries (i686), not modelled"
_I686_64 = {f"mba_linear_{i:03d}": _SPLIT64 for i in range(4, 50, 5)}  # every fifth linear sample is 64-bit
KNOWN_MISSES: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {
    "i686-pe-O0": dict(_I686_64),
    "i686-pe-O2": dict(_I686_64),
}


# Samples whose final HLIL the oracle cannot read, with the reason. Empty: any unvalidated sample
# fails the test, so a result can never pass merely because nothing refuted it.
ORACLE_UNVALIDATED: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = {"i686-pe-O0": dict(_I686_64), "i686-pe-O2": dict(_I686_64)}


def _oracle(func, entry) -> tuple[str, str]:
    try:
        final = oracle.function_result(func)
    except oracle.Unvalidated as exc:
        return "unvalidated", str(exc)
    result = oracle.compare(final, oracle.reference(entry["expected"], entry["width"]), entry["width"])
    return result.kind, result.detail


def _hlil_clean(func, expected) -> bool:
    """The function's HLIL has no more bitwise operators than the expected answer."""
    text = "\n".join(str(i) for i in func.hlil.instructions)
    return len(BITWISE.findall(text)) <= len(BITWISE.findall(to_str(expected)))


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def simplified(request):
    build, level = request.param
    entries = manifest()
    start = time.perf_counter()
    # Coverage, not latency: with all 96 functions analyzed in parallel, Python's GIL stretches each
    # function's planning well past the default 5 s (tests/binja/test_budget.py covers the budget).
    bv = open_sample(sample("mba", build, level), d810=True,
                     options={settings.FUNCTION_SECONDS: 60, "analysis.limits.maxFunctionAnalysisTime": 180_000})
    set_types(bv, {e["name"]: signature(e) for e in entries})
    key = f"{build}-{level}"
    COVERAGE["seconds"][key] = round(time.perf_counter() - start, 1)
    yield key, bv, entries
    bv.file.close()


def test_samples(simplified):
    level, bv, entries = simplified
    stats: dict = {}
    refuted = []
    mismatched, unvalidated, analysis_failures = [], [], []
    for entry in entries:
        func = function_named(bv, entry["name"])
        expected = parse(entry["expected"], entry["width"])
        if func.hlil is None:
            analysis_failures.append((entry["name"], str(func.analysis_skip_reason)))
            continue
        lifted = lift_return(func)
        plain = strip_versions(lifted) if lifted is not None else None
        if plain is not None and plain.width > entry["width"]:
            plain = UnOp("trunc", plain, entry["width"])  # x64 returns zx.q(32-bit result)
        elif plain is not None and plain.width < entry["width"]:
            plain = None  # i686 returns a 64-bit value in edx:eax; the oracle checks the final HLIL
        cat = stats.setdefault(entry["category"], {"total": 0, "simplified": 0, "hlil_clean": 0, "failures": [],
                                                   "oracle": {}})
        cat["total"] += 1
        kind, detail = _oracle(func, entry)
        cat["oracle"][kind] = cat["oracle"].get(kind, 0) + 1
        if kind == "mismatch":
            mismatched.append((entry["name"], detail))
        elif kind == "unvalidated" and entry["name"] not in ORACLE_UNVALIDATED.get(level, {}):
            unvalidated.append((entry["name"], detail))
        # The MLIL lift is comparable only when it is over the parameters alone; otherwise (an opaque
        # edx:eax pair on i686) the oracle on the final HLIL is the check.
        comparable = plain is not None and {v.name for v in variables(plain)} <= {"x", "y", "z"}
        if comparable and check_equivalent(plain, expected, use_z3=False) is Verdict.REFUTED:
            refuted.append(entry["name"])
        # Some expected answers mix arithmetic and bitwise ops themselves (x - (y & z)).
        demixed = plain is not None and (not is_mba(plain) or is_mba(expected))
        if demixed and node_count(plain) <= node_count(expected) + 2:
            cat["simplified"] += 1
        reports = log.latest_reports(func)
        if any(r.budget_exhausted for r in reports.values()):
            cat.setdefault("budget_exhausted", []).append(entry["name"])
        cat.setdefault("plugin_seconds", []).append(round(sum(r.total_seconds for r in reports.values()), 3))
        if _hlil_clean(func, expected):
            cat["hlil_clean"] += 1
        else:
            cat["failures"].append(entry["name"])
    COVERAGE[level] = stats
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT / "coverage.json").write_text(json.dumps(COVERAGE, indent=2))

    assert analysis_failures == [], f"no HLIL after analysis: {analysis_failures}"
    assert refuted == [], f"semantics changed: {refuted}"
    assert mismatched == [], f"final HLIL differs from the expected computation: {mismatched}"
    assert unvalidated == [], f"final HLIL not validated: {unvalidated}"
    allowed = set(KNOWN_MISSES.get(level, {}))
    if cobra_shim.load() is None:
        allowed |= {e["name"] for e in entries if e["category"] == "poly"}
    failed = {name for s in stats.values() for name in s["failures"]}
    assert failed - allowed == set(), sorted(failed - allowed)
    listed = set(KNOWN_MISSES.get(level, {}))
    assert listed - failed == set(), f"listed as misses but now clean, remove them: {sorted(listed - failed)}"
    assert COVERAGE["seconds"][level] < 600

```

`tests/binja/test_scratch.py`:

```py
"""Private stack cleanup: real native IL, independent value models, and negative controls."""

from dataclasses import replace

import pytest
from binaryninja import (ILInstructionAttribute as Attr, MediumLevelILFunction,
                         MediumLevelILOperation as Op, Settings, SSAVariable, Type, Variable, VariableSourceType)
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from helpers import function_named, lift_return, open_sample, set_types, settle
from flowcases import text

from binja_d810.binja import log, settings, scratch
from binja_d810.binja.mlil.lift import Backing
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp, Var, substitute, variables
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent

VALUES = ("scratch_dead", "scratch_roundtrip", "scratch_encoded_address", "scratch_read", "scratch_branch", "scratch_loop", "scratch_partial")
TYPES = {name: f"uint32_t {name}(uint32_t x)" for name in (*VALUES, "scratch_escape")}
TYPES["scratch_unknown"] = "uint32_t scratch_unknown(uint32_t x, void (*f)(uint32_t))"


def value_ir(func):
    expr = lift_return(func, check_versions=False)
    assert expr is not None, text(func)
    parameter = func.parameter_vars[0]
    inputs = [v for v in variables(expr) if isinstance(v.ref, (SSAVariable, Backing))
              and v.ref.var.identifier == parameter.identifier and v.ref.version == 0]
    width = max([32] + [v.width for v in inputs])
    source = Var("scratch_input", width)
    expr = substitute(expr, {v.name: source if v.width == width else UnOp("trunc", source, v.width) for v in inputs})
    return expr, source if width == 32 else UnOp("trunc", source, 32)


def reference(name, x):
    c = lambda n: Const(n, 32)
    if name == "scratch_dead": return BinOp("add", x, c(11), 32)
    if name == "scratch_roundtrip": return BinOp("xor", x, c(49), 32)
    if name == "scratch_encoded_address": return BinOp("xor", x, c(81), 32)
    if name == "scratch_read": return BinOp("add", BinOp("mul", x, c(9), 32), c(1), 32)
    if name == "scratch_branch": return BinOp("xor", x, c(19), 32)
    if name == "scratch_loop": return BinOp("xor", x, c(41), 32)
    return BinOp("or", BinOp("and", x, c(0xffffff00), 32), c(0x6b), 32)


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def builds(request):
    off = open_sample(sample("scratch", *request.param), d810=True, options={settings.SCRATCH: False})
    on = open_sample(sample("scratch", *request.param), d810=True)
    for bv in (off, on):
        set_types(bv, TYPES)
        settle(bv)
    yield request.param, on, off
    on.file.close()
    off.file.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", VALUES)
def test_value_is_proven_against_an_independent_model(builds, request, name):
    build, on, _ = builds
    if name == "scratch_partial" and build == ("i686-pe", "O2"):
        request.applymarker(pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=
            "native MLIL already folds a byte store followed by a four-byte stack load to 0x6b, losing the upper bytes before D810"))
    expr, x = value_ir(function_named(on, name))
    assert expr.width == 32
    assert check_equivalent(expr, reference(name, x)) is Verdict.PROVEN, text(function_named(on, name))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ("scratch_dead", "scratch_roundtrip", "scratch_branch", "scratch_loop"))
def test_dead_scratch_traffic_is_removed(builds, name):
    _, on, off = builds
    func = function_named(on, name)
    report = log.latest_report(func)
    assert report.scratch_stores > 0, report.scratch
    assert len(list(func.mlil.instructions)) >= 1
    assert text(func) != text(function_named(off, name))
    assert "scratch:" in log.render(report)


def test_escaping_slot_is_left_unchanged(builds):
    _, on, off = builds
    func = function_named(on, "scratch_escape")
    assert text(func) == text(function_named(off, "scratch_escape"))
    report = log.latest_report(func)
    assert not report.scratch_stores and not report.scratch_accesses and not report.scratch_aliases


def test_an_unknown_call_keeps_the_memory_barrier(builds):
    _, on, off = builds
    func = function_named(on, "scratch_unknown")
    def calls(f):
        return sum("CALL" in i.operation.name for i in f.mlil.instructions)
    assert calls(func) == calls(function_named(off, "scratch_unknown")) == 1
    assert any("unknown call" in n for n in log.latest_report(func).scratch)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("limit", ("instructions", "nodes", "frame_bytes"))
def test_named_caps_leave_unproved_code_unchanged(builds, limit):
    _, _, off = builds
    original = function_named(off, "scratch_dead").mlil
    changed, report = scratch.run(original, replace(scratch.Limits(), **{limit: 1}))
    assert changed is original and report.notes
    assert not report.stores and not report.accesses and not report.aliases


def test_an_expired_shared_budget_cannot_commit(builds):
    _, _, off = builds
    original = function_named(off, "scratch_dead").mlil
    changed, report = scratch.run(original, deadline=Deadline.after(0))
    assert changed is original and report.exhausted
    assert any("budget" in n for n in report.notes)


def local_program(func, mode):
    """Native IL controls with explicit bytes, independent of compiler stack allocation."""
    il = MediumLevelILFunction(func.arch, low_level_il=func.llil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_function(func.mlil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_block(func.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
    il.set_current_address(func.start, func.arch)
    slot = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x2000)
    value = il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, 0x12345678))
    if isinstance(mode, Attr):
        il.set_expr_attributes(value, {mode})
    il.append(value)
    if mode == "partial":
        il.append(il.set_var_field(1, slot, 0, il.const(1, 0x6b)))
        il.append(il.ret([il.var(4, slot)]))
    else:
        il.append(il.ret([il.const(4, 17)]))
    il.finalize()
    il.generate_ssa_form()
    return il


@pytest.mark.parametrize("attribute", (Attr.ILPreventDeadStoreElimination, Attr.ILPreventAliasAnalysis))
def test_native_protected_stores_survive(builds, attribute):
    _, _, off = builds
    original = local_program(function_named(off, "scratch_dead"), attribute)
    changed, report = scratch.run(original)
    assert changed is original and report.stores == 0
    assert any("protected" in n for n in report.notes)


def test_liveness_cap_never_returns_partial_deadness(builds):
    _, _, off = builds
    original = local_program(function_named(off, "scratch_dead"), "dead")
    changed, report = scratch.run(original, scratch.Limits(visits=1))
    assert changed is original and report.stores == 0
    assert "liveness budget exhausted" in report.notes
    changed, report = scratch.run(original)
    assert changed is not original and report.stores == 1


def test_native_partial_overwrite_preserves_the_older_live_bytes(builds):
    _, _, off = builds
    original = local_program(function_named(off, "scratch_dead"), "partial")
    changed, report = scratch.run(original)
    assert report.stores == 0
    assert sum(i.operation in (Op.MLIL_SET_VAR, Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_FIELD) for i in changed.instructions) == 2


def test_dead_store_cleanup_preserves_native_call_outputs(builds):
    _, _, off = builds
    func = function_named(off, "scratch_dead")
    il = MediumLevelILFunction(func.arch, low_level_il=func.llil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_function(func.mlil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_block(func.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
    il.set_current_address(func.start, func.arch)
    slot = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x2000)
    output = func.parameter_vars[0]
    il.append(il.call([il.var(4, output)], il.const_pointer(off.address_size, func.start), []))
    il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, 29)))
    il.append(il.ret([il.var(4, output)]))
    il.finalize()
    il.generate_ssa_form()
    changed, report = scratch.run(il)
    assert report.stores == 1 and changed is not il
    calls = [i for i in changed.instructions if i.operation == Op.MLIL_CALL]
    assert len(calls) == 1 and calls[0].dest.constant == func.start
    assert calls[0].output == il[0].output
    assert [(i.size, i.operation) for i in calls[0].output_exprs] == [(4, Op.MLIL_VAR)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("volatile", (False, True))
def test_native_alias_promotion_requires_an_ordinary_private_slot(builds, volatile):
    _, _, off = builds
    func = function_named(off, "scratch_dead")
    slot = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x3000)
    kind = Type.int(4, False).mutable_copy()
    kind.volatile = volatile
    func.create_user_var(slot, kind.immutable_copy(), "scratch_test_slot")
    settle(off)
    assert slot.type is not None and slot.type.width == 4
    assert bool(slot.type.volatile) == volatile
    try:
        il = MediumLevelILFunction(func.arch, low_level_il=func.llil)
        il.prepare_to_copy_function(func.mlil)
        il.prepare_to_copy_block(func.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
        il.set_current_address(func.start, func.arch)
        il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, 0)))
        il.append(il.store(4, il.address_of(slot), il.const(4, 0x12345678)))
        il.append(il.ret([il.load(4, il.address_of(slot))]))
        il.finalize()
        il.generate_ssa_form()
        assert slot in il.ssa_form.aliased_vars
        changed, report = scratch.run(il)
        if volatile:
            assert changed is il and not report.stores and not report.accesses and not report.aliases
        else:
            assert report.accesses == 2 and report.aliases == 1
            assert slot not in changed.ssa_form.aliased_vars
            assert not any(n.operation in scratch._LOADS | scratch._STORES
                           for i in changed.instructions for n in scratch.walk(i))
            from binja_d810.binja.mlil.lift import lift
            ret = next(i for i in changed.instructions if i.operation == Op.MLIL_RET)
            value = lift(ret.src[0].ssa_form, root_instr=ret, check_versions=False)
            assert check_equivalent(value, Const(0x12345678, 32)) is Verdict.PROVEN
    finally:
        func.delete_user_var(slot)


def test_native_i686_partial_store_limitation_is_not_introduced_by_d810():
    views = [open_sample("scratch_i686-pe_O2.dll", d810=False),
             open_sample("scratch_i686-pe_O2.dll", d810=True)]
    try:
        for bv in views:
            set_types(bv, {"scratch_partial": TYPES["scratch_partial"]})
            settle(bv)
        before, _ = value_ir(function_named(views[0], "scratch_partial"))
        after, _ = value_ir(function_named(views[1], "scratch_partial"))
        assert check_equivalent(before, after) is Verdict.PROVEN
    finally:
        for bv in views: bv.file.close()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("build", MATRIX, ids=IDS)
```

`tests/binja/test_selfcall_arguments.py`:

```py
"""Frame checks over synthetic MLIL with many ABI parameters, across the native build matrix."""

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from binaryninja import MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, Variable, VariableSourceType
from helpers import function_named, open_sample, set_types

from binja_d810.binja.unflatten import selfcall

COUNT = 48


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def wide(request):
    bv = open_sample(sample("outlined", *request.param), d810=False)
    # Only the function's ABI parameter locations are used by the synthetic MLIL below.
    signature = "uint64_t sc_dispatch(" + ", ".join(f"uint64_t p{i}" for i in range(COUNT)) + ")"
    set_types(bv, {"sc_dispatch": signature})
    func = function_named(bv, "sc_dispatch")
    assert len(func.parameter_vars) == COUNT
    yield func
    bv.file.close()


def _call(func, mode="passthrough"):
    il = MediumLevelILFunction(func.arch, low_level_il=func.llil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_function(func.mlil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_block(func.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
    il.set_current_address(func.start, func.arch)
    params = list(func.parameter_vars)
    args = [il.const(8, 7), *[il.var(8, p) for p in params[1:]]]
    local = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x1000)
    if mode == "assigned":
        for n, param in enumerate(params):
            il.append(il.set_var(8, param, il.const(8, n + 1)))
    elif mode == "address":
        args[-1] = il.address_of(local)
    elif mode in ("reassigned", "overwritten", "partial", "memory"):
        address = il.address_of(local)
        if func.arch.address_size < 8:
            address = il.zero_extend(8, address)
        il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], address))
        if mode == "overwritten":
            il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], il.var(8, params[-2])))
        elif mode == "partial":
            il.append(il.set_var_field(1, params[-1], 0, il.const(1, 0)))
        elif mode == "memory":
            cell = il.const_pointer(func.arch.address_size, func.view.start)
            il.append(il.store(8, cell, il.var(8, params[-1])))
            il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], il.load(8, cell)))
    elif mode == "merged":
        local_arm, input_arm, join = MediumLevelILLabel(), MediumLevelILLabel(), MediumLevelILLabel()
        il.append(il.if_expr(il.compare_equal(8, il.var(8, params[1]), il.const(8, 0)), local_arm, input_arm))
        il.mark_label(local_arm)
        address = il.address_of(local)
        if func.arch.address_size < 8:
            address = il.zero_extend(8, address)
        il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], address))
        il.append(il.goto(join))
        il.mark_label(input_arm)
        il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], il.var(8, params[-2])))
        il.append(il.goto(join))
        il.mark_label(join)
    elif mode == "returned":
        result = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x3000)
        # An unknown helper may return its pointer argument, as memcpy and identity helpers do.
        il.append(il.call([result], il.const_pointer(func.arch.address_size, func.start + 4), [il.address_of(local)]))
        args[-1] = il.var(8, result)
    elif mode == "deep":
        previous = params[1]
        for n in range(selfcall.MAX_TRACE + 1):
            var = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x2000 - 8 * n)
            il.append(il.set_var(8, var, il.var(8, previous)))
            previous = var
        args[-1] = il.var(8, previous)
    il.append(il.tailcall([], il.const_pointer(func.arch.address_size, func.start), args))
    il.finalize()
    il.generate_ssa_form()
    assert list(il.basic_blocks), "the synthetic function must have a valid entry block"
    if mode in ("reassigned", "overwritten", "partial", "merged", "memory"):
        assert il.get_var_definitions(params[-1])
    elif mode == "deep":
        assert il.get_var_definitions(previous)
    elif mode == "returned":
        assert il.get_var_definitions(result)
    return il, params


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["passthrough", "assigned", "overwritten"])
def test_many_independent_parameters_do_not_exhaust_the_frame_check(wide, mode):
    il, params = _call(wide, mode)
    moves = selfcall.moves(il, len(il) - 1, params)
    assert moves is not None and len(moves) == 1
    assert moves[0][0] == params[0]
    assert selfcall.loop(il, wide.view) is not None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["address", "reassigned", "returned", "deep", "merged", "partial", "memory"])
def test_late_frame_addresses_and_deep_definition_chains_stay_calls(wide, mode):
    il, params = _call(wide, mode)
    assert selfcall.moves(il, len(il) - 1, params) is None
    assert selfcall.loop(il, wide.view) is None


def test_shared_argument_expressions_use_their_call_sites_ssa_versions(wide):
    il = MediumLevelILFunction(wide.arch, low_level_il=wide.llil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_function(wide.mlil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_block(wide.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
    il.set_current_address(wide.start, wide.arch)
    params = list(wide.parameter_vars)
    args = [il.const(8, 7), *[il.var(8, p) for p in params[1:]]]
    il.append(il.call([], il.const_pointer(wide.arch.address_size, wide.start + 4), args))
    local = Variable(wide, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x1000)
    address = il.address_of(local)
    if wide.arch.address_size < 8:
        address = il.zero_extend(8, address)
    il.append(il.set_var(8, params[-1], address))
    il.append(il.tailcall([], il.const_pointer(wide.arch.address_size, wide.start), args))
    il.finalize()
    il.generate_ssa_form()
    assert selfcall.moves(il, 0, params) is not None
    assert selfcall.moves(il, len(il) - 1, params) is None
```

`tests/binja/test_shift_reference.py`:

```py
"""Shift semantics against Binary Ninja's IL and the hardware.

tests/samples/src/shifts_*.S pairs each variable-count function (`shl8_var`) with constant-input
functions whose result Binary Ninja's dataflow folds (`shl8_by8`). Three references must agree:
the IR evaluator applied to the lifted variable-count function, Binary Ninja's folded constant,
and the architecture manual's definition (written out here).
"""

import pytest
from binaryninja import MediumLevelILOperation
from helpers import open_sample

from binja_d810.binja.mlil.lift import lift
from binja_d810.ir.evaluate import evaluate
from binja_d810.ir.expr import mask, to_signed, variables


def hardware(arch: str, op: str, x: int, count: int, width: int) -> int:
    """Intel SDM SHL/SHR/SAR/ROL/ROR: count masked to 5 bits (6 for 64-bit operands); rotates then
    take it modulo the operand size. ARM ARM LSLV/LSRV/ASRV/RORV: count modulo the register width."""
    if arch == "x86":
        c = count & (0x3F if width == 64 else 0x1F)
    else:
        c = count % width
    m = mask(width)
    if op in ("rol", "ror"):
        c %= width
        if c == 0:
            return x & m
        return ((x << c) | (x >> (width - c))) & m if op == "rol" else ((x >> c) | (x << (width - c))) & m
    if op == "shl":
        return (x << c) & m
    if op == "lshr":
        return (x & m) >> c
    return (to_signed(x, width) >> c) & m


# (file, variable-count function, constant function, op, x, count, width)
CASES = [
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl8_var", "shl8_by8", "shl", 1, 8, 8),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "sar8_var", "sar8_by8", "ashr", 0x80, 8, 8),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shr8_var", "shr8_imm9", "lshr", 0x80, 9, 8),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl32_var", "shl32_by33", "shl", 1, 33, 32),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl64_var", "shl64_by65", "shl", 1, 65, 64),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "lsl32_var", "lsl32_by33", "shl", 1, 33, 32),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "lsl64_var", "lsl64_by65", "shl", 1, 65, 64),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "asr32_var", "asr32_by32", "ashr", 0x80000000, 32, 32),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "lsr32_var", "lsr32_by32", "lshr", 0x80000000, 32, 32),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "rol8_var", "rol8_by9", "rol", 0x81, 9, 8),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "ror32_var", "ror32_by33", "ror", 1, 33, 32),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "rol64_var", "rol64_by65", "rol", 0x8000000000000001, 65, 64),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "ror32_var", "ror32_by33", "ror", 1, 33, 32),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "ror64_var", "ror64_by65", "ror", 1, 65, 64),
]
# Constant-only fixtures: Binary Ninja's folded value against the manual.
FOLDED = [
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shr16_by16", "lshr", 0x8000, 16, 16),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl8_imm9", "shl", 1, 9, 8),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl16_imm17", "shl", 1, 17, 16),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shl32_imm33", "shl", 1, 33, 32),
    ("shifts_x86_64.so", "sar8_imm9", "ashr", 0x80, 9, 8),
    ("shifts_arm64.dylib", "lsr64_by65", "lshr", 1 << 63, 65, 64),
]


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def views():
    opened = {name: open_sample(name, d810=False) for name in ("shifts_x86_64.so", "shifts_arm64.dylib")}
    yield opened
    for bv in opened.values():
        bv.file.close()


def _function(bv, name):
    for candidate in (name, "_" + name):
        found = bv.get_functions_by_name(candidate)
        if found:
            return found[0]
    raise LookupError(name)


def _returned_constant(func) -> int:
    (ret,) = [i for i in func.mlil.instructions if i.operation == MediumLevelILOperation.MLIL_RET]
    value = ret.src[0].value
    assert value.type.name in ("ConstantValue", "ConstantPointerValue"), value
    return value.value


def _arch(file_name: str) -> str:
    return "x86" if "x86" in file_name else "arm64"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", CASES, ids=lambda c: c[1])
def test_lifted_shift_matches_binary_ninja_and_hardware(views, case):
    file_name, var_func, const_func, op, x, count, width = case
    bv = views[file_name]
    expected = hardware(_arch(file_name), op, x, count, width)
    assert _returned_constant(_function(bv, const_func)) & mask(width) == expected

    func = _function(bv, var_func)
    (ret,) = [i for i in func.mlil.instructions if i.operation == MediumLevelILOperation.MLIL_RET]
    ir = lift(ret.src[0].ssa_form, root_instr=ret, check_versions=False)
    assert ir is not None, str(ret)
    env = {}
    for leaf in variables(ir):
        name = leaf.ref.var.name if hasattr(leaf.ref, "var") else leaf.name
        env[leaf.name] = x if name.startswith("arg1") else count if name.startswith("arg2") else 0
    assert evaluate(ir, env) & mask(width) == expected, (str(ret), ir)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", FOLDED, ids=lambda c: c[1])
def test_binary_ninja_folds_like_the_hardware(views, case):
    file_name, const_func, op, x, count, width = case
    folded = _returned_constant(_function(views[file_name], const_func)) & mask(width)
    assert folded == hardware(_arch(file_name), op, x, count, width)
```

`tests/binja/test_substitution.py`:

```py
"""Bitwise substitution and polynomial predicates (v4.3): collapsed and folded; ordinary bitwise code stays."""

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from helpers import function_named, open_sample, set_types

from binja_d810.binja import log

TYPES = {name: f"uint32_t {name}(uint32_t x, uint32_t y)" for name in (
    "sub_or", "sub_and", "sub_xor", "sub_bool", "sub_const", "xor_cancel", "plain_mask", "plain_or", "mix", "merge",
    "sq_pred", "sq_div", "sq_near")}
TYPES["sq_merged"] = "uint32_t sq_merged(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t n)"
# What each substitution must lose: the operations (or constant) only its encoded form has.
COLLAPSED = {"sub_or": ("^", "&"), "sub_and": ("^", "~"), "sub_xor": ("~", "&"), "sub_bool": ("^",),
             "sub_const": ("0xf0",), "xor_cancel": ("^",)}
CONTROLS = ("plain_mask", "plain_or", "mix", "merge")


def _open(build, level, d810):

    set_types(bv, TYPES)
    return bv


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def views(request):
    on, off = _open(*request.param, d810=True), _open(*request.param, d810=False)
    yield on, off
    on.file.close()
    off.file.close()


def _text(bv, name) -> str:
    return "\n".join(map(str, function_named(bv, name).hlil.instructions))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", COLLAPSED)
def test_substitutions_collapse(views, name):
    text = _text(views[0], name)
    assert not [token for token in COLLAPSED[name] if token in text], text
    for level, report in log.latest_reports(function_named(views[0], name)).items():
        assert not report.rolled_back and not report.errors, (level, report.errors)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", CONTROLS)
def test_ordinary_bitwise_code_is_unchanged(views, name):
    assert _text(views[0], name) == _text(views[1], name)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["sq_pred", "sq_div", "sq_merged"])
def test_polynomial_predicates_fold(views, name):
    text = _text(views[0], name)
    assert "0x5a" not in text, text  # the dead branch xors with 0x5a


def test_a_satisfiable_near_miss_stays(views):
    assert "if (" in _text(views[0], "sq_near")
```

`tests/binja/test_unflatten.py`:

```py
"""v4.2: unflattening, in its activity after the MLIL pass, on the flatten fixtures (tests/samples/src/flatten.c)

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from binaryninja import Settings
from flowcases import has, text
from helpers import function_named, marks, open_sample, settle
from unflattencases import NEGATIVES, NOT_FLATTENED, ORDERS, SHAPES

from binja_d810.binja import log, settings, unflatten, workflow
from binja_d810.binja.unflatten import rewrite

ONE = ("x86_64-elf", "O2")  # the build the single-build tests use


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def builds(request):
    """(build-level, D-810 on and settled, D-810 off)."""

    on.file.close()
    off.file.close()


def _states(hlil: str, name: str) -> list[str]:
    return [hex(c) for c in SHAPES[name] if has(hlil, hex(c))]


def _first(found: list[int], k: int):
    return found.index(k) if k in found else None


def _lines(func) -> list[str]:
    report = log.latest_reports(func).get("mlil")
    return [] if report is None else report.unflatten


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(SHAPES))
def test_a_flattened_function_is_unflattened(builds, name):
    key, on, _ = builds
    if (key, name) in NOT_FLATTENED:
        return
    func = function_named(on, name)
    hlil = text(func)
    assert not _states(hlil, name), hlil
    found = marks(func)
    for earlier, later in ORDERS[name]:
        a, b = _first(found, earlier), _first(found, later)
        assert a is not None and b is not None and a < b, f"mark({earlier}) before mark({later}):\n{hlil}"
    assert _lines(func), workflow.debug_report_text(func)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", NEGATIVES)
def test_a_negative_is_unchanged(builds, name):
    key, on, off = builds
    func = function_named(on, name)
    assert not _lines(func), f"{key} {name}: {_lines(func)}"
    assert text(func) == text(function_named(off, name))


def test_the_debug_report_shows_the_rounds(builds):
    _, on, _ = builds
    if not _lines(function_named(on, "fl_tree")):
        pytest.fail("fl_tree was not unflattened")
    assert "unflatten: round 1" in workflow.debug_report_text(function_named(on, "fl_tree"))


def test_a_large_handler_keeps_its_loop_and_result(builds):
    _, on, _ = builds
    func = function_named(on, "fl_large_loop")
    hlil = text(func)
    assert not _states(hlil, "fl_large_loop"), hlil
    assert "while" in hlil or "for" in hlil, hlil
    assert ("0x60" in hlil or "0x5f" in hlil) and "^" in hlil and "+ 7" in hlil, hlil
    assert len(list(func.hlil.instructions)) < 40, hlil  # keep the loop; do not clone its 96 iterations
    assert marks(func) == [91, 92], hlil


def _open_one():
    bv = open_sample(sample("flatten", *ONE), d810=True)
    settle(bv)
    return bv


def _reanalyze(bv, name):
    function_named(bv, name).reanalyze()
    settle(bv)
    return text(function_named(bv, name))


def test_the_setting_turns_unflattening_off_and_on():
    bv = _open_one()
    try:
        assert not _states(text(function_named(bv, "fl_tree")), "fl_tree")
        Settings().set_bool(settings.UNFLATTEN, False, bv)
        assert _states(_reanalyze(bv, "fl_tree"), "fl_tree")
        Settings().set_bool(settings.UNFLATTEN, True, bv)
        assert not _states(_reanalyze(bv, "fl_tree"), "fl_tree")
    finally:
        bv.file.close()


def test_a_failure_keeps_the_function_analyzable(monkeypatch):
    errors = []

    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
        raise RuntimeError("injected")

    monkeypatch.setattr(rewrite, "rewrite", fail)
    monkeypatch.setattr(log.logger, "log_error", lambda message, *args: errors.append(message))
    bv = _open_one()
    try:
        func = function_named(bv, "fl_tree")
        assert func.hlil is not None and _states(text(func), "fl_tree")
        assert any("binja-d810 unflatten failed at" in e and "injected" in e for e in errors), errors
    finally:
        bv.file.close()


def test_a_round_over_the_growth_cap_is_not_applied(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(unflatten, "GROWTH", 0)
    monkeypatch.setattr(unflatten, "GROWTH_SLACK", 0)
    bv = _open_one()
    try:
        func = function_named(bv, "fl_tree")
        assert _states(text(func), "fl_tree")
        assert any("not applied" in line for line in _lines(func)), _lines(func)
    finally:
        bv.file.close()
```

```py
"""v4.2: plans over the MLIL graph (binja_d810.binja.unflatten.graph) for the flatten fixtures
(tests/samples/src/flatten.c), on 8 builds, with D-810 off."""

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from binaryninja import ILSourceLocation, MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILOperation as Op
from flowcases import has, text
from helpers import function_named, open_sample
from unflattencases import NEGATIVES, NO_JUMP_TABLE, NOT_FLATTENED, SHAPES

from binja_d810.binja.unflatten.graph import MLILGraph
from binja_d810.binja.unflatten import has_table_dispatcher, rewrite
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.expr import Const

@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def off(request):

def _plan(bv, name):

@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(SHAPES))

    assert found.threads and found.states, f"{key} {name}: {found}"
    assert all(graph.name(v) for v in found.states)

    if (key, "fl_dense") in NOT_FLATTENED:

    if (key, "fl_dense") in NO_JUMP_TABLE:
        assert not jumps, f"listed as having no jump table, but the dispatcher jumps: {key}"
        return
    assert jumps, f"{key}: {found.dispatcher}"


def test_the_budget_probe_recognizes_a_constant_state_jump_table(off):

@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(SHAPES) + NEGATIVES)
def test_a_constant_condition_is_decided(off, name):
    key, bv = off
    func = function_named(bv, name)
    graph = MLILGraph(func.mlil, view=bv, ranges=[])
    for b in graph.blocks():
        last = func.mlil[graph.il_block(b).end - 1]
        if last.operation == Op.MLIL_IF and last.condition.operation in (Op.MLIL_CONST, Op.MLIL_CONST_PTR):
            term = graph.terminator(b)
            assert isinstance(term, Branch) and term.cond == Const(1 if last.condition.constant else 0, 1), \
                f"{key} {name} block {b}: {last} -> {term}"

    _, bv = off
    graph, found = _plan(bv, "fl_tree")
    assert found.threads
    assert rewrite.size_bound(graph, found) >= len(rewrite.rewrite(graph, found))


def _gotos_as_resolved_jumps(func, mode="constant"):
    """A copy with the form BN uses after resolving an indirect jump to one internal block."""
    old = func.mlil
    new = MediumLevelILFunction(old.arch, low_level_il=old.llil)
    new.prepare_to_copy_function(old)
    for block in old.basic_blocks:
        new.prepare_to_copy_block(block)
        for instr in block:
            loc = ILSourceLocation.from_instruction(instr)
            new.set_current_address(instr.address, block.arch)
            if instr.operation == Op.MLIL_GOTO:
                address = old[instr.dest].address
                label = new.get_label_for_source_instruction(instr.dest)
                dest = new.const_pointer(old.arch.address_size, address + (mode == "different"), loc)
                if mode == "load":
                    dest = new.load(old.arch.address_size, dest, loc)
                new.append(new.jump_to(dest, {address: label}, loc), loc)
            else:
                new.append(instr.copy_to(new), loc)
    new.finalize()
    new.generate_ssa_form()
    return new


def test_a_resolved_constant_jump_can_be_threaded_like_a_goto(off):
    _, bv = off
    mlil = _gotos_as_resolved_jumps(function_named(bv, "fl_tree"))
    graph = MLILGraph(mlil, view=bv, ranges=[])
    jumps = [b for b in graph.blocks() if mlil[graph.il_block(b).end - 1].operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO]
    assert jumps
    assert all(isinstance(graph.terminator(b), Goto) for b in jumps)
    found = plan(graph)
    assert any(t.pred in jumps for t in found.threads), found
    rewritten = rewrite.rewrite(graph, found)
    assert sum(i.operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO for i in rewritten.instructions) < len(jumps)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["load", "different"])
def test_a_single_target_alone_does_not_make_a_jump_unconditional(off, mode):
    _, bv = off
    mlil = _gotos_as_resolved_jumps(function_named(bv, "fl_tree"), mode)
    graph = MLILGraph(mlil, view=bv, ranges=[])
    jumps = [b for b in graph.blocks() if mlil[graph.il_block(b).end - 1].operation == Op.MLIL_JUMP_TO]
    assert jumps and all(isinstance(graph.terminator(b), Jump) for b in jumps)
```

`tests/binja/test_unflatten_widths.py`:

```py
"""Mixed-width writes to an untyped copied variable must keep their own SSA widths."""

from types import SimpleNamespace

import pytest
from arch import IDS, MATRIX, sample
from binaryninja import (MediumLevelILFunction, MediumLevelILLabel, MediumLevelILOperation as Op,
                         Variable, VariableSourceType)
from helpers import function_named, open_sample

from binja_d810.binja import unflatten
from binja_d810.binja.unflatten.graph import MLILGraph
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.expr import Const
from binja_d810.unflatten.graph import Assign, Unknown
from binja_d810.unflatten.thread import plan

STATES = (0x19, 0x2d, 0x47)
WIDE = 0x1122334455667788


@pytest.fixture(scope="module", params=MATRIX, ids=IDS)
def off(request):
    bv = open_sample(sample("mixed_outlined", *request.param), d810=False)
    yield bv
    bv.file.close()


def _machine(bv, mode="constant"):
    func = function_named(bv, "mixed_dispatch")
    il = MediumLevelILFunction(func.arch, low_level_il=func.llil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_function(func.mlil)
    il.prepare_to_copy_block(func.mlil.basic_blocks[0])
    il.set_current_address(func.start, func.arch)
    slot = Variable(func, VariableSourceType.StackVariableSourceType, 0, -0x2000)
    assert slot.type is None
    incoming = list(func.parameter_vars)[0]
    condition_size = 8 if mode == "wide_read" else 2 if mode == "low_read" else 4
    def encoded(state):
        return state | (0xA1B20000 if mode == "low_read" else 0)
    head, a, test_b, b, test_c, c = [MediumLevelILLabel() for _ in range(6)]
    il.append(il.set_var(8, slot, il.const(8, WIDE)))
    if mode in ("uniform_phi", "mixed_phi"):
        left, right = MediumLevelILLabel(), MediumLevelILLabel()
        il.append(il.if_expr(il.compare_equal(4, il.var(4, incoming), il.const(4, 0)), left, right))
        il.mark_label(left)
        il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, encoded(STATES[0]))))
        il.append(il.goto(head))
        il.mark_label(right)
        if mode == "uniform_phi":
            il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, encoded(STATES[1]))))
    else:
        il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, encoded(STATES[0]))))
    il.append(il.goto(head))
    il.mark_label(head)
    il.append(il.if_expr(il.compare_equal(condition_size, il.var(condition_size, slot),
                                        il.const(condition_size, STATES[0])), a, test_b))
    il.mark_label(a)
    mark = function_named(bv, "mark").start
    il.append(il.call([], il.const_pointer(bv.address_size, mark), [il.const(4, 91)]))
    if mode == "input":
        value = il.var(4, incoming)
    elif mode == "load":
        value = il.load(4, il.const_pointer(bv.address_size, bv.start))
    else:
        value = il.const(4, encoded(STATES[1]))
    if mode == "partial":
        il.append(il.set_var_field(1, slot, 0, il.const(1, STATES[1])))
    else:
        il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, value))
    il.append(il.goto(head))
    il.mark_label(test_b)
    il.append(il.if_expr(il.compare_equal(condition_size, il.var(condition_size, slot),
                                        il.const(condition_size, STATES[1])), b, test_c))
    il.mark_label(b)
    il.append(il.call([], il.const_pointer(bv.address_size, mark), [il.const(4, 92)]))
    il.append(il.set_var(4, slot, il.const(4, encoded(STATES[2]))))
    il.append(il.goto(head))
    il.mark_label(test_c)
    il.append(il.if_expr(il.compare_equal(condition_size, il.var(condition_size, slot),
                                        il.const(condition_size, STATES[2])), c, head))
    il.mark_label(c)
    il.append(il.call([], il.const_pointer(bv.address_size, mark), [il.const(4, 93)]))
    il.append(il.ret([il.const(bv.address_size, 7)]))
    il.finalize()
    il.generate_ssa_form()
    assert slot.type is None
    assert {d.size for d in il.get_var_definitions(slot)} >= {4, 8}
    return func, il, slot


def test_untyped_versions_keep_their_actual_assignment_widths(off):
    _, il, slot = _machine(off)
    graph = MLILGraph(il, view=off, ranges=[])
    definitions = [i for i in il.ssa_form.instructions
                   if i.operation == Op.MLIL_SET_VAR_SSA and i.dest.var.identifier == slot.identifier]
    assert {d.size for d in definitions} == {4, 8}
    for d in definitions:
        key = graph._key(d.dest)
        assert graph.width(key) == d.size * 8
        assert graph.definition(key) == Assign(Const(d.src.constant, d.size * 8))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["constant", "uniform_phi", "low_read"])
def test_a_mixed_width_temporary_does_not_hide_constant_dispatcher_states(off, mode):
    func, il, slot = _machine(off, mode)
    graph = MLILGraph(il, view=off, ranges=[])
    found = plan(graph)
    assert found.threads and slot.identifier in found.states
    def marker(block):
        return next((i.params[0].constant for i in graph.il_block(block) if i.operation == Op.MLIL_CALL), None)
    transitions = {(marker(t.pred), marker(t.outcome.dest)) for t in found.threads if t.outcome is not None}
    assert {(91, 92), (92, 93)} <= transitions
    ctx = SimpleNamespace(mlil=il, function=func)
    report = unflatten.run(ctx, deadline=Deadline.after(5), ranges=[])
    assert any("edges threaded" in line for line in report), report
    assert ctx.mlil is not il
    calls = [i for i in ctx.mlil.instructions if i.operation == Op.MLIL_CALL]
    assert {i.params[0].constant for i in calls} >= {91, 92, 93}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", ["mixed_phi", "input", "load", "partial", "wide_read"])
def test_ambiguous_widths_and_unknown_state_writes_stay_conservative(off, mode):
    _, il, _ = _machine(off, mode)
    graph = MLILGraph(il, view=off, ranges=[])
    assert not plan(graph).threads


def test_width_inference_stops_at_its_definition_budget(off):
    _, il, slot = _machine(off, "uniform_phi")
    graph = MLILGraph(il, view=off, ranges=[], max_nodes=1)
    phi = next(i for i in il.ssa_form.instructions
               if i.operation == Op.MLIL_VAR_PHI and i.dest.var.identifier == slot.identifier)
    key = graph._key(phi.dest)
    assert graph.width(key) == 0
    assert graph.definition(key) == Unknown()
```

`tests/binja/unflattencases.py`:

```py
"""The flatten fixtures' cases (tests/samples/src/flatten.c), shared by test_unflatten_graph.py and test_unflatten.py."""

# Each flattened function's state constants.
SHAPES = {
    "fl_tree": [0x7a3c19e5, 0x1b4d8c27, 0x5e91a3f0, 0x33c6d218, 0x6f2b9c41],
    "fl_dense": list(range(0x40, 0x47)),
    "fl_nested": [0x2d81f6a3, 0x49e07b12, 0x0c5a9e84, 0x71f3d250],
    "fl_loop": [0x58c2e13b, 0x26b9d4f7, 0x4e7a0d93, 0x1c95b2e6, 0x6a17c05e],
    "fl_large_loop": [0x5187a321, 0x3b65d902, 0x6c194e53],
    "fl_glue": [0x3e6a1d97, 0x17f4a6c9, 0x52c8b0e3, 0x6d09e3b5],
}
# (earlier, later) mark(k) calls: the order the machine runs its handlers in, on every path through both.
ORDERS = {
    "fl_tree": [(1, 2), (2, 3), (2, 4), (4, 5)],
    "fl_dense": [(11, 14), (14, 16), (16, 12), (12, 15), (15, 13), (13, 17)],
    "fl_nested": [(21, 22), (22, 23), (22, 24)],
    "fl_loop": [(31, 32), (32, 33), (33, 34)],
    "fl_large_loop": [(91, 92)],
    "fl_glue": [(51, 52), (51, 53), (52, 54), (53, 54)],
}
NEGATIVES = ["plain_for", "found_flag", "global_state", "escaped_state"]
# (build-level, function) -> why the compiler left no dispatcher there. Strict: a listed case whose state
# constants are still in the HLIL fails the baseline test, so the list stays true.
NOT_FLATTENED: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
# (build-level, function) -> why the dense switch has no jump table there. Strict: a listed case whose
# dispatcher jumps fails, so the list stays true.
_COMPARE_TREE = "clang for arm64 lowers the 7-case switch to a tree of compares, not a jump table"
NO_JUMP_TABLE: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {
    ("arm64-O0", "fl_dense"): _COMPARE_TREE,
    ("arm64-O2", "fl_dense"): _COMPARE_TREE,
}
```

`tests/samples/allocations.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Static fixtures with real allocator imports. No sample binary is executed.
set -euo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
OUT="$HERE/build"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
printf 'LIBRARY ucrtbase.dll\nEXPORTS\n malloc\n free\n' > "$OUT/allocation_imports.def"
for opt in O0 O2; do
  clang -arch arm64 "-$opt" -shared -o "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_$opt.dylib" "$HERE/src/allocation_roundtrips.c"
  for target in x86_64-pc-windows-msvc i686-pc-windows-msvc; do
    id=x86_64-pe; machine=x64
    if [ "$target" = i686-pc-windows-msvc ]; then id=i686-pe; machine=x86; fi
    lld-link /lib /def:"$OUT/allocation_imports.def" /machine:"$machine" /out:"$OUT/allocation_imports_$id.lib"
    clang -target "$target" "-$opt" -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector -c "$HERE/src/allocation_roundtrips.c" -o "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_${id}_$opt.obj"
    lld-link /dll /noentry /nodefaultlib /out:"$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_${id}_$opt.dll" "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_${id}_$opt.obj" "$OUT/allocation_imports_$id.lib"
  done
  clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -fPIC "-$opt" -ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector -c "$HERE/src/allocation_roundtrips.c" -o "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_x86_64-elf_$opt.o"
  ld.lld -shared -Bsymbolic -nostdlib -o "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_x86_64-elf_$opt.so" "$OUT/allocation_roundtrips_x86_64-elf_$opt.o"
done
rm -f "$OUT"/allocation_imports.def "$OUT"/allocation_imports_*.lib "$OUT"/allocation_imports_*.exp "$OUT"/allocation_roundtrips_*.obj "$OUT"/allocation_roundtrips_*.o "$OUT"/allocation_roundtrips_*.lib "$OUT"/allocation_roundtrips_*.exp
```

`tests/samples/build.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the sample binaries into tests/samples/build: the generated MBA corpus and the fixture
# sources for every target in tests/binja/arch.py, at -O0 and -O2, plus exact-assembly fixtures.
# ARM64 keeps v1's names (mba_O2.dylib); other targets add the build id (mba_x86_64-pe_O2.dll).
set -euo pipefail
HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
OUT="$HERE/build"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
uv run --project "$HERE/../.." python "$HERE/gen_mba.py" --out "$OUT"
uv run --project "$HERE/../.." python "$HERE/gen_opaque.py" --out "$OUT"
SOURCES=("$OUT/mba.c" "$OUT/opaque.c" "$HERE/src/regression.c" "$HERE/src/safety.c" "$HERE/src/effects.c" "$HERE/src/hlil_fixtures.c" "$HERE/src/predicates.c" "$HERE/src/bcf.c" "$HERE/src/div.c" "$HERE/src/flow.c" "$HERE/src/flatten.c" "$HERE/src/substitution.c" "$HERE/src/keys.c" "$HERE/src/key_bounds.c" "$HERE/src/pointer_uses.c" "$HERE/src/callees.c" "$HERE/src/scratch.c" "$HERE/src/flag_conditions.c" "$HERE/src/outlined.c" "$HERE/src/mixed_outlined.c" "$HERE/src/loops.c")
FLAGS=(-ffreestanding -fno-builtin -fno-stack-protector)
for opt in O0 O2; do
  for src in "${SOURCES[@]}"; do
    base="$(basename "$src" .c)"
    clang -arch arm64 "-$opt" -shared -o "$OUT/${base}_$opt.dylib" "$src"
    for target in x86_64-pc-windows-msvc i686-pc-windows-msvc; do
      id="$([ "$target" = x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ] && echo x86_64-pe || echo i686-pe)"
      clang -target "$target" "-$opt" "${FLAGS[@]}" -c "$src" -o "$OUT/${base}_${id}_$opt.obj"
      lld-link /dll /noentry /nodefaultlib /out:"$OUT/${base}_${id}_$opt.dll" "$OUT/${base}_${id}_$opt.obj" >/dev/null
    done
    clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -fPIC "-$opt" "${FLAGS[@]}" -c "$src" -o "$OUT/${base}_x86_64-elf_$opt.o"
    ld.lld -shared -nostdlib -o "$OUT/${base}_x86_64-elf_$opt.so" "$OUT/${base}_x86_64-elf_$opt.o"
  done
done
# Exact-assembly fixtures: shift boundaries, effects, partial registers, carry-flag selects.
for asm in shifts_x86_64 effects_x86_64 partial_x86_64 select_x86_64; do
  clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -c "$HERE/src/$asm.S" -o "$OUT/$asm.o"
  ld.lld -shared -o "$OUT/$asm.so" "$OUT/$asm.o"
done
clang -target i686-linux-gnu -c "$HERE/src/partial_i686.S" -o "$OUT/partial_i686.o"
ld.lld -shared -o "$OUT/partial_i686.so" "$OUT/partial_i686.o"
clang -arch arm64 -shared -o "$OUT/shifts_arm64.dylib" "$HERE/src/shifts_arm64.S"
# Internal branches misclassified as tail calls, plus actual-call and writable-table controls.
clang -arch arm64 -shared -o "$OUT/internal_branches.dylib" "$HERE/src/internal_branches.S"
clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -fPIC -c "$HERE/src/internal_branches.S" -o "$OUT/internal_branches_x86_64.o"
ld.lld -shared -o "$OUT/internal_branches_x86_64.so" "$OUT/internal_branches_x86_64.o"
for target in x86_64-pc-windows-msvc i686-pc-windows-msvc; do
  id="$([ "$target" = x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ] && echo x86_64-pe || echo i686-pe)"
  clang -target "$target" -c "$HERE/src/internal_branches.S" -o "$OUT/internal_branches_$id.obj"
  lld-link /dll /noentry /nodefaultlib /safeseh:no /export:internal_branch /export:internal_call \
    /export:written_internal_branch /export:set_internal_pointer \
    /out:"$OUT/internal_branches_$id.dll" "$OUT/internal_branches_$id.obj" >/dev/null
done
# Outlined dispatchers carrying a callback in an undeclared register.
clang -arch arm64 -shared -o "$OUT/entry_outlined.dylib" "$HERE/src/entry_outlined.S"
clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -fPIC -c "$HERE/src/entry_outlined.S" -o "$OUT/entry_outlined_x86_64.o"
ld.lld -shared -Bsymbolic -o "$OUT/entry_outlined_x86_64.so" "$OUT/entry_outlined_x86_64.o"
for target in x86_64-pc-windows-msvc i686-pc-windows-msvc; do
  id="$([ "$target" = x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ] && echo x86_64-pe || echo i686-pe)"
  clang -target "$target" -c "$HERE/src/entry_outlined.S" -o "$OUT/entry_outlined_$id.obj"
  lld-link /dll /noentry /nodefaultlib /safeseh:no \
    /export:entry_dispatch /export:entry_h1 /export:entry_h2 /export:entry_h3 /export:entry_forward \
    /export:volatile_dispatch /export:volatile_h1 /export:volatile_h2 /export:volatile_h3 \
    /export:clobber_dispatch /export:clobber_h1 /export:clobber_h2 /export:clobber_h3 \
    /out:"$OUT/entry_outlined_$id.dll" "$OUT/entry_outlined_$id.obj" >/dev/null
done
# Handlers carrying declared register parameters and stack state through tail branches.
clang -arch arm64 -shared -o "$OUT/inherited_outlined.dylib" "$HERE/src/inherited_outlined.S"
clang -target x86_64-linux-gnu -fPIC -c "$HERE/src/inherited_outlined.S" -o "$OUT/inherited_outlined_x86_64.o"
ld.lld -shared -Bsymbolic -o "$OUT/inherited_outlined_x86_64.so" "$OUT/inherited_outlined_x86_64.o"
for target in x86_64-pc-windows-msvc i686-pc-windows-msvc; do
  id="$([ "$target" = x86_64-pc-windows-msvc ] && echo x86_64-pe || echo i686-pe)"
  clang -target "$target" -c "$HERE/src/inherited_outlined.S" -o "$OUT/inherited_outlined_$id.obj"
  lld-link /dll /noentry /nodefaultlib /safeseh:no \
    /export:incoming_dispatch /export:incoming_h1 /export:incoming_h2 /export:incoming_h3 \
    /export:changed_dispatch /export:changed_h1 /export:changed_h2 /export:changed_h3 \
    /export:shifted_dispatch /export:shifted_h1 /export:shifted_h2 /export:shifted_h3 \
    /out:"$OUT/inherited_outlined_$id.dll" "$OUT/inherited_outlined_$id.obj" >/dev/null
done
bash "$HERE/allocations.sh"
bash "$HERE/constant_buffers.sh"
rm -f "$OUT"/*.obj "$OUT"/*.o "$OUT"/*.lib "$OUT"/*.exp
ls "$OUT"
```
