`tests/samples/gen_constant_buffers.py`:

```py
"""Generate constant-input C buffer fixtures and an independent arithmetic manifest."""

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import random


def fixture(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    rotate, multiplier, add, shift = rng.randrange(1, 32), rng.getrandbits(32), rng.getrandbits(32), rng.randrange(32)
    state = initial = rng.getrandbits(32)
    plaintext = bytes(rng.randrange(32, 127) for _ in range(rng.randrange(4, 64))) + b"\0"
    keys, cipher = [], []
    for byte in plaintext:
        key = rng.getrandbits(32)
        state = ((((state >> rotate) | (state << (32 - rotate))) & 0xffffffff) * multiplier + add + key) & 0xffffffff
        keys.append(key)
        cipher.append(((state >> shift) ^ byte) & 255)
    return dict(seed=seed, rotate=rotate, multiplier=multiplier, add=add, shift=shift,
                initial=initial, keys=keys, cipher=cipher, plaintext=list(plaintext))


HEADER = '''#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define F __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline,used))
#else
#define F __attribute__((noinline,used,visibility("default")))
#endif
#define STATE(x) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(x))
#define BUFFER(x) __asm__ volatile("" : "+m"(x) : : "memory")
volatile uint32_t constant_buffer_observer;
F void constant_buffer_use(const uint8_t *p) { constant_buffer_observer=*p; }
F void constant_buffer_length(const uint8_t *p, uint32_t n) { constant_buffer_observer=p[n-1]; }
F uint32_t constant_buffer_unknown(uint32_t x) { return constant_buffer_observer+x; }
F void ce_length(void) {
  uint8_t buffer[7]; uint32_t s=65;
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<7;++i) { STATE(s); buffer[i]=(uint8_t)s; s+=1; }
  BUFFER(buffer); constant_buffer_length(buffer,7);
}
F void ce_unknown(uint32_t s) {
  uint8_t buffer[8];
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<8;++i) { STATE(s); buffer[i]=(uint8_t)s; s+=1; }
  BUFFER(buffer); constant_buffer_use(buffer);
}
F void ce_writable(void) {
  uint8_t buffer[8]; uint32_t s=constant_buffer_observer;
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<8;++i) { STATE(s); buffer[i]=(uint8_t)s; s+=1; }
  BUFFER(buffer); constant_buffer_use(buffer);
}
F void ce_call(void) {
  uint8_t buffer[8]; uint32_t s=constant_buffer_unknown(65);
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<8;++i) { STATE(s); buffer[i]=(uint8_t)s; s+=1; }
  BUFFER(buffer); constant_buffer_use(buffer);
}
F void ce_reentry(uint32_t count) {
  uint8_t buffer[4]; uint32_t s=65;
  do {
    STATE(s); buffer[0]=(uint8_t)s; buffer[1]=(uint8_t)(s+1);
    buffer[2]=(uint8_t)(s+2); buffer[3]=0; s+=1;
    BUFFER(buffer);
  } while(--count);
  constant_buffer_use(buffer);
}
F void ce_volatile(void) {
  volatile uint8_t buffer[8];
  for(uint32_t i=0;i<8;++i) buffer[i]=(uint8_t)(65+i);
  constant_buffer_observer=buffer[1];
}
'''


def source(item, mode):
    name = f"ce_{mode}_{item['seed']:03d}"
    length, r = len(item["keys"]), item["rotate"]
    update = f"(((s >> {r}) | (s << {32-r})) * {item['multiplier']}u + {item['add']}u + KEY)"
    lines = [f"F void {name}(void) {{", f"uint8_t buffer[{length}];", f"uint32_t s={item['initial']}u;"]
    if mode == "loop":
        lines += ["static const uint32_t keys[]={" + ",".join(str(v)+"u" for v in item["keys"]) + "};",
                  "static const uint8_t cipher[]={" + ",".join(map(str,item["cipher"])) + "};",
                  f"for (uint32_t i=0;i<{length};++i) {{", "s="+update.replace("KEY", "keys[i]")+"; STATE(s);",
                  f"buffer[i]=(uint8_t)((s >> {item['shift']}) ^ cipher[i]);", "}"]
    else:
        for index, (key, cipher) in enumerate(zip(item["keys"], item["cipher"])):
            lines += ["s="+update.replace("KEY", str(key)+"u")+"; STATE(s);",
                      f"buffer[{index}]=(uint8_t)((s >> {item['shift']}) ^ {cipher});"]
    lines += ["BUFFER(buffer);", "constant_buffer_use(buffer);", "}"]
    return name, "\n".join(lines)


def generate(out, seeds):
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    code, manifest = [HEADER], []
    for seed in seeds:
        item = fixture(seed)
        for mode in ("loop", "unrolled"):
            name, function = source(item, mode)
            code.append(function)
            manifest.append(dict(item, name=name, mode=mode))
    (out / "constant_buffers.c").write_text("\n\n".join(code))
    (out / "constant_buffers.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--seeds", type=int, default=16)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    generate(args.out, range(args.seeds))

```

`tests/samples/gen_mba.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate MBA test samples: C source plus a manifest of expected simplifications.

Usage: uv run python tests/samples/gen_mba.py --out tests/samples/build
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import random
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, UnOp, Var, is_mba, ops, substitute, to_str, variables  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.rules.instantiate import instantiate  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.rules.prove import solve_constants  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.rules.registry import load_rules  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.third_party.d810.mba.rules import VerifiableRule  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent  # noqa: E402

SEED = 1810
PARAMS = ("x", "y", "z")
CTYPE = {32: "uint32_t", 64: "uint64_t"}
SUFFIX = {32: "u", 64: "ull"}
SYMBOL = {"add": "+", "sub": "-", "mul": "*", "and": "&", "or": "|", "xor": "^", "shl": "<<", "lshr": ">>"}
C_OPS = frozenset(SYMBOL) | {"neg", "not"}

ZERO_IDENTITIES = [  # (simple, complex) with simple == complex for all x, y
    ("x + y", "(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)"),
    ("x + y", "(x | y) + (x & y)"),
    ("x ^ y", "(x | y) - (x & y)"),
    ("x | y", "(x & ~y) + y"),
    ("x & y", "(x | y) - (x ^ y)"),
    ("x - y", "(x ^ y) - 2 * (~x & y)"),
    ("~x", "-x - 1"),
    ("x", "(x & y) + (x & ~y)"),
]
TARGETS = ["x + y", "x - y", "x ^ y", "x | y", "x & y", "x + y + z", "x ^ y ^ z", "(x & y) | z", "2 * x + 3 * y", "x - (y & z)"]
POLY = [
    ("(x & y) * (x | y) + (x & ~y) * (~x & y)", "x * y"),
    ("(x & y) * (x | y) + (x & ~y) * (~x & y) + (x | y) - (x & y)", "x * y + (x ^ y)"),
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Sample:
    name: str
    category: str
    width: int
    obfuscated: Expr
    expected: Expr


def _linear(rng: random.Random, width: int) -> tuple[Expr, Expr]:
    target_text = rng.choice(TARGETS)
    target = parse(target_text, width)
    complex_forms = [c for s, c in ZERO_IDENTITIES if s == target_text]
    obf = parse(rng.choice(complex_forms), width) if complex_forms else target
    for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 4)):
        simple, complex_ = rng.choice(ZERO_IDENTITIES)
        first, second = rng.sample(PARAMS, 2)
        mapping = {"x": Var(first, width), "y": Var(second, width)}
        zero = BinOp("sub", substitute(parse(complex_, width), mapping), substitute(parse(simple, width), mapping), width)
        coeff = rng.choice([1, 2, 3, 5, 7, -1, -3, 0x1337])
        obf = BinOp("add", obf, BinOp("mul", Const(coeff, width), zero, width), width)
    return obf, target


def _c_ok(e: Expr) -> bool:
    return ops(e) <= C_OPS and all(v.name in PARAMS for v in variables(e))


def generate() -> list[Sample]:
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    samples: list[Sample] = []
    instances = {type(r).__name__: r for r in VerifiableRule.instantiate_all()}
    for rule in load_rules():
        if 32 not in rule.widths:
            continue
        obf, repl = instantiate(rule.pattern, 32), instantiate(rule.replacement, 32)
        if obf is None:  # symbolic constants: values that satisfy the rule's constraints (v2.1)
            def matches(values, rule=rule):
                candidate = instantiate(rule.pattern, 32, constants=values)
                return candidate is not None and rule.match(normalize(candidate)) is not None

            constants = solve_constants(instances[rule.name], 32, accept=matches)
            if constants is not None:
                obf = instantiate(rule.pattern, 32, constants=constants)
                repl = instantiate(rule.replacement, 32, constants=constants)
        if obf is None or repl is None or not _c_ok(obf) or not is_mba(normalize(obf)):
            continue
        if is_mba(normalize(repl)):  # rule output is still MBA: not a deobfuscation sample
            continue
        if rule.match(normalize(obf)) is None:
            continue
        samples.append(Sample(f"mba_d810_{rule.name}", "d810", 32, obf, normalize(repl)))
    for i in range(50):
        width = 64 if i % 5 == 4 else 32
        obf, target = _linear(rng, width)
        if is_mba(normalize(obf)):
            samples.append(Sample(f"mba_linear_{i:03d}", "linear", width, obf, normalize(target)))
    for i, (obf_text, expected_text) in enumerate(POLY):
        samples.append(Sample(f"mba_poly_{i}", "poly", 32, parse(obf_text, 32), normalize(parse(expected_text, 32))))
    for s in samples:
        if check_equivalent(s.obfuscated, s.expected, use_z3=False) is Verdict.REFUTED:
            raise AssertionError(f"generator bug: {s.name}")
    return samples


def _bitwise_only(e: Expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(e, (Var, Const)):
        return True
    if isinstance(e, UnOp):
        return e.op == "not" and _bitwise_only(e.operand)
    return e.op in ("and", "or", "xor") and _bitwise_only(e.left) and _bitwise_only(e.right)


def _arith_only(e: Expr) -> bool:
    if isinstance(e, (Var, Const)):
        return True
    if isinstance(e, UnOp):
        return e.op == "neg" and _arith_only(e.operand)
    return e.op in ("add", "sub", "mul") and _arith_only(e.left) and _arith_only(e.right)


def _plain(e: Expr, width: int) -> str:
    if isinstance(e, Var):
        return e.name
    if isinstance(e, Const):
        return f"0x{e.value:x}{SUFFIX[width]}"
    if isinstance(e, UnOp):
        return f"({'-' if e.op == 'neg' else '~'}{_plain(e.operand, width)})"
    return f"({_plain(e.left, width)} {SYMBOL[e.op]} {_plain(e.right, width)})"


def _c(e: Expr, temps: list[str], width: int) -> str:
    if isinstance(e, (Var, Const)):
        return _plain(e, width)
    # Each purely bitwise or purely arithmetic subterm goes through an optimization barrier, so
    # clang cannot fold across the mix (at -O2 it turns (x * x) & 3 into x & 1).
    if _bitwise_only(e) or _arith_only(e):
        temps.append(_plain(e, width))
        return f"t{len(temps) - 1}"
    if isinstance(e, UnOp):
        return f"({'-' if e.op == 'neg' else '~'}{_c(e.operand, temps, width)})"
    return f"({_c(e.left, temps, width)} {SYMBOL[e.op]} {_c(e.right, temps, width)})"


def emit_function(s: Sample) -> str:
    t = CTYPE[s.width]
    temps: list[str] = []
    body = _c(s.obfuscated, temps, s.width)
    lines = [f"EXPORT {t} {s.name}({t} x, {t} y, {t} z) {{", "    (void)x; (void)y; (void)z;"]
    lines += [f"    {t} t{i} = {text}; B(t{i});" for i, text in enumerate(temps)]
    lines += [f"    return {body};", "}", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def emit_c(samples: list[Sample]) -> str:
    header = (
        "// Generated by tests/samples/gen_mba.py. Do not edit.\n"
        "#include <stdint.h>\n"
        '#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))\n'
        "#ifdef _WIN32\n"
        "#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))\n"
        "#else\n"
        '#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))\n'
        "#endif\n\n"
    )
    return header + "\n".join(emit_function(s) for s in samples)


def write(out_dir: Path) -> None:
    samples = generate()
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out_dir / "mba.c").write_text(emit_c(samples))
    manifest = [
        {"name": s.name, "category": s.category, "width": s.width,
         "obfuscated": to_str(normalize(s.obfuscated)), "expected": to_str(s.expected)}
        for s in samples
    ]
    (out_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {len(samples)} samples to {out_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    write(parser.parse_args().out)

```

`tests/samples/gen_opaque.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the opaque-predicate corpus: C source plus a manifest.

Each function is `if (P) return LIVE; return DEAD;` (or the mirrored `if (!(P))`), with P a condition
whose value never changes. Intermediates pass through an empty asm barrier so the compiler cannot
see through the predicate. Every predicate's value is proven here before it is emitted.

Usage: uv run python tests/samples/gen_opaque.py --out tests/samples/build
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]))

from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.constancy import constant_value  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict  # noqa: E402

LIVE, DEAD = "x + y", "x ^ z ^ 0x5a"
WIDTHS = {"x": 32, "y": 32, "z": 32}


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Predicate:
    name: str
    family: str
    temps: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]  # (name, C expression), each followed by the barrier
    condition: str  # C, over the temps
    ir: str  # the same condition over x, y, z, in binja_d810's IR syntax (for the proof)
    value: int


PREDICATES = [
    Predicate("parity_next", "parity", (("t", "x * (x + 1)"),), "(t & 1) == 0", "eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)", 1),
    Predicate("parity_prev", "parity", (("t", "x * (x - 1)"),), "(t & 1) != 0", "ne((x * (x - 1)) & 1, 0)", 0),
    Predicate("square_mod4", "parity", (("t", "x * x"),), "(t & 3) != 2", "ne((x * x) & 3, 2)", 1),
    Predicate("odd_square", "parity", (("t", "(x | 1) * (x | 1)"),), "(t & 1) == 1", "eq(((x | 1) * (x | 1)) & 1, 1)", 1),
    Predicate("setnz", "d810", (("t", "x | 0x10u"),), "t != 0x0fu", "ne(x | 0x10, 0x0f)", 1),
    Predicate("setz", "d810", (("t", "x | 0x80u"),), "t == 0x7fu", "eq(x | 0x80, 0x7f)", 0),
    Predicate("setb", "d810", (("t", "x & 0x07u"),), "t < 0x08u", "ult(x & 7, 8)", 1),
    Predicate("setnz_y", "d810", (("t", "y | 0x300u"),), "t != 0xffu", "ne(y | 0x300, 0xff)", 1),
    Predicate("mba_add", "mba", (("a", "(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)"), ("b", "x + y")), "a == b",
              "eq((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y), x + y)", 1),
    Predicate("mba_or", "mba", (("a", "(x & ~y) + y"), ("b", "x | y")), "a != b", "ne((x & ~y) + y, x | y)", 0),
    Predicate("mba_sub", "mba", (("a", "(x ^ y) - 2 * (~x & y)"), ("b", "x - y")), "a == b",
              "eq((x ^ y) - 2 * (~x & y), x - y)", 1),
    Predicate("mba_and", "mba", (("a", "(x | y) - (x ^ y)"), ("b", "x & y")), "a == b",
              "eq((x | y) - (x ^ y), x & y)", 1),
    Predicate("mba_xor", "mba", (("a", "(x | y) - (x & y)"), ("b", "x ^ y")), "a != b",
              "ne((x | y) - (x & y), x ^ y)", 0),
    Predicate("byte_range", "range", (("t", "x & 0xffu"),), "t <= 0xffu", "ule(x & 0xff, 0xff)", 1),
    Predicate("nonzero_odd", "range", (("t", "x | 1u"),), "t != 0u", "ne(x | 1, 0)", 1),
    Predicate("two_bits", "range", (("t", "(x ^ y) & 3u"),), "t < 4u", "ult((x ^ y) & 3, 4)", 1),
    Predicate("sign_set", "range", (("t", "x | 0x80000000u"),), "(int32_t)t < 0", "slt(x | 0x80000000, 0)", 1),
]


def verify(p: Predicate) -> None:
    found = constant_value(parse(p.ir, 1, WIDTHS), Deadline.after(30))
    if found is None or found[0] != p.value or found[1].verdict is not Verdict.PROVEN:
        raise AssertionError(f"generator bug: {p.name} is not proven to be {p.value}: {found}")


def emit(p: Predicate, mirrored: bool) -> str:
    name = f"opaque_{p.name}{'_mirrored' if mirrored else ''}"
    taken, other = (LIVE, DEAD) if p.value else (DEAD, LIVE)
    lines = [f"EXPORT uint32_t {name}(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) {{", "    (void)x; (void)y; (void)z;"]
    lines += [f"    uint32_t {t} = {text}; B({t});" for t, text in p.temps]
    if mirrored:
        lines += [f"    if (!({p.condition})) return {other};", f"    return {taken};", "}", ""]
    else:
        lines += [f"    if ({p.condition}) return {taken};", f"    return {other};", "}", ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


HEADER = (
    "// Generated by tests/samples/gen_opaque.py. Do not edit.\n"
    "#include <stdint.h>\n"
    '#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))\n'
    "#ifdef _WIN32\n"
    "#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))\n"
    "#else\n"
    '#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))\n'
    "#endif\n\n"
)


def write(out_dir: Path) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    functions, manifest = [], []
    for p in PREDICATES:
        verify(p)
        for mirrored in (False, True):
            functions.append(emit(p, mirrored))
            manifest.append({"name": f"opaque_{p.name}{'_mirrored' if mirrored else ''}", "family": p.family,
                             "condition": p.condition, "value": p.value, "mirrored": mirrored,
                             "live": LIVE, "dead": DEAD})
    (out_dir / "opaque.c").write_text(HEADER + "\n".join(functions))
    (out_dir / "opaque_manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(f"wrote {len(manifest)} opaque-predicate samples to {out_dir}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, required=True)
    write(parser.parse_args().out)

```

`tests/samples/src/allocation_roundtrips.c`:

```c
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define F __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline,used))
#define I __declspec(dllimport)
#else
#define F __attribute__((noinline,used,visibility("default")))
#define I
#endif
I void *malloc(size_t size);
I void free(void *pointer);
#define B(x) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(x) : : "memory")

F void *heap_allocate(size_t size) { return malloc(size); }
F void heap_release(void *pointer) { free(pointer); }
F void *heap_small(void) { return heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); }
F void heap_drop(void *p) { heap_release(p); }

F uint32_t heap_roundtrip(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    *p=x^0x51u; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    heap_release(p);
    return value;
}
F uint32_t heap_box(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_small(); B(p);
    *p=x*7+3; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    heap_drop(p);
    return value;
}
F uint32_t heap_partial(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    *p=x; B(p);
    ((uint8_t *)p)[1]=0x67; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    heap_release(p);
    return value;
}
void *volatile heap_saved;
F uint32_t heap_escape(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    heap_saved=p;
    *p=x^0x51; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    heap_release(p);
    return value;
}
F uint32_t heap_failure(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    if (!p) return 17;
    *p=x^0x51; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    heap_release(p);
    return value;
}
F uint32_t heap_merge(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    uint32_t *q=(x&1) ? p : (uint32_t *)heap_saved; B(q);
    *q=x; B(q);
    uint32_t value=*q; B(value);
    heap_release(p);
    return value;
}
F uint32_t heap_observed_bits(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *p=heap_allocate(sizeof(uint32_t)); B(p);
    *p=x; B(p);
    uint32_t value=*p; B(value);
    uintptr_t address=(uintptr_t)p; B(address);
    heap_release(p);
    return value^(uint32_t)(address&15);
}
```

`tests/samples/src/bcf.c`:

```c
// v3.1 fixtures: OLLVM-style bogus control flow (an obfuscated export) and the shapes around it.
// Intermediates pass through empty asm barriers so the compiler keeps the structure.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

// OLLVM's opaque-predicate inputs: globals the compiler cannot see through.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_x, bcf_y;

EXPORT void bcf_sink(uint32_t v) { B(v); bcf_y = v; }

// One masked-constant encoding step: (t & m) | (~t & ~m), which is t ^ ~m. Each step reads t
// twice, so the chain is small as shared values and doubles in size as a tree at every step.
#define STEP(t, m) do { uint32_t u_ = (t) & (m); B(u_); uint32_t v_ = ~(t) & ~(m); B(v_); (t) = u_ | v_; B(t); } while (0)

// x * (x - 1) is even; its low bit passes through 12 encoding steps (K undoes them). Always a + 1.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_chain(uint32_t a) {
    uint32_t x = bcf_x, y = bcf_y; B(x); B(y);
    uint32_t t = x * (x - 1); B(t);
    STEP(t, 0x628ed16bu);
    STEP(t, 0x9d712e94u);
    STEP(t, 0x75deac2du);
    STEP(t, 0x8a2153d2u);
    STEP(t, 0xc0aace2eu);
    STEP(t, 0x3f5531d1u);
    STEP(t, 0x90414451u);
    STEP(t, 0x653ab10eu);
    STEP(t, 0x188dec13u);
    STEP(t, 0xe77213ecu);
    STEP(t, 0x803573ebu);
    STEP(t, 0x2472629du);
    if (((t ^ 0x513ce429u) & 1) == 0 || y < 10) return a + 1;
    return a ^ 0x5a;
}

// The predicate's value computed on two paths and merged: each arm's k is 0, so the merged k is 0.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_merge(uint32_t a, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t x = bcf_x; B(x);
    uint32_t k;
    if (c & 1) { uint32_t t = x * (x - 1); B(t); k = t & 1; B(k); }
    else { uint32_t t = x * (x + 1); B(t); k = t & 1; B(k); }
    if (k == 0) return a + 1;
    return a ^ 0x5a;
}

// A value proven constant (1) and used by arithmetic and a call: both uses should read 1.
EXPORT uint32_t const_use(uint32_t a) {
    uint32_t x = bcf_x; B(x);
    uint32_t s = x | 0x10; B(s);
    uint32_t k = s != 0x0f;
    bcf_sink(k);
    return a + k * 3;
}

// glibc's pointer alignment: q is used twice; p - q is -8 | p, which must not
// make the arithmetic line mixed.
EXPORT uint32_t align_gate(uint32_t p, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t q = (p + 8) & ~7u; B(q);
    bcf_sink(q);
    return (n + p - q - 8) >> 3;
}

// A proven constant read after a merge: SSA form numbers instructions differently (phi nodes), so
// a read must be found through its own instruction, never by index.
EXPORT uint32_t const_after_merge(uint32_t a, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t x = bcf_x; B(x);
    uint32_t s = x | 0x10; B(s);
    uint32_t k = s != 0x0f;
    uint32_t m = (c & 1) ? a * 3 : a + 7; B(m);
    bcf_sink(m);
    bcf_sink(k);
    return m;
}

// glibc's pointer alignment, again: d = p - q is its own instruction, used once by arithmetic that
// HLIL shows as one statement with it. d is -8 | p, which must not make that statement mixed.
EXPORT uint32_t align_gate2(uint32_t p, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t q = (p + 8) & ~7u; B(q);
    bcf_sink(q);
    uint32_t d = p - q; B(d);
    return (n + d - 8) >> 3;
}

// The same inside a larger statement (v3.2): p - q sits beside a call's result, so HLIL's root is
// p - q alone and the statement is bcf_id(n) + (p - q). -8 | p must not make it mixed.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_id(uint32_t v) { B(v); return v; }

EXPORT uint32_t align_call(uint32_t p, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t q = (p + 8) & ~7u; B(q);
    bcf_sink(q);
    return bcf_id(n) + (p - q);
}

// v3.5: a read unused in the original code stays when a rewrite in the same function makes the pass
// remove what the rewrite left dead. The barrier reads v, which Binary Ninja does not see: a load nothing uses.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_v;

EXPORT uint32_t dead_read(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    uint32_t v = bcf_v; B(v);
    uint32_t t = a ^ b; B(t);
    uint32_t u = a & b; B(u);
    return t + 2 * u;
}

// v3.5: a read through a computed address that a fold leaves unused stays: such a read may fault.
EXPORT uint32_t bcf_table[4];

EXPORT uint32_t computed_read(uint32_t a, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t x = bcf_table[a & 3]; B(x);
    uint32_t t = x * (x - 1); B(t);
    if ((t & 1) == 0) return c + 1;
    return c ^ 0x5a;
}
```

`tests/samples/src/div.c`:

```c
// v3.2 fixtures: division in opaque predicates (2 / (x * x + 1) == y * y + 3) and
// divisions that may trap. Barriers keep the compilers from seeing through values, so the divisions
// are emitted as division instructions (x86 div/idiv, ARM64 udiv/sdiv).
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

// The predicate's inputs: globals the compiler cannot see through.
EXPORT uint32_t div_x, div_y;

// x * x + 1 is never 0 (squares are 0 or 1 modulo 4), so 2 / (x * x + 1) is 0, 1 or 2; y * y + 3 is
// none of those (squares are 0, 1 or 4 modulo 8). Always a + 1.
EXPORT uint32_t div_opaque(uint32_t a) {
    uint32_t x = div_x, y = div_y; B(x); B(y);
    uint32_t d = x * x + 1; B(d);
    uint32_t q = 2u / d; B(q);
    uint32_t r = y * y + 3; B(r);
    if (q == r) return a ^ 0x5a;
    return a + 1;
}

// (x * x + 1) % m with m = 4 (a register, not an immediate): a square plus one is 1 or 2 modulo 4.
// Always a + 1.
EXPORT uint32_t rem_opaque(uint32_t a) {
    uint32_t x = div_x; B(x);
    uint32_t m = 4; B(m);
    uint32_t d = x * x + 1; B(d);
    uint32_t r = d % m; B(r);
    if (r == 0) return a ^ 0x5a;
    return a + 1;
}

// Divisions that may trap, whose only use is a condition the plugin folds (q * (q + 1) is even): b
// may be 0, and x | 1, never 0, is -1 for x = -1 (MIN / -1 traps on x86). Both divisions stay.
EXPORT uint32_t div_trap(uint32_t a, uint32_t b) {
    uint32_t x = div_x; B(x);
    uint32_t q = a / b;
    int32_t d = (int32_t)(x | 1); B(d);
    int32_t s = (int32_t)a / d;
    uint32_t u = (uint32_t)s;
    if (((q * (q + 1)) & 1) || ((u * (u + 1)) & 1)) return a ^ 0x5a;
    return a + 1;
}

// The quotient compared with y * y + 3 computed on two paths and merged: the merged value is not
// constant, but the comparison is false on each path. Always a + 1.
EXPORT uint32_t div_merge(uint32_t a, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t x = div_x, y = div_y; B(x); B(y);
    uint32_t r;
    if (c & 1) { r = y * y + 3; B(r); }
    else { uint32_t z = y + c; B(z); r = z * z + 3; B(r); }
    uint32_t d = x * x + 1; B(d);
    uint32_t q = 2u / d; B(q);
    if (q == r) return a ^ 0x5a;
    return a + 1;
}

// A division that cannot trap, kept: the MBA around the quotient is a + q, and q stays a division.
EXPORT uint32_t div_keep(uint32_t a) {
    uint32_t x = div_x; B(x);
    uint32_t d = x * x + 1; B(d);
    uint32_t q = a / d;
    return (q ^ a) + 2 * (q & a);
}

// r = y * y + 3 is computed before a loop and carried round it unchanged
// through copies (t = r; r = t), while the loop updates x. The quotient is compared with r in the
// loop: r is a merge whose only value from outside is y * y + 3, and x a merge of two values. The
// comparison is false for every x. Always a + n.
EXPORT uint32_t div_loop(uint32_t a, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t y = div_y; B(y);
    uint32_t r = y * y + 3; B(r);
    uint32_t x = div_x; B(x);
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        uint32_t d = x * x + 1; B(d);
        uint32_t q = 2u / d; B(q);
        if (q == r) a ^= 0x5a;
        a += 1;
        uint32_t t = r; B(t); r = t;
        x = x * 3 + k; B(x);
    }
    return a;
}

```

`tests/samples/src/effects.c`:

```c
// Effect-policy fixtures: values materialized from calls and aliased or
// volatile reads, with an MBA over them.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

EXPORT uint32_t eff_source(uint32_t x) { __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(x)); return x * 2654435761u; }
EXPORT void eff_sink(uint32_t *p) { __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory"); }

EXPORT uint32_t eff_call_result(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t m = eff_source(x);
    uint32_t t0 = m ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = m & y; B(t1);
    return t0 + 2u * t1;
}
EXPORT uint32_t eff_aliased(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x;
    eff_sink(&a);
    uint32_t t0 = a ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = a & y; B(t1);
    return t0 + 2u * t1;
}
volatile uint32_t eff_global;
EXPORT uint32_t eff_volatile(uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t0 = eff_global ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = eff_global & y; B(t1);
    return t0 + 2u * t1;
}
```

`tests/samples/src/effects_x86_64.S`:

```S
// Effect-policy fixtures (spec section 5.2) as exact x86-64 code: an MBA that is 0 feeds an
// instruction with a memory operand, so the candidate root contains the load.
    .intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl eff_load_and_zero, eff_load_add
    .type eff_load_and_zero, @function
    .type eff_load_add, @function
// uint32_t eff_load_and_zero(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, const uint32_t *p): ((x^y) - (x|y) + (x&y)) & *p
eff_load_and_zero:
    mov eax, edi
    xor eax, esi
    mov ecx, edi
    or ecx, esi
    sub eax, ecx
    mov ecx, edi
    and ecx, esi
    add eax, ecx
    and eax, [rdx]
    ret
// uint32_t eff_load_add(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, const uint32_t *p): ((x^y) + 2*(x&y)) + *p
eff_load_add:
    mov eax, edi
    xor eax, esi
    mov ecx, edi
    and ecx, esi
    lea eax, [rax + 2*rcx]
    add eax, [rdx]
    ret
```

`tests/samples/src/entry_outlined.S`:

```S
// Outlined dispatchers with an undeclared callback register. Only one machine's
// handlers preserve it; another uses a volatile register, and a third overwrites it.
#if defined(__APPLE__) || (defined(_WIN32) && defined(__i386__))
#define SYM(name) _##name
#else
#define SYM(name) name
#endif
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define LOCAL(name) L##name
#else
#define LOCAL(name) .L##name
#endif
.text
.macro function name
.p2align 4
.globl \name
#ifdef __ELF__
.type \name, @function
#endif
\name:
.endm
.macro endfunction name
#ifdef __ELF__
.size \name, .-\name
#endif
.endm

#if defined(__aarch64__)
#define SAVED x21
#define VOLATILE x9
.macro dispatch name, h1, h2, h3, reg
function \name
    cmp w0, #11
    b.eq \h1
    cmp w0, #22
    b.eq \h2
    cmp w0, #33
    b.eq \h3
    cmp w0, #44
    b.ne LOCAL(default)\@
    br \reg
LOCAL(default)\@:
    mov x0, #0
    ret
endfunction \name
.endm
.macro handler name, dest, state, reg, clobber=0
function \name
.if \clobber
    mov \reg, #0
.endif
    mov w0, #\state
    b \dest
endfunction \name
.endm
#else
#if defined(__x86_64__)
#define SAVED %r12
#define VOLATILE %r10
#ifdef _WIN32
#define ARG %ecx
#else
#define ARG %edi
#endif
#else
#define SAVED %esi
#define VOLATILE %edx
#define ARG 4(%esp)
#endif
.macro dispatch name, h1, h2, h3, reg
function \name
    cmpl $11, ARG
    je \h1
    cmpl $22, ARG
    je \h2
    cmpl $33, ARG
    je \h3
    cmpl $44, ARG
    jne LOCAL(default)\@
    jmp *\reg
LOCAL(default)\@:
    xor %eax, %eax
    ret
endfunction \name
.endm
.macro handler name, dest, state, reg, clobber=0
function \name
.if \clobber
    xor \reg, \reg
.endif
    movl $\state, ARG
    jmp \dest
endfunction \name
.endm
#endif

dispatch SYM(entry_dispatch), SYM(entry_h1), SYM(entry_h2), SYM(entry_h3), SAVED
handler SYM(entry_h1), SYM(entry_dispatch), 22, SAVED
handler SYM(entry_h2), SYM(entry_dispatch), 33, SAVED
handler SYM(entry_h3), SYM(entry_forward), 44, SAVED
function SYM(entry_forward)
#if defined(__aarch64__)
    b SYM(entry_dispatch)
#else
    jmp SYM(entry_dispatch)
#endif
endfunction SYM(entry_forward)

dispatch SYM(volatile_dispatch), SYM(volatile_h1), SYM(volatile_h2), SYM(volatile_h3), VOLATILE
handler SYM(volatile_h1), SYM(volatile_dispatch), 22, VOLATILE
handler SYM(volatile_h2), SYM(volatile_dispatch), 33, VOLATILE
handler SYM(volatile_h3), SYM(volatile_dispatch), 44, VOLATILE

dispatch SYM(clobber_dispatch), SYM(clobber_h1), SYM(clobber_h2), SYM(clobber_h3), SAVED
handler SYM(clobber_h1), SYM(clobber_dispatch), 22, SAVED, 1
handler SYM(clobber_h2), SYM(clobber_dispatch), 33, SAVED
handler SYM(clobber_h3), SYM(clobber_dispatch), 44, SAVED
```

`tests/samples/src/flag_conditions.c`:

```c
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define F __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline,used))
#else
#define F __attribute__((noinline,used,visibility("default")))
#endif
#define B(x) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(x))
#define FLAGS \
    uint32_t d=x-y, n=d>>31, z=(d==0), v=((x^y)&(x^d))>>31, c=(x<y); \
    B(n); B(z); B(v); B(c)
#define CONDITION(name, expression) \
    F uint32_t flag_##name(uint32_t x,uint32_t y) { FLAGS; return (expression); }
CONDITION(eq, z)
CONDITION(ne, !z)
CONDITION(slt, n!=v)
CONDITION(sle, z || n!=v)
CONDITION(sgt, !z && n==v)
CONDITION(sge, n==v)
CONDITION(ult, c)
CONDITION(ule, c || z)
CONDITION(ugt, !c && !z)
CONDITION(uge, !c)
F uint32_t flag_signed_chain(int32_t x,int32_t y,int32_t z) { return x<=y && x>=z; }
F uint32_t flag_fixed_chain(int32_t x,int32_t y) { return x<=y && x>=17; }
F uint32_t flag_unsigned_chain(uint32_t x,uint32_t y,uint32_t z) { return x<y || x>z; }
F uint32_t flag_nested_chain(uint32_t x,uint32_t y,uint32_t z) {
    return (x<y || x>z) && (y!=z || x==7);
}
volatile uint32_t flag_output;
F uint32_t flag_shared(uint32_t x,uint32_t y) {
    FLAGS;
    flag_output=n;
    return z || n!=v;
}
```

`tests/samples/src/flatten.c`:

```c
// v4.2 fixtures: hand-flattened state machines (a sparse compare tree, a dense switch, nested whiles, a machine
// with a counted loop) and ordinary code D-810 must leave alone. B(s) at every dispatch hands the state to an
// empty asm that may change it, so the compiler cannot thread the dispatcher away itself; the binary keeps the
// value unchanged, which is what an analysis sees. Every state constant is made up for these fixtures, with a
// byte that is not printable (Binary Ninja writes a store of 4 printable bytes as a strncpy call at -O0).
// Conditional transitions read what the handlers computed, so the compiler cannot hoist them out of the loop.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#define KEEP(p) __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory")
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif

// A handler's visible work, in the order the machine runs it. Exported and storing k, so every build keeps
// the calls, names them and passes k (with an empty body, Binary Ninja sees an arm64 ret and drops them).
EXPORT_DATA volatile int marked;
EXPORT int mark(int k) { B(k); marked = k; return k; }
EXPORT_DATA uint32_t *peeked;
LOCAL void peek(uint32_t *p) { KEEP(p); peeked = p; }  // may read or write *p, later too: p escapes

// ---- Flattened ----

EXPORT int fl_tree(int x) {  // 5 sparse states, one transition picked by r > x
    uint32_t s = 0x7a3c19e5u;
    int r = 0;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        if (s == 0x7a3c19e5u) { r += mark(1); s = 0x1b4d8c27u; }
        else if (s == 0x1b4d8c27u) { r += mark(2); s = r > x ? 0x5e91a3f0u : 0x33c6d218u; }
        else if (s == 0x5e91a3f0u) { r += mark(3); s = 0x33c6d218u; }
        else if (s == 0x33c6d218u) { r += mark(4); s = 0x6f2b9c41u; }
        else if (s == 0x6f2b9c41u) { return r + mark(5); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

EXPORT int fl_dense(int x) {  // 7 consecutive states: a switch compilers emit as a jump table
    uint32_t s = 0x40;
    int r = x;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        switch (s) {
        case 0x40: r += mark(11); s = 0x43; break;
        case 0x41: r += mark(12); s = 0x44; break;
        case 0x42: r += mark(13); s = 0x46; break;
        case 0x43: r += mark(14); s = 0x45; break;
        case 0x44: r += mark(15); s = 0x42; break;
        case 0x45: r += mark(16); s = 0x41; break;
        case 0x46: return r + mark(17);
        default: return -1;
        }
    }
}

EXPORT int fl_nested(int x) {  // Hodur-style: one while per state inside the dispatch loop
    uint32_t s = 0x2d81f6a3u;
    int r = 0;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        while (s == 0x2d81f6a3u) { r += mark(21); s = 0x49e07b12u; B(s); }
        while (s == 0x49e07b12u) { r += mark(22); s = ((r ^ x) & 1) ? 0x0c5a9e84u : 0x71f3d250u; B(s); }
        while (s == 0x0c5a9e84u) { r += mark(23); s = 0x71f3d250u; B(s); }
        if (s == 0x71f3d250u) { return r + mark(24); }
    }
}

EXPORT int fl_loop(int n) {  // a counted loop inside one state
    uint32_t s = 0x58c2e13bu;
    int r = 0, i = 0;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        if (s == 0x58c2e13bu) { r += mark(31); i = 0; s = 0x26b9d4f7u; }
        else if (s == 0x26b9d4f7u) {
            if (i < n) { r += mark(40 + i); i++; } else { s = 0x4e7a0d93u; }
        }
        else if (s == 0x4e7a0d93u) { r += mark(32); s = 0x1c95b2e6u; }
        else if (s == 0x1c95b2e6u) { r += mark(33); s = 0x6a17c05eu; }
        else if (s == 0x6a17c05eu) { return r + mark(34); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

EXPORT int fl_large_loop(int x) {  // recovering the dispatcher must not require unrolling this handler
    uint32_t s = 0x5187a321u;
    uint32_t r = (uint32_t)x;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        if (s == 0x5187a321u) {
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 96; ++i) {
                B(i);
                r = (r ^ i) + 7;
            }
            s = 0x3b65d902u;
        }
        else if (s == 0x3b65d902u) { r += mark(91); s = 0x6c194e53u; }
        else if (s == 0x6c194e53u) { return r + mark(92); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

static int (*lazy)(int);  // resolved on first use, as malware resolves its imports
LOCAL int twice(int v) { B(v); return v * 2; }
EXPORT int fl_glue(int x) {  // a handler picks the next state, then shared code with a branch of its own runs
    uint32_t s = 0x3e6a1d97u;
    int r = 0;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        if (s == 0x3e6a1d97u) {  // the pick reads a value the shared code reads again
            int v = mark(51);
            s = 0x17f4a6c9u;
            if (v > x) s = 0x52c8b0e3u;
            KEEP(&lazy);
            if (!lazy) lazy = twice;
            r += lazy(v) + v;
        }
        else if (s == 0x52c8b0e3u) { r += mark(52); s = 0x6d09e3b5u; }
        else if (s == 0x17f4a6c9u) { r ^= mark(53) * 3; s = 0x6d09e3b5u; }  // unlike 52: not merged into one call
        else if (s == 0x6d09e3b5u) { return r + mark(54); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

// ---- Negatives: no state machine, or a state the function does not own ----

EXPORT int plain_for(int n) {
    int r = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) r += mark(i);
    return r + n;
}

EXPORT int found_flag(const int *a, int n, int k) {
    int found = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (a[i] == k) found = 1;
        B(found);
    }
    if (found == 1) return mark(41);
    return mark(42);
}

EXPORT_DATA volatile uint32_t g_state;

EXPORT int global_state(int x) {  // every read of the state is a load: another thread may change it
    int r = 0;
    g_state = 0x13a7c5e9u;
    for (;;) {
        uint32_t s = g_state;
        if (s == 0x13a7c5e9u) { r += mark(51); g_state = 0x4c0e8b36u; }
        else if (s == 0x4c0e8b36u) { r += mark(52); g_state = x > 0 ? 0x7d52f1a4u : 0x2e9b6c03u; }
        else if (s == 0x7d52f1a4u) { r += mark(53); g_state = 0x2e9b6c03u; }
        else if (s == 0x2e9b6c03u) { return r + mark(54); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

EXPORT int escaped_state(int x) {  // peek may change the state after every transition
    uint32_t s = 0x6b1d93c2u;
    int r = 0;
    peek(&s);
    for (;;) {
        if (s == 0x6b1d93c2u) { r += mark(61); s = 0x1f84a6d0u; peek(&s); }
        else if (s == 0x1f84a6d0u) { r += mark(62); s = x > 0 ? 0x57c3e91bu : 0x0ad6f274u; peek(&s); }
        else if (s == 0x57c3e91bu) { r += mark(63); s = 0x0ad6f274u; peek(&s); }
        else if (s == 0x0ad6f274u) { return r + mark(64); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

```

`tests/samples/src/flow.c`:

```c
// v4.0 fixtures: jumps and calls through encoded tables of code pointers (Hikari-style indirect branches
// and calls), an identity wrapper, and the shapes D-810 must leave alone. Tables are writable statics, as
// obfuscators emit them. KEEP hands a table's address to an empty asm that may write memory: otherwise
// clang's globalopt makes a never-written static table constant at -O2. A C initializer can only add or
// subtract a constant from an address, so the decodes are ADD, SUB, a key global and an MBA form of SUB.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#define KEEP(p) __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory")
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#endif
// Wrappers are local functions, as obfuscators emit them: an exported one is called through the PLT in an
// ELF shared object. PE keeps the export, for its symbol.
#ifdef _WIN32
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif
#define KEY 0x13371337
#define ENC(p) ((intptr_t)(p) + KEY)
typedef intptr_t (*fn_t)(intptr_t);

EXPORT intptr_t f_a(intptr_t x) { B(x); return x + 0x100; }
EXPORT intptr_t f_b(intptr_t x) { B(x); return x * 7; }
EXPORT_DATA void *sink_store;
EXPORT void sink_ptr(void *p) { B(p); sink_store = p; }  // uses p, so it is a parameter
EXPORT void *escaped_offset(void) {
    static intptr_t data[2];
    void *p = data;
    B(p);
    return (char *)p + sizeof(intptr_t);
}

// ---- Jumps through code-pointer tables (labels as values) ----

EXPORT int tbl_jump_const(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[1] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

EXPORT int tbl_jump_sub(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {(intptr_t)&&L0 - KEY, (intptr_t)&&L1 - KEY};
    KEEP(tbl);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[1] + KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

EXPORT int tbl_jump_var(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1), ENC(&&L2), ENC(&&L3)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[x & 3] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
L2: return x ^ 0xa2;
L3: return x ^ 0xa3;
}

static intptr_t jump_key = KEY;  // never written
// Keep an otherwise unused read in machine code for the LLIL evidence tests.
EXPORT void key_read_unused(void) { KEEP(&jump_key); intptr_t value = jump_key; B(value); }
EXPORT int tbl_jump_keyglobal(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    KEEP(&jump_key);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[1] - jump_key);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

EXPORT int tbl_jump_mbadecode(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    intptr_t t = tbl[1], k = -KEY;
    B(k);
    goto *(void *)((t ^ k) + 2 * (t & k));  // t + k, that is t - KEY
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

static uint32_t index_key = 0x51;  // never written; the index is computed from it
EXPORT int tbl_jump_keyindex(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    KEEP(&index_key);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[(int32_t)(0x52 - index_key)] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

EXPORT int mba_jump(int x, int y) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    int a = x, b = y;
    B(a);
    B(b);
    int i = (a ^ b) + 2 * (a & b) - (a + b) + 1;  // always 1
    goto *(void *)(tbl[i] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xa0;
L1: return x ^ 0xa1;
}

// ---- Calls through code-pointer tables ----

static intptr_t ctab[] = {ENC(f_a), ENC(f_b)};
EXPORT intptr_t tbl_call_const(intptr_t x) { KEEP(ctab); return ((fn_t)(ctab[1] - KEY))(x); }
EXPORT intptr_t tbl_call_shared(intptr_t x) { KEEP(ctab); return ((fn_t)(ctab[1] - KEY))(x) + 1; }

static intptr_t stab[] = {(intptr_t)f_a - KEY, (intptr_t)f_b - KEY};
EXPORT intptr_t tbl_call_sub(intptr_t x) { KEEP(stab); return ((fn_t)(stab[0] + KEY))(x) + 2; }

static intptr_t utab[] = {ENC(f_a), ENC(f_b)};
EXPORT intptr_t tbl_call_user(intptr_t x) { KEEP(utab); return ((fn_t)(utab[1] - KEY))(x) + 3; }

static intptr_t mtab[] = {ENC(f_a), ENC(f_b)};
EXPORT intptr_t mba_call(intptr_t x, int y) {
    KEEP(mtab);
    int a = (int)x, b = y;
    B(a);
    B(b);
    int i = (a ^ b) + 2 * (a & b) - (a + b) + 1;  // always 1
    return ((fn_t)(mtab[i] - KEY))(x);
}

static fn_t rtab[] = {f_a, f_b};  // plain function pointers, indexed from the key global
EXPORT intptr_t tbl_call_keyindex(intptr_t x) {
    KEEP(rtab);
    KEEP(&index_key);
    return rtab[(int32_t)(0x52 - index_key)](x);
}

// ---- An identity wrapper over a one-entry code pointer ----

LOCAL void *ident(void *p) { B(p); return p; }
static void *off_fa = (void *)f_a;
EXPORT intptr_t ident_call(intptr_t x) { KEEP(&off_fa); return ((fn_t)ident(off_fa))(x) + 4; }

// ---- Must stay as they are ----

static intptr_t wtab[] = {ENC(f_a), ENC(f_b)};
EXPORT intptr_t written_call(intptr_t x) { KEEP(wtab); return ((fn_t)(wtab[1] - KEY))(x) + 5; }
EXPORT void written_store(intptr_t v) { KEEP(wtab); wtab[1] = v; }

EXPORT int written_table(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    if (x == 99)
        tbl[1] = ENC(&&L0);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[1] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xb0;
L1: return x ^ 0xb1;
}

static intptr_t etab[] = {ENC(f_a), ENC(f_b)};
EXPORT intptr_t escaped_call(intptr_t x) { sink_ptr(etab); return ((fn_t)(etab[1] - KEY))(x) + 6; }

EXPORT int escaped_table(int x) {
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1)};
    sink_ptr(tbl);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[1] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xc0;
L1: return x ^ 0xc1;
}

static const char not_code[16] = "data, not code";
EXPORT int bad_entry_table(int x) {  // two labels: with one, clang jumps to it directly
    static intptr_t tbl[] = {ENC(&&L0), ENC(&&L1), ENC(not_code), ENC(&&L0)};
    KEEP(tbl);
    goto *(void *)(tbl[x & 3] - KEY);
L0: return x ^ 0xd0;
L1: return x ^ 0xd1;
}

static uint32_t config_flag = 7;  // never written; read in a condition, not as a code pointer
EXPORT int config_test(int x) {
    KEEP(&config_flag);
    if (config_flag == 7)
        return x + 1;
    return x - 1;
}

EXPORT_DATA uint32_t wrapper_effect;
LOCAL void *not_ident(void *p) { B(p); wrapper_effect = 1; return p; }
static void *off_fb = (void *)f_b;
EXPORT intptr_t not_identity_call(intptr_t x) { KEEP(&off_fb); return ((fn_t)not_ident(off_fb))(x) + 7; }
```

`tests/samples/src/hlil_fixtures.c`:

```c
// HLIL-pass fixtures: MBA in branches, joins and loops; a reassigned input;
// effects embedded in HLIL expressions; conditional evaluation.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

EXPORT uint32_t hl_source(uint32_t x) { __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(x)); return x * 2654435761u; }

EXPORT uint32_t cf_branch(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t r;
    if (c & 1) {
        uint32_t t0 = x ^ y; B(t0);
        uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
        r = t0 + 2u * t1;
    } else {
        uint32_t t0 = x | y; B(t0);
        uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
        r = t0 - t1;
    }
    return r + c;
}
EXPORT uint32_t cf_loop(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t acc = y;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        uint32_t t0 = acc ^ x; B(t0);
        uint32_t t1 = acc & x; B(t1);
        acc = t0 + 2u * t1 + i;
    }
    return acc;
}
EXPORT uint32_t cf_reassign(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t0 = x ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
    x = x * 3u + 1u; B(x);
    return t0 + 2u * t1 + x;
}
EXPORT uint32_t hl_call_inline(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
    return (hl_source(x) ^ y) + 2u * t1;
}
volatile uint32_t hl_global;
EXPORT uint32_t hl_volatile(uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t1 = hl_global & y; B(t1);
    return (hl_global ^ y) + 2u * t1;
}
EXPORT uint32_t hl_select(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t c) {
    uint32_t t0 = x ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
    return c ? t0 + 2u * t1 : y;
}

// Lift work (v2.1): each step reads both values twice, so the fully inlined tree grows fourfold per
// step (the handlers of a Tigress VM). A lift must cut deep definitions without exploring that tree.
#define DAG_STEP a = (a ^ b) + 2 * (a & b); B(a); b = (b | a) - (b & ~a); B(b);
EXPORT uint32_t lift_dag(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x, b = y;
    DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP
    DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP DAG_STEP
    return a ^ b;
}

// Comparison results used as values (x86 setcc, ARM64 cset) inside MBA:
// b is x & 1 (bool_ne) or its complement (bool_eq), so both return x + y. In bool_wide, b is not
// x & 3, and nothing may treat it so.
EXPORT uint32_t bool_ne(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x & 1; B(t);
    uint32_t b = t != 0; B(b);
    return ((x | b) ^ y) + 2 * ((x | b) & y);
}
EXPORT uint32_t bool_eq(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x & 1; B(t);
    uint32_t b = t == 0; B(b);
    return ((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)) + b + (x & 1) - 1;
}
EXPORT uint32_t bool_wide(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x & 3; B(t);
    uint32_t b = t != 0; B(b);
    return ((x | b) ^ y) + 2 * ((x | b) & y);
}

// A value used twice and kept (a Tigress VM's handlers): a is stored and also combined, so a rewrite
// of the return over a's definition would copy it; over a itself, (a ^ z) + 2 * (a & z) is a + z.
EXPORT uint32_t shared_value(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z, uint32_t *out) {
    uint32_t a = (x * y) - (x | y) + (x & 7); B(a);
    *out = a;
    return (a ^ z) + 2 * (a & z);
}

// OLLVM: an arithmetic definition and a bitwise use, each unmixed; merging them made one
// mixed expression. Over a itself the use is a ^ 0x00ff00ff.
EXPORT uint32_t split_mix(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x * 7 + y; B(a);
    return (a & 0xff00ff00) | (~a & 0x00ff00ff);
}

// Three-address MBA: single-use temporaries, each unmixed in three-address MLIL, that HLIL shows as one
// mixed statement. A smaller mixed result, (x + y) | z, may replace it.
EXPORT uint32_t mixed_chain(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t z) {
    uint32_t a = x ^ y; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x & y; B(b);
    return (a + 2 * b) | z;
}
```

```S
// A saved register is declared only by the dispatcher. Handlers carry it back
// implicitly, with the state in an incoming stack slot. Controls change the
// register or the stack frame before entering the handler.
#if defined(__APPLE__) || (defined(_WIN32) && defined(__i386__))
#define SYM(name) _##name
#else
#define SYM(name) name
#endif
#ifdef __APPLE__
#define LOCAL(name) L##name
#else
#define LOCAL(name) .L##name
#endif
.text
.macro function name
.p2align 4
.globl \name
#ifdef __ELF__
.type \name, @function
#endif
\name:
.endm
.macro endfunction name
#ifdef __ELF__
.size \name, .-\name
#endif
.endm

#if defined(__aarch64__)
.macro dispatch name, h1, h2, h3, changed=0, shifted=0
function \name
.if \shifted
    sub sp, sp, #16
.endif
    ldr w8, [sp, #0x20]
    cmp w8, #11
    b.ne LOCAL(second)\@
.if \changed
    eor x21, x21, #1
.endif
    b \h1
LOCAL(second)\@:
    cmp w8, #22
    b.eq \h2
    cmp w8, #33
    b.eq \h3
    mov x0, x21
.if \shifted
    add sp, sp, #16
.endif
    ret

.endm

    mov w8, #\state
    str w8, [sp, #0x20]
    b \dest
endfunction \name
.endm
#else

#define RESULT %rax
#else
#define STACK %esp
#define SAVED %esi
#define RESULT %eax
#endif

    sub $16, STACK
.endif

    jne LOCAL(second)\@

.endif

    cmpl $33, 0x20(STACK)
    je \h3
    mov SAVED, RESULT
.if \shifted
    add $16, STACK
.endif
    ret
endfunction \name
.endm

    movl $\state, 0x20(STACK)
    jmp \dest
endfunction \name
.endm
#endif
```

```S
// An indirect jump back into its own function can be lifted as a tail call.
// The direct edge makes the shared target belong to the function. The pointer
// stays writable so the target must be checked before restoring the back edge.
// Controls: a real call to a shared internal return block, and a written pointer.
#if defined(__APPLE__) || (defined(_WIN32) && defined(__i386__))
#define SYM(name) _##name
#else
#define SYM(name) name
#endif

#ifdef __APPLE__
#define LOCAL(name) L##name
#else
#define LOCAL(name) .L##name
#endif

.text
.macro function name
.p2align 4
.globl \name
#if defined(__ELF__)
.type \name, @function
#endif
\name:
.endm
.macro endfunction name
#if defined(__ELF__)
.size \name, .-\name
#endif
.endm

#if defined(__aarch64__)
function SYM(internal_branch)
    cbz w0, LOCAL(branch_target)
    adrp x8, LOCAL(branch_pointer)@PAGE
    ldr x8, [x8, LOCAL(branch_pointer)@PAGEOFF]
    br x8
LOCAL(branch_target):
    add w0, w0, #3
    ret
endfunction SYM(internal_branch)

    ldr x8, [x8, LOCAL(call_pointer)@PAGEOFF]
    blr x8
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret

    add w0, w0, #5
    ret

    str x0, [x8, LOCAL(written_pointer)@PAGEOFF]

endfunction SYM(internal_call)

    jmp *%rax
LOCAL(written_target):
    lea 7(ARG), %eax
    ret
endfunction SYM(written_internal_branch)

    mov PTRARG, LOCAL(written_pointer)(%rip)

endfunction SYM(set_internal_pointer)
#else

    test %ecx, %ecx

    mov LOCAL(branch_pointer), %eax
```

`tests/samples/src/key_bounds.c`:

```c
// Adjacent mutable buffers and encoded keys. All values are synthetic.
#include <stdint.h>
#define KEEP(p) __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory")
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif
#define OBJECT(name) static struct { volatile uint8_t bytes[32]; uint32_t key; } name = {{1}, 0x537ac921u}
#define RESULT(name) (x ^ (0x648bda32u - name.key))
#define TOUCH(name) do { KEEP(&name); x += name.bytes[0]; } while (0)
static volatile uint8_t page_padding[16] = {7};
EXPORT uint8_t read_padding(void) { return page_padding[0]; }

OBJECT(loop_data);
EXPORT uint32_t bounded_loop(uint32_t x) {
    TOUCH(loop_data);
    _Pragma("clang loop unroll(disable)")
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 28; ++i) {
        loop_data.bytes[i] ^= 7;
        __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(i)); // retain the unsigned comparison at -O2
    }
    return RESULT(loop_data);
}
OBJECT(mask_data);
EXPORT uint32_t bounded_mask(uint32_t x) {
    KEEP(&mask_data);
    mask_data.bytes[x & 31] = 7;
    return RESULT(mask_data);
}
OBJECT(boolean_data);
EXPORT uint32_t bounded_boolean_loop(uint32_t x) {
    TOUCH(boolean_data);
    uint32_t i = 0;
    for (;;) {
        boolean_data.bytes[i] = 9;
        ++i;
        unsigned again = i < 28;
        __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(again));
        if (!(again & 1)) break;
    }
    return RESULT(boolean_data);
}
OBJECT(overlap_data);
EXPORT uint32_t overlap_last(uint32_t x) {
    TOUCH(overlap_data);
    _Pragma("clang loop unroll(disable)")
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i <= 32; ++i) {
        ((volatile uint8_t *)&overlap_data)[i] = 7;
        __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(i));
    }
    return RESULT(overlap_data);
}
OBJECT(wide_data);
EXPORT uint32_t overlap_width(uint32_t x) {
    KEEP(&wide_data);
    *(volatile uint64_t *)((uint8_t *)&wide_data + 28) = x;
    KEEP(&wide_data);
    return RESULT(wide_data);
}
OBJECT(unknown_data);
EXPORT uint32_t unbounded_index(uint32_t x) {
    TOUCH(unknown_data);
    ((volatile uint8_t *)&unknown_data)[x] = 7;
    return RESULT(unknown_data);
}
OBJECT(initial_data);
EXPORT uint32_t unknown_initial(uint32_t x) {
    TOUCH(initial_data);
    uint32_t i = x;
    do { ((volatile uint8_t *)&initial_data)[i] = 7; } while (++i < 28);
    return RESULT(initial_data);
}

LOCAL uint32_t read_bytes(const volatile uint8_t *p) { return p[0] + p[7]; }
LOCAL uint32_t forward_bytes(const volatile uint8_t *p) { return read_bytes(p) + 1; }
LOCAL void write_bytes(volatile uint8_t *p) { p[32] = 7; }
volatile const uint8_t *saved_pointer;
LOCAL void save_bytes(const volatile uint8_t *p) { saved_pointer = p; }
LOCAL const volatile uint8_t *return_bytes(const volatile uint8_t *p) { return p; }

OBJECT(forward_data);

OBJECT(return_data);
```

`tests/samples/src/keys.c`:

```c
// v4.3 fixtures: constants encoded against key globals that no visible code writes (constant encryption, as
// Hikari, Pluto and O-MVLL emit it), and the globals D-810 must leave alone: an exported one, a written one,
// one whose address escapes, one holding an address (relocated), and settings that are only compared, plainly or
// after an operation with a constant. KEEP hands a key's address to an empty asm that may write memory: otherwise
// clang makes a never-written static constant at -O2. B() on the MBA form's halves stops clang from folding (n | c) + (n & c) back to n + c.
// Every key and constant is made up for these fixtures.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#define KEEP(p) __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory")
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif

EXPORT_DATA volatile int marked;
EXPORT int mark(int k) { B(k); marked = k; return k; }
EXPORT_DATA void *sink_store;
EXPORT void sink_ptr(void *p) { B(p); sink_store = p; }

static uint32_t key32 = 0x5a17c3e9u;  // never written
static uint64_t key64 = 0x1f2e3d4c5b6a7988ull;  // never written

// ---- Constants encoded against a key ----

EXPORT uint32_t key_xor(uint32_t x) { KEEP(&key32); return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key32); }  // x ^ 0x11111111
EXPORT uint32_t key_mba(uint32_t x) {  // x + (0x1234 - key32), the subtraction in an MBA form
    KEEP(&key32);
    uint32_t n = -key32, a = n | 0x1234u, b = n & 0x1234u;
    B(a);
    B(b);
    return x + a + b;
}
EXPORT uint32_t key_shift(uint32_t x) { KEEP(&key32); return x << ((key32 + 0xa5e83c1cu) & 31); }  // x << 5
EXPORT uint64_t key_mul64(uint64_t x) { KEEP(&key64); return x * (key64 ^ 0x1f2e3d4c5b6a798bull); }  // x * 3

// ---- A flattened machine whose states are encoded against the key ----

EXPORT int key_states(int x) {
    KEEP(&key32);
    uint32_t s = 0x7a3c19e5u - key32;
    int r = 0;
    for (;;) {
        B(s);
        if (s == 0x7a3c19e5u - 0x5a17c3e9u) { r += mark(11); s = 0x1b4d8c27u - key32; }
        else if (s == 0x1b4d8c27u - 0x5a17c3e9u) { r += mark(12); s = (r > x ? 0x5e91a3f0u : 0x33c6d218u) - key32; }
        else if (s == 0x5e91a3f0u - 0x5a17c3e9u) { r += mark(13); s = 0x33c6d218u - key32; }
        else if (s == 0x33c6d218u - 0x5a17c3e9u) { return r + mark(14); }
        else { return -1; }
    }
}

// ---- Must stay as they are ----

EXPORT_DATA uint32_t key_exported = 0x5a17c3e9u;  // another module may write it
EXPORT uint32_t exported_key(uint32_t x) { return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key_exported); }

static uint32_t key_written = 0x5a17c3e9u;
EXPORT uint32_t written_key(uint32_t x) { KEEP(&key_written); return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key_written); }
EXPORT void set_key(uint32_t v) { KEEP(&key_written); key_written = v; }

static uint32_t key_escaped = 0x5a17c3e9u;  // sink_ptr may write it, later too
EXPORT uint32_t escaped_key(uint32_t x) { sink_ptr(&key_escaped); return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key_escaped); }

static uintptr_t key_address = (uintptr_t)&marked;  // an address: the loader relocates it
EXPORT uintptr_t address_key(uintptr_t x) { KEEP(&key_address); return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key_address); }

static uint32_t config_level = 7;  // never written, but only compared: a setting, not a key
EXPORT int level_test(int x) {
    KEEP(&config_level);
    if (config_level == 7)
        return x + 1;
    return x - 1;
}
static uint32_t key_unset;  // zero until something writes it: the loader's fill, not a key the program chose
EXPORT uint32_t unset_key(uint32_t x) { KEEP(&key_unset); return x ^ (0x6b28d4fau - key_unset); }
static uint32_t config_mode = 0x5a17c3e9u;  // never written; (mode ^ c) == 1 is mode == c ^ 1: a setting too
EXPORT int key_branch(int x) {
    KEEP(&config_mode);
    if ((config_mode ^ 0x5a17c3e8u) == 1)
        return x + mark(1);
    return x - mark(2);
}
```

`tests/samples/src/loops.c`:

```c
// v4.3 fixtures: junk loops. A loop that only steps its own counter until it meets a value, with nothing reading
// the counter afterwards, does nothing but spend time; an odd step meets every value of the counter's width, so
// the loop ends. The empty asm keeps the compiler from deleting a loop it cannot see through (the binary keeps no
// trace of it). Every constant is made up for these fixtures.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#endif

EXPORT_DATA volatile int marked;
EXPORT int mark(int k) { B(k); marked = k; return k; }

EXPORT int junk_loop(int x) {
    mark(1);
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)x;
    do { i += 0x2f1bu; B(i); } while (i != 0x5d3a71c4u);
    return mark(2);
}

// Controls: the counter is read after the loop, which only ends on its low byte, so the value it ends on is not
// known; an even step may never meet the value.
EXPORT int junk_read(int x) {
    mark(3);
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)x;
    do { i += 0x2f1bu; B(i); } while ((uint8_t)i != 0xc4u);
    return mark(4) + (int)i;
}

EXPORT int junk_even(int x) {
    mark(5);
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)x;
    do { i += 0x2f1au; B(i); } while (i != 0x5d3a71c4u);
    return mark(6);
}

// The exit test runs only on the iterations an opaque copy of the counter lets it; the body holds a loop of its
// own. An odd step alone does not end either.
EXPORT int junk_skip(int x) {
    mark(7);
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)x;
    for (;;) {
        i += 0x2f1bu;
        uint32_t j = i;
        B(j);
        if (!(j & 0x100u) && i == 0x5d3a70c4u) break;
        B(i);
    }
    return mark(8);
}

EXPORT int junk_inner(int x) {
    mark(9);
    uint32_t i = (uint32_t)x;
    do {
        i += 0x2f1bu;
        uint32_t k = i;
        do { k += 0x2u; B(k); } while (k != 0x11u);
    } while (i != 0x5d3a71c4u);
    return mark(10);
}
```

```c
// A dispatcher mixing direct self-calls with a separate handler that calls back.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif

EXPORT_DATA volatile int marked;
EXPORT int mark(int k) { B(k); marked = k; return k; }

// ---- A machine mixing direct self calls with an outlined handler ----
struct mixed_frame { uint64_t r; };
typedef uint64_t (*mixed_step_t)(uint32_t, struct mixed_frame *);
LOCAL uint64_t mixed_dispatch(uint32_t s, struct mixed_frame *f);
static mixed_step_t volatile mixed_back = mixed_dispatch;
LOCAL uint64_t mixed_handler(uint32_t s, struct mixed_frame *f) {
    f->r += (uint64_t)mark(82);
    return mixed_back(0x623d1945u, f);
}
LOCAL uint64_t mixed_dispatch(uint32_t s, struct mixed_frame *f) {
    B(s);
    switch (s) {
    case 0x173b5d29u: f->r += (uint64_t)mark(81); return mixed_back(0x4c816e37u, f);
    case 0x4c816e37u: return mixed_handler(s, f);
    case 0x623d1945u: f->r += (uint64_t)mark(83); return mixed_back(0x2a758c61u, f);
    case 0x2a758c61u: return f->r + (uint64_t)mark(84);
    default: return 0;
    }
}
EXPORT uint64_t mixed_machine(uint64_t x) {
    struct mixed_frame f = {x};
    return mixed_dispatch(0x173b5d29u, &f);
}
```

`tests/samples/src/outlined.c`:

```c
// v4.3 fixtures: outlined flattening. A flattened function split into a dispatcher that switches over a
// parameter, handlers that are separate functions reading and writing the original locals through a frame
// pointer, and a way back through two code pointers in writable data: a handler calls through the first to a
// one-line stub, which calls through the second to the dispatcher. At -O2 the calls are tail branches; at -O0
// they are calls then returns. A self-calling dispatcher returns its own result through a code pointer. The
// pointers are volatile, so the compiler reads each one where it is called and cannot call its target directly
// (the binary keeps no trace of volatile). Every state constant is made up for these fixtures.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define EXPORT_DATA __declspec(dllexport)
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define EXPORT_DATA __attribute__((visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif

EXPORT_DATA volatile int marked;
EXPORT int mark(int k) { B(k); marked = k; return k; }

// ---- Handlers outlined from their dispatcher ----

struct frame { int r; int x; };
typedef int (*step_t)(uint32_t, struct frame *);
LOCAL int ol_dispatch(uint32_t s, struct frame *f);
LOCAL int ol_stub(uint32_t s, struct frame *f);
static step_t volatile ol_back = ol_dispatch;  // never written
static step_t volatile ol_return = ol_stub;  // never written

LOCAL int ol_stub(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) { return ol_back(s, f); }
LOCAL int ol_h1(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) { f->r += mark(1); return ol_return(0x1b4d8c27u, f); }
LOCAL int ol_h2(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) {
    f->r += mark(2);
    return ol_return(f->r > f->x ? 0x5e91a3f0u : 0x33c6d218u, f);
}
LOCAL int ol_h3(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) { f->r += mark(3); return ol_return(0x33c6d218u, f); }
LOCAL int ol_h4(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) { f->r += mark(4); return ol_return(0x6f2b9c41u, f); }
LOCAL int ol_shared(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) { f->x += mark(6); return ol_return(0x6f2b9c41u, f); }
LOCAL int ol_dispatch(uint32_t s, struct frame *f) {
    B(s);
    switch (s) {
    case 0x7a3c19e5u: return ol_h1(s, f);
    case 0x1b4d8c27u: return ol_h2(s, f);
    case 0x5e91a3f0u: return ol_h3(s, f);
    case 0x33c6d218u: return ol_h4(s, f);
    case 0x6f2b9c41u: return f->r + mark(5);
    case 0x0e57b3a9u: return ol_shared(s, f);  // also called directly: not the dispatcher's alone
    default: return -1;
    }
}
EXPORT int ol_machine(int x) {
    struct frame f = {0, x};
    return ol_dispatch(0x7a3c19e5u, &f);
}
EXPORT int ol_other(int x) {
    struct frame f = {0, x};
    return ol_shared(0, &f);
}

// ---- A dispatcher that calls itself through a code pointer ----

typedef int (*self_t)(uint32_t, int, int);
LOCAL int sc_dispatch(uint32_t s, int r, int x);
static self_t volatile sc_self = sc_dispatch;  // never written
LOCAL int sc_dispatch(uint32_t s, int r, int x) {
    B(s);
    switch (s) {
    case 0x2d81f6a3u: return sc_self(0x49e07b12u, r + mark(21), x);
    case 0x49e07b12u: r += mark(22); return sc_self(((r ^ x) & 1) ? 0x0c5a9e84u : 0x71f3d250u, r, x);
    case 0x0c5a9e84u: return sc_self(0x71f3d250u, r + mark(23), x);
    case 0x71f3d250u: return r + mark(24);
    default: return -1;
    }
}
EXPORT int sc_machine(int x) { return sc_dispatch(0x2d81f6a3u, 0, x); }

// ---- Must stay as they are: ordinary recursion, and a state machine passing the address of its own local ----

typedef int (*count_t)(int, int);
LOCAL int rc_count(int n, int acc);
static count_t volatile rc_self = rc_count;  // never written
LOCAL int rc_count(int n, int acc) {
    B(n);
    if (n == 0)
        return acc;
    return rc_self(n - 1, acc + mark(n));
}
EXPORT int rc_machine(int x) { return rc_count(x, 0); }

typedef int (*frame_self_t)(uint32_t, int *, int);
LOCAL int lf_dispatch(uint32_t s, int *acc, int x);
static frame_self_t volatile lf_self = lf_dispatch;  // never written
LOCAL int lf_dispatch(uint32_t s, int *acc, int x) {
    int local = *acc;
    B(s);
    switch (s) {
    case 0x6b1d93c2u: local += mark(61); return lf_self(0x1f84a6d0u, &local, x);
    case 0x1f84a6d0u: local += mark(62); return lf_self(x > 0 ? 0x57c3e91bu : 0x0ad6f274u, &local, x);
    case 0x57c3e91bu: local += mark(63); return lf_self(0x0ad6f274u, &local, x);
    case 0x0ad6f274u: return local + mark(64);
    default: return -1;
    }
}
EXPORT int lf_machine(int x) {
    int acc = 0;
    return lf_dispatch(0x6b1d93c2u, &acc, x);
}
```

`tests/samples/src/partial_i686.S`:

```S
// Partial-register fixtures (spec section 6.1) for 32-bit x86 (cdecl: x at [esp+4], y at [esp+8]).
    .intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl part32_al, part32_ah
    .type part32_al, @function
    .type part32_ah, @function
// uint8_t part32_al(uint8_t x, uint8_t y) == (x + y) & 0xff
part32_al:
    mov eax, [esp + 4]
    mov ecx, [esp + 8]
    mov edx, eax
    xor al, cl
    and dl, cl
    add dl, dl
    add al, dl
    ret
// uint32_t part32_ah(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) == (x & 0xffff00ff) | ((((x >> 8) + (y >> 8)) & 0xff) << 8)
part32_ah:
    mov eax, [esp + 4]
    mov ecx, [esp + 8]
    mov edx, eax
    xor ah, ch
    and dh, ch
    add dh, dh
    add ah, dh
    ret
```

`tests/samples/src/partial_x86_64.S`:

```S
// Partial-register fixtures (spec section 6.1) as exact x86-64 code (System V: edi = x, esi = y).
// Each computes the MBA (x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y) == x + y on part of a register, keeping the rest.
    .intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl part_al, part_ah, part_ax, part_eax_zx, part_overlap, part_sx
    .type part_al, @function
    .type part_ah, @function
    .type part_ax, @function
    .type part_eax_zx, @function
    .type part_overlap, @function
    .type part_sx, @function
// uint8_t part_al(uint8_t x, uint8_t y) == (x + y) & 0xff
part_al:
    mov eax, edi
    xor al, sil
    mov ecx, edi
    and cl, sil
    add cl, cl
    add al, cl
    ret
// uint32_t part_ah(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) == (x & 0xffff00ff) | ((((x >> 8) + (y >> 8)) & 0xff) << 8)
part_ah:
    mov eax, edi
    mov ecx, esi
    mov edx, edi
    xor ah, ch
    and dh, ch
    add dh, dh
    add ah, dh
    ret
// uint32_t part_ax(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) == (x & 0xffff0000) | ((x + y) & 0xffff)
part_ax:
    mov eax, edi
    xor ax, si
    mov ecx, edi
    and cx, si
    add cx, cx
    add ax, cx
    ret
// uint64_t part_eax_zx(uint64_t x, uint64_t y) == (x + y) & 0xffffffff (32-bit ops zero-extend)
part_eax_zx:
    mov eax, edi
    xor eax, esi
    mov ecx, edi
    and ecx, esi
    lea eax, [rax + 2*rcx]
    ret
// uint32_t part_overlap(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) == ((x & 0xffffff00) | ((x + y) & 0xff)) + y
part_overlap:
    mov eax, edi
    mov ecx, edi
    xor cl, sil
    mov edx, edi
    and dl, sil
    add dl, dl
    add cl, dl
    mov al, cl
    add eax, esi
    ret
// int32_t part_sx(int8_t x, int8_t y) == sign-extended (x + y) & 0xff
part_sx:
    mov eax, edi
    xor al, sil
    mov ecx, edi
    and cl, sil
    add cl, cl
    add al, cl
    movsx eax, al
    ret

```

`tests/samples/src/pointer_uses.c`:

```c
// Pointer carriers: returning a pointer is safe only when every caller use is safe.
#include <stdint.h>
#define KEEP(p) __asm__ volatile("" : : "r"(p) : "memory")
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#define LOCAL EXPORT
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#define LOCAL __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("hidden")))
#endif
#define OBJECT(name) static struct { uint8_t bytes[16]; uint32_t key; } name = {{3}, 0x537ac921u}
#define RESULT(name) (x ^ (0x648bda32u - name.key))
#define ANCHOR(name) do { KEEP(&name); if (*(volatile uint8_t *)name.bytes != 3) return 0; } while (0)
static volatile uint8_t padding[16] = {7};
EXPORT uint8_t read_padding(void) { return padding[0]; }

LOCAL uint32_t *pass_pointer(uint32_t *p) { return p; }
LOCAL uint32_t *forward_pointer(uint32_t *p) { return pass_pointer(p); }
LOCAL uint8_t *offset_pointer(uint8_t *p) { return p + 3; }
volatile void *saved_pointer;
LOCAL void save_pointer(void *p) { saved_pointer = p; }

LOCAL uint32_t read_indirect(uint32_t **p) { return **p; }
LOCAL uint32_t *get_indirect(uint32_t **p) { return *p; }
LOCAL uint32_t local_read(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved); return read_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved);
}
LOCAL uint32_t *local_return(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved); return get_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved);
}
LOCAL void local_write(uint32_t *p, uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved); x += read_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved); *saved = x;
}
LOCAL void local_escape(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved); save_pointer((void *)&saved);
}
LOCAL void write_indirect(uint32_t **p) { **p = 7; }
LOCAL void local_forward(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved); write_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved);
}
LOCAL uintptr_t local_partial(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved);
    uint32_t n = read_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved);
    return n + *(volatile uint16_t *)&saved;
}
LOCAL uint32_t local_partial_write(uint32_t *p) {
    uint32_t *volatile saved = p; KEEP(&saved);
    uint32_t n = read_indirect((uint32_t **)&saved);
    *(volatile uint8_t *)&saved = 0;
    return n + *saved;
}

OBJECT(read_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_read(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(read_data); x += *pass_pointer(&read_data.key); return RESULT(read_data);
}
OBJECT(chain_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_chain(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(chain_data); x += *forward_pointer(&chain_data.key); return RESULT(chain_data);
}
OBJECT(offset_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_offset(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(offset_data); x += *offset_pointer(offset_data.bytes); return RESULT(offset_data);
}
OBJECT(local_read_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_local_read(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(local_read_data); x += local_read(&local_read_data.key); return RESULT(local_read_data);
}
OBJECT(local_return_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_local_return(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(local_return_data); x += *local_return(&local_return_data.key); return RESULT(local_return_data);
}

OBJECT(write_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_write(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(write_data); *pass_pointer(&write_data.key) = x; ANCHOR(write_data); return RESULT(write_data);
}
OBJECT(escape_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_escape(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(escape_data); save_pointer(forward_pointer(&escape_data.key)); return RESULT(escape_data);
}
OBJECT(top_data);
EXPORT uint32_t *return_top(void) { ANCHOR(top_data); return forward_pointer(&top_data.key); }
EXPORT uint32_t return_top_reader(uint32_t x) { ANCHOR(top_data); return RESULT(top_data); }
OBJECT(mixed_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_mixed(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(mixed_data); x += *pass_pointer(&mixed_data.key);
    *pass_pointer(&mixed_data.key) = x; ANCHOR(mixed_data); return RESULT(mixed_data);
}
OBJECT(indirect_data);
EXPORT uint32_t return_indirect(uint32_t x, uint32_t *(*fn)(uint32_t *)) {
    ANCHOR(indirect_data); x += *fn(&indirect_data.key); return RESULT(indirect_data);
}

OBJECT(local_write_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_local_write(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(local_write_data); local_write(&local_write_data.key, x); return RESULT(local_write_data);
}
OBJECT(local_escape_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_local_escape(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(local_escape_data); local_escape(&local_escape_data.key); return RESULT(local_escape_data);
}
OBJECT(local_forward_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_local_forward(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(local_forward_data); local_forward(&local_forward_data.key); return RESULT(local_forward_data);
}
OBJECT(partial_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_partial(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(partial_data); x += local_partial(&partial_data.key); return RESULT(partial_data);
}
OBJECT(partial_write_data);
EXPORT uint32_t stored_partial_write(uint32_t x) {
    ANCHOR(partial_write_data); x += local_partial_write(&partial_write_data.key); return RESULT(partial_write_data);
}
```
