`tests/samples/src/predicates.c`:

```c
// v3 fixtures: opaque predicates (conditions that never change, hidden from the compiler by empty
// asm barriers) and ordinary conditions that must stay. The dead branches return x ^ 0x5a.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

// x * (x + 1) is even.
EXPORT uint32_t opaque_parity(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x * (x + 1); B(t);
    if ((t & 1) == 0) return x + y;
    return x ^ 0x5a;
}

// d810 PredSetnz: x | 0x10 always has bit 4 set, 0x0f never.
EXPORT uint32_t opaque_setnz(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x | 0x10; B(t);
    if (t != 0x0f) return x + y;
    return x ^ 0x5a;
}

// An MBA-encoded equality: (x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y) == x + y.
EXPORT uint32_t opaque_mba(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = (x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y); B(a);
    uint32_t b = x + y; B(b);
    if (a == b) return x + y;
    return x ^ 0x5a;
}

// Ordinary: depends on x.
EXPORT uint32_t plain_condition(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x & 1; B(t);
    if (t == 0) return x + y;
    return x ^ 0x5a;
}

// OLLVM's form: signed remainder of a product of consecutive integers.
EXPORT uint32_t mod2(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    int32_t t = (int32_t)x * ((int32_t)x - 1); B(t);
    if (t % 2 == 0) return x + y;
    return x ^ 0x5a;
}

// A predicate over memory: whatever happens to the condition, the loads stay.
EXPORT uint32_t load_condition(uint32_t *p, uint32_t y) {
    if ((*p * (*p + 1)) & 1) return y ^ 0x5a;
    return y + 1;
}

// The mirrored form: the predicate guards the dead branch.
EXPORT uint32_t mirrored(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t = x * (x + 1); B(t);
    if ((t & 1) != 0) return x ^ 0x5a;
    return x + y;
}

// Loop conditions over bitwise operations and products: they depend on the inputs and stay. HLIL
// gives a loop's condition size 0 (a boolean) over 4-byte operands (seen on real code, and on every build here).
EXPORT uint32_t loop_bitwise(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t acc = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; ((i ^ x) & 7) != y; i++) {
        acc += i;
        if (i > 64) break;
    }
    return acc;
}

EXPORT uint32_t loop_masked(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t acc = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; (i & 0xff) < y; i++) acc += i ^ x;
    return acc;
}

EXPORT uint32_t loop_product(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t acc = y;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; ((i * x) & 3) != 2; i++) {
        acc ^= i;
        if (i > 64) break;
    }
    return acc;
}

```

`tests/samples/src/regression.c`:

```c
// Ordinary code that must produce zero rewrites.
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

EXPORT uint32_t reg_crc32_step(uint32_t crc, uint32_t byte) {
    crc ^= byte;
    for (int k = 0; k < 8; k++) crc = (crc >> 1) ^ (0xEDB88320u & (0u - (crc & 1u)));
    return crc;
}
EXPORT uint32_t reg_fnv1a(uint32_t h, uint32_t byte) { return (h ^ byte) * 16777619u; }
EXPORT uint32_t reg_fmix32(uint32_t h) {
    h ^= h >> 16; h *= 0x85ebca6bu; h ^= h >> 13; h *= 0xc2b2ae35u; h ^= h >> 16;
    return h;
}
EXPORT uint32_t reg_popcount(uint32_t x) {
    x = x - ((x >> 1) & 0x55555555u);
    x = (x & 0x33333333u) + ((x >> 2) & 0x33333333u);
    x = (x + (x >> 4)) & 0x0F0F0F0Fu;
    return (x * 0x01010101u) >> 24;
}
EXPORT uint32_t reg_rotl(uint32_t x, uint32_t r) { return (x << (r & 31)) | (x >> ((32 - r) & 31)); }
EXPORT uint32_t reg_clear_lowest(uint32_t x) { return x & (x - 1u); }
EXPORT uint32_t reg_average(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) { return (x & y) + ((x ^ y) >> 1); }
EXPORT uint32_t reg_abs_diff(int32_t x, int32_t y) { int32_t d = x - y; int32_t m = d >> 31; return (uint32_t)((d ^ m) - m); }
// glibc's AVX2 strcasecmp: an aligned base reused, so inlining it into the window offset only
// copies it (v2.0 rewrote b - a + base into b - (a & 0x7f)).
EXPORT uint64_t reg_align_window(uint64_t a, uint64_t b, uint64_t n) {
    uint64_t base = a & ~(uint64_t)0x7f;
    uint64_t off = b - a + base;
    return off ^ (base * n);
}
// Constant chains: ((x & 4095) - 3968) - 96 is constant folding, not deobfuscation.
EXPORT uint32_t reg_window_bound(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t r = x & 4095u;
    uint32_t i = r - 0xfe0u;
    return (r - 0xf80u > 0x60u) ? i : y;
}

```

`tests/samples/src/safety.c`:

```c
// Review Focus inputs: reassigned inputs, narrow types, loads.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

EXPORT uint32_t safety_reassign(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t t0 = x ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
    x = x * 3u + 1u; B(x);
    return t0 + 2u * t1 + x;
}
EXPORT uint8_t safety_u8(uint8_t x, uint8_t y) {
    uint8_t t0 = x ^ y; B(t0);
    uint8_t t1 = x & y; B(t1);
    return (uint8_t)(t0 + 2u * t1);
}
EXPORT uint32_t safety_load(const uint32_t *p, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t m = *p;
    uint32_t t0 = m ^ y; B(t0);
    uint32_t t1 = m & y; B(t1);
    return t0 + 2u * t1;
}
```

`tests/samples/src/scratch.c`:

```c
// Empty asm barriers keep scratch traffic in the binary; they emit no runtime operations.
#include <stdint.h>
#ifdef _WIN32
#define F __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define F __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif
#define M(value) __asm__ volatile("" : "+m"(value))
#define P(value) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(value) : : "memory")

void *volatile scratch_capture;
F void scratch_sink(void *p) { scratch_capture = p; }

F uint32_t scratch_dead(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x + 3; M(slot);
    slot = x ^ 7; M(slot);
    return x + 11;
}

F uint32_t scratch_roundtrip(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x;
    uint32_t *p = &slot; P(p);
    *p = x ^ 0x31;
    uint32_t result = *p;
    slot = 23; M(slot);
    return result;
}

F uint32_t scratch_encoded_address(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot;
    uintptr_t address = (uintptr_t)&slot;
    uintptr_t a = address ^ 0x3du; P(a);
    uintptr_t b = address & 0x3du; P(b);
    uintptr_t p = a + 2 * b - 0x3du; P(p);
    *(uint32_t *)p = x ^ 0x51u;
    uint32_t result = *(uint32_t *)p;
    slot = 29; M(slot);
    return result;
}

F uint32_t scratch_read(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x * 9; M(slot);
    return slot + 1;
}

F uint32_t scratch_branch(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x; M(slot);
    if (x & 1) { slot = 31; M(slot); }
    else { slot = 47; M(slot); }
    slot = 3; M(slot);
    return x ^ 19;
}

F uint32_t scratch_partial(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x;
    uint8_t *p = (uint8_t *)&slot; P(p);
    p[0] = 0x6b; M(slot);
    return slot;
}

F uint32_t scratch_loop(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i != 5; ++i) { slot = x + i; M(slot); }
    return x ^ 41;
}

F uint32_t scratch_escape(uint32_t x) {
    uint32_t slot = x;
    scratch_sink(&slot);
    return slot ^ x;
}

F uint32_t scratch_unknown(uint32_t x, void (*f)(uint32_t)) {
    uint32_t slot = x; M(slot);
    f(x);
    M(slot);
    return slot;
}

```

`tests/samples/src/select_x86_64.S`:

```S
// Branchless selects through the carry flag (v4.2), as exact x86-64 code (System V: edi = x, esi = y).
// neg sets CF when its operand is non-zero; sbb r, r is then 0 or -1.
    .intel_syntax noprefix
    .text
    .globl sel_sbb, sel_adc, sel_cmp
    .type sel_sbb, @function
    .type sel_adc, @function
    .type sel_cmp, @function
// uint32_t sel_sbb(uint32_t x) == x != 0 ? 0x30 : 0x20
sel_sbb:
    mov eax, edi
    neg eax
    sbb eax, eax
    and eax, 0x10
    add eax, 0x20
    ret
// uint32_t sel_adc(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) == y + (x != 0)
sel_adc:
    mov eax, esi
    neg edi
    adc eax, 0
    ret
// uint32_t sel_cmp(uint32_t x) == x != 0: sel_sbb's select compared with its non-zero arm
sel_cmp:
    mov eax, edi
    neg eax
    sbb eax, eax
    and eax, 0x10
    add eax, 0x20
    cmp eax, 0x30
    sete al
    movzx eax, al
    ret
```

`tests/samples/src/substitution.c`:

```c
// v4.3 fixtures: OLLVM-style instruction substitution (bitwise only), ordinary bitwise code that must
// stay, and the classic number-theoretic predicates. Every intermediate passes an empty asm barrier,
// so the compiler cannot simplify across it. The dead branches xor with 0x5a.
#include <stdint.h>
#define B(v) __asm__ volatile("" : "+r"(v))
#ifdef _WIN32
#define EXPORT __declspec(dllexport) __attribute__((noinline, used))
#else
#define EXPORT __attribute__((noinline, used, visibility("default")))
#endif

// x | y as (x & y) | (x ^ y).
EXPORT uint32_t sub_or(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x & y; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x ^ y; B(b);
    return a | b;
}

// x & y as (x ^ ~y) & x.
EXPORT uint32_t sub_and(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = ~y; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x ^ a; B(b);
    return b & x;
}

// x ^ y as (~x & y) | (x & ~y).
EXPORT uint32_t sub_xor(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = ~x & y; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x & ~y; B(b);
    return a | b;
}

// One bit: (x ^ (y ^ 1)) & x & 1 is x & y & 1.
EXPORT uint32_t sub_bool(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = y ^ 1; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x ^ a; B(b);
    return b & x & 1;
}

// Constants that cancel: (x | 0xf0) & 0x0f is x & 0x0f.
EXPORT uint32_t sub_const(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x | 0xf0; B(a);
    return a & 0x0f;
}

// x ^ y ^ x is y.
EXPORT uint32_t xor_cancel(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x ^ y; B(a);
    return a ^ x;
}

// Ordinary bitwise code: a mask, a combination, a byte shuffle, a bit merge.
EXPORT uint32_t plain_mask(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    B(x);
    return x & 0xff;
}

EXPORT uint32_t plain_or(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    B(x);
    return x | y;
}

EXPORT uint32_t mix(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = (x >> 8) & 0xff; B(a);
    uint32_t b = (x >> 16) & 0xff00; B(b);
    return a | b;
}

EXPORT uint32_t merge(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = x & 0xf0f0; B(a);
    uint32_t b = y & ~0xf0f0u; B(b);
    return a | b;
}

// 7 * y * y - 1 is never a square.
EXPORT uint32_t sq_pred(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = 7 * y * y - 1; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x * x; B(b);
    if (a == b) return x ^ 0x5a;
    return x + y;
}

// 2 / (y * y + 1) is 0, 1 or 2; x * x + 3 never is.
EXPORT uint32_t sq_div(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = 2 / (y * y + 1); B(a);
    uint32_t b = x * x + 3; B(b);
    if (a == b) return x ^ 0x5a;
    return x + y;
}

// The square read through a loop merge: i is x * x on entry and (x + k) * (x + k) after.
EXPORT uint32_t sq_merged(uint32_t x, uint32_t y, uint32_t n) {
    uint32_t i = x * x; B(i);
    uint32_t r = 0;
    for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        uint32_t a = 7 * y * y - 1; B(a);
        if (a == i) r ^= 0x5a;
        r += k;
        uint32_t z = x + k;
        i = z * z; B(i);
    }
    return r;
}

// A near miss: 7 * y * y - 1 == x * x + 6 holds for y = 1, x = 0. It stays.
EXPORT uint32_t sq_near(uint32_t x, uint32_t y) {
    uint32_t a = 7 * y * y - 1; B(a);
    uint32_t b = x * x + 6; B(b);
    if (a == b) return x ^ 0x5a;
    return x + y;
}

```

`tests/unit/exprgen.py`:

```py
"""Seeded random IR expressions for property tests."""

import random

from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, Expr, UnOp, Var

DEFAULT_OPS = ("add", "sub", "mul", "and", "or", "xor", "neg", "not")


def random_expr(rng: random.Random, names=("a", "b", "c"), width=32, depth=4, ops=DEFAULT_OPS) -> Expr:
    if depth == 0 or rng.random() < 0.25:
        if rng.random() < 0.8:
            return Var(rng.choice(names), width)
        return Const(rng.choice([0, 1, 2, 3, 0xFF, -1, rng.getrandbits(width)]), width)
    op = rng.choice(ops)
    if op in ("neg", "not"):
        return UnOp(op, random_expr(rng, names, width, depth - 1, ops), width)
    if op == "shl":
        return BinOp(op, random_expr(rng, names, width, depth - 1, ops), Const(rng.randrange(width), width), width)
    return BinOp(op, random_expr(rng, names, width, depth - 1, ops), random_expr(rng, names, width, depth - 1, ops), width)

```

`tests/unit/test_allocation_lifetime.py`:

```py
import json
import random

import pytest

from binja_d810.allocations.contracts import Contract, parse
from binja_d810.allocations.lifetime import Event, prove
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.evaluate import evaluate
from binja_d810.ir.expr import Const, Var


A = Contract("allocate", 0, True, True)
F = Contract("deallocate", 0, False, True)


def plan(events, allocation=A, release=F, **kwargs):
    return prove(events, 8, allocation, release, max_bytes=8, max_events=100, **kwargs)


def test_full_elision_needs_explicit_failure_and_effect_guarantees():
    events = [Event("store", 0, 0, 4, Var("value", 32)), Event("load", 1, 0, 4), Event("free", 2)]
    assert plan(events).elide
    for alloc, free in ((Contract("allocate", 0, True, False), F),
                        (A, Contract("deallocate", 0))):
        found = plan(events, alloc, free)
        assert found.loads == {1: Var("value", 32)} and not found.elide and found.notes
    nullable = plan(events, Contract("allocate", 0))
    assert not nullable.loads and not nullable.elide and nullable.notes


@pytest.mark.parametrize("little_endian", (False, True))
def test_random_partial_stores_match_an_independent_bytearray(little_endian):
    rng = random.Random(4321)
    order = "little" if little_endian else "big"
    for _ in range(100):
        data = bytearray(8)
        events = [Event("store", 0, 0, 8, Const(0, 64))]
        for step in range(12):
            size = rng.choice((1, 2, 4, 8))
            offset = rng.randrange(9 - size)
            value = rng.getrandbits(size * 8)
            data[offset:offset + size] = value.to_bytes(size, order)
            events.append(Event("store", step + 1, offset, size, Const(value, size * 8)))
        events += [Event("load", "result", 0, 8), Event("free", "free")]
        found = plan(events, little_endian=little_endian)
        assert found.elide and evaluate(found.loads["result"], {}) == int.from_bytes(data, order)


def test_unknown_bytes_prevent_elision_and_are_never_invented():
    events = [Event("store", 0, 0, 1, Const(17, 8)), Event("load", 1, 0, 4), Event("free", 2)]
    found = plan(events)
    assert not found.loads and not found.elide and found.notes


@pytest.mark.parametrize("event", (Event("escape", 2), Event("call", 2), Event("branch", 2),
                                  Event("store", 2, -1, 4, Const(0, 32)), Event("load", 2, 7, 4)))
def test_eventual_escapes_unknown_effects_and_out_of_bounds_accesses_cancel_the_proof(event):
    found = plan([Event("store", 0, 0, 4, Const(9, 32)), Event("load", 1, 0, 4), event])
    assert not found.loads and not found.elide and found.notes


def test_release_order_and_budget_are_checked():
    assert not plan([Event("free", 0), Event("load", 1, 0, 4)]).elide
    assert not plan([Event("free", 0), Event("free", 1)]).elide
    assert not plan([Event("free", 0)], deadline=Deadline.after(0)).elide
    assert not plan([Event("store", 0, 0, 4, Const(0, 32)), Event("load", 0, 0, 4)]).loads


def test_metadata_is_explicit_and_not_inferred_from_a_function_name_or_purity():
    text = json.dumps(dict(version=1, role="allocate", parameter=0, fresh=True, ordinary=True))
    assert parse(text, 4096) == Contract("allocate", 0)
    for extra in ({"nonnull": 1}, {"pure": True}, {"name": "malloc"}, {"parameter": -1},
                  {"fresh": False}, {"ordinary": False}, {"version": 2}):
        spec = json.loads(text) | extra
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            parse(json.dumps(spec), 4096)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse(text, 1)

```

`tests/unit/test_assurance.py`:

```py
"""Verification assurance: every verdict says how it was reached."""

import builtins

from binja_d810.ir.expr import Var
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic.linear_mba import LinearMBABackend
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Check, Verdict, check
from binja_d810.simplify import simplify_expression


def p(text, width=32):
    return parse(text, width)


def _without_z3(monkeypatch):
    real_import = builtins.__import__

    def fake_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
        if name == "z3":
            raise ImportError("no z3")
        return real_import(name, *args, **kwargs)

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "__import__", fake_import)


POLY = "(x & y) * (x | y) + (x & ~y) * (~x & y)"


def test_linear_pairs_are_proven_by_signature():
    assert check(p("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)"), p("x + y")) == Check(Verdict.PROVEN, "signature", "")


def test_non_linear_pairs_are_proven_by_z3():
    assert check(p("x * (y + 1)"), p("x * y + x")) == Check(Verdict.PROVEN, "z3", "")


def test_without_z3_a_non_linear_pair_is_only_tested(monkeypatch):
    _without_z3(monkeypatch)
    assert check(p(POLY, 8), p("x * y", 8)) == Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 unavailable")


def test_disabled_z3_is_reported():
    assert check(p(POLY, 8), p("x * y", 8), use_z3=False) == Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 disabled")


def test_proof_timeout_is_reported():
    hard = p("(x * y * z) ^ ((x | y) * (z & x)) ", 64)
    result = check(hard, p("((x | y) * (z & x)) ^ (z * x * y)", 64), z3_timeout_ms=1)
    assert result.verdict in (Verdict.TESTED, Verdict.PROVEN)
    if result.verdict is Verdict.TESTED:
        assert result == Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 timeout")


def test_refutation_by_sampling():
    assert check(p("x + y"), p("x ^ y")) == Check(Verdict.REFUTED, "sampling", "")


def test_rewrite_carries_the_final_verdict():
    outcome = simplify_expression(p("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y) + z"), [], [LinearMBABackend()])
    assert outcome.rewrite is not None
    assert (outcome.rewrite.verdict, outcome.rewrite.method) == (Verdict.PROVEN, "signature")


def test_sampling_only_rewrite_is_reported_as_tested():
    outcome = simplify_expression(p(POLY, 8), [], [_Fixed(p("x * y", 8))],
                                  check=lambda a, b: check(a, b, use_z3=False))
    assert outcome.rewrite is not None
    assert (outcome.rewrite.verdict, outcome.rewrite.method, outcome.rewrite.reason) == \
        (Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 disabled")


class _Fixed:
    name = "fixed"

    def __init__(self, result):
        self.result = result

    def simplify(self, e, deadline=None):
        return self.result


def test_refuted_candidates_are_counted_and_never_applied():
    outcome = simplify_expression(p("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)"), [], [_Fixed(Var("x", 32))])
    assert outcome.rewrite is None
    # Tier 2 offers the wrong answer for the whole expression and again for a subtree.
    assert outcome.refuted == 2 and all("refuted" in message for _, message in outcome.errors)


def test_legacy_verdict_only_check_still_works():
    outcome = simplify_expression(p("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)"), [], [LinearMBABackend()],
                                  check=lambda a, b: Verdict.TESTED)
    assert outcome.rewrite is not None and outcome.rewrite.verdict is Verdict.TESTED


def test_linear_identities_written_with_shifts_and_extensions_are_proven():
    # HLIL on x64: (y ^ x) + (trunc32(zx64(y) & zx64(x)) << 1) is linear once normalized.
    from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp

    x, y = parse("x", 32), parse("y", 32)
    wide_and = BinOp("and", UnOp("zx", y, 64), UnOp("zx", x, 64), 64)
    e = BinOp("add", BinOp("xor", y, x, 32), BinOp("shl", UnOp("trunc", wide_and, 32), Const(1, 8), 32), 32)
    assert check(e, p("x + y")) == Check(Verdict.PROVEN, "signature", "")
```

`tests/unit/test_bitwise.py`:

```py
import pytest

from binja_d810.ir.expr import node_count
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic.bitwise import BitwiseBackend
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent

CASES = [  # OLLVM substitutions with constants, and constant interactions atoms cannot see
    ("(x & 0x5a) | (x ^ 0x5a)", "x | 0x5a"),
    ("(x ^ ~0x5a) & x", "x & 0x5a"),
    ("(~x & 0x5a) | (x & ~0x5a)", "x ^ 0x5a"),
    ("(x | 0xf0) & 0x0f", "x & 0x0f"),
    ("(~x & 0x55) | (x & 0xaa)", "(x ^ 0x55) & 0xff"),
    ("(x ^ (y ^ 1)) & x & 1", "x & y & 1"),
    ("((x + y) & 0x5a) | ((x + y) ^ 0x5a)", "(x + y) | 0x5a"),  # an atom
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [8, 16, 32, 64])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("text,expected", CASES)
def test_substitutions_collapse(text, expected, width):
    e = parse(text, width)
    found = BitwiseBackend().simplify(e)
    assert found is not None and node_count(found) <= node_count(normalize(parse(expected, width)))
    assert check_equivalent(e, found) is Verdict.PROVEN


def test_one_bit_root():
    e = parse("(a ^ (b ^ a)) & a", 1)
    assert BitwiseBackend().simplify(e) == normalize(parse("a & b", 1))


def test_extensions_are_atoms():
    e = parse("(zx32(c) & y) | (zx32(c) ^ y)", 32, {"c": 8})
    assert BitwiseBackend().simplify(e) == normalize(parse("zx32(c) | y", 32, {"c": 8}))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", [
    "x + y",                                   # not a bitwise root
    "(a & 0xf0) | (b & 0x0f)",                 # already minimal: a bit merge
    "(a & b) | (c & d) | (e ^ (a & e))",       # five names
    "(x & 1) | (x & 2) | (x & 4) | (x & 8) | (x & 16)",  # five constants
])
def test_left_alone(text):
    assert BitwiseBackend().simplify(parse(text, 32)) is None

```

`tests/unit/test_cobra_shim.py`:

```py
import random

import pytest

from binja_d810.semantic import cobra_shim

solve = cobra_shim.load()
needs_cobra = pytest.mark.skipif(solve is None, reason="CoBRA not available")


def test_binding_is_found_when_d810_cobra_is_installed():
    pytest.importorskip("d810_cobra._cobra")
    assert cobra_shim._python_binding() is not None


@needs_cobra
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "expr, width, accepted",
    [
        ("(x&y)+(x|y)", 64, {"x+y", "y+x"}),
        ("(x ^ 0x10) + 2 * (x & 0x10)", 64, {"16+x", "x+16"}),
        ("((a^b)&c) | ((a&b)^c)", 64, {"c^a&b", "a&b^c", "c^(a&b)", "(a&b)^c"}),
    ],
)
def test_readme_examples(expr, width, accepted):
    assert solve(expr, width).replace(" ", "") in accepted


@needs_cobra
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "expr, width",
    [
        ("(v0 ^ v1) + 2 * (v0 & v1) + 3 * ((v0 | v1) - (v0 & ~v1) - v1)", 32),
        ("(v0 * v1) + (v0 & v1) * (v0 | v1) - 2 * (v0 * v1)", 32),
        ("(v0 | 0xff) - (v0 & (-256)) + v1", 16),
        # CoBRA renumbers the variables left after dropping an unused one; v0 here cancels out.
        ("v1 + 2 * v2 + (v0 ^ v1) - (v0 | v1) + (v0 & v1)", 32),
        ("(v0 & 256) + v1 + (v2 ^ v2)", 16),
    ],
)
def test_output_means_the_same_as_input(expr, width):
    out = solve(expr, width)
    assert out is not None
    mask = (1 << width) - 1
    rng = random.Random(0)
    for _ in range(64):
        env = {f"v{i}": rng.getrandbits(width) for i in range(3)}
        assert eval(out, {}, env) & mask == eval(expr, {}, env) & mask, out


@needs_cobra
def test_unsupported_operators_are_refused():
    assert solve("(v0 >> 3) + (v0 & v1)", 32) is None


def test_render_parenthesises_by_precedence():
    tree = {"kind": "bin", "op": "-", "a": {"kind": "var", "name": "a"},
            "b": {"kind": "bin", "op": "+", "a": {"kind": "var", "name": "b"},
                  "b": {"kind": "un", "op": "~", "a": {"kind": "const", "value": -3}}}}
    assert cobra_shim._render(tree).replace(" ", "") == "a-(b+~(-3))"
```

`tests/unit/test_constancy.py`:

```py
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.expr import Const, to_str
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic.constancy import constant_value, fold_shared
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict
from binja_d810.simplify import simplify_expression


def c(text, width=1):
    return parse(text, width, {"x": 32, "y": 32, "z": 32, "b": 8})


def test_parity_and_mba_equalities_are_proven_constant():
    for text, value in [("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)", 1), ("ne((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y), x + y)", 0),
                        ("ne(x | 16, 15)", 1), ("ult(x & 7, 8)", 1), ("ne((x * x) & 3, 2)", 1)]:
        value_and_check = constant_value(c(text), Deadline.after(10))
        assert value_and_check is not None, text
        assert value_and_check[0] == value and value_and_check[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN, (text, value_and_check)


def test_non_constant_conditions_are_not_constant():
    for text in ["eq(x & 1, 0)", "ugt(x, 5)", "eq(x | 1, 3)", "ne((x * y) & 1, 0)"]:
        assert constant_value(c(text), Deadline.after(10)) is None, text


def test_a_condition_constant_on_samples_but_not_always_is_never_folded():
    # Random 32-bit samples almost never hit x & 0xffff == 0x1234; a proof (or a model) decides.
    out = simplify_expression(c("ne(x & 0xffff, 0x1234)"), [], [])
    assert out.rewrite is None


def test_small_inputs_are_proven_exhaustively():
    value_and_check = constant_value(parse("ult(zx32(b) & 7, 8)", 1, {"b": 8}), Deadline.after(10))
    assert value_and_check[0] == 1 and value_and_check[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN


def test_simplify_folds_proven_constant_conditions_and_values():
    out = simplify_expression(c("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)"), [], [])
    assert out.rewrite is not None and out.rewrite.replacement == Const(1, 1)
    assert "constancy" in out.rewrite.source and out.rewrite.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN
    value = simplify_expression(c("(x * (x - 1)) & 1", 32), [], [])
    assert value.rewrite is not None and value.rewrite.replacement == Const(0, 32)


def test_an_unproven_constant_is_reported_and_left_alone():
    from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Check

    out = simplify_expression(c("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)"), [], [],
                              check=lambda a, b: Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 timeout"))
    assert out.rewrite is None and out.skipped == "constant on every sample, not proven"


def test_conditions_decided_by_form_or_bounds_are_folded_and_proven():
    for text, value in [("eq(x, x)", 1), ("ne(x, x)", 0), ("ugt(zx32(trunc8(x)), 0xff)", 0),
                        ("ule(zx32(trunc8(x)), 0xff)", 1), ("uge(zx32(b), 0x100)", 0)]:
        out = simplify_expression(c(text), [], [])
        assert out.rewrite is not None and out.rewrite.replacement == Const(value, 1), (text, out)
        assert out.rewrite.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN, (text, out.rewrite)


def test_equality_with_a_small_value_is_not_constant_on_samples():
    # Random 32-bit z almost never equals a 3-bit value; small and equal samples do (a loop
    # condition in predicates.c: ((i ^ x) & 7) != y).
    from binja_d810.semantic.constancy import sampled_constant

    for text in ["eq((x ^ y) & 7, z)", "ne((x ^ y) & 7, z)", "ult(x & 0xff, y)", "eq(x & y, z)", "eq(x | y, 0)",
                 "eq(x & y, (-1))"]:
        assert sampled_constant(c(text)) is None, text


def test_a_refuted_constant_falls_back_to_the_simplified_condition():
    # Every sample says 1 (random sums almost never hit 0x1234); the proof refutes that, and the
    # linear backend's x + y still stands, proven.
    from binja_d810.semantic.linear_mba import LinearMBABackend

    out = simplify_expression(c("ne(((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)) & 0xffff, 0x1234)"), [], [LinearMBABackend()])
    assert out.rewrite is not None and out.rewrite.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN, out
    assert out.rewrite.replacement == normalize(c("ne((x + y) & 0xffff, 0x1234)")), to_str(out.rewrite.replacement)
    assert "constancy" not in out.rewrite.source and not out.errors, out


def _bcf_condition(depth=30):
    """((t ^ K) & 1) == 0 with t the 30-step chain over x * (x - 1): always 1, 2^30 tree nodes."""
    from test_dag import MASKS, chain

    from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp

    k = 0
    for m in MASKS[:depth]:
        k ^= ~m & 0xFFFFFFFF
    t = BinOp("xor", chain(depth), Const(k, 32), 32)
    return BinOp("eq", BinOp("and", t, Const(1, 32), 32), Const(0, 32), 1)


def test_constants_over_shared_values_are_proven_without_expanding_the_tree():
    import time

    from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp
    from binja_d810.semantic.constancy import fold_shared

    started = time.perf_counter()
    found = fold_shared(_bcf_condition(), Deadline.after(10))
    assert found is not None and found[0] == 1 and found[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN, found
    varying = BinOp("eq", BinOp("and", _bcf_condition().left.left, Const(2, 32), 32), Const(0, 32), 1)
    assert fold_shared(varying, Deadline.after(10)) is None
    assert time.perf_counter() - started < 3


def test_an_unproven_constant_is_not_proven_again_in_the_same_function_run():
    # A 17-node condition spent its 2 s proof in both rounds of a pass.
    from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Check

    calls = []

    def check(a, b):
        calls.append(b)
        return Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "z3 timeout")

    cache: dict = {}
    for _ in range(3):
        out = simplify_expression(c("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)"), [], [], check=check, tier1_cache=cache)
        assert out.rewrite is None and out.skipped == "constant on every sample, not proven", out
    assert len(calls) == 1, calls


def test_fold_shared_evaluates_a_variable_free_expression():
    # A per-path variant whose merged values were all constants: exact by evaluation.
    from binja_d810.semantic.constancy import fold_shared
    from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const

    found = fold_shared(BinOp("xor", Const(1, 1), Const(0, 1), 1), Deadline.never())
    assert found is not None and found[0] == 1 and found[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN


def test_fold_shared_samples_a_few_dozen_times_before_the_proof(monkeypatch):
    # v3.3: sampling only guesses the value (and rejects ordinary roots after a sample or two); the proof
    # decides. One OLLVM-obfuscated function spent 13.5 of 20 s evaluating shared values 277 times each.
    from binja_d810.semantic import constancy

    samples = []
    real = constancy.evaluate_shared_batch
    monkeypatch.setattr(constancy, "evaluate_shared_batch",
                        lambda e, envs: (samples.append(len(envs)), real(e, envs))[1])
    found = constancy.fold_shared(_bcf_condition(), Deadline.never())
    assert found is not None and found[1].verdict is Verdict.PROVEN
    assert 0 < sum(samples) <= 64, samples


def test_an_inconclusive_fold_is_remembered_for_the_run_by_shape(monkeypatch):
    # v3.5: one large function's slowest root (2 s, "constant on every sample, not proven") was proven again in
    # every pass: its lift's names change from pass to pass, its shape does not.
    from binja_d810.semantic import constancy, memo

    memo.clear()
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(constancy, "_z3_prove", lambda *a: (calls.append(1), (None, "z3 timeout"))[1])
    monkeypatch.setattr(constancy, "low_bits_value", lambda e: None)  # only the stubbed solver decides
    run: dict = {}
    first = constancy.fold_shared(c("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)"), Deadline.never(), inconclusive=run)
    second = constancy.fold_shared(c("eq((y * (y + 1)) & 1, 0)"), Deadline.never(), inconclusive=run)
    assert first is not None and first[1].verdict is Verdict.TESTED and second == first
    assert len(calls) == 1
    constancy.fold_shared(c("eq((y * (y + 1)) & 1, 0)"), Deadline.never())  # another run: tried again
    assert len(calls) == 2


def test_a_proof_cut_short_by_the_deadline_is_not_remembered(monkeypatch):
    from binja_d810.semantic import constancy, memo

    memo.clear()
    calls = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(constancy, "_z3_prove", lambda *a: (calls.append(a[3]), (None, "z3 timeout"))[1])
    monkeypatch.setattr(constancy, "low_bits_value", lambda e: None)  # only the stubbed solver decides
    run: dict = {}
    for _ in range(2):
        constancy.fold_shared(c("eq((x * (x + 1)) & 1, 0)"), Deadline.after(0.5), inconclusive=run)
    assert len(calls) == 2 and not run


def test_fold_shared_proves_by_low_bits():
    value, found = fold_shared(parse("eq(7 * y * y - 1, x * x)", 64), Deadline.never())
    assert value == 0 and (found.verdict, found.method) == (Verdict.PROVEN, "low bits")


def test_per_path_square_variants_fold():
    # i = phi(a * a, b * b): each per-path variant of 7 * y * y - 1 == i is proven never true (merged squares).
    for square in ("a * a", "b * b"):
        value, found = fold_shared(parse(f"eq(7 * y * y - 1, {square})", 32), Deadline.never())
        assert value == 0 and found.verdict is Verdict.PROVEN
```

`tests/unit/test_constant_program.py`:

```py
from dataclasses import replace
import random

import pytest

from binja_d810.consteval.program import AddressOf, Assign, Branch, Jump, Limits, Load, LoadIndirect, Stop, Store, StoreIndirect, run
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline
from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp, Var


def test_random_constant_keystreams_match_an_independent_python_model():
    for seed in range(128):
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        state = initial = rng.getrandbits(32)
        rotate, multiplier, add, shift = rng.randrange(1, 32), rng.getrandbits(32), rng.getrandbits(32), rng.randrange(32)
        length = rng.randrange(4, 64)
        plaintext = bytes(rng.randrange(32, 127) for _ in range(length)) + b"\0"
        program = {0: Assign("state", Const(initial, 32))}
        at = 1
        for byte in plaintext:
            k = rng.getrandbits(32)
            state = (((state >> rotate) | (state << (32 - rotate))) * multiplier + add + k) & 0xffffffff
            cipher = ((state >> shift) ^ byte) & 255
            s = Var("state", 32)
            expression = BinOp("add", BinOp("add", BinOp("mul", BinOp("ror", s, Const(rotate, 32), 32),
                                                                         Const(multiplier, 32), 32), Const(add, 32), 32), Const(k, 32), 32)
            program[at] = Assign("state", expression)
            program[at + 1] = Store("buffer", Const((at - 1) // 2, 32), UnOp("trunc", BinOp("xor",
                                       BinOp("lshr", s, Const(shift, 32), 32), Const(cipher, 32), 32), 8))
            at += 2
        program[at] = Stop()
        result = run(program, {"buffer": len(plaintext)})
        assert not result.reason and bytes(result.buffers["buffer"]) == plaintext


def loop():
    index = Var("i", 32)
    return {0: Assign("i", Const(0, 32)),
            1: Branch(BinOp("ult", index, Const(12, 32), 1), 2, 5),
            2: Store("buffer", index, UnOp("trunc", BinOp("add", index, Const(65, 32), 32), 8)),
            3: Assign("i", BinOp("add", index, Const(1, 32), 32)), 4: Jump(1), 5: Stop()}


def test_loop_execution_and_each_budget_fail_closed_without_partial_buffers():
    assert bytes(run(loop(), {"buffer": 12}).buffers["buffer"]) == b"ABCDEFGHIJKL"
    for limit, value in (("steps", 3), ("trips", 2), ("buffer_bytes", 1), ("instructions", 1), ("nodes", 1)):
        result = run(loop(), {"buffer": 12}, limits=replace(Limits(), **{limit: value}))
        assert result.reason and not result.buffers and not result.values
    assert run(loop(), {"buffer": 12}, deadline=Deadline.after(0)).reason


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad", (Assign("x", Var("unknown", 32)), object(),
                                Load("x", "buffer", Const(0, 32), 4), Store("buffer", Const(4, 32), Const(0, 8))))
def test_unknown_inputs_effects_uninitialized_and_out_of_bounds_accesses_cancel_the_region(bad):
    result = run({0: Store("buffer", Const(0, 32), Const(7, 8)), 1: bad, 2: Stop()}, {"buffer": 4})
    assert result.reason and not result.buffers


@pytest.mark.parametrize("little_endian", (False, True))
def test_partial_memory_operations_preserve_byte_order(little_endian):
    program = {0: Store("b", Const(0, 32), Const(0x12345678, 32)), 1: Store("b", Const(1, 32), Const(0xab, 8)),
               2: Load("value", "b", Const(0, 32), 4), 3: Stop()}
    result = run(program, {"b": 4}, little_endian=little_endian)
    assert result.values["value"] == (0x1234ab78 if little_endian else 0x12ab5678)


def test_scalar_width_changes_require_an_explicit_ir_conversion():
    program = {0: Assign("x", Const(7, 8)), 1: Assign("y", Var("x", 32)), 2: Stop()}
    assert run(program, {}).reason == "constant variable width is ambiguous"
    program[1] = Assign("y", UnOp("zx", Var("x", 8), 32))
    assert run(program, {}).values["y"] == 7


def test_pointer_iterator_loops_use_buffer_identity_without_inventing_a_stack_base():
    p, end = Var("p", 64), Var("end", 64)
    program = {0: AddressOf("p", "b", Const(0, 64), 64), 1: AddressOf("end", "b", Const(12, 64), 64),
               2: Branch(BinOp("ne", p, end, 1), 3, 6), 3: StoreIndirect(p, Const(65, 8)),
               4: Assign("p", BinOp("add", p, Const(1, 64), 64)), 5: Jump(2),
               6: Assign("distance", BinOp("sub", end, p, 64)), 7: Stop()}
    result = run(program, {"b": 12})
    assert not result.reason and bytes(result.buffers["b"]) == b"A" * 12
    assert result.values["distance"] == 0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ("ult", "slt", "xor"))
def test_unknown_pointer_bits_and_order_cannot_be_evaluated(operation):
    p = Var("p", 64)
    expression = BinOp(operation, p, p, 1 if operation in ("ult", "slt") else 64)
    result = run({0: AddressOf("p", "b", Const(0, 64), 64), 1: Assign("out", expression), 2: Stop()}, {"b": 8})
    assert result.reason and not result.buffers


def test_a_pointer_cannot_be_serialized_as_a_fabricated_constant_address():
    result = run({0: AddressOf("p", "b", Const(0, 64), 64),
                  1: Store("b", Const(0, 64), Var("p", 64)), 2: Stop()}, {"b": 8})
    assert result.reason == "local pointer is observed as data" and not result.buffers
```

`tests/unit/test_constant_state.py`:

```py
import pytest
from binja_d810.consteval.program import Address
from binja_d810.consteval.state import State, binary


def test_partial_register_writes_do_not_invent_the_upper_bits():
    state = State(16)
    state.field("r", 0x5a, 0, 8, 64)
    assert state.read("r", 8) == 0x5a
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): state.read("r", 64)
    state.field("r", 0x123456789abcde, 8, 56, 64)
    assert state.read("r", 64) == 0x123456789abcde5a


def test_logical_values_sharing_a_physical_slot_remain_distinct():
    state = State(4)
    state.assign("old", 7, 32); state.store(0, 7, 4)
    state.assign("new", 9, 32); state.store(0, 9, 4)
    assert state.read("old", 32) == 7 and state.load(0, 4) == 9


@pytest.mark.parametrize("little", (False, True))
def test_physical_bytes_and_partial_overlap_are_exact(little):
    state = State(4, little)
    state.store(0, 0x12345678, 4); state.store(1, 0x67, 1)
    assert state.load(0, 4) == (0x12346778 if little else 0x12675678)


def test_unknown_bytes_and_absolute_pointer_bits_stay_unknown():
    state = State(8)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): state.load(0, 1)
    pointer = Address("frame", 3, 64)
    state.assign("p", pointer, 64)
    assert state.read("p", 64) == pointer
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): state.read("p", 32)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError): state.store(0, pointer, 8)
    assert binary("add", pointer, 4, 64, 64, 64) == Address("frame", 7, 64)
```

`tests/unit/test_constant_strings.py`:

```py
from binja_d810.consteval.strings import recognize


def test_termination_and_adjacent_length_are_only_display_heuristics():
    options = dict(maximum=12, minimum=4)
    assert recognize(list(b"hello\0tail"), 0, **options) == "hello"
    assert recognize(list(b"hello"), 0, length=5, **options) == "hello"
    assert recognize(list(b"hello"), 0, **options) is None
    assert recognize(list(b"hello"), 0, length=6, **options) is None
    assert recognize([None, 65, 66, 67, 68, 0], 0, **options) is None
    assert recognize(list(b"hello\0"), -1, **options) is None
    assert recognize(list(b"hello\0"), 0, maximum=4, minimum=4) is None
    assert recognize(list(b"abc\x01\0"), 0, **options) is None
```

```py
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "samples"))
import gen_mba  # noqa: E402

from binja_d810.ir.expr import is_mba, node_count  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.rules.registry import load_rules  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic import cobra_shim  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.backend import default_backends  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.simplify import simplify_expression  # noqa: E402

SAMPLES = gen_mba.generate()


def test_corpus_has_every_category():
    # d810 count depends on how many proven rules are variable-only with a non-MBA replacement;
    # record the actual number in the Task 20 report.
    counts = Counter(s.category for s in SAMPLES)
    assert counts["d810"] >= 25 and counts["linear"] >= 40 and counts["poly"] == 2


def test_samples_are_correct_mbas():
    for s in SAMPLES:
        assert is_mba(normalize(s.obfuscated)), s.name
        assert check_equivalent(s.obfuscated, s.expected) is not Verdict.REFUTED, s.name


@pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("clang") is None, reason="clang missing")
def test_emitted_c_compiles(tmp_path):
    src = tmp_path / "mba.c"
    src.write_text(gen_mba.emit_c(SAMPLES))
    subprocess.run(["clang", "-arch", "arm64", "-fsyntax-only", "-Wall", "-Werror", str(src)], check=True)


def test_arithmetic_subterms_are_behind_barriers():
    # Without one, clang -O2 folds (x * x) & 3 into x & 1 and the sample has no MBA left.
    from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse

    text = gen_mba.emit_function(gen_mba.Sample("s", "d810", 32, parse("(x * x) & 3", 32), parse("x & 1", 32)))
    assert "t0 = (x * x); B(t0);" in text


def test_pipeline_simplifies_corpus():
    rules, backends = load_rules(), default_backends()
    failures = {"d810": [], "linear": [], "poly": []}
    for s in SAMPLES:
        out = simplify_expression(s.obfuscated, rules, backends)
        repl = out.rewrite.replacement if out.rewrite else None
        # Some targets mix arithmetic and bitwise ops themselves (x - (y & z)), so only demand a
        # non-MBA result when the expected answer is not one.
        demixed = not is_mba(repl) or is_mba(s.expected) if repl is not None else False
        ok = repl is not None and demixed and node_count(repl) <= node_count(s.expected) + 2
        if not ok:
            failures[s.category].append(s.name)
    assert failures["d810"] == []
    assert failures["linear"] == []
    if cobra_shim.load() is not None:
        assert failures["poly"] == []
```

`tests/unit/test_d810_adapter.py`:

```py
import pytest

from binja_d810.ir.expr import node_count, to_str
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.rules.d810_adapter import D810Rule
from binja_d810.rules.instantiate import instantiate
from binja_d810.rules.prove import solve_constants
from binja_d810.rules.registry import instance, load_rules
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Verdict, check_equivalent

RULES = {r.name: r for r in load_rules()}

# Rules that cannot match their own instantiated pattern, each with a reason. Keep empty unless justified.
SELF_MATCH_XFAIL: dict[str, str] = {
    # Zext(x & 1, 32) == 2: the zero extension's source width is not given by the pattern, so no
    # instance can be built; tests/unit/test_predicate_rules.py covers the comparison rules.
    "Pred0Rule4": "zext source width not determined by the pattern",
}


def ir(text, width=32):
    return normalize(parse(text, width))


def test_hackers_delight_xor():
    rw = RULES["Xor_HackersDelightRule_1"].match(ir("(a | b) - (a & b)"))
    assert rw is not None
    assert rw.replacement == ir("a ^ b")
    assert rw.source == "Xor_HackersDelightRule_1"


def test_rule_only_fires_at_proven_widths():
    rule = D810Rule(instance("Xor_HackersDelightRule_1"), widths=[32])
    assert rule.match(ir("(a | b) - (a & b)", 64)) is None


def test_defining_constraints_compute_constants():
    rule = RULES.get("CstSimplificationRule3")
    if rule is None:
        pytest.skip("CstSimplificationRule3 not proven in manifest")
    target = ir("(a - 3) + 5 * (a - 7)")
    rw = rule.match(target)
    assert rw is not None
    assert rw.replacement == ir("6 * a - 38")


def test_instantiate_resolves_bnot_leaves_in_both_d810_spellings():
    from binja_d810.ir.expr import UnOp, Var
    from binja_d810.third_party.d810.mba.dsl import Var as PVar

    z_not = UnOp("not", Var("z", 32), 32)
    assert instantiate(PVar("bnot_x_2"), 32) == z_not
    assert instantiate(PVar("bnot_x2"), 32) == z_not  # Xor_Rule_2/3 spell it without the underscore


def test_disabled_rules_are_not_loaded():
    assert "Xor_HackersDelightRule_1" not in {r.name for r in load_rules(disabled={"Xor_HackersDelightRule_1"})}


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", sorted(RULES))
def test_rule_matches_its_own_instantiated_pattern(name):
    if name in SELF_MATCH_XFAIL:
        pytest.xfail(SELF_MATCH_XFAIL[name])
    rule = RULES[name]
    width = 32 if 32 in rule.widths else max(rule.widths)
    constants = None
    raw = instantiate(rule.pattern, width)
    if raw is None:  # symbolic constants: solve the rule's constraints for them (v2.1)
        def matches(values):
            candidate = instantiate(rule.pattern, width, constants=values)
            if candidate is None:
                return False
            replacement = instantiate(rule.replacement, width, constants=values)
            simplified = replacement is not None and normalize(candidate) == normalize(replacement)
            return simplified or rule.match(normalize(candidate)) is not None  # simplified: skipped below

        constants = solve_constants(instance(name), width, accept=matches)
        assert constants is not None, f"{name}: no constants satisfy its constraints at {width} bits"
        raw = instantiate(rule.pattern, width, constants=constants)
        assert raw is not None, f"{name}: pattern still has unsupported leaves"
    target = normalize(raw)
    expected = instantiate(rule.replacement, width, constants=constants)
    if expected is not None and node_count(target) <= node_count(normalize(expected)):
        pytest.skip("normalize() already simplifies this pattern")
    rw = rule.match(target)
    assert rw is not None, f"{name} did not match {to_str(target)}"
    assert check_equivalent(target, rw.replacement) is not Verdict.REFUTED

```

`tests/unit/test_dag.py`:

```py
"""Shared values (v3.1): a lifted condition reuses SSA values, so its expression is a DAG whose tree
can be exponentially larger. Everything the constancy path does with it must stay linear."""

import time

from binja_d810.ir.evaluate import evaluate, evaluate_shared
from binja_d810.ir.expr import BinOp, Const, UnOp, Var, brief, distinct_nodes, tree_size
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse

x = Var("x", 32)
MASKS = [(0x9E3779B9 * (i + 1)) & 0xFFFFFFFF for i in range(30)]


def chain(depth: int = 30):
    """t' = (t & m) | (~t & ~m) from p = x * (x - 1): each step reads t twice."""
    t = BinOp("mul", x, BinOp("sub", x, Const(1, 32), 32), 32)
    for m in MASKS[:depth]:
        t = BinOp("or", BinOp("and", t, Const(m, 32), 32),
                  BinOp("and", UnOp("not", t, 32), Const(~m & 0xFFFFFFFF, 32), 32), 32)
    return t


def timed(f):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    value = f()
    return value, time.perf_counter() - start


def test_sizes_count_the_tree_and_the_shared_nodes():
    e = chain()
    assert distinct_nodes(e) < 300
    assert tree_size(e) > 2 ** 30
    small = parse("(a & b) + (a & b)", 32)
    assert tree_size(small) == 7


def test_hashing_and_comparison_are_linear():
    a, b = chain(), chain()  # equal, built separately: no shared objects between them
    (_, seconds) = timed(lambda: (hash(a), hash(b), a == b, a != chain(29)))
    assert a == b and hash(a) == hash(b) and a != chain(29)
    assert seconds < 0.5, seconds


def test_evaluation_is_linear_and_agrees_with_the_tree_evaluator():
    value, seconds = timed(lambda: evaluate_shared(chain(), {"x": 12345}))
    assert seconds < 0.5, seconds
    k = 0
    for m in MASKS:
        k ^= ~m & 0xFFFFFFFF
    assert value == ((12345 * 12344) & 0xFFFFFFFF) ^ k  # each step is t ^ ~m
    small = parse("((a ^ b) + 2 * (a & b)) | ~c", 32)
    env = {"a": 7, "b": 0xFFFFFFF0, "c": 3}
    assert evaluate_shared(small, env) == evaluate(small, env)


def test_z3_terms_are_built_once_per_shared_value():
    from binja_d810.semantic.verify import to_z3

    import z3

    _, seconds = timed(lambda: to_z3(chain(), {"x": z3.BitVec("x", 32)}))
    assert seconds < 0.5, seconds


def test_brief_text_is_bounded():
    text, seconds = timed(lambda: brief(chain(), limit=200))
    assert seconds < 0.5 and len(text) <= 260, text
    assert brief(parse("a + 1", 32)) == "(a + 1)"


def test_repr_is_bounded():
    text, seconds = timed(lambda: repr(chain()))
    assert seconds < 0.5 and len(text) < 400, text[:400]
    assert repr(parse("a + 1", 32)) == "BinOp(op='add', left=Var(name='a', width=32), right=Const(value=1, width=32), width=32)"

```

`tests/unit/test_deadcode.py`:

```py
from binja_d810.binja.deadcode import dead_definitions


def test_definitions_reached_from_a_live_use_are_live():
    pure = {"a": [], "b": ["a"], "c": ["b"], "d": ["a"]}
    assert dead_definitions(pure, roots=["c"]) == {"d"}


def test_chains_of_unused_copies_are_dead_together():
    # x8_1 = x ^ y; var_10 = x8_1; x8_2 = var_10 with nothing reading x8_2.
    pure = {"x8_1": ["x", "y"], "var_10": ["x8_1"], "x8_2": ["var_10"]}
    assert dead_definitions(pure, roots=["ret"]) == {"x8_1", "var_10", "x8_2"}


def test_cycles_terminate():
    assert dead_definitions({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}, roots=["a"]) == set()
    assert dead_definitions({"a": ["b"], "b": ["a"]}, roots=[]) == {"a", "b"}


def test_definitions_die_with_the_root_only_if_every_use_is_inside_it():
    from binja_d810.binja.deadcode import dying_with_root

    # t1 used by root and t2; t2 used only by root; t3 also used by another statement (9).
    uses = {"t1": [5, 3], "t2": [5], "t3": [5, 9]}
    defined_at = {"t1": 2, "t2": 3, "t3": 4}
    assert dying_with_root(uses, defined_at, root_statement=5) == {"t1", "t2"}
    assert dying_with_root({"t": []}, {"t": 1}, root_statement=5) == set()


def test_single_use_definitions_are_shown_in_the_statement_that_uses_them():
    from binja_d810.binja.deadcode import shown_in

    # Three-address MLIL: t1 = x ^ y; t2 = x & y; t3 = t1 + t2 * 2; root = t3 | z.
    # HLIL shows one statement, so the chain is one (mixed) statement.
    uses = {"t1": [3], "t2": [3], "t3": [4]}
    defined_at = {"t1": 1, "t2": 2, "t3": 3}
    assert shown_in({"t1", "t2", "t3"}, uses, defined_at, root_statement=4) == {"t1": None, "t2": None, "t3": None}
    # OLLVM: a = x * 7 + y is used twice (t1 = a & M; t2 = ~a), so HLIL shows it on its own.
    uses = {"a": [2, 3], "t1": [5], "t2": [4], "t3": [5]}
    defined_at = {"a": 1, "t1": 2, "t2": 3, "t3": 4}
    assert shown_in({"a", "t1", "t2", "t3"}, uses, defined_at, root_statement=5) == {
        "a": "a", "t1": None, "t2": None, "t3": None}
    # A single-use definition used by a statement that stands alone is shown in that one.
    uses = {"m": [2], "a": [3, 4]}
    defined_at = {"m": 1, "a": 2}
    assert shown_in({"m", "a"}, uses, defined_at, root_statement=5) == {"m": "a", "a": "a"}


def test_a_check_runs_only_for_a_definition_that_would_be_removed():
    from binja_d810.binja.deadcode import dead_with_checks

    ran = []
    checks = {"live": lambda: ran.append("live") or True, "dead": lambda: ran.append("dead") or True}
    pure = {"live": ["a"], "dead": ["b"], "a": [], "b": []}
    assert dead_with_checks(pure, ["live"], checks) == {"dead", "b"}
    assert ran == ["dead"]


def test_a_failed_check_keeps_the_definition_and_what_it_reads():
    from binja_d810.binja.deadcode import dead_with_checks

    # q = a / b where b may be 0: not removable, so a and b stay alive.
    pure = {"q": ["a", "b"], "a": [], "b": [], "t": []}
    assert dead_with_checks(pure, [], {"q": lambda: False}) == {"t"}
```

`tests/unit/test_deadline.py`:

```py
"""Deadlines and the shared per-function allowance."""

import threading
import time

from binja_d810.binja.budget import Ledger
from binja_d810.deadline import Deadline


def test_deadline_basics():
    assert Deadline.never().remaining() > 1e6 and not Deadline.never().expired()
    d = Deadline.after(0.05)
    assert 0 < d.remaining() <= 0.05 and not d.expired()
    time.sleep(0.06)
    assert d.expired() and d.remaining() == 0
    assert Deadline.after(5).earlier(Deadline.after(1)).remaining() <= 1


def test_hlil_pass_gets_only_what_mlil_left():
    ledger = Ledger()
    mlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    mlil.charge(3.0)
    hlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "hlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert 1.9 < hlil.remaining() <= 2.0 and hlil.inherited


def test_an_adopted_generation_is_inherited_by_the_hlil_pass():
    # Unflattening replaces the MLIL object (v4.2): the HLIL pass sees the new one as ctx.mlil.
    ledger = Ledger()
    mlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    mlil.charge(3.0)
    mlil.adopt(222, object())
    hlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "hlil", generation=222, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert 1.9 < hlil.remaining() <= 2.0 and hlil.inherited and mlil.used() == 3.0


def test_repeated_calls_in_one_generation_get_no_fresh_allowance():
    ledger = Ledger()
    first = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    first.charge(4.5)
    again = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert again.remaining() <= 0.5
    hlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "hlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    hlil.charge(0.5)
    hlil_again = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "hlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert hlil_again.remaining() == 0


def test_reanalysis_is_a_new_generation():
    ledger = Ledger()
    ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0).charge(5.0)
    fresh = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=222, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert fresh.remaining() > 4.9


def test_hlil_only_invocation_starts_its_own_generation():
    ledger = Ledger()
    ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=111, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0).charge(4.0)
    # HLIL regenerated alone (its MLIL is a different object than the one the MLIL pass saw).
    hlil = ledger.begin(("view", 0x1000), "hlil", generation=999, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert hlil.remaining() > 4.9 and not hlil.inherited


def test_views_and_functions_are_separate():
    ledger = Ledger()
    ledger.begin(("view-a", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=1, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0).charge(5.0)
    assert ledger.begin(("view-b", 0x1000), "mlil", generation=1, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0).remaining() > 4.9
    assert ledger.begin(("view-a", 0x2000), "mlil", generation=1, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0).remaining() > 4.9


def test_ledger_is_bounded():
    ledger = Ledger(capacity=3)
    for start in range(10):
        ledger.begin(("view", start), "mlil", generation=start, keepalive=object(), allowance=5.0)
    assert len(ledger) == 3


def test_concurrent_charges_are_counted():
    ledger = Ledger()
    allowance = ledger.begin(("view", 1), "mlil", generation=1, keepalive=object(), allowance=100.0)
    threads = [threading.Thread(target=lambda: [allowance.charge(0.01) for _ in range(100)]) for _ in range(4)]
    for t in threads:
        t.start()
    for t in threads:
        t.join()
    assert abs(allowance.used() - 4.0) < 1e-6


# --- deadline propagation -------------------------------------------------------------------

from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic import cobra_shim  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.linear_mba import LinearMBABackend  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import Check, Verdict, check  # noqa: E402
from binja_d810.simplify import simplify_expression  # noqa: E402


def test_expired_deadline_starts_no_proof():
    a, b = parse("x * (y + 1)", 32), parse("x * y + x", 32)
    assert check(a, b, deadline=Deadline.after(0)) == Check(Verdict.TESTED, "sampling", "proof budget exhausted")


def test_expired_deadline_stops_planning():
    outcome = simplify_expression(parse("(x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)", 32), [], [LinearMBABackend()],
                                  deadline=Deadline.after(0))
    assert outcome.rewrite is None and outcome.skipped == "budget exhausted"


def test_slow_backend_is_cut_off_by_the_deadline():
    class Slow:
        name = "slow"
        calls = 0

        def simplify(self, e, deadline=None):
            Slow.calls += 1
            time.sleep(0.05)
            return None

    start = time.monotonic()
    simplify_expression(parse("((x ^ y) + 2 * (x & y)) * ((x | y) - (x & y)) + (x ^ (y & z))", 32), [], [Slow()],
                        deadline=Deadline.after(0.12))
    assert time.monotonic() - start < 0.12 + 0.05 + 0.05  # one call (0.05 s) past the deadline, plus scheduling


def test_cobra_lock_wait_respects_the_deadline(monkeypatch):
    import d810_cobra

    class FakeBinding:
        limits = []

        @staticmethod
        def simplify_budgeted(signature, names, bitwidth, tree, max_vars, time_limit_ms, size):
            FakeBinding.limits.append(time_limit_ms)
            return None, False

    monkeypatch.setattr(d810_cobra, "_cobra", FakeBinding, raising=False)
    solve = cobra_shim._python_binding()
    held = threading.Event()
    release = threading.Event()

    def hold():
        with cobra_shim._SOLVE_LOCK:
            held.set()
            release.wait(2)

    holder = threading.Thread(target=hold)
    holder.start()
    held.wait(1)
    try:
        start = time.monotonic()
        assert solve("(v0 ^ v1) + 2 * (v0 & v1)", 32, Deadline.after(0.1)) is None
        assert time.monotonic() - start < 0.1 + 0.05
        assert cobra_shim.lock_wait_seconds() >= 0.09
    finally:
        release.set()
        holder.join()
    assert solve("(v0 ^ v1) + 2 * (v0 & v1)", 32, Deadline.after(0.2)) is None
    assert FakeBinding.limits and FakeBinding.limits[-1] <= 200  # the solver's own limit is clamped


def test_allowance_stays_inside_binary_ninjas_own_analysis_limit():
    # Binary Ninja abandons a function's analysis after analysis.limits.maxFunctionAnalysisTime
    # (20 s by default): the plugin must never take the function's HLIL down with it.
    from binja_d810.binja.budget import plugin_allowance

    assert plugin_allowance(5, 20_000) == 5
    assert plugin_allowance(60, 20_000) == 10
    assert plugin_allowance(60, 0) == 60  # 0: Binary Ninja imposes no limit


def test_the_ledger_keeps_only_recent_il_objects_alive():
    # The keepalive guards a generation token (an IL object's address) between a function's MLIL
    # and HLIL passes; holding thousands of IL objects kept closed binaries' analysis in memory.
    import gc
    import weakref

    class IL:
        pass

    ledger = Ledger(capacity=4096)
    refs = []
    for i in range(1000):
        il = IL()
        refs.append(weakref.ref(il))
        ledger.begin(("view", i), "mlil", generation=id(il), keepalive=il, allowance=1.0)
        del il
    gc.collect()
    alive = sum(1 for r in refs if r() is not None)
    assert alive <= 256 and refs[-1]() is not None
```

`tests/unit/test_division.py`:

```py
"""Division and remainder in the IR: total semantics, ARM64's.

x / 0 = 0, x % 0 = x, MIN / -1 = MIN, MIN % -1 = 0; signed division rounds toward zero and the
remainder takes the dividend's sign. Lifted divisions never meet the zero or overflow cases (a trap
proof comes first); with these values narrowing is an exact identity everywhere.
"""

import itertools
import random

import pytest
import z3

from binja_d810.ir.bits import possible_ones
from binja_d810.ir.evaluate import evaluate
from binja_d810.ir.expr import DIV_OPS, BinOp, Const, UnOp, Var, is_mba, mask, to_signed, to_str
from binja_d810.ir.normalize import normalize
from binja_d810.ir.parse import parse
from binja_d810.semantic.verify import to_z3

WIDTHS = (8, 16, 32, 64)


def reference(op: str, a: int, b: int, w: int) -> int:
    m = mask(w)
    if op == "udiv":
        return 0 if b == 0 else a // b
    if op == "urem":
        return a if b == 0 else a % b
    sa, sb = to_signed(a, w), to_signed(b, w)
    if sb == 0:
        return 0 if op == "sdiv" else a
    q = abs(sa) // abs(sb) * (1 if (sa < 0) == (sb < 0) else -1)
    return q & m if op == "sdiv" else (sa - q * sb) & m


def values(w: int) -> list[int]:
    m, top = mask(w), 1 << (w - 1)
    edges = [0, 1, 2, 3, 7, m, m - 1, top, top - 1, top + 1]
    rng = random.Random(w)
    return edges + [rng.getrandbits(w) for _ in range(12)]


def test_division_ops_are_binary_ops():
    assert DIV_OPS == {"udiv", "urem", "sdiv", "srem"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        BinOp("udiv", Var("x", 32), Var("y", 16), 32)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("w", WIDTHS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("op", sorted(DIV_OPS))
def test_semantics_match_the_reference(op, w):
    for a, b in itertools.product(values(w), repeat=2):
        assert evaluate(BinOp(op, Const(a, w), Const(b, w), w), {}) == reference(op, a, b, w), (op, a, b)


def test_the_defined_cases():
    w, top = 32, 1 << 31
    assert evaluate(BinOp("udiv", Const(7, w), Const(0, w), w), {}) == 0
    assert evaluate(BinOp("urem", Const(7, w), Const(0, w), w), {}) == 7
    assert evaluate(BinOp("sdiv", Const(top, w), Const(mask(w), w), w), {}) == top  # MIN / -1 = MIN
    assert evaluate(BinOp("srem", Const(top, w), Const(mask(w), w), w), {}) == 0
    assert evaluate(BinOp("sdiv", Const(-7 & mask(w), w), Const(2, w), w), {}) == -3 & mask(w)  # toward zero
    assert evaluate(BinOp("srem", Const(-7 & mask(w), w), Const(2, w), w), {}) == -1 & mask(w)  # dividend's sign


@pytest.mark.parametrize("w", WIDTHS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("op", sorted(DIV_OPS))
def test_z3_agrees_with_evaluation(op, w):
    ctx = z3.Context()
    for a, b in itertools.product(values(w)[:12], repeat=2):
        e = BinOp(op, Const(a, w), Const(b, w), w)
        got = z3.simplify(to_z3(e, {}, ctx)).as_long()
        assert got == evaluate(e, {}), (op, a, b)


def test_z3_agrees_on_variables():
    # Not only on constants: the solver's view of x / 0 and MIN / -1 is the evaluator's.
    ctx = z3.Context()
    x, y = Var("x", 16), Var("y", 16)
    zv = {"x": z3.BitVec("x", 16, ctx), "y": z3.BitVec("y", 16, ctx)}
    for op in sorted(DIV_OPS):
        e = BinOp(op, x, y, 16)
        for a, b in [(5, 0), (0x8000, 0xffff), (0xfff9, 2), (9, 4)]:
            s = z3.Solver(ctx=ctx)
            s.add(zv["x"] == a, zv["y"] == b, to_z3(e, zv, ctx) != evaluate(e, {"x": a, "y": b}))
            assert s.check() == z3.unsat, (op, a, b)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("op,ext", [("udiv", "zx"), ("urem", "zx"), ("sdiv", "sx"), ("srem", "sx")])
def test_narrowing_is_exact_at_every_value(op, ext):
    x, y = Var("x", 8), Var("y", 8)
    wide = UnOp("trunc", BinOp(op, UnOp(ext, x, 16), UnOp(ext, y, 16), 16), 8)
    narrow = BinOp(op, x, y, 8)
    assert normalize(wide) == narrow
    for a, b in itertools.product(range(256), repeat=2):
        env = {"x": a, "y": b}
        assert evaluate(wide, env) == evaluate(narrow, env), (op, a, b)


def test_narrowing_takes_a_constant_that_fits():
    x = Var("x", 32)
    wide = UnOp("trunc", BinOp("udiv", UnOp("zx", x, 64), Const(7, 64), 64), 32)
    assert normalize(wide) == BinOp("udiv", x, Const(7, 32), 32)
    signed = UnOp("trunc", BinOp("sdiv", UnOp("sx", x, 64), Const(-7 & mask(64), 64), 64), 32)
    assert normalize(signed) == BinOp("sdiv", x, Const(-7 & mask(32), 32), 32)
    # 2**32 does not fit: the quotient is not the narrow one.
    big = UnOp("trunc", BinOp("udiv", UnOp("zx", x, 64), Const(1 << 32, 64), 64), 32)
    assert normalize(big) != BinOp("udiv", x, Const(0, 32), 32)


def test_known_bits_bound_unsigned_division_and_remainder():
    y = Var("y", 32)
    assert possible_ones(BinOp("udiv", Const(2, 32), y, 32)) == 3  # 2 / y is 0, 1 or 2
    low = BinOp("and", Var("x", 8), Const(0x0F, 8), 8)
    for op in ("udiv", "urem"):
        e = BinOp(op, low, Var("y", 8), 8)
        bound = possible_ones(e)
        assert bound == 0x0F
        for a, b in itertools.product(range(256), repeat=2):
            assert evaluate(e, {"x": a, "y": b}) & ~bound == 0
    assert possible_ones(BinOp("sdiv", Const(2, 8), Var("y", 8), 8)) == 0xFF


def test_printing_and_parsing_round_trip():
    e = BinOp("udiv", Const(2, 32), BinOp("add", BinOp("mul", Var("x", 32), Var("x", 32), 32), Const(1, 32), 32), 32)
    text = to_str(e)
    assert text == "udiv(2, ((x * x) + 1))"
    assert parse(text, 32, {"x": 32}) == e
    for op in sorted(DIV_OPS):
        assert parse(f"{op}(x, y)", 32, {"x": 32, "y": 32}) == BinOp(op, Var("x", 32), Var("y", 32), 32)


def test_division_is_neither_arithmetic_nor_bitwise_for_mba():
    # A quotient of a bitwise value is not something Tier 2 rewrites (as rotates).
    e = BinOp("udiv", BinOp("and", Var("x", 32), Var("y", 32), 32), Const(3, 32), 32)
    assert not is_mba(e)
```

`tests/unit/test_effects_policy.py`:

```py
"""Effect policy tables, tested on stand-in IL nodes: no Binary Ninja needed."""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import pytest

from binja_d810.binja import effects


@dataclass
class Op:
    name: str


@dataclass
class Node:
    """Duck-types the parts of a Binary Ninja IL instruction the policy reads."""

    op: str
    operands: list = field(default_factory=list)

    @property
    def operation(self):
        return Op(self.op)


def var():
    return Node("MLIL_VAR_SSA", ["ssa-var"])


def const():
    return Node("MLIL_CONST", [7])


@pytest.mark.parametrize("op", ["MLIL_LOAD_SSA", "MLIL_LOAD_STRUCT_SSA", "MLIL_VAR_ALIASED", "MLIL_VAR_ALIASED_FIELD",
                                "MLIL_CALL_SSA", "MLIL_INTRINSIC_SSA", "MLIL_DIVU", "MLIL_MODS", "MLIL_UNDEF",
                                "MLIL_UNIMPL_MEM", "MLIL_FADD", "MLIL_SOMETHING_NEW"])
def test_effectful_or_unknown_operations_are_rejected(op):
    tree = Node("MLIL_ADD", [var(), Node(op, [var()])])
    assert effects.mlil_effect(tree) == f"effect: {op}"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("op", ["MLIL_VAR_SSA_FIELD", "MLIL_ADDRESS_OF", "MLIL_CMP_E", "MLIL_BOOL_TO_INT", "MLIL_ROL",
                                "MLIL_POPCNT", "MLIL_BSWAP", "MLIL_ADC", "MLIL_SBB", "MLIL_CONST_PTR", "MLIL_IMPORT"])
def test_pure_operations_are_safe_to_reevaluate(op):
    tree = Node("MLIL_XOR", [var(), Node(op, [var(), const()])])
    assert effects.mlil_effect(tree) is None


def test_effects_are_found_at_any_depth():
    deep = Node("MLIL_ADD", [var(), Node("MLIL_ROL", [Node("MLIL_NOT", [Node("MLIL_LOAD_SSA", [var()])]), const()])])
    assert effects.mlil_effect(deep) == "effect: MLIL_LOAD_SSA"


def test_lists_of_operands_are_searched():
    assert effects.mlil_effect(Node("MLIL_ADD", [[var(), Node("MLIL_CALL_SSA")], const()])) == "effect: MLIL_CALL_SSA"


def hvar(name="x"):
    return Node("HLIL_VAR", [name]) if False else _HVar(name)


class _HVar(Node):
    def __init__(self, name):
        super().__init__("HLIL_VAR", [])
        self.var = name


def test_hlil_reads_of_plain_variables_are_candidates():
    tree = Node("HLIL_ADD", [Node("HLIL_XOR", [_HVar("x"), _HVar("y")]), Node("HLIL_CONST", [3])])
    assert effects.hlil_effect(tree) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("op", ["HLIL_DEREF", "HLIL_CALL", "HLIL_ARRAY_INDEX", "HLIL_DIVU", "HLIL_INTRINSIC", "HLIL_NEW_THING"])
def test_hlil_effects_bound_candidates(op):
    assert effects.hlil_effect(Node("HLIL_ADD", [_HVar("x"), Node(op, [_HVar("y")])])) == f"effect: {op}"


def test_hlil_pure_unsupported_operations_bound_candidates_too():
    assert effects.hlil_effect(Node("HLIL_ADD", [_HVar("x"), Node("HLIL_POPCNT", [_HVar("y")])])) == "unsupported: HLIL_POPCNT"


def test_hlil_aliased_variable_reads_are_effects():
    assert effects.hlil_effect(Node("HLIL_XOR", [_HVar("x_1"), _HVar("y")]), aliased=frozenset({"x_1"})) == \
        "effect: aliased read"
```
